kṛtvoṅkāreṇa doṣāṃstu hanyātkāyādisambhavān | | 7
vāyavyāgneyamāhendravāruṇībhiryathākramam |
kilviṣaṃ vāruṇādbhiśca hanyātsiddhyarthamātmanaḥ | | 8
śoṣaṇaṃ dahanaṃ stambhaṃ plāvanaṃ ca yathākramāt |
vāyvagnīndrajanākhyābhirdhāraṇābhiḥ kṛte sati | | 9
dhyātvā viśuddhamātmānaṃ praṇamedarkamāsthitam |
dehaṃ tenaiva sañcintya pañcabhūtamayaṃ param | | 1.49.10
sūkṣmaṃ sthūlaṃ tathākṣāṇi svasthāneṣu prakamya ca |
vinyasyāṅgāni khādīni hṛdādyāni hṛdyādiṣu | | 11
khasvāhā hadayaṃ bhānoḥ khamarkāya śirastathā |
ulkā svāhā śikhārkasya yai ca huṃ kavacaṃ param | |
khāṃ phaḍastraṃ ca saṃhārāścāditaḥ praṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ | | 12
sa pūrve praṇavasyātho mantrakarmaprasiddhaye |
ebhirjalaṃ tridhā japtvā snānadravyāṇi tena ca | | 13
tato mūrtiṣu sarvāsu rātrāvagnau prapūjayet | | 14
prākpaścimodagabhyagrāṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ niśāsu vai |
saptākṣareṇa tanmantraṃ dhyātvā ca padmakarṇikām | | 15
ādityamaṇḍalāntasthaṃ tatra dehaṃ prakalpayet |
prabhāmaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ dhyātvā dehaṃ yathā purā | |
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalam | | 16
raktairgandhaiśca puṣpaiśca carubhirbalibhistathā |
raktacandanamiśrairvā vastrairāvaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | | 17
āvāhanādikarmāṇi rakṣāṃ tu hṛdayena ca |
taccittaśca sadā kuryājjñātvā karmakramaṃ budhaḥ | | 18
kṛtvā cāvāhanaṃ mantrairekatra sthāpanaṃ tataḥ |
yāvadyāgāvasānaṃ tu sānnidhyaṃ tatra kalpya ca | | 19
dattvā pādyādikāṃ pūjāṃ śaktyā vārghyaṃ nivedya ca |
japitvā vidhivaddhyātvā tato devīṃ visarjayet | | 1.49.20
eṣa karma kramaḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ yajanakramāt |
pravakṣyāmi japasthānaṃ padmeśāvaraṇe tathā | | 21
ādityaṃ karṇikāsaṃsthaṃ daleṣvaṅgāni pūrvaśaḥ |
somādīnrāhuparyaṃtāngrahāṃścaivodagāditaḥ | | 22
mūrtimallokapālāṃśca kramādāvaraṇeṣvatha |
tadastrāṇi ca rakṣārthaṃ svamantraiḥ pūjayetkramāt | | 23
praṇavaiścābhidhānaiśca caturthyāṃ hyabhiyojitaiḥ |
sarveṣāṃ kathitā mantrā mudrāśca kathayāmyataḥ | | 24
vyomamudrā ratiḥ padmā mahāśvetāstrameva ca |
uttānau tu karau kṛtyā aṅgulyo grathitāḥ kramāt |
tarjanīṃ yanti yāvattāḥ same vādhomukhe sthite | | 26
tarjanyo 1 madhyamasyaiva jyeṣṭhāgre vānugopari |
mudreyaṃ sarvamudrāṇāṃ vyoma mudreti kīrtitā | |
sarvakarmasu yogo.ayaṃ tathā sthānaṃ prakalpate | | 27
padmavatprasṛtāḥ sarvā mahāśvetā raveḥ smṛtā |
javasaṃnihito nityaṃ rathārūḍho raviḥ smṛtaḥ | | 28
hastāvūrdhvamukhau kṛtvā vāmāṅguṣṭhena yojitau |
dravyāṇāṃ śodhane yojyā rakṣārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | | 29
anayā mudrayā sarvaṃ rakṣitaṃ śodhitaṃ bhavet |
arghyaṃ datvā prayoktavyā pūjānte ca viśeṣataḥ | | 1.49.30
japadhyānāvasāne ca yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ |
anena vidhinā nityaṃ japedabdamatandritaḥ | | 31
sa labhetepsitānkāmānihāmutra na saṃśayaḥ |
rogārto mucyate rogāddhanahīno dhanaṃ labhet | | 32
rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyamaputraḥ putramāpnuyāt |
prajñāmedhāsamṛddhīśca ciraṃ jīvati mānavaḥ | |
surūpāṃ labhate kanyāṃ kulīnā puruṣo dhruvam | | 33
saubhāgyaṃ strī kulīnāpi kanyā ca puruṣottamam |
avidyo labhate vidyāmityuktaṃ bhānunā purā | | 34
nityayāgaḥ smṛto hyeṣa dhanadhānyasukhāvahaḥ |
prajāpaśuvivṛddhiśca niṣkāmasyāpi jāyate | | 35
tadaikaḥ stūyate svarge śabdyate ca narottamaḥ |
bhaktyā taṃ pūjayedyastu naraḥ puṇyataraḥ sadā | | 36
iha vai kāmikaṃ prāpya tato gacchenmanoḥ padam |
dvijastasya prasādena tejasā budhasannibhaḥ | | 37
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe

saptamīmāhātmyavarṇanam
vāsudeva uvāca
naimittikaṃ tato vakṣye yajjñātvā ca samāsataḥ |
saptamyāṃ grahaṇe caiva saṃkrāntiṣu viśeṣataḥ | | 1

śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ havirbhuktvaikadā divā |
samyagācamya sandhyāyāṃ vāruṇaṃ praṇipatya ca | | 2

indriyāṇi ca saṃyamya kṛtaṃ dhyātvā svapedadhaḥ |
darbhaśayyāgato rātrau prātaḥ snātaḥ susaṃyataḥ | | 3

tataḥ sandhyāmupāsyātha pūrvoktaṃ ca manuṃ japet |
juhuyācca tadā vahniṃ sūryāgnī parikalpya ca | |4

sūryāgnikaraṇaṃ vakṣye tarpaṇaṃ ca samāsataḥ |
arcanāgāramullikhya praviśyārcya janairjanam | | 5

prakṣipyāstīrya darbhaśca pātrādyālabhya ca kramāt |
pavitraṃ dvikuśaṃ kṛtvā sāgraṃ prādeśasammitam | | 6
tena pātrāṇi samprokṣya saṃśodhyādha vilokya ca |
udagagre sthite pātre prajvālyātholmukena ca | | 7

paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tathājyotyavanaṃ tridhā |
parimṛjya sruvādīṃśra darbhaiḥ samprokṣayettataḥ | | 8

juhuyātprokṣya tānvahnau tatrārkaṃ pūrvavad vrajet |
abhūmau sthitapātreṇa viṣṭareṇa tu pāṇinā | |

dānena yaduśārdūla nāntarikṣe sthale kvacit | | 9

dakṣiṇena sruvaṃ gṛhya juhuyātpāvakaṃ budhaḥ |
hadayena kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kartavyāḥ pūrvacoditāḥ | | 1.50.10

arkādāramya saṃjñārthaṃ dadyāttūṣṇīṃ hutiṃ sthitaḥ |
varuṇāya śatairmāghe saptamyāṃ varuṇaṃ yajet | | 11
yathāśaktyā tu viprebhyaḥ pradadyātkhaṇḍaveṣṭakān |
dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā prāpnoti yācitaṃ phalam | | 12

evaṃ vai phālgune sūryaṃ caitre vaiśākha eva ca |
vaiśākhe māsi dhātāramindraṃ jyeṣṭhe yajedravim | | 13

tathāśvayuji parjanyaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ kārtike yajet | | 14

mārgaśīrṣe ca mitraṃ ca pauṣe viṣṇuṃ yajedyadi |
saṃvatsareṇa yatproktaṃ phalamiṣṭaṃ dine dine | |

tatsarvamāpnuyāt kṣipraṃ bhaktyā śraddhānvito vratī | | 15

evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kṛtvā vai kāñcanaṃ ratham |
saptabhirvājibhiryuktaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam | | 16

ādityapratimāṃ madhye śuddhahemnā kṛtāṃ śubhām |
ratnairalaṅkṛtāṃ kṛtvā hemapadmoparisthitām | | 17
tasmin rathavare kṛtvā sārathiṃ cāgrataḥ sthitam |
vṛtaṃ dvādaśabhirvipraiḥ kramānmāsādhipātmabhiḥ | | 18

madhye kṛtvā svamācāryaṃ pūjayitvā yathāśrutiḥ |
sañcintyādityavarṇaṃ vai vastraratnādinārhayet | | 19

evaṃ māsādhipānviprānsampūjyātha nivedayet |
ācāryāya rathaṃ chatraṃ grāmaṃ gāśca mahīṃ śubhām | | 1.50.20

aśvānmāsādhipebhyastu dvādaśabhyo nivedayet |
evaṃ bhaktyā yathāśaktyā hemaratnādibhūṣaṇam | | 21

dattvā tasya namaskṛtya vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ nivedayet |
ata ūrdhvaṃ na doṣo.atra vratasyākaraṇeṣvapi || 22

evamastviti viprendraiḥ sahācāryaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
bahvīścaivāśiṣo dattvā pravadetprīyatāmiti | | 23

ādityo yena kāmena tvayā ārādhito vrataiḥ |
tubhyaṃ dadātu taṃ kāmaṃ sampūrṇaṃ bhavatu vratam | | 24

ācāryānviprarūpaistu praviṣṭo bhāskaraḥ svayam |
dāsyatyeva paraṃ kartumityuktaṃ bhānunā svayam | | 25

viprebhyo guṇavadbhyaśca nisvebhyaśca viśeṣataḥ |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca śaktyā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām | |
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca vratametatsamāpayet | | 26

puruṣaḥ strī bhavedrājñāṃ tādṛśāmatha vallabhā | | 27

niṣpannamaṇḍalaṃ bhuṅkte sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ sukhī | | 28

vittahīno.api yo 1 bhaktyā kṛttvā tāmramayaṃ ratham |
dadyādvratāvasāne tu kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathoditam | |
so.aśītiyojanaṃ bhuṅkte vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ nṛpaḥ | | 29
evaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ yo.api vittahīnaḥ karoti nā |
āṣaṣṭiyojanaṃ bhuṅkte dīrghāyurnīrujaḥ sukhī | |
sūryaloke ca kalpāntaṃ yāvatsthitvedamāpnuyāt | | 1.50.30

manasāpi ca yo bhaktyā yajedarkamatandritaḥ |
sarvāvasthāsu so.apyatra vyādhibhirmucyate bhṛśam | | 31

āpado na spṛśantyenaṃ nīhārā iva bhāskaram |
kiṃ punarvratasampannaṃ bhaktaṃ 1 mantraiśca rakṣitam | | 32

yata evaṃ tato jñātvā vidhānaṃ kalpacoditam |
sukhena phalasiddhyarthaṃ kuryātsarvamaśeṣataḥ | | 33

ityetatkathitaṃ sāmba purā sūryeṇa me śubham |
kalpo.ayaṃ prathame kalpe sarvadā gopito mayā | | 34

anena vidhinā vatsa viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
bhānumārādhayetkṣipraṃ yadīcchetphalamuttamam | | 35

mayāsyaiva prasādena prāptāḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
asurā nirjitāścaiva surāḥ sarve vaśīkṛtāḥ | | 36

tvayāpyayaṃ gopitavyaḥ kalpaḥ sūryasya sammataḥ |
prasādādasya kalpasya sadā sannihito raviḥ | |

cakre.asminnirjitā yena surā suranaroragāḥ | | 37

yadinādhiṣṭhitaṃ cakramidaṃ sūryāṃśubhiḥ svayam |
satataṃ syātprabhāyuktaṃ kathamadhyāhataṃ bhavet | | 38

ahametaṃ japannityaṃ yajandhyāyaṃśca śaktitaḥ |
jāto.asmi sarvakāmānāṃ pūjyaḥ śreṣṭhaśca tejasā | 39

tvamabhyasyaiva manasā vācā vā karmaṇāpi vā |
kuru bhaktimanenaiva vidhinā phalasiddhaye | | 1.50.40

vidhānamāditaḥ putra saptamīṃ kurute ca yaḥ | | 41
seha 1 prāpyā.akhilaṃ kāmamārogyaṃ ca jayaṃ tathā |
bhārgavyā parayā yukto gacchedvairocanaṃ sadaḥ | | 42

iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe

mahāsaptamīvratavarṇanam
vāsudeva uvāca
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ matkulodvaha |
ekabhaktaṃ sadākhyātaṃ ṣaṣṭyāṃ naktamudāhṛtam | | 1
saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kecidicchanti suvrata |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kecidvadantīha saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kila | | 2
kṛtopavāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pūjayedbhāskaraṃ budhaḥ |
raktacandanamiśraistu karavīraiśca suvrata | | 3
guggulena mahābāho saṃyāvena ca suvrata |
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ 2 bhāskaraṃ ravim | | 4
evaṃ hi caturo māsānmāghādīnpūjayedravim |
ātmanaścāpi śudhyarthaṃ prāśanaṃ gomayasya ca | | 5
snānaṃ ca gomayeneha kartavyaṃ cātmaśuddhaye |
brāhmaṇāndivyabhaumāṃśca bhojayeccāpi śaktitaḥ | | 6
jyeṣṭhādiṣvatha māseṣu śvetacandanamucyate |
śvetāni cāpi puṣpāṇi śubhagandhānvitāni vai | | 7
kṛṣṇāgarustathā dhūpo naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ smṛtam |
tenaiva brāhmaṇāṃstuṣṭānbhojayecca mahāmate | | 8
prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ tu snānaṃ tenaiva putraka |
kārtikādiṣu māseṣu agastikusumaiḥ smṛtam | | 9
pūjayennaraśārdūla dhūpaiścaivāparājitaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ guḍapūpāstu tathā cekṣurasaṃ smṛtam | | 1.51.10
tenaiva brāhmaṇāṃstāta bhojayasva svaśaktitaḥ |
kuśodakaṃ prāśayethāḥ snānaṃ ca kuru śuddhaye | | 11
tṛtīye pāraṇāsyānte māghe māsi mahāmate |
devadevasya pūjā ca kartavyā śaktito budhaiḥ |
rathasya cāpi dānaṃ tu rathayātrā tu suvrata | | 13
vratasya prāptihetorvai kartavyā vibhave sati |
dānaṃ svarṇarathasyeha yathoktaṃ vibhave sati | |
ityeṣā kathitā putra rathāhvā saptamī śubhā | | 14
mahāsaptamī vikhyātā mahāpuṇyā mahodayā |
yāmupoṣya dhanaṃ putrānkīrtiṃ vidyāmavāpnuyāt | | 15
tathākhilaṃ kuvalayaṃ candreṇa ca samorciṣā | | 16
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe
sūryapūjāvarṇanam
sumanturuvāca
antardhānaṃ gato vīraṃ śāmbasyeha prapaśyataḥ | | 1
śāmbo.api kṛtvā vidhivatsaptamīṃ rathasaptamīm |
ādhi(di?)bhirvyādhibhirmukto jagāmāśu svamandiram | | 2
śatānīka uvāca
keneha martyalokeṣu rathayātrā pravartitā | | 3
sumanturuvāca
rudreṇa kuruśārdūla āsīnaḥ kāñcane girau | | 4
padmāsanaṃ padmayoniṃ sukhāsīnaṃ prajāpatim |
praṇamya śirasā devo rudro vācamudairayat | | 5
śrīrudra uvāca
ya eṣa bhagavāndevo bhāskaro lokabhāskaraḥ |
kathameṣa bhrameddevo rathastho vimalaḥ sadā | | 6
brahmovāca
yathā divi bhramettāta rathārūḍho raviḥ sadā |
tathā te vartayiṣye.ahaṃ rathaṃ cāsya trilocana | | 7
hiraṇyamayena kāntena aṣṭabandhaikaneminā | | 8
cakreṇa bhāsvatā caiva divi sūryaḥ prasarpati |
daśayojanasāhasro vistāro.apyasya kathyate | | 9
yugamasya tu vistīrṇamaruṇo yatra sārathiḥ | | 1.52.10
prāsaṅgaḥ kācano divyo yuktaḥ pavanagairhayaiḥ |
chandobhirvājirūpaistu yataścakraṃ tataḥ sthitaiḥ | | 11
yenāsau paryaṭedvyomni bhāsvatā tu divaspatiḥ |
athaitāni tu sūryasya pratyaṅgāni rathasya tu | | 12
saṃvatsarasyāvayavaiḥ kalpitāni yathākramam |
nābhyastisrastu cakrasya trayaḥ kālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | | 13
rathavedī smṛte tasya ayane dakṣiṇottare | | 14
rātrirvarūtho dharmo.asya dhvaja ūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | | 16
cakramakṣanibaddhaṃ tu dhruve cākṣaḥ samarpitaḥ |
sahacakro bhramatyakṣaḥ sa cākṣo bhramati dhruve | | 19
akṣaḥ sahaiva cakreṇa bhramate.asau dhruve sthitaḥ |
evamakṣavaśāttasya 3 sanniveśo rathasya tu | | 1.52.20
tathā saṃyogabhāvena saṃsiddho bhāskaro rathaḥ |
tena cāsau ravirdevo nabhaḥ saṃsarpate sadā | | 21
yugākṣakoṭīsambaddhe dve raśmī syandanasya tu |
dhruve te bhramato raśmī na cakrayugayostu vai | | 22
bhramato maṇḍalānyasya raverasya rathasya tu |
kulālacakravadyāti maṇḍalaṃ sarvatodiśam | | 23
ṛgyajurbhyāṃ gṛhītena vicakrāśvena vai dhruve | | 24
yugākṣakoṭī te tasya bhramete syandanasya tu |
saktāsaktaṃ ca bhramate maṇḍalaṃ sarvatodiśam | | 26
ākṛṣyete dhruveṇeha samaṃ tiṣṭhati suvrata |
dhruveṇa mucyamāne tu punā raśmiyugena vai |
saratho.adhiṣṭhito devairvibhramedṛṣibhiḥ saha | | 29
gandharvairapsarobhiśca sarpagrāmaṇirākṣasaiḥ |
etairvasati vai sūrye māsau dvau dvau krameṇa tu | | 1.52.30
khaṇḍako vāsukiścaiva sakarṇo raśmireva ca | | 31
tumbururnāradaścaiva gandharvau gāyatāṃ varau |
kratusthalāpsaraścaiva yā ca sā puñjikasthalā | | 32
madhumādhavayoreṣa gaṇo vasati bhāskare |
menakā sahajanyā ca gaṃdharvo ca hahā hūhūḥ | | 35
rathasvanaśca grāmaṇyau rathacitraśca tāvubhau |
pauruṣeyo vadhaścaiva yātudhānau mahābalau | | 36
śuciśukrau tu dvau māsau vasantyete divākare |
pramlocā dundukāścaiva gandharvau bhānudardurau | | 38
ete nabho nabhasyau ca nivasanti divākare | | 39
citrasenaśca gandharvastathā vasuruciśca yaḥ |
vasantyete tu vai sūrye iṣorjau kālaparyayāt | | 43
hemaṃtikau tu dvau māsau vasantyete divākare |
sahe caiva sahasye ca vasantyete divākare |.| 46
tilottamā ca rambhā ca sarvaloke ca viśrute | | 48
brahmopetaśca vai rakṣo yajño yajñastathaiva ca | |
ete tapastapasyai ca nivasanti divākare | | 49
anye.api ye mandehā rākṣasādhipatayo devadevaguhyatamasya rakṣārthaṃ sakala devairasmadādibhiḥ
sanniyuktāstānbhavate kathayāmi | | 1.52.50
rudra uvāca
vada brahmankathāṃ divyāṃ yāmahaṃ praṣṭumāgataḥ |
tāmeva vistareṇaiva kathayāśu mama prabho | | 51
diviṣṭhaṃ bhāskaraṃ dṛṣṭvā nametkena vidhānataḥ |
kiṃ phalaṃ tasya vā deva samāpte bhavati karmaṇi | | 52
brahmovāca
śṛṇu rudra samāsena bhāskarasya natikriyām |
yāṃ kṛtvā rogaduḥkhārtā mucyante pāpasañcayāt | | 53
sadyo gomayalipte ca tatraivāvāhayedravim | | 54
pūjayitvā gaṇeśādīnvāsudevaṃ ca sātyakim |
satyabhāmāṃ tathā lakṣmīmumāṃ devīṃ ca śaṅkaram | | 55
maṇḍalasya samīpasthānpūrvoktānvedamantravit |
śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ lakṣaṃ vā nijapāpataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā śaktiṃ praṇamyātha sadā saṃyatamānasaḥ | | 57
raktike ca hiraṇyasya śatamātre sahasrake | | 58
māṣakāṇāṃ catuṣkaṃ cāyutaṃ daśaguṇaṃ diśet |

devadevasya vai yātrāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā hara | | 4
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu yaḥ kṛtvā rathamārohitaṃ ravim |
tṛtīyāyāmaikabhaktaṃ caturthyāṃ naktamucyate |
pañcamyāmayācitaṃ syātṣaṣṭhyāṃ caivamupoṣaṇam | | 6
saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāddṛṣṭvā devaṃ rathe sthitam |
pūjayitvā ca vidhinā śaktyā bhaktyā trilocana | | 7
sauvarṇaṃ tu rathaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātropari sthitam |
rathamadhye nyasedvyoma pūjitaṃ maṇibhirhara | | 8
padmarāgaṃ nyasenmadhye mauktikaṃ pūrvato nyaset |
iṃdranīlamatho yāmyāṃ vāruṇyāṃ marakataṃ hara | | 9
pravālamuttare rudra savajraṃ vinyased budhaḥ |
śvetaṃ pītāsitaṃ cāpi raktaṃ cāndhakasūdana | | 1.59.10
etāni tāta vastrāṇi dikṣu sarvāsu vinyaset |
puṣpairdāmairalaṃkṛtya rathaṃ rudra samantataḥ |
bhojayitvātha vā viprānācāryāya nivedayet |
yo.adhīte saptamīkalpaṃ sopākhyānaṃ ca bhārata | | 13
ācāryaḥ sa dvijo jñeyo varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ |
saurāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śaivānāṃ pārvatīpriya | | 14
alābhe tu suvarṇasya rathaṃ rājatamādiśet |
tadalābhe tāmramayaṃ rathaṃ vyoma ca kārayet | | 15
abhāve cāpi tāmrasya rathaḥ piṣṭamayaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sahiraṇyo mahādeva tāmrabhājanamāśritaḥ | | 16
kauśeyayugmasahitaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
pūrvoktāya mahādeva vācakāya mahātmane | | 17
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ gubhagandhādhivāsitam |
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā rathāhvā saptamī hara |
kathitā te mayā rudra mahatīyaṃ prakīrtitā | | 19
snānaṃ dānamatho homaḥ pūjā grahapaterhara |
śatasāhasraṃ bhavedasyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhūdharavidyate | | 1.59.20
evameṣā puṇyatamā māghe proktā tu saptamī |
yāmupoṣya naro bhaktyā sūryasyānucaro bhavet | | 21
brāhmaṇo yāti devatvaṃ kṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet |
vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ yāti śūdro vaiśyatvameti ca | | 22
vidyāvinayasampannaṃ bharttāraṃ 3 kanyakā labhet |
aputrā strī sutaṃ vindetsaumāgyaṃ ca gaṇādhipa | | 23
vidhavā cāpyupoṣyemāṃ saptamīṃ tripurāntaka |
nānyajanmasu vaidhavyaṃ prāpnuyātpārvatīpriya | | 24
bahuputrā bahudhanā patyurvallabhatāṃ vrajet |
yāvadvai sapta janmāni striyastu puruṣāstathā | | 25
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate brahmahatyayā | | 26
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārdhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe

rathayātrāvarṇanam
sumanturuvāca
ityuktvā sa jagāmāśu surajyeṣṭhaṃ trilocanam |
rathayātrā mahābāho sūryasyetyamitaujasaḥ | | 1
śatānīka uvāca
tuṣṭyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu annamāpuścaturvidham | | 2
devarṣisiddhamanujaiḥ stutasya hi dinedine | | 2
kaḥ stotumīśastamajaṃ yasyaitatsacarācaram |
avyayasyāprameyasya vibudhyetodayājjagat | | 4
karābhyāṃ yasya deveśau kaviṣṇū lokapūjitau |
utpannau dvijaśārdūla lalāṭāttripurāntakaḥ | | 5
so.ahamicchāmi devasya tasya sarvātmanā dvija | | 6
kenopāyena mantrairvā rahasyaiḥ paricaryayā | | 7
dānairvṛtopavāsairvā homairjāpyairathāpi vā |
saikā vidyā hi vidyānāṃ yayā tuṣyati sarvakṛt |
śrutānāmapi tatpuṇyaṃ yatra bhānoḥ prakīrtanam | | 9
ekaḥ śreṣṭhatamo maṃtrastadekaṃ paramaṃ vratam | | 1.60.10
upoṣitaṃ ca tacchreṣṭhaṃ yena bhānuḥ prasīdati |
sā caikā rasanā dhanyā mārtaṇḍaṃ stauti yā sadā | | 11
tadekaṃ nirmalaṃ cittaṃ yadgataṃ satataṃ ravau |
ślāghyānāmapi tau ślāghyāviha loke paratra ca | | 12
yo sadā dvijaśārdūla bhānoḥ pūjākarau karau |
tadekaṃ kevalaṃ dhanyaṃ śarīraṃ sarvajantuṣu | | 13
yadeva pulakodbhāsi bhānornāmānukīrtane |
atha vā sāparo rogo yā na vakti raverguṇam |
navadvārāṇi santyasminpure puruṣasattama | | 15
prākāraistvāvṛte viṣvagvṛthā tāni vidurbudhāḥ |
dattvāvadhānaṃ yacchabde vinaiva ravisaṃstutim | | 16
janmanyaviphalā sevā kṛtā yāśritya bhāskaram | | 17
eko bhānunamaskāraḥ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ | | 18
ratnānāmākaro meruḥ sarvāścaryamayaṃ nabhaḥ |
tīrthānāmāśrayo gaṃgā devānāmāśrayo raviḥ | | 19
evamādiguṇo bhogo bhānoramitatejasaḥ |
so.ahamicchāmi taṃ devaṃ saptalokaparāyaṇam |
divākaramaśeṣasya jagato hṛdyavasthitam | | 21
ārādhayitumīśeśaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāmitaujasam |
mārtaṇḍaṃ bhuvanādhāraṃ smṛtamātrāghadāriṇam | | 22
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi
saptamīkalpe sūryaparicaryāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo.adhyāyaḥ | 60 |

sūrya-mahimāvarṇanam
sumanturuvāca
tamekamakṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ sadasatormahat |
bhedābhedasvarūpasthaṃ praṇipatya raviṃ nṛpa | | 1
ṛṣīṇāṃ kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ taṃ nibodha narādhipa | | 2
ārādhanāya saviturmahātmā padmasaṃbhavaḥ |
samastavṛttisaṃrodhātkaivalyapratipādakam |
tadā jagatpatirbrahmā praṇipatya maharṣibhiḥ | |4
sarvaiḥ kilokto bhagavānātmayoniḥ prajāhitam |
yoyaṃ yogo bhagavatā prokto vṛttinirodhajaḥ | | 5
prāptuṃ śakyaḥ sa tvanekairjanmabhirjagataḥ pate |
na yogayogyaṃ bhavati mana ebhiranirjitaiḥ |
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kimu prāpte kalau yuge |
bhagavaṃstvāmupāsīnānprasanno vaktumarhasi | | 9
anāyāsena yenaiva uttarema bhavārṇavam |
uttarema bhavāmbhodhiṃ tathā tvamanuciṃtaya |
aparicchedyamāhātmyamārādhayata bhāskaram | tanniṣṭhāstadgatadhiyastatkarmāṇastadāśrayāḥ | | 15
taddṛṣṭayastanmanasaḥ sarvasmintsa iti sthitāḥ |
samastānyatha karmāṇi tatra sarvātmanātmani | | 16
etattadakṣaraṃ brahma pradhānapuruṣāvubhau | | 17
yato yasminyathā cobhau sarvayyāpinyavasthitau |
yasmādbhinnamidaṃ sarvaṃ yaccedaṃ yacca neṅgati | mokṣakāraṇamavyaktamacintyamaparigraham | |
samārādhya jagannāthaṃ kriyāyogena mucyate | | 19
yānyuktāni purā tena brahmaṇā kurunandana |
vakṣyāmi śrūyatāmadya rahasyamidamuttamam |
bhuñjaṃściṃtaya mārtaṃḍaṃ svapāṃściṃtaya bhāskaram |
evamekāgracittastvaṃ saṃśritaḥ satataṃ ravim | | 26
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe
sūryadiṇḍīsaṃvādam
sumanturuvāca
athānyaṃ sarahasyaṃ tu saṃvādaṃ vacmi te.akhilam |
śrutvā tasyārthataḥ stotraṃ tutoṣa bhagavānraviḥ |
uvāca devadevastaṃ diṇḍinaṃ gaṇanāyakam | | 3
āditya uvāca
haṃta diṇḍe prasanno.asmi bhaktyā stotreṇa te.anagha |
diṇḍiruvāca
eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yatprāpto.asi mamāntikam |
tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ svapneṣvapi ca durlabham | | 5
yathaiṣā brahmahatyā me āgatā lokagarhitā |
bhavāñjānāti sarveśo hadisthaḥ sarvadehinām | | 6
tathā ca duritaṃ sarvaṃ yaccānyallokagarhitam | | 7
yadyadicchāmyahaṃ tattatsarvamastu divaspate |
etenaivānumānena prasanno bhagavanniti | | 8
evaṃ sarvasukhāhlādamadhyastho.api hi bhānumān | | 9
tvaṃ māmagādhe saṃsāre magnamuddhartumarhasi |
tatprasādaṃ kuru vibho jagatāṃ tvaṃ jagatpate | | 11
jñānadānena yenaivamuttareyaṃ bhavārṇavam |
yogaṃ nirbījamatyantaṃ duḥkhasaṃyogabheṣajam |
śrutvā yogaṃ tu taṃ diṇḍirnirbījaṃ niṣkalaṃ babhau | | 13
praṇipatya mahātejā idaṃ vacanamabravīt |
devadeva tvayā yogo yaḥ prokto dhvāntanāśana | |
naiṣa prāpyo mayā nānyairmānavairajitendriyaiḥ | | 14
so.ahamicchāmi deveśa tvatprasādādanirjitaiḥ |
āditya uvāca
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
karttāsi kena caiva tvamevaṃ doṣānprahāsyasi | | 21
bhaktyātipraṇayasyāpi cañcalatvānmano yadi |
suvarṇarajatādyaistvaṃ śailamṛddārulekhanam |
pūjopahārairvividhaiḥ sampūjaya trilocanam | | 24
tasyāśritaṃ samāviśya sarvabhāvena sarvadā |
uparyadhastathā pārśve cintayaṃstanmayaśca vai | | 26
snānaistīrthodakairhadyaiḥ puṣpairgandhānulepanaiḥ |
yacca yacca taveṣṭaṃ vai kiñcidbhojyādikaṃ tava |
kathayā ramate ceto yadi tadbhavato mama |
śrotavyāḥ prītiyogena matsvarūpodayāḥ kathāḥ | | 1.62.30
heyāstānnikhilāndiṇḍe parityajya sukhī bhava | | 31
padamāpnoṣi mā bhaiṣīrmayyarpitamanā bhava | | 32
mayi saṃnyasya sarvaṃ tvamātmānaṃ yatnavānbhava |
madarthaṃ kuru karmāṇi mā ca dharmavyatikramam | | 33
evaṃ vyapohya hatyāstvaṃ brahmaṇa mokṣyase bhavāt |
etenaivopadeśena vyākhyātamakhilaṃ tava | | 34
kriyāyogaṃ samāsthāya madarpitamanā bhava | | 35
diṇḍiruvāca
vistareṇa samākhyāhi prasannastvaṃ hi duḥkhahā | | 36
tvāmṛte na hi tadvaktuṃ samartho.anyo jagadguro |
guhyametatpavitraṃ ca tadācakṣva prasīda me | | 37
āditya uvāca
ākhyāsyate tadakhilaṃ nirvikalpaṃ gaṇādhipa |
ityuktvāntardadhe devaḥ sarvalokapradīpakaḥ | | 38
sa ca diṇḍirmahātejā jagāmāśu nabhogatim | | 39
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi
diṇḍyādityasaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo.adhyāya | 62 |
ādityamahimāvarṇanam
sumanturuvāca
uvāca sa mahātejā diṇḍirlokeśamādarāt | | 1
devadevena bhavatādiṣṭo.asmi ca mahātmanā |
santoṣayitumīśehaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi | | 3
brahmovāca
ehyehi matsakāśaṃ ca matsamīpe gaṇādhipa |
brahmahatyā praṇaṣṭā te darśanādeva tasya tu | | 4
anugrāhyo.asi bhūteśa bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ |
ārādhanāya bhūteśa yadīśe pravaṇaṃ manaḥ | | 5
yadi devapatiṃ bhānumārādhayitumicchasi |
bhagavantamanādyantaṃ bhava dīkṣāguṇānvitaḥ | | 6
janmabhirbahubhiḥ pūtā narāstadgatacetasaḥ |
bhavanti bhagavansaurāstadā dīkṣāguṇānvitāḥ | | 8
anekajanmasaṃsāracite pāpasamuccaye |
ravau ca devadeveśe śraddhāṃ bhavati niścalā | | 12
tadā dīkṣāguṇānsarve bhajante nātra saṃśayaḥ | | 13
hastāvalambadopyeko bhaktiprīto divākaraḥ | | 14
sarvabhāgavato bhūtvā sarvapāpaharaṃ ravim |
diṇḍiruvāca
kiṃ lakṣaṇā narā dīkṣāmarhanti padmasambhava |
yacca dīkṣānvitaiḥ kāryaṃ tanme kathaya padmaja | | 16
brahmovāca
bhāvabhaktaśca mārtaṇḍe tasya dīkṣā guṇānvitā | | 17
na ca drogdhā paraṃ vāde sa mārtaṇḍaṃ samarcati | | 18
tebhyaśca nānyamātmānaṃ sa naraḥ sauratāṃ vrajet | | 19
yo na jānāti yatiṣu sa vai dīkṣāguṇānbhajet | | 21
bhāvaṃ na kurute yastu sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam |
sutapteneha tapasā yathairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ |
gaṇeśvara kṛtārthatvācchlāghyaḥ sauraḥ sa mānavaḥ | | 24
api na: sa kule dhanyo jāyate kulapāvanaḥ |
bhagavānbhaktibhāvena yena bhānurupāsitaḥ | | 25
sa naro bhānusālokyamāpnoti dhutakalmaṣaḥ | | 26
yastu devālayaṃ bhānorbhaktyā kārayati dhruvam |
prayacchati sahasrāṃśoḥ sadā prayatamānasaḥ | | 1.63.30
yajñeśo bhagavānpūṣā sadā kratubhirijyate |
na te diṇḍinnavāpyante manuṣyairalpasañcayaiḥ |
bhānordadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham | | 33
prayaccha tāni mārtaṇḍe bhavethāścaiva tanmanāḥ | | 35
ārādhya yāti taṃ devaṃ tasminneva naro layam | | 36
puṣpaistīrthodakairgandhairmadhunā sarpiṣā tathā |
kṣīreṇa snāpayedbhānuṃ graheśaṃ gopatiṃ khagam | | 37
prayāsyati gaṇaśreṣṭha nirvṛttiṃ ca vilakṣaṇām | | 38
manasaścaiva yogena ārādhaya divākaram | | 39
viṣṇuśca pālayellokāṃstamārādhya divākaram | | 1.63.40
rudraśca prāptavāndevīṃ bhavānīṃ tatprasādataḥ |
dīpyante ṛṣayaścāpi tamārādhya divākaram | | 41
sa tvamebhiḥ prakāraistamupavāsaiśca bhāskaram |
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe brahmadiṇḍisaṃvāde ādityakriyāyogavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo.adhyāyaḥ | 63 |
phalasaptamīvarṇanam
diṇḍiruvāca
yadyatkāryaṃ yathā caiva bhāskarārādhane narai |

brahmovāca
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ | | 4
tannāmajāpī tatkarmaratastadgatamānasaḥ |
niṣkāmaḥ puruṣo diṇḍe sa brahma paramāpnuyāt | | 6

saṃsāragarte paṅkasthe sugatiḥ prāpyate katham | | 8

nirvyalīkena cittena kaḥ prayāsyati sadgatim | | 9

tadārādhaya sarveśaṃ bhāskaraṃ jyotiṣāṃ patim | | 11

yadi saṃsāranirvedādabhivācchasi sadgatim |
tadārādhaya mārtaṇḍaṃ bhaktipravaṇacetasā | | 13
dūrvāṅkarairapi diṇḍe tadabhāve.arcayāryamam | | 14
puṣpapatrāmbubhirdhūpairyathāvibhavamātmanaḥ |
sa yātyuttamake sthāne sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati | | 16
dināni divi tāvanti tiṣṭhatyarkasamo naraḥ | | 17
ahanyahani yatpāpaṃ kurute gaṇanāyaka |
gocarmamātraṃ sammārjya hanti tadbhāskarālaye | | 18
so.api lokaṃ samāsādya haṃsena saha modate | | 19
upalepanakṛdyāti matpuraṃ yānamāsthitaḥ | | 1.64.20
so.api gacchati yatrāste bhagavānyādasāṃ patiḥ | | 21

anulipte naro dattvā na durgatimavāpnuyāt | | 22

vidyādharatvamaparaiḥ saṃrādhyeha divākaram | | 29
devendratvaṃ gatastasmānnānyaḥ pūjyatamaḥ kvacit | | 1.64.30

atha bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe samāgate | | 36

ayācitaṃ caturthyāṃ tu pañcamyāmekabhojanam | | 37

arcayitvā dinakaraṃ gandhadhūpanivedanaiḥ | | 38

pradhyāyanmanasā devaṃ sarvabhūtārtināśanam | | 39
vibuddhastvatha saptamyāṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam | | 1.64.40
pūjayitvā dinakaraṃ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ tāta devasya phalāni kathayanti hi | |4 1
kharjūranālikerāṇi tathā āmraphalāni tu |
mātuliṅgaphalānyeva kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ | | 42

śāligodhūmapiṣṭāni kārayedgaṇanāyaka |
guḍagarbhakṛtānīha ghṛtapākena pāvayet | |44

ādau kṛtvā bhādrapadaṃ yathā saṃkhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | | 1.64.50
divyānbhogānmahādeva tatastebhyo nivedayet | | 51

brahmayājñavalkyasamvādavarṇanam
brahmovāca
prabhāte saṃstuto devo mūrtihetormayā purā |
yajantaṃ cāparaṃ devaṃ bhaktinamraṃ mahāmatiḥ | | 1

siddhārthasaptamīvratavarṇanam
brahmovāca
vacmi te paramaṃ devaṃ sarvadevaiśca pūjitam |
padmākṛtiṃ sadā brahmā nalinairguggulena tu |
vyomarūpaṃ sadā devaṃ mahādevorcate ravim | | 2
jātipuṣpairdvijaśreṣṭha dhūpena vijayena tu |
vṛṣaṇaṃ sihlakaṃ vipra śrīkhaṇḍamagarustathā | | 3
karpūraṃ ca tathā mustā śarkarā satvacā dvija |
ityeṣa vijayo dhūpaḥ svayaṃ devena nirmitaḥ | | 4
keśavaścakrarūpaṃ tu sadā sampūjayedravim |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmo nīlotpalakadambakaiḥ | | 5
mayā sa pṛṣṭo deveśastasyaivārādhanāya vai | | 6
kāni puṣpāṇi ceṣṭāni sadā bhāskarapūjane |
tena coktāni puṣpāṇi svayaṃ tāni nibodha me | | 7
mallikāyāstu kusumairbhogavāñjāyate naraḥ |

śatapuṣpasahasraistu pūṣasālokyatāṃ vrajet | |

tribhiḥ santatyavicchinnā caturbhirbhārgavīṃ labhet | | 23
pañcabhirvipulaṃ dhānyaṃ ṣaḍbhirāyurbalaṃ yaśaḥ |
saptamaṇḍalakārī syānmaṃḍalādhipatirnara | | 24

tilatailapradānena sūryaloke mahīyate | | 26

saṃpūjya vidhivaddevaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhirbudhaḥ | | 27
yathāśaktyā tataḥ paścānnaivedyaṃ bhaktito nyaset |
puṣpāṇāṃ pravarā jātī dhūpānāṃ vijayaḥ paraḥ | | 28

dīpadāne ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naivedye modakaḥ paraḥ | | 29

sukhāsīnastataḥ paśyedraverabhimukhe sthitaḥ | | 31

kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā taṃ vāñchitaṃ naraḥ | | 32

dvitīyāyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ dvau gṛhītvā tu suvrata | | 33
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ grahītavyāstrayo.api ca |
jñeyāścaturthyāṃ catvāraḥ pañcamyāṃ pañca eva hi | | 34
ṣaṭ pibeccāpi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ |
saptamyāṃ saptamāyāṃ tu sapta caiva pibennaraḥ | | 35

siddhārthakastvaṃ hi loke sarvatra śrūyase yathā | |
tathā māmapi siddhārthamarthataḥ kurutāṃ raviḥ | | 36

evameva parāḥ kāryā saptamyaḥ sapta sarvadā |
ekātprabhṛti kāryā sā sarvadodakasaptamī | | 38

trīṃstathā madhunā sārdhaṃ dadhnā catura eva ca | | 39

pañcagavyena vai sapta pibetsiddhārthakāndvija | | 1.68.40

tasmātsampūjayeddevaṃ vidhinānena bhāskaram | | 42

svapnadarśanavarṇanam
brahmovāca
saptamyāmuṣito vipraḥ svapnadarśanamucyate |
svapne dṛṣṭe ca saptamyāṃ puruṣo niyatavrataḥ | | 1
samāpya vidhivatsarvaṃ japahomādikaṃ kramāt |
tataḥ śayīta śayane devadevaṃ vicintayan |
samprasupto yadā paśyedudayantaṃ divākaram | | 3
śakradhvajaṃ tathā candraṃ tasya sarvāḥ samṛddhayaḥ |
dṛśyaṃ janaṃ tathā śaktiṃ sragvigoveṇunisvanāḥ | | 4
śvetābjacāmarādarśakanakāsisutodbhavam |
rudhirasya srutiṃ sekaṃ pānaṃ caiśvaryakārakam | | 5
śvetāyāḥ pañcapūtāyā darśanaṃ vṛddhikārakam |
prajāpaterghṛtāktasya darśanaṃ putradaṃ smṛtam | | 6
śastavṛkṣābhirohaśca kṣipramaiśvaryakārakaḥ |
dohanaṃ mahiṣīsiṃhīgodhenūnāṃ svake mukhe | | 7
dhanuṣāṃ ca śarāṇāṃ ca nābhau ca drutanirgatiḥ |
abhihanyātsvayaṃ khādetsiṃhāngā bhujagāṃstathā | | 8
svāṃgaśīrṣaṃ hutavahe tasya śrīragrataḥ sthitā |
rājate haimane pātre yo bhuṃkte pāyasaṃ dvijaḥ | | 9
padmapatre yathā viprastasya jantorbalaṃ bhavet |
dyūte vāde.atha vā yuddhe vijayo hi sukhāvahaḥ | | 1.69.10
agnestu grasanaṃ vipra āgreyaṃ vṛddhikārakam |
gātrasya jvalanaṃ vipra śirovedhaśca bhūtaye | | 11
mālyāmbarāṇāṃ yuktānāṃ śastānāṃ śuklapakṣiṇām |
sadā lābhaṃ praśaṃsanti tathā viṣṭhānulepanam | | 12
svāṅgasya kartane kṣepe rathayāne prajāgamaḥ |
nānāśirobāhutā ca hastānāṃ kurute śriyam | | 13
agamyāgamanaṃ caiva śokamadhyayanaṃ tathā |
devadvijajanācāryaguruvṛddhatapasvinaḥ | | 14
yadyadvadanti tatsarvaṃ satyameva hi nirdiśet |
praśastadarśanaṃ caiva abhiṣeko nṛpaśriyāḥ | | 15
syādrājyaṃ śiraśchedena bahudhā sphuṭitena tu |
ruditaṃ harṣasamprāptyai rājyaṃ nigaḍabandhane | | 16
turaṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ padmaṃ rājānāṃ śvetakuñjaram |
mahadaiśvaryamāpnoti yobhīkaścādhirohati | | 17
grasamāno grahāṃstārā mahīṃ ca parivartayan |
unmūlayanparvatāṃśca rājyalābhamavāpnuyāt | | 18
dehānniṣkrāntirantrāṇāṃ tairvā vṛkṣasya veṣṭanam |
pātaḥ samudrasaritāmaiśvaryāṇi sukhāni ca | | 19
udadhiṃ saritaṃ vāpi tīrtvā pāraṃ prayāti ca |
adriṃ laṅghayateścāpi bhavantyarthajayāyuṣaḥ | | 1.69.20
ujjvalā strī viśedaṅkamāśīrvādaparāḥ striyaḥ |
bhavatyarthāgamaḥ śīghraṃ kṛmibhiryadi bhakṣyate | | 21
svapne svapna iti jñātaṃ dṛṣṭaprakathanaṃ tathā |
saṃyogaścaiva maṅgalyairārogyadhanakārakaḥ |
aiśvaryarājyalābhāya yasminsvapna udāhṛtaḥ | | 23
tairdṛṣṭai rogiṇo rogānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ |
na svapnaṃ śobhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā svapyātprātaśca kīrtayet | |
rājabhojakaviprebhyaḥ śucibhyaśca śucirnaraḥ | | 24
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe

sarṣapasaptamīvarṇanam
brahmovāca
tato madhyāhnasamaye snātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
tathaiva devānvidhivatpūjayitvā yathāsukham | | 1
samyakkṛtajapo maunī naro hutahutāśanaḥ |
niṣkramya devāyatanādbhojakānbhojayettataḥ 1 | | 2
tathā purāṇaviduṣa itihāsavido dvijān |
tathā vedavidaścaiva divyānbhaumāṃśca suvrata | | 3
raktāni vastrāṇi tathā ca gāvaḥ sugandhamālyādi haviṣyamannam |
payasvinī cāpyatha bhojakāya deyā tathānyatpriyamātmano yat | | 4
bhavedalābho yadi bhojakānāṃ viprāstadārhanti jayopajīvinaḥ |
ye mantravidbrāhmaṇapāṭhakāśca ye ye.api sāmādhyayaneṣu yuktāḥ | | 5

teṣāmṛte mantravidastathā vedavido dvijāḥ | | 6

śraddadhāno.anasūyaśca anantaṃ prāpnuyātsukham 3 | | 7
tatphalaṃ saptamī sapta kṛtvā prāpnoti mānavaḥ | | 8
duṣprāpaṃ nāsti talloke anayā yanna labhyate |
na ca rogostyasau loke anayā yo na śāmyati | | 9
kuṣṭhāni cāpi sarvāṇi durucchedyānyapi dhruvam |
apayānti yathā nāgā garuḍasya bhayārditāḥ | | 1.70.10
vrataniyamatapobhiḥ saptamīḥ saptaevaṃ vidhivadiha hi kṛtvā mānavo dharmaśīlaḥ |
śrutadhanasutabhāgyārogyapuṇyairupeto vrajati tadanulokaṃ śāśvataṃ tigmaraśmeḥ | | 11
imaṃ vidhiṃ dvijaśreṣṭha śrutvā kṛtvā ca mānavaḥ |
sarve te paramātmānaṃ pūjayanti divākaram | | 13
jijñāsurlabhate kāmānbhaktaḥ sūryagatiṃ labhet | | 16
kṣemeṇa gacchate.adhvānaṃ yastvidaṃ paṭhatedhvani |
yo yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ sa taṃ prāpnoti ca dhruvam | | 17
ekāntabhāvopagata ekānte susamāhitaḥ |
prāpyaitatparamaṃ guhyaṃ bhūtvā sūryavrato naraḥ | | 18
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ |
lagnagarbhā pramucyeta garbhiṇī janayetsutam | | 19
vandhyā prasavamāpnoti putrapautrasamanvitam |
mayāpi tava mākhyātaṃ bhaktyā bhānoridaṃ dvija | | 1.70.20
sa hi dhātā vidhātā ca sarvasya jagato guruḥ | | 21
udyanyaḥ kurute nityaṃ jagadvitimiraṃ karaiḥ |
dvādaśātmā sa deveśaḥ prīyatāṃ te.aditeḥ sutaḥ | | 22
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe

brahmaproktasūryanāmavarṇanam
brahmovāca
nāmabhiḥ saṃstuto devo yairarkaḥ parituṣyati |
namaḥ sūryāya nityāya ravaye kāryabhānave |
bhāskarāya mataṅgāya mārtaṇḍāya vivasvate | | 2

divākarāya dīptāya agnaye mihirāya ca | | 3

namo gopataye nityaṃ diśāṃ ca pataye namaḥ | |4

aparājitāvarṇanam
brahmovāca
māsi bhādrapade śuklā saptamī yā gaṇādhipa |
caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ naktamādiśet |
upavāsaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam | | 2 |
puṣpāṇi karavīrasya tathā raktaṃ ca candanam | |3
dhūpakriyā guggulena naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakāḥ |
śvetāni bhīmapuṣpāṇi tathā śvetaṃ ca candanam|
dhūpamājyamihākhyātaṃ naivadyaṃ pāyasaṃ raveḥ | | 5
tato.agastyasya puṣpāṇi kuṅkumaṃ ca vilepanam | | 6
dhūpārthaṃ sihlakaṃ proktamatha vā ravivarṇakam |
śālyodanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sarasaṃ phālgunādiṣu | | 7
raktotpalāni bhūteśa sāguruṃ candanaṃ tathā |
ananto dhūpa uddiṣṭo naivedyaṃ khaṇḍapūpakāḥ | | 8
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ granthisahitamaguruḥ sihlakaṃ tathā |
mustā tathendraṃ bhūteśa śarkarā gṛhyate tryaham | | 9
ityeṣa dhūpo.anantastu kathito devasattama |
śṛṇu nāmāni devasya prāśanāni ca suvrata |
sudhāṃśuraryamā caiva savitā tripurāntakaḥ | | 11
pāraṇeṣveva sarveṣu prīyatāmiti kīrtayet |
gomūtraṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ coṣṇaṃ payo dadhi | | 12
yastvetāṃ saptamo kuryādanena vidhinā naraḥ |
aparājito bhavetso.asau sadā śatrubhirāhave | | 13
jitvā śatruṃ labhetāpi trivargaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
trivargamatha samprāpya svarbhānoḥ puramaśnute | | 14
tataḥ pūrṇeṣu māseṣu pūjayecchaktitaḥ khagam |
gandhapuṣpopahāraistu purāṇaśravaṇena ca | | 15
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā ca bhāskarasya priyaṃ sadā | | 16
bhāskarāya dhvajāndadyānnānāratnavibhūṣitān |
ya itthaṃ kurute vīra saptamīṃ yatnataḥ sadā | | 17
sa parājitya vai śatruṃ yāti haṃsasalokatām | | 18
śuklāśvodbhavayānena āpagena patākinā |
āpagādhipasaṃkāśa āpagānucaro bhavet | | 19
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe aparājitāvarṇanaṃ
athaikonaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ
mahājayākalpavarṇanam
brahmovāca
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
mahājayā tadā sā vai saptamī bhāskarapriyā | | 1
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasya vaco yathā | | 2
yastasyāṃ mānavo bhaktyā ghṛtena snāpayedravim |
so.aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya svargalokamavāpnuyāt | | 3
payasā snāpayedyastu bhāskaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yāti sūryasalokatām | |4
tejasā harisaṃkāśaḥ kāntyā sūryasamastathā | | 5
sthitvā tatra ciraṃ kālaṃ rājā bhavati cāñjasā |

nandā sā kathitā vīra sarvānandakarī śubhā | | 1
saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ | | 2

śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ saviturbhavet |
yadā prathamatā caiva tadā vai bhadratāṃ vrajet | | 1

dagdhvā tu guggulaṃ tasya dadyādbhadraṃ tathāgrataḥ | | 3

yadāgneyaṃ tatra māṇikyaṃ nyasedvā lohitaṃ maṇim | | 5

gāṅgeyamantatastasya svaśaktyā vinyasedbudhaḥ | | 6

ṣaṣṭhyāmayācitaṃ proktaṃ(kta?) upavāso hyataḥ paraḥ | | 7

brahmovāca
praśaṃsanti mahātmānaḥ saṃvādaṃ bhāskarāśrayam |
gautamyā saha kauśalyā sumanāyāṃ surālaye | | 1

na vāsasī śobhane ye yathā te patinā saha | | 4

kauśalyovāca
svargaprāptiriyaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ phalamuttamam | | 8

trilokakartuḥ savitustṛptistadguṇasambhavā | | 15

ye tvakāmā narāḥ samyaktatkurvanti ca śobhane |

divākarasya dharmajña nivedyāssarvadācyuta | | 21

agastiṃ kiṃśukaṃ tadvatpūjārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu |
tamālapatraṃ ca hare sadaiva bhagavatpriyam | | 27
tulasī kālatulasī tathā raktaṃ ca candanam |
padmotpalasamutthāni raktaṃ nīlotpalaṃ tathā |
sitotpalaṃ tu bhānostu dayitāni sadācyuta | | 29
kuṭajaṃ śālmalīpuṣpaṃ tathānyadgandhavarjitam |

suvarṇamaṇimuktāni rajataṃ ca tathācyuta |

brahmovāca
kṛṣṇa rājā mahānāsīdyayātikulasambhavaḥ |
prabhāvaistejasā kāntyā kṣāntyā balasamanvitaḥ |
dhairyagambhīryasampanno vadānyo yaśasānvitaḥ | | 2
buddhyā vikramadakṣaśca sampanno brāhmaṇāyataḥ |
kṛtī kavistathā śūraḥ ṣaṭpadākhyairna nirjitaḥ | | 3
sadā pañcasu raktaśca vasumadbhirna nirjitaḥ |
rudratā vasubhirjātaiḥ sattvaśraddhāsamanvitaḥ | | 4
ambujasyāṇḍajasyeva ātreyasya tathācyuta |
ambujāyāstathā kṛṣṇa vāryapātraṃ sa vai vibho | | 5
gāṅgeyena bale tulyaḥ paulastyārcāśramo yathā |
gāṅgeyasya tathā kṛṣṇa dhiṣaṇasya hareryathā | | 6
kāmyaśca dvijabhaktastu tathā vālmīkivatsadā |

eṣāṃ naikairguṇairyuktaḥ sa rājā kṣmātale vibho |
satrājite mahābāhau kṛṣṇa dhātrīṃ samāśrite | | 9
yāvatsūrya udeti sma yāvacca pratitiṣṭhati |
satrājitaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ kṣetramityamidhīyate | | 1.116.10
nānyāyakṛnna cāśakto vadānyo balavattaraḥ |
catvāraḥ sacivāstasya rājñaḥ satrājitasya tu |
babhūburapratihatāḥ sadā vāti balasya vai | | 13
divākare jagadbhānau raktacandanamālini | | 14

na kevalaṃ janasyāpi hyabhavattasya vismayaḥ | | 15
kathaṃ syāt sampadeṣā me punarapyanyajanmani | | 16
evaṃ sa bahuśo rājā tadā kṛṣṇa mahāyaśāḥ |
tadā papraccha dharmajñānsa viprānsamupāgatān | | 18
sarvāśca sasukhānvīra viviktāntaḥ purasthitaḥ |
tadahaṃ praṣṭumicchāmi kiñcittadvaktumarhatha | | 1.116.20
sadvidyākhilavijñānasamyagdhautāntarātmabhiḥ |
bhavadbhiryadyanugrāhyaḥ syāmahaṃ vedavittamāḥ | | 21
vaktumarhatha vidvāṃsaḥ sarvasyaivopakāriṇaḥ | | 22
brahmovāca

rājovāca

parāvasuruvāca

aruṇa uvāca
kimarthaṃ bhojakastubhyaṃ priyo deveśa kathyatām |
nānye viprādayo varṇā devatāyataneṣu vai | | 1
kaścāyaṃ bhojako deva kasya putraḥ kimātmakaḥ |
varṇataścāsya me brūhi karma cāsya samantataḥ | | 2
āditya uvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭo.asmi bhadraṃ te vainateya mahāmate |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sarvaṃ gadato mama khecara | | 3
viprādayastu ye tvanye varṇāḥ kaśyapanandana |
devālayeṣu ye viprāḥ prītyā māṃ pūjayanti hi |
anyāśca devatāvṛttyā te syurdevalakāḥ khaga | |
etasmātkāraṇānmahyaṃ bhojako dayitaḥ sadā | | 5
varṇato brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ svānuṣṭhānaparo yadi |
anuṣṭhānavihīno hi narakaṃ yātyasaṃśayam | | 6
na tyājyaṃ bhojakaistasmātsvakaṃ karma kadācana |
mayāsau nirmitaḥ pūrvaṃ tejasā svena vai khaga | | 7
pūjārthamātmano nūnaṃ karma cāsya prakīrtitam |
priyavratasuto rājā śākadvīpe mahāmatiḥ | | 8
tena me kāritaṃ divyaṃ vimānapratimaṃ gṛham |
tasmindvīpe tadātmīye divyaṃ śilāmayaṃ mahat | | 9
sa madarcāṃ kārayitvā kāñcanīṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
pratiṣṭhāpanāya vai tasyāścintayāmāsa suvrataḥ | | 1.117.10
kṛtamāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teneyaṃ pratimā kṛtā |
ko vai pratiṣṭhāpayitā devamarkaṃ śubhālaye | | 11
evaṃ sañcintayitvā tu jagāma śaraṇaṃ mama |
bhaktiṃ tasya ca sañcintya khagāhaṃ pārthivasya tu | | 12
gato.ahaṃ darśanaṃ tasya uktañcāpi mayā khaga |
kiṃ cintayasi rājendra kutaściṃtā samāgatā | | 13
brūhi yatte hṛdi prauḍhaṃ cintākāraṇamāgatam |
saṃpādayiṣye tatsarvaṃ vimanā bhava mā nṛpa | | 14
dvīpe.asmindevadevasya kṛtamāyatanaṃ tava |
mayā bhaktyā jagannātha tatheyaṃ pratimā kṛtā | | 16
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedyastu tava devālaye khaga |
yatra santi trayo varṇā dvīpesminkṣatriyādayaḥ | | 17
te mayoktā na kurvanti pratiṣṭhāṃ tava kṛtsnaśaḥ |
na cāpyarcāṃ jagannātha brāhmaṇaścātra vidyate | | 18
teneyamāgatā cintā hṛdi śalyaṃ tayārpitam |
tato mayokto rājā.asau vainateya vacaḥ śubham | | 19
evametanna saṃdeho yathāttha tvaṃ narādhipaḥ |
kṣatriyāditrayo varṇā dvīpe.asminnātra saṃśayaḥ | | 1.117.20
te ca nārhanti me pūjāṃ na pratiṣṭhāṃ kadācana |
tasmātte śreyase rājanpratiṣṭhāmātmanastathā | | 21
sṛjāmi prathamaṃ varṇaṃ bhagasaṃjñamanaupamam |
ityuktvā tamahaṃ vīra rājānaṃ khagasattama | | 22
jagāma paramāṃ cintāṃ tasya kāryasya siddhaye |
śaśikundendusaṃkāśāḥ saṃkhyayāṣṭau mahābalāḥ |
kāṣāyavāsasaḥ sarve karaṇḍāmbujadhāriṇaḥ |
lalāṭaphalakāddvau tu dvau cānyau vakṣasastathā | | 25
caraṇābhyāṃ tathā dvau tu pādābhyāṃ dvau tathā khaga |
pitaraṃ manyamānā māmidaṃ vacanamabruvan |
tāta tāta mahādeva lokanātha jagatpate | | 27
kimarthaṃ bhavatā sṛṣṭā vayaṃ devasya dehataḥ |
brūhi sarvaṃ kariṣyāma ādeśaṃ bhavato.akhilam | | 28
pitāsmākaṃ bhavāndevo vayaṃ putrā na saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktavantaste sarve mayoktā devasambhavāḥ | | 29
priyavratasuto yoyamasya vākyaṃ kariṣyatha |
sa cāpyukto mayā rājā śākadvīpādhipaḥ khaga | | 1.117.30
ya ete matsutā rājannarghyā brāhmaṇasattamāḥ |
kārayantu pratiṣṭhāṃ me sarvairebhirmahīpate | | 31.
kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tu mamārcāyāṃ narādhipa |
paścādāyatanaṃ sarvameṣāmarpaya pūjane | | 32
ete matpūjane yogyāḥ pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvaśaḥ |
samāpya na prahartavyaṃ bhojakebhyaḥ kadācana | | 33
sarvamāyatanārthaṃ tu gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ ca yat |
dhanadhānyādikaṃ rājanyanmamāyatane bhavet | | 34
tatsarvaṃ bhojakebhyastu dātavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dhanadhānyasuvarṇādi gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ ca yat | |
yanmadīyaṃ bhavetkiñjidgrāme vā nagare kvacit | | 35
tasya sarvasya rājendra madīyasya samantataḥ |
adhipā bhojakāḥ sarve nānye viprādayo nṛpa | | 36
yathādhikārī putrastu pitṛdravyasya vai bhavet |
tathā madīyavittasya bhojakāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ | | 37
ityuktena mayā rājñā tathā sarvaṃ pravartitam |
kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tu dattvā sarvasvameva hi | |
bhojakebhyaḥ khagaśreṣṭha tato harṣamavāptavān | | 38
evamete mayā sṛṣṭā bhojakā garuḍāgraja |
ahamātmā tato hyeṣāṃ sarve sumanasastathā | | 39
matputreṇa samā jñeyāstathā mama hitāḥ sadā |
tasmāttebhyaḥ pradātavyaṃ na hartavyaṃ kadācana | | 1.117.40
bhojakasya haredyastu lobhāddveṣāttathāpi vā |

tatsarvaṃ bhojakasvaṃ hi pitṛparyāgataṃ mama | | 42

mamājñāṃ pāleyadyastu svānuṣṭhānaparaḥ sadā | | 43

abhyaṅgadhāraṇaṃ nityaṃ tathā triṣavaṇaṃ smṛtam | | 44
pañcakṛtvaḥ sadā pūjyo hyahaṃ rātrau dine tathā |
devabrāhmaṇavedānāṃ nindā kāryā na vai kvacit | | 45
nānyādevapratiṣṭhā tu kāryā vai bhojakena tu |
mamāpi ca na kartavyā tena ekākinā kvacit | | 46
sarvameva nivedyānnaṃ nāśnīyādbhojakaḥ sadā |
na bhuñjīta gṛhaṃ gatvā śūdrasya garuḍāgraja | | 47
śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ prayatnena sadā tyājyaṃ hi bhojakaiḥ |
ye.aśnanti bhojakā nityaṃ śūdrānnaṃ śūdraveśmani | | 48
te vai pūjāphalaṃ cātra kathaṃ prāpsyanti khecara |
gatvā gṛhaṃ tu śūdrasya na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana | | 49
gṛhāgataṃ ca śūdrānnaṃ tacca tyājyaṃ tathaiva ca |
ādhmātavyombujo nityaṃ bhojakenāgrato mama | | 1.117.50
sakṛtpravādite śaṃkhe mama prītirhi jāyate |
ṣaṇmāsānnātra sandehaḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā | | 51
tasmācchaṃkhaḥ sadā vādyo bhojakena prayatnataḥ |
tasyeyaṃ paramā vṛttirnaivedyaṃ yanmadīyakam | | 52
nābhojyaṃ bhuñjate yasmāttenaite bhojakā matāḥ |
bhojayanti ca māṃ nityaṃ tena te bhojakā smṛtāḥ |
abhyaṅgaṃ ca prayatnena prāyaṃ śuddhikaraṃ param | | 54
abhyaṅgahīno hyaśucirbhojakaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ |
yastu māṃ pūjayedvīra abhyaṅgena vinā khaga | | 55
na tasya santatiḥ syādvai na cāhaṃ prītimānbhave |
muṇḍanaṃ śirasā kāryaṃ śikhā dhāryā prayatnataḥ | | 56
naktaṃ cādityadivase tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pravartayet |
saptamyāmupavāsastu mama saṃkramaṇe tathā | | 57
kartavyo bhojakenaiva matprītyai garuḍāgraja |
trikālaṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ japedvācā puro mama | | 58
mukhamāvṛtya yatnena pūjanīyo.ahamādarāt |
maunaṃ cāsya prayatnena tyaktvā krodhaṃ ca dūrataḥ | | 59
śūdrebhyo yastu vaiśyebhyo lobhātkāmātprayacchati |
nirmālyaṃ mama vai vatsa sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam | | 1.117.60
lobhādvai bhojako yastu matpuṣpāṇi khagādhipa |
yacchatenyasya duṣṭātmā mayyanāropya khecara | | 61
sa jñeyo me paraḥ śatruḥ sa māmarho na cārcitum |
nirmālyaṃ mama deyaṃ syādbrāhmaṇādiṣu vai nṛṣu | | 62
naivedyaṃ yanmadīyaṃ tu tadaśnīyātsadaiva hi |
tenāsau śuddhyate nityaṃ haviṣyānnasamaṃ tathā | | 63
tatkṣaṇādutkṣipedyastu mamāṃgātpuṣpameva hi |
nānyasya deyaṃ naivedyaṃ madīyamudake kṣipet | | 64
pañcagavyasamaṃ tasya manmataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mamāṅgalagnaṃ yatkiñcidgandhaṃ puṣpamathāpi vā | | 65
dātavyaṃ na ca vaiśyāya na śūdrāya kadācana |
ātmanā tadgrahītavyaṃ na vikreyaṃ kathañcana | | 66
yastu nāropya puṣpāṇi avyaṅgāni mamopari |
yaḥ kaścidāharelloke sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam | | 67
snapanaṃ mama nirmālyaṃ pāvakaṃ yastu laṅghayet |
sa naro narakaṃ yāti saraudraṃ rauravaṃ khaga | | 68
bhojakena sadā kāryaṃ snapanaṃ me prayatnataḥ |
yathā na laṅghayetkaścidyathā śvā nāpi bhakṣayet | | 69
yadyayatnaparaḥ kuryādbhojakaḥ snapanaṃ mama |
yathā vai laṅghitamatirbhakṣyatāṃ ca khagādhipa | | 1.117.70
sa yāti narakaṃ raudraṃ tāmiśraṃ nāma nāmataḥ |
ekabhaktaṃ sadā kāryaṃ snānaṃ traikālameva hi | | 71
tricailaṃ parivarteta bhavitavyaṃ dinedine |
pūjākāle.arghakāle ca krodhastyājyaḥ prayatnataḥ | | 72
amāṃgalyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ vaktavyaṃ ca śubhaṃ tadā |
īdṛgbhūto bhojako me preyān pūjākaraḥ sadā | | 73
sanmānyaḥ pūjanīyaśca viprādīnāṃ yathāsmyaham |
yaḥ karotyavamānaṃ tu vṛttirūpaṃ tu bhojake | | 74
tasyāhaṃ roṣametyāśu kulaṃ hanmi samantataḥ |
priyo me bhojako nityaṃ yathā tvaṃ vinatāsuta | | 75
upalepanakartā ca sammārjanaparaśca yaḥ | |
parāvasuruvāca
ityuktvā bhagavānbhānurbabhrāma rathamāsthitaḥ | | 76

pūjyastasmānmahārāja bhojakastu mahīpate | | 77

brahmovāca
itthaṃ śrutvā sa rājā tu karmaṇaḥ phalamātmanaḥ |

tasmiṃstasminkārayati upalepanamādarāt | | 1.117.80

vācake vetanaṃ dattvā bhānordevasya mandire | | 81

prāptāvubhau parāṃ prītiṃ gatiṃ cānuttamāṃ tathā | | 82
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpa upalepanasnāpanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ | 117 |

dīpadānaphalavarṇanam
brahmovāca
dīpaṃ prayacchati naro bhānorāyatane tu yaḥ |
datvā phalamavāpnoti yadanyena na labhyate | | 2
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇātra te vacmi saṃvādaṃ pāpanāśanam |
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha bhadrasya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ | | 3
jagatyasminpurī ramyā nāmnā māhiṣmatī purā |
tasyāmāsīddvijaḥ kṛṣṇa nāgaśarmeti viśrutaḥ | |4
tasya putraśataṃ jātaṃ prasādādbhāskarasya ca |
teṣāṃ kaniṣṭho bhadrastu tatputrāṇāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | | 5
sa ca nityaṃ jagaddhāturdevadevasya bhāsvataḥ |
dīpavartiparastadvattailādyāharaṇodyataḥ | | 6
bhānorāyatane tasya sahasraṃ bhārgavīpriya |
sarve te bhrātaro bhadraṃ papracchuridamādarāt | | 8
bho bhadra vada vai bhrātarbhadraṃ testu sadā dvija |
kautūhalaparāḥ sarve yatpṛcchāmastaducyatām | | 9
viṣaye sati vaktavyaṃ yanmayā tadihocyatām | | 1.118.10
bhavanto mama sarve vai bhrātaro guravastathā | | 11
kathaṃ na kathayāmyeṣa bhavatāṃ putrasammitaḥ |
tasmādbruvantu māṃ sarve bhrātaro yadvivakṣitam | | 12
bhrātara ūcuḥ

suprayatnaṃ tu paśyāmo bhānorāyatane param | | 13
tava dīpapradānāya yathā bhadra sadodyamam | | 14
tattvaṃ tatkathayāsmākaṃ haṃta kautūhalaṃ param |
yannāma dīpadānasya bhavatā viditaṃ phalam | | 15
tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ saviśeṣaṃ mahābala |
evamuktastatastaistu bhrātṛbhiścodito mudā | | 16
vyājahāra sa bhrātṛrṇāṃ na kiñcidapi suvrata |
punaḥ punarasau taistu bhrātṛbhiścodito mudā | | 17
dākṣiṇyasāro bhadrastu kathayāmāsa kṛtsnaśaḥ |
bhavatāṃ kautukaṃ caitadatīvālpe.api vastuni | | 18
tadeṣa kathayāmyadya yadvrataṃ mama suvrata |
ikṣvākurājñastu purā vaśiṣṭho.abhūtpurohitaḥ | | 19
dīpadānādibhiścaiva cakre tatra sa vai dvijaḥ |
kārtike dīpako bhaktyā pradattastena vai sadā | | 21
devatāyatane cāhamavasaṃ vyathito bhṛśam | | 22
pūyaśoṇitaniṣpandaṃ prāvahankāyataḥ sadā |
śīrṇa ghrāṇo hyarvaravo durgaṃdhapatitastathā | | 23
duṣṭabuddhyā sadā yuktaḥ saptāśvaṃ prati suvrata |
yadṛcchyā dīpadānaṃ vartyādīnāṃ vibhāvasau | |24
tattadbhuktvā sadā tuṣṭiṃ vrajāmi dvijasattamāḥ |
ekadā tu tatastasminbhānorāyatane gataḥ | | 25
rātrau dṛṣṭā mayā tatra bhaktā jāgaraṇāgatāḥ |
pratiśrayaṃ prārthitāśca taiśca datto dayānvitaḥ | | 26
vyādhito.ayaṃ sudīnaśca iti kṛtvā matiṃ śubhām |
tato.ahamagnimāśritya sthitasteṣāṃ samīpataḥ | | 27
duṣṭāṃ buddhiṃ samāśritya hartukāmo vivasvataḥ |
divyamābharaṇaṃ bhānośchidrānveṣī dvijottamāḥ | | 28
sthito.ahaṃ bhojakā hyatra yadi nidrāṃ vrajanti te |
yenāsya vairivadbhānorharāmyābharaṇaṃ śubham | | 29
atha suptā bhojakāste nidrayā mohitāstadā |
nirvāṇāścāpi dīpāstu tato.ahamutthitastvaran | | 1.118.30
mudā paramayā yukto gato vaiśvānaraṃ prati |
prajvālyaṃ pāvakaṃ yatnāddīpavartintato mayā | | 31
yojayitvā tu vai dīpe dhṛto dīpo.agrato raveḥ |
hartukāmenābharaṇaṃ bhānordevasya suvrata | | 32
atha te bhojakāḥ sarve vṛddhā devasya putrakāḥ |
taistu dṛṣṭo hyahaṃ tatra dīpahasto vibhāvasoḥ | | 33
puraḥ sthito dvijaśreṣṭhā gṛhītaścāpi tairiha |
tato.ahaṃ tejasā mūḍho bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ | | 34
vilapankaruṇaṃ teṣāṃ pādayoravaniṃ gataḥ |
taiścāpi karuṇāṃ kṛtvā mukto.ahaṃ bhojakaistadā | | 35
gṛhīto rājapuruṣaiḥ pṛṣṭaścāpi samantataḥ |
kimidaṃ bhavatārabdhaṃ devadevasya maṃdire | | 36
dīpaṃ prajvālya duṣṭātmankathyatāṃ mā ciraṃ kuru |
ityuktvā tu tatastaistu śastrahastaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ | | 37
tato.ahaṃ vyādhinā kliṣṭo bhayena ca dvijottamāḥ |
hitvā prāṇāngato yatra svayaṃ devo vibhāvasuḥ | | 38
sthitvā kalpaṃ tatastatra yuṣmākaṃ bhrātṛtāṃ gataḥ |
dattasyārkasya bhavane yasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā |
duṣṭabuddhyā kṛtaṃ yattu mayā dīpapravartanam | | 1.118.40
bhagāyatanadīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalam |
kṣudhābhibhūtena mayā devadevasya bhūṣaṇam | | 41
dīpaśca devapurato jvālito bhāskarasya tu |
kuṣṭhinā cāpi śūdreṇa prāptaṃ brāhmaṇyamuttamam |
nānāvidhāni śāstrāṇi sāṃgaṃ vedaṃ samāptavān | | 43
duṣṭabuddhyā dhṛtāddīpātphalametanmahādbhutam |
prāptaṃ mayā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kiṃ punardīpadāyinām | | 44
prayacchāmi raverdhāmni jñātamasya hi yatphalam | |45
yuṣmākamidamuktaṃ vai snehātsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
arkāyatanadīpasya bhadrovocadyathā purā |
dinedine japannāma bhāskarasya samāhitaḥ | |47
dadāti kārtike yastu bhagāyatanadīpakam |
dīpaṃ dadāti yatnādyatphalaṃ tasya nibodha me |
tasmādāyatane bhānordīpāndadyātsadācyuta | | 52
tasmāddadyānnāharedvai śreyo.arthī dīpakaṃ naraḥ | | 54
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe bhadropākhyāna
ādityāyatanadīpadānaphalavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ | 118 |

aiśānyāṃ diśi vai kuryādadhivāsanamaṇḍapam | | 1
catustoraṇasampannaṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam |
diśāsu vidiśāsveva patākābhistu bhūṣitam | | 2
āgneyyāṃ diśi raktāḥ syuḥ kṛṣṇāḥ syuryāmyanairṛte |
śvetā diśyaparasyāṃ tu vāyavyāmeva pāṇḍurā | | 3
citrā cottara pārnye tu pītā pūrvottare tathā |
śriyamāyurjayaṃ caiva balaṃ yaśo yadūttama | | 4
dadāti sā vīra kṛtā sampadardhe na saṃśayaḥ |
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ mṛṇmayī pratimā bhavet | | 5
subhikṣakṣemadā nityaṃ sarvā maṇimayīkṛtā |
gāṅgeyā puṣṭidā raupyā syādvai kīrtipravartinī | | 6
prajāvṛddhiṃ tāmramayīṃ kuryānnityamasaṃśayaḥ |
bhūmerlābhaṃ tu vipulaṃ kuryādaśmamayī sadā | | 7
pradhānapuruṣaṃ hanti trapulohamayī sadā |
sarvadevamayasyaivamarcā kuryātprayatnataḥ | | 8
sāmba uvāca
sarvadevamayatvaṃ hi brūhi me bhāskarasya tu |
sarvadevamayo hyeṣa kathaṃ nārada kathyate | | 9
nārada uvāca
budhasomau smṛtau netre lalāṭe ceśvaraḥ sthitaḥ | | 1.133.10
surajyeṣṭhaḥ śirastasya kapāle.asya bṛhaspatiḥ |
ekādaśe tathā rudrāḥ kaṇṭhamasya samāśritāḥ | | 11
dharmādharmau ca devasya oṣṭhasampuṭake sthitau | | 12
sarvaśāstramayī devī jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī |
diśaśca vidiśaścaiva sarvāḥ śrotreṣu saṃsthitāḥ | | 13
brahmendrau tāludeśe tu sthitau devaiśca pūjitau |
ādityā dvādaśa vibhobhrurvormadhye samāśritāḥ | | 14
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu samudrā jaṭhare sthitāḥ |
rākṣasāśca gaṇāḥ sarve hṛdaye syuḥ sthitāḥ raveḥ |
nadyo bāhugatāścaiva nagāḥ kakṣāntare sthitāḥ | | 16
pṛṣṭhamadhye sthito meruḥ stanayorantare kujaḥ |
tasya putro dharmarājaḥ sthito vai nābhimaṇḍale | | 17
kaṭideśe pṛthivyādyā liṅge sṛṣṭiḥ samāśritā |
jānunī cāśvinīdevāvūrū tasyācalā smṛtāḥ | | 18
sapta pātālalokāstu nakhamadhye samāśritāḥ |
sasāgaravanā pṛthvī pādamadhye.asya vartate | | 19
devaḥ kālāgnirudro yo dantānteṣu samāśritaḥ |
sarvadevamayo bhānuḥ sarvadevātmakastathā | | 1.133.20
vyaṃgeṣu vāyavaścaiva lokālokaṃ carācaram |
vyāptaṃ karmaśarīreṇa vāyunā tasya vai vibhoḥ | | 21
sa eṣa bhagavānarko bhūtānugrahaṇe sthitaḥ |
etatte paramaṃ jñānametatte paramaṃ padam | | 22
tasya sthānavibhāgena pratimāsthāpanaṃ yathā |
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne pratimāpratiṣṭhākalpe viśvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ | 133 |
atha catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ
maṇḍalavidhivarṇanam
nārada uvāca
daśamī trayodaśī caiva paurṇamāsī ca kīrtitā | | 1
somo bṛhaspatiścaiva śukraścaiva budhastathā |
ete saumyā grahāḥ proktāḥ pratiṣṭhāyajñakarmaṇi | | 2
triṣūttarāsu revatyāmaśvinyāṃ brāhmabhe tathā |
punarvasvostathā haste vāsave śravaṇe.athavā | |
bharaṇyāṃ caiva nakṣatre bhānoḥ sthāpanamuttamam | | 3
śodhayitvā tu vai bhūmiṃ tuṣakeśavivarjitām |
vālukāṅgārapāṣāṇāsthivihīnāṃ viśodhya tu | | 4
caturhastasamāyuktā vedī vistarato raveḥ | | 5
maṇḍapastu pramāṇena daśahastaḥ samaṃtataḥ |
maṇḍalaṃ vṛkṣaśākhābhiḥ kārayedvidhipūrvakam | | 6
nadīsaṅgamatīrotthāṃ mṛttikāṃ ca samānayet |
upalipya tato bhūmiṃ kārayetkuṇḍamuttamam | | 7
caturasraṃ śriyā yuktaṃ pūrvaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tu kārayet |
dakṣiṇe cārdhacandraṃ syādvāruṇyāṃ diśi vartulam | | 8
padmākāraṃ tu vai kuryāduttare ca vicakṣaṇaḥ |
toraṇāni tataḥ kuryātpañcahastāni suvrata | | 9
nyagrodhodumbarau caiva bilvapālāśameva ca |
aśvatthaśca śamī caiva candanaśceti kīrtitāḥ | | 1.134.10 śuklavastrasamāyuktaścitrapaṭṭasamanvitaḥ |
japamālānvitaḥ kuryāttoraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ | | 11
agnimī,leti mantreṇa yajedvai pūrvatoraṇam |
iṣetvorjeti mantreṇa yajeddakṣiṇatoraṇam | | 12
śaṃ no devīti mantreṇa yajeduttaratoraṇam | | 13
kalaśāṃstu samādāya hemagarbhasamanvitān |
śvetacandanapaṅkena kaṇṭhasvastikabhūṣaṇān | | 14 yavaśāliśarāvānnavastrālaṅkāravigrahān |
ājighreti ca mantreṇa kalaśāṃstu niveśayet | | 15
dukūlaścitrapaṭṭaiśca veṣṭayetstambhamālikām |
dhvajādarśapatākābhiścāmaraistu vitānakaiḥ | | 16
śaṅkhaghaṇṭāninādaiśca geyamaṅgalavācanaiḥ |
tūryabherīninādaiśca vedadhvanisamanvitaiḥ | | 17
puṇyaiśca jayaśabdaiśca kārayeta mahotsavam |
vicitrasragvitānāḍhyaṃ prakīrṇakusumāṅkuram |
tanmadhye tu kuśāstīrṇe devārcāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ | | 19
patākāṃ pītavarṇāṃ tu pūrve śakrāya dāpayet |
āgneyyāṃ raktavarṇābhāṃ yamāśāyāṃ yamopamān | | 1.134.20
nīlāñjanasamaprakhyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ ca pradāpayet |
vāruṇyāṃ sitavarṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ vāyavyagocare | | 21
haritāṃ yakṣarājāya aiśānyāṃ sarvavarṇikām |
śvetaraktakacūrṇena padmamālekhayettataḥ | | 22
vaidyā vedīti mantreṇa vedyā ālabhanaṃ bhavet |
pūrvāgrānuttarāgrāṃśca kuśānāstīrya yatnataḥ | | 23
yogeyogeti mantreṇa kuśaścāstaraṇaṃ bhavet |
śayyā tatraiva kartavyā divyāstaraṇasaṃyutā | | 24
gaḍuke dve vicitre tu tanmadhye sthāpayedbudhaḥ | vicitradīpamālābhirbhakṣyabhojyānnapānakaiḥ | | 25
pūpakānsuvicitrānvai modakāṃśca pradāpayet |
pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ caiva dadhyodanasamanvitam | | 26
dadhi candrasamaprakhyaṃ śubhacchatraṃ ca vinyaset | | 27
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne sūryapratiṣṭhāyāṃ

abhijñaḥ sauraśāstrāṇāmaruṇo yadusattama 1 |
bhojako bhojakaiścānyairbrāhmaṇaiśca tathā vṛtaḥ | | 2

snāpayetkalaśaṃ gṛhya devadevaṃ vibhāvasum |

sārasvataṃ jalaṃ puṇyaṃ cāndrabhāgaṃ sasaindhavam |

anyadvāpi śuci toyaṃ nadīnadataḍāgajam |
yathāśaktyā upāhṛtya kalaśaiḥ kāñcanādibhiḥ | | 8

sugandhīni ca mālyāni sthalajānyambujāni ca |
candanāni ca mukhyāni gandhāśca vividhāstathā | | 1.135.10
brāhmī suvarcalā mustā viṣṇukrāntā śatāvarī |

sambhṛtyaitāṃstu sambhārānsnānakarmavibhāgavit |

tvaṃ devī vanditā devaiḥ sakalairdaityadānavaiḥ | | 17

kāryaṃ hi vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ devasya yadunaṃdana |
itthamuccārayedvācaṃ kuryātsnānaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | | 1.135.20
vyomagaṅgā ca pūrṇena dvitīyakalaśena tu | | 21
sārasvatasya pūrṇena kalaśena surottama |
śakrādayobhiṣiṃcantu lokapālāḥ surottamāḥ | | 22
sāgarodakapūrṇena caturthakalaśena tu |
vāriṇā paripūrṇena padmapatrasugandhinā | | 23

himavaddhemakūṭādyāścābhiṣiñcantu vāriṇā | | 24
nairṛtodakapūrṇena ṣaṣṭhena kalaśena tu |
sarvatīrthāmbupūrṇena padmareṇusuvāsinā | | 25
saptamenābhiṣiñcantu ṛṣayaḥ sapta ye varāḥ |
vasavaścābhiṣiñcantu kalaśenāṣṭamena vai | | 26

tato vai kalaśairdivyaiḥ snānakarma samārabhet | | 27
samudraṃ gaccha yaḥ prokto mantrametamudīrayet |

rogaṃ prāpnoti kartā vai duḥkhaṃ kārayitā tathā | | 49

trivārānpurato.arkasya ācamasveti ca bruvan | ve

ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi adhivāsanamuttamam |

iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne sūryapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ |136 |
atha saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam
nārada uvāca
yaḥ prāsādaṃ racayati pumāndevatānāṃ prayatnāttatra prītyā sapadi kurute sthāpanāṃ bhānubhaktaḥ |
divyānbhogā~mllabhati ca sadā kāmataścāprameyāṃstānbhuktvāsau punarapi bhaveccakravartī pṛthivyām | | 1
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvanti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi |
teṣāṃ mṛte.apyaparamārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram | | 2
iti te kathitamidaṃ devapūjyasya savituḥ sthāpanamivādhānam |
sādhāraṇaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpane vīra | | 3
snāto bhukto vastrālaṅkṛtakusumairgandhaiḥ pratimāyā āstīrṇāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
suptāyāṃ tu sa nṛtyagītairjāgaraṇaiḥ samyagevādhivāsya daivajñena pratidiṣṭakāle saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
abhyarcya kusumagandhānulepanaiḥ śaṅkhatūryanirghoṣaiḥ prādakṣiṇyena nayedāyatanasya prayatnena kṛtvā baliṃ pratimāmabhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃśca sādhūndattvā hiraṇyakalaśaṃ vidhinā nikṣipetpiṃṇḍikāmadhye suśvabhre sthāpakadaivajñadvijānsamyagviśeṣato.abhyarcyākalpāntaṃ bhogī bhavatīha paratra sukhī | |4
viṣṇorbhāgavatā matāśca savituḥ śambhoḥ sabhasmadvijā mātṛrṇāmapi mātṛmaṇḍalavido viprā vidurbrāhmaṇāḥ |
sarve yasya vimuktaśuklavasanā buddhasya raktāmbarā ye yaṃ devamupāśritāḥ suvidhinā taistasya kāryā kriyā | | 5
sāmānyamidaṃ devānāmadhivāsanaṃ bhavati mayā kathitam |
kriyamāṇamidaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpanam | |
naro bhaktyā iha kāmānavāpya svargabhājanaṃ bhavati | | 6
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpratiṣṭhāpanamāditaḥ |
yatkṛtvā savituḥ snānaṃ naro yāti manogatim | | 7

kārayetpurato bhaktayā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ | | 8

sumanturuvāca
evaṃ sa ānayitvā tu magānsāmbo mahīpate |
sa mahātmā purā sāmbaścandrabhāgāsarittaṭe | | 1
puraṃ niveśayāmāsa sthāpayitvā divākaram |

sāṃbena kāritaṃ yasmāttasmātsāmbapuraṃ smṛtam | | 3
tasminpratiṣṭhito devaḥ puramadhye divākaraḥ |
satkṛtya sthāpitāḥ sarve ātmanāmāṅkite pure | | 4
magānāṃ tu sadācāro dṛṣṭācārakulocitaḥ |
devaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ gītaṃ vedaproktena karmaṇā | | 5
kṛtakṛtyastadā sāmbo varaṃ labdhvā punaryuvā |
ādidevaṃ surajyeṣṭhamādityaṃ praṇipatya saḥ | | 6
prasthito nirmalaḥ sāmbaḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ tadā | | 7
magānāṃ kāraṇārthena prārthitā bhojavaṃśajāḥ |
vasudevasya pautreṇa gotrajena mahātmanā | | 8
kanyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ magānāṃ bhojakottamaiḥ |
sarvāstāḥ sahitāḥ kanyāḥ pravālamaṇibhūṣitāḥ | | 9
arcayitvā tu tāḥ sarvāḥ preṣitāḥ saviturgṛham |
punargatvā tu sāṃbena pṛṣṭo devo divākaraḥ | | 1.140.10
magānāṃ jñānamākhyāhi vedānavyaṅgameva ca |
pṛccha tvaṃ nāradaṃ gatvā sa te sarvaṃ vadiṣyati |
evamukto.atha vai sāmbo gatavānnāradaṃ prati | | 12
gatvā kṛtsnamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai tena niveditam |
sa cāpyāha tataḥ sāmbaṃ na jāne jñānamuttamam | | 13

kṛṣṇānurodhātte sarvaṃ sa vakṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
nāradenaivamuktastu sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ | | 15

bālā yauvanasampannāḥ sanniviṣṭā magottamāḥ | | 17

varayitvā kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ viprapraṇayanaṃ śubham | | 19

pūjāyāṃ ye ratā bhānoryeṣāṃ caiva varapradaḥ | | 1.140.20
paryāptaṃ sarvameteṣāmiha cāmuṣmikaṃ phalam |
anitye sati mānuṣye devapūjāratā hi ye | | 21
kintu cintayataḥ sūryaṃ cintayitvā tu bhojakān |
jñānaṃ prati tathā caiṣāṃ hadaye saṃśayo mama | | 22
kathaṃ pūjākarā hyete ke magāḥ ke ca bhojakāḥ |
jñānaṃ kiṃ paramaṃ teṣāṃ jñeyasteṣāṃ ka eva tu | | 23
divyeti te kathaṃ proktāḥ kimarthaṃ kūrcadhāraṇam |
sauravrataṃ kimarthaṃ tu vācakāste kathaṃ smṛtāḥ | | 24
kimarthaṃ tejasā vedāngāyantaścaiva te katham |
athāhikañcukasyāṅgaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ca kasya vai | | 25
kasya vai kā samākhyātā yadutpannaṃ kathaṃ smṛtam |
kathaṃ devāṃśca gāyanti yajñaṃ kurvanti te katham | | 26
agnihotraṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ pañca dolāśca kāḥ smṛtāḥ |
kālīsuto mahātejā uvāca paramaṃ vacaḥ | | 28
sādhusādhu yaduśreṣṭha sādhu pṛṣṭo.asmi suvrata |
durjñeyaceṣṭitaṃ kiñcidbhojakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | | 29
bhāskarasya prasādena mamāpi smṛtimāgatam |
yathākhyātaṃ vaśiṣṭhena tathā te vacmi kṛtsnaśaḥ | | 1.140.30
magānāṃ caritaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ kṛṣṇanandana |
jñānavedina evaite karmayogaṃ samāśritāḥ | | 31
śrūyante ṛṣayaḥ sarve maunena niyamasthitāḥ |
bhuñjate cāpi maunena sarve vai paramarṣayaḥ | | 32
municaryākṛtaste.api śākadvīpanivāsinaḥ |

śatānīka uvāca
ya ete bhojakāḥ proktā devadevasya pūjakāḥ |
nānyaṃ bhojyamathaiteṣāṃ brāhmaṇaiśca kadācana | | 1
bhāskarasya priyā hyete pūjyatvaṃ ca tathā gatāḥ |
divyāścaite smṛtā viprā ādityāmbhaḥ samudbhavāḥ | | 2
abhojyatvaṃ kathaṃ yātā bhojakāstadvadasva me |
kiṃ kurvāṇāstathā karma bhojyatāṃ yānti me vada | | 3
sumanturuvāca
kṛtavarmaṇā purā rājaṃstathā sāmbo mahābalaḥ | | 4

bhuktavanto gṛhe sarve bhojakasya mahātmanaḥ | | 5

tāvṛṣī divamāruḍhau rājannāradaparvatau | 7

vāsudeva uvāca
na te bhojyā mahābāho bhojyā bhojāśca sarvadā |
abhivādyāṃ prayatnena yathādityo mahāmate | | 1.146.10

tacchrūyatāṃ yaduśreṣṭha yatkāryaṃ cāpi tairvibho | |

śirasā dhārayetkeśānsa jñeyo bhojakādhamaḥ | | 17

dānaṃ brāhmaṇapūjāṃ ca kurvato bhojakasya tu | |

abhyaṅgo yaduśārdūla pavitraḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ | | 19

madhye brahmā mahātejā agre gośrutibhūṣaṇaḥ | | 1.146.20

yajurvedastathā śreṣṭhaścātharvasahitaḥ sthitaḥ | | 21
trayo.agnayastathā rājaṃstrayo lokāḥ sthitāḥ kramāt |
evameva pavitrastu abhyaṅgo bhojakasya tu | | 22

te.adhamā bhojakā jñeyā ye ca devasvahāriṇaḥ | | 24

atra pṛṣṭo yathā devo bhāskaro devapūjitaḥ |
aruṇena mahābāho ke priyā bhojakāstathā | | 1
pūjāyāṃ tava ke yogyāḥ ke na yogyā bhavanti ca |

yaduvāca mahābāho tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu | | 2
bhāskara uvāca
te priyā mama vai nityaṃ ye na niṃdanti daivatān | | 3
vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣisevāṃ tu vedānāṃ nindanaṃ ca ye |
kurvanti bhojakā jñeyāḥ sarve te mama vairiṇaḥ | | 4
yeṣāṃ bhāryāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ karṣaṇaṃ ye prakurvate |
nṛpasevāṃ khagaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ patitāstu te | |
bhuñjate ye ca śūdrānnaṃ jñeyāste śatravo mama | | 5
pūjā kṛtā tu yā taistu tathārghyaṃ ca khagottama |
pūjāṃ tāmatha cāpyarghyaṃ nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi khecara | | 6

yacchanti ye ca vaiśyāya bhojakā me na te priyāḥ | | 8

ye na jānanti me mudrāṃ kiṅkarāṇāṃ ca nāmataḥ | | 9

tāñchṛṇuṣva khagaśreṣṭha bhūtvā caikāgramānasaḥ | | 1.147.10
devadvijamanuṣyāṇāṃ pitṛrṇāṃ cāpi pūjakāḥ |
te priyā mama vai nityaṃ śaktāḥ pūjayituṃ ravim | | 11
yeṣāṃ muṇḍaṃ śiro nityaṃ ye cābhyaṅgasamanvitāḥ |
vādayanti ca ye śaṅkhaṃ divyāste bhojakā matāḥ | | 12
trikālaṃ ye ca māṃ nityaṃ susnātāḥ krodhavarjitāḥ |
pūjayanti khagaśreṣṭha te priyā mama bhojakāḥ | | 13
vāre madīye naktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ye ca prakurvate |
saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu tathā saṅkramaṇe mama | | 14

te priyāḥ satataṃ mahyaṃ bhojakā garuḍāgraja | | 15
mayi bhaktiṃ na kurvanti brāhmaṇānpūjayanti no |
na te pūjyā na vandyāśca ye dviṣanti ca māṃ sadā | | 16
ye kurvanti mahāyajñānbhojakā garuḍāgraja |
priyāste satataṃ vīra bhojakānāṃ tathottamāḥ |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pañcayajñānpravartayet | | 18
ekabhaktena ye nityaṃ vartante kaśyapātmaja |
bhuñjate na ca ye rātrau bhojakāste priyā mama | | 19
mama vāre ca ye vīra tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca keśava |
na rātrau bhuñjate prājñā matpriyāste magāḥ khaga | | 1.147.20
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ ye tu bhojakā garuḍāgraja |
na yacchanti piturmāturdivase tena me priyāḥ | | 21
itthaṃ bhūtā bhojakā yā māghamāse ca saptamī |
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam | | 22

ghṛtāhutyo guggulaśca kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ tathā | | 23

pañcavarṇā patākāstu śvetaṃ chatraṃ ca me priyam | | 24
nānyavarṇaiḥ kṛtā pūjā tathā prīṇāti māṃ khaga |
yathā kṛtā bhojakena pūjā prīṇāti māṃ sadā | |
nānyadevapratiṣṭhā tu kartavyā bhojakena tu | | 25
vāsudeva uvāca
lakṣaṇaṃ bhojakānāṃ tu tato merumathākramat | | 26
evaṃ bhojyā bhojakāstu na cābhojyāḥ kadācana |
anuṣṭhānavihīnā ye na te bhojyāstu bhojakāḥ | | 27
bhaumāstu brāhmaṇā ye tu anuṣṭhānavivarjitāḥ |
te.apyabhojyā bhavantīha vikarmasthā viśeṣataḥ | | 28
nāsti pūjyatamaṃ kiñcinmāṅgalyaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā |
caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ muktvā bhojakamuttamam | |
pūjite bhojake vīra ādityaḥ pūjito bhavet | | 29
bhuñjate yasya vai gehe bhojakā yadunaṃdana |
tasya bhuṅkte svayaṃ bhānurbrahmā viṣṇustathā śivaḥ | | 1.147.30
yatheha sarvasattvānāṃ pradhānatve sthito raviḥ |
tatheha sarvabhūtānāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate | | 31
tīrthānāṃ tu kurukṣetraṃ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā |
tathā pūjyatamo jñeyaḥ pūjyānāṃ bhojako vibho | | 32
viśeṣeṇa ca saurāṇāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate |

tathottamo bhojakastu samprokto bhāskareṇa tu | | 38
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sāmbopākhyāne bhojakalakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ | 147 |
kālacakravarṇanam
sumanturuvāca
adha sāmbo mahātejā dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ pituḥ kare |
papraccha pitaraṃ sāmbo bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
kutastāta tvayā prāptaṃ cakramādityasannibham | | 2
kimarthaṃ vahate deva divyamāyudhamuttamam |
etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ śrotukāmasya kautukāt | | 3
vāsudeva uvāca
prāptaṃ cakraṃ mayā tasmādbhāskarāllokapūjitāt | |5
nabhogaḥ pañcakārūḍhaḥ sthitaḥ sākṣāddivākaraḥ |
grahāḥ somādayo yasya saṃsthitā nābhimaṇḍale | | 6
ādityā dvādaśa samā areṣu kramaśastathā |
proktaṃ pathiṣu tattvāni pṛthivyādīni yāni vai | |7
etaistattvaiḥ parivyāptaṃ cakraṃ kālātmakaṃ param |
saṃkṣepātte mayākhyātaṃ dattaṃ cakramivāparam | | 8
sāmba uvāca
kathaṃ kālamayaṃ deva cakraṃ kamalamucyate |
vāsudeva uvāca
kamalaṃ hyṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaṭdalaṃ cākṣayāśritam |
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ taddhi tatra sāṅgo raviḥ sthitaḥ | | 1.148.10
yacca kālatrayaṃ loke tannābhitrayamucyate |
māsā arā mahābāho pakṣāśca pradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | | 11
nemī caiva pare prokte ayane dakṣiṇottare |
pathinābhiṣu yoge ca yogākhyāstapanādibhiḥ | | 12
etairvyāptamidaṃ cakraṃ sthūlasūkṣmaprabhedataḥ | | 13
atroddiṣṭeṣu kāleṣu ye noddiṣṭā mayā tava |
yugādikalpaparyantāste.api cātra sthitāḥ kramāt | | 14
yatte kālātmakaṃ cakramidaṃ saṃkṣepato mayā |
kathitaṃ tadviniṣkrāntaṃ pradīptātsūryamaṇḍalāt | | 15
asurāṇāṃ vadhāyedaṃ mayā labdhaṃ divākarāt |
ārādhya tapasā sūryaṃ purā kalpe jagadgurum | |
ataḥ sampūjyayāmyenaṃ grahaistattvairvṛtaṃ sadā | | 16
arkaṃ bhakto hi cakrasthaṃ yaḥ pūjayati bhaktimān |
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ puṣpottarapuraṃ vrajet | | 17
tasmāttaṃ matkulānandaṃ mitraṃ sampūjayāmyaham |
grahaistattvairvṛtaṃ bhaktyā svamantraiḥ satataṃ vibhum | | 18
saptamyāṃ cakramālikhya ye yajanti divākaram |
raktacandanapūrṇena kuṃkumena sugaṃdhinā | | 19
piṣṭagandhādibhirvāpi raktavarṇakamiśrakaiḥ |
raktaiśca kamalaiḥ śuddhaiḥ karavīraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ | | 1.148.20
anyairvā kusumairvanyaiḥ pratyagrairjantuvarjitaiḥ |
aparyuṣitaniśchidraiḥ śubhadhanyairdalairapi | | 21
phalaiḥ pakvairoṣadhibhistathā dūrvāṅkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ |
dhūpaiśca vividhairgandhaistathā vastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ | | 22
bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca peyaiśca coṣyairlehyaiśca śaktitaḥ |
vitānaśobhāsikataiḥ palāśairupaśobhitaiḥ | | 23
chatracāmaraghaṇṭābhirbhūṣaṇairdarpaṇādibhiḥ |
sarvatra jayaghoṣaiśca sampūrṇe pūjayanti ye | sampūrṇānvividhānkāmānnirvighnānprāpnuvanti te | | 25
svacakraṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ vṛddhimāyāti suvrata |
hanyate paracakraṃ ca yatredaṃ pūjyate sakṛt | | 26
saṅkrāntau grahaṇe cāpi likhitvā yo japedidam |
bhavanti niyatāḥ sāmba tasya sānugrahā grahāḥ | | 27
sarvarogavihīnastu sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ |
ciraṃ jīvati dharmātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ | | 28

praṇavena mahābāho caturbāhusamanvitaḥ | |4

saṃjñāṃ ca yaduśārdūla śreyase satataṃ budhaḥ | | 6
āgneyyāṃ lekhakaṃ vīra nairṛtyāmaśvinau tathā |
vāyavyāṃ pūjayeddevaṃ manuṃ vaivasvataṃ vibhum | | 7
aiśānyāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ yamunāṃ lokapāvanīm |
dakṣiṇe ca tato devīṃ paścime garuḍaṃ tathā |
uttare nāgarājānaṃ putramairāvataṃ śubham | | 9
āgneyyāṃ pūjayeddheliṃ praheliṃ nairṛte tathā |
vāyavyāmurvaśīṃ devīmīśāne vinatāṃ tathā | | 1.150.10
tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūrve pūjayedgurumādarāt |
paścime tvarkaputraṃ tu uttare dhiṣaṇaṃ tathā | | 11
aiśāne śaśiputraṃ tu somamāgneyamaṇḍale |
pūjayeddakṣiṇe koṇe nairṛte rāhumādarāt | | 12

caturthāvaraṇe devaṃ pūjayellekhamādarāt | | 13

virūpākṣaṃ nairṛte devaṃ jaleśaṃ paścime tathā | | 14

śriyamṛddhiṃ vibhūtiṃ ca dhṛtiṃ caivonnatiṃ tathā | | 17

indraṃ viṣṇuṃ cāryamaṇaṃ bhagaṃ parjanyameva ca | | 18

pūjayedvaruṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhe caivametāndivākarān | | 19
śiro netre tathā varma astraṃ ca yadusattama |

sūta uvāca
atha rājā mahātejāḥ śatānīko dvijottamam |

na cāpy asya sthitā vipra gatir lokeṣu vidyate | | 3

kīrtitaṃ bhavatā mahyam aśvamedhaśatād varam | | 5

anurādhā tathā jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ sūryapuraḥsarā ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām ||8||
śāṃtiṃ kurvatu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām || 11 ||
pūrveṇa bhāsayaṃtyete sūryayogaparāḥ śubhāḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhaktyā sūryapadāṃbuje || 12 ||
mithunaṃ ca tulā kuṃbhaḥ paścime ca vyavasthitāḥ ||
japaṃtyete sadākālamādityaṃ grahanāya kam || 14 ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ khakholkājñānatatparāḥ ||
satapodattapuṣpābhyāṃ ye smṛtā satataṃ budhaiḥ || 15 ||
siddhāḥ samṛddhatapaso ye cānye vai mahātapāḥ ||
vidyādharā mahātmāno garuḍaśca tvayā saha || 21 ||
ādityaparamā hyete ādityārādhane ratāḥ ||
mahānātho.atha vikhyāto daityaḥ paramavīryavān || 23 ||
balaṃ vīryaṃ ca te ṛddhimārogyaṃ ca bruvaṃtu te ||24||
mahāḍhyo yo hayagrīvaḥ prahlādaḥ prabhayānvitaḥ ||
tānaikāgnimukho daityaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ || 25 ||
tuṣṭiṃ balaṃ tathā.a.arogyaṃ prayacchaṃtu surārayaḥ || 26 ||
vairocano hiraṇyākṣasturvasuśca sulocanaḥ ||
mucakuṃdo mukuṃdaśca daityo raivatakastathā ||27||
bhāvena parameṇemaṃ yajaṃte satataṃ ravim ||
mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāṭopāḥ śaṃkhādyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ || 1.179.30 ||
atipītena dehena visphuradbhogasaṃpadā ||
sa te śāṃti śubhaṃ śīghramacalaṃ saṃprayacchatu ||
atigaureṇa dehena caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ || 39 ||
kuliko nāma nāgendro nityaṃ sūryaparāyaṇaḥ ||
sūryapādā rcanāsaktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ||42||
na taṃ sarpā vihiṃsati na viṣaṃ kramate sadā || 44 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe saura dharmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonāśītyuttaraśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ ||179|| ||
śāntikavarṇanam
sarvagrahapatiṃ devaṃ lokeśaṃ lokanāyakam ||
sūryārcanaratā nadyaḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam ||4||
mahāvibhavasaṃpannaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ ||
sūryārcanasamāsaktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam||8||
lalāṭe hemapaṭalaprabaddhena virājate || 9 ||

yakṣavṛndasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭisamanvitaḥ ||
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahātejā nānāyakṣādhipaḥ khaga ||
sūryabhaktaḥ sūryarataḥ sūryapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ||
sūryaprasādasaṃpannaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam || 14 ||

nānārūpadharā yakṣāḥ sūryabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ || 17 ||
yakṣiṇyo vividhākārāstathā yakṣakumārakāḥ ||
siddhiṃ cāśu prayacchaṃtu nityaṃ ca susamāhitāḥ || 1.180.20 ||
sāgarāḥ sarvataḥ sarve gṛhāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
sūryasyārādhanaparāḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam || 22 ||
pātāle rākṣasā ye tu nityaṃ sūryārcane ratāḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sarve tejasā nityadīpitāḥ || 24 ||

ye ca svargasthitāḥ sarve bhūmigā ye grahottamāḥ || || 31 ||
dakṣiṇe kiraṇe yasya sūryasya ca sthito hariḥ || 32 ||
haro yasya sadā vāme lalāṭe kaṃjajaḥ sthitaḥ ||
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā || 33 ||
jayaḥ sūryāya devāya tamohaṃtre vivasvate ||
jayapradāya sūryāya bhāskarāya namostu te || 35 ||

tamoghnāya jayāyaiva ajitāya namonamaḥ ||37||

gāyatrīdeharūpāya sāvitrīdayitāya ca ||
sumaṃturuvāca ||
evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śāṃtimaruṇasya mahīpate ||
śreyase vainateyasya garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 1.180.40 ||
etasminneva kāle tu suparṇaḥ patravānabhūt ||
tejasā budhasaṃkāśo valena hariṇā samaḥ || 41 ||
prasādāddevadevasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ || 42 ||
evamanye.api rājeṃdra mānavā ye ca rogiṇaḥ ||
asmitkṛte.agnikārye tu virujāste bhavaṃti hi ||
tasmādyatnena kartavyamagnikāryaṃ vidhānataḥ || 43 ||
karaṇīyaṃ ca rājeṃdra mānavaiśca prarogibhiḥ ||
asminkṛte agnikāye virujāste bhavaṃti hi|| 44 ||
graho paghāte durbhikṣa utpāteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
avarṣamāṇe parjanye lakṣahomasamanvitaḥ || 45 ||

cetasā suprasannena sarpiṣā madhunā saha ||

idaṃ ca śāṃtikaṃ kuryādbaliṃ dayātprayatnataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte śriyaṃ devā varṣaṃte kāmanā nṛṇām || 48 ||
vidhinā sarvalokastu dhyāyamāno divākaram|| 49 ||
sa vijitya raṇe śatruṃ mānaṃ ca paramaṃ labhet ||
vyādhibhirnābhibhūyeta putrapautraiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
bhavedādityasadṛśastejasā prabhayā tathā || 51 ||
yānuddiśya paṭhedvīra vācako mānavo bhuvi||
na pīḍyate ca tai rogairvātapittakaphātmakaiḥ || 52 ||
na cotpatti bhayaṃ tasya nābhicārakajaṃ bhavet ||
te sarve praśamaṃ yāṃti śravaṇādasya bhārata|||54 ||
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ ||
itihāsamimaṃ puṇyamagnikāryamanuttamam ||

sūryabhakte sadā deyaṃ sūryeṇa kathitaṃ purā ||
aruṇasya mahābāho garuḍasyāruṇena ca || 1.180.60 ||

smṛtibhedavarṇanam
|| śatānīka uvāca|| ||
paṃcaprakāraṃ dharmaṃ me vada smārtaṃ yathākramam ||
kautukaṃ pṛccha te brahmansamāsavyāsayogataḥ || 1 ||
|| sumanturuvāca || ||
paṃcadhā varṇitaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇu rājansamāsataḥ ||
yathoktaṃ bhāskareṇeha aruṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 ||
sahasrakiraṇaṃ bhānumudayasthaṃ divākaram ||
bhagavandevadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala ||
smṛtidharmānyathātattvaṃ vaktumarhasi pṛcchataḥ || 4 ||
evaṃ pṛṣṭastu bhagavānaruṇena khagādhipaḥ ||
uvāca parayā prītyā pūjayitvā mahīpate || 5 ||
|| || bhāskara uvāca || ||
smṛtidharmaṃ vedamūlaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ garuḍāgraja ||
pūrvānubhūtaṃ yaddhyānamatha tatsmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ || 6 ||
dharmaḥ kriyātmā nirdiṣṭaḥ śreyobhyudayalakṣaṇaḥ ||
sa ca pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ || 7 ||
asya śabdasyānuṣṭhānātsvargo mokṣaśca jāyate ||
iha loke sukhaiśvaryamalaṃ yacca khagādhipa || 8 ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
kathaṃ paṃcavidho hyeṣa prokto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
kasya bhedāstu te paṃca brūhi me devasattama || 9 || ||
|| bhāskara uvāca || ||
vedadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāṃ sa tatparaḥ ||
varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittiko yathā || 1.181.10 ||
varṇatvamekamāśritya adhikāre pravartate ||
savarṇāśramadaṃḍastu bhikṣā daṃḍādiko yathā ||11||
varṇāśramāśramatvaṃ ca yodhikṛtya pravartate||
sa varṇāśramadharmastu daṃḍādyā mekhalā yathā ||12||
yo guṇena pravarteta sa guṇo dharma ucyate ||
yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ pālanaṃ param ||13||
nimittamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate ||
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyo jātidravyaguṇāśrayaḥ ||14||
eṣa tu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ samāsādaviśeṣataḥ ||
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā || 15 ||
sa caturdhā nirūpyastu svarūpaphalasādhanaiḥ ||
pramāṇatastu pratyekasamastaiśca yathākramam || 16 ||
śrutyā saha virodhe tu bādhyate viṣayaṃ vinā ||
vyavasthayā virodhena kāryo yatnaḥ parīkṣyate ||17||
smṛtyā saha virodhena cārthaśāstrasya sādhanam ||
parasparavirodhe tu arthaśāstrasya sādhanam ||18||
adṛṣṭārthe vikalpastu vyavasthāsaṃbhave sati ||
smṛtiśāstravikalpastu ākāṃkṣāpūraṇe sati || 19 ||
vedamūle sthitaṃ tvetadanuṣṭhānaṃ kriyā satī ||
evaṃ śakyavidhānaṃ tu nyāyo hyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 1.181.20 ||
niṣedhavidhirūpaṃ tu dvidhā śāstraṃ khagādhipa ||
ekarūpaṃ vadaṃtyanye bahurūpamathā pare || 21 ||
paṃcaprakārāḥ smṛtaya evaṃ śiṣyavyavasthitāḥ ||
tridhā caturdhā dvedhā vā ekadhā bahudhā khaga || 22 ||
dṛṣṭārthā tu smṛtiḥ kācidadṛṣṭārthā tathāparā ||
anuvādasmṛtistvanyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu paṃcamī ||
sarvā etā vedamūlāḥ smṛtā vai ṛṣibhiḥ svayam || 23 || ||
|| aruṇa uvāca || ||
yā etā bhavatā proktāḥ smṛtayaḥ parvagopane ||
etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi samāsādeva sattama || 24 ||
dṛṣṭārthā kā matā deva adṛṣṭārthā ca kā bhavet ||
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpā kā nyāyamūlā ca kā bhavet ||
anuvādasmṛtiḥ kā syādṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu kā bhavet || 25 ||
evamukto mahātejā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ||
uvāca taṃ khagaṃ vīraṃ praṇataṃ vinayānvitam || 26 ||
|| āditya uvāca || ||
ṣaḍguṇasya svarūpaṃ tu prayogā tkāryagauravāt ||
samayānāmupāyānāṃ yogo vyāsasamāsataḥ || 27 ||
adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca nikṣepaḥ karaṇānāṃ nirūpaṇam ||

saṃdhyopāstistathā kāryā śuno māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet ||
adṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ proktā manunā vinatātmaja || 29 ||
pālāśaṃ dhārayeddaṃḍamubhayārthā vidurbudhāḥ ||

śrutau dṛṣṭaṃ yathā kāryaṃ smṛto tattādṛśaṃ yadi ||
uktānuvādinī sā tu pārivrājyaṃ tathā gṛhāt || 31 ||
ukto dharmaśca saṃkṣepātparibhāṣā ca tadgatā ||
tatsādhanaṃ ca deśādi itthamityabravīdraviḥ || 32 ||
brahmāvartaḥ paro deśa ṛṣiśastastvanaṃtaraḥ ||
madhyadeśastato.apyanya āryāvartastvanaṃtaraḥ || 33 ||

upalabhya yathātattvaṃ sa ca darśitavānṛṣiḥ ||
samyaksaṃsādhanaṃ dharmaḥ kartavyastvadhikāriṇā || 37 ||
niṣkāmena sadā vīra kāmyaṃ rūpānvitena ca ||
ācārayuktaḥ śraddhālurvedajño.adhyātmaciṃtakaḥ ||
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaśca yaḥ || 38 ||
|| aruṇa uvāca || ||

|| āditya uvāca || ||

|| || āditya uvāca || ||
uktaṃ dharmasya rūpaṃ tu sādhikāraṃ sanātanam ||

|| aruṇa uvāca || ||
