haṃsasvarāmekavarṇāṃ madhupiṃgalalocanām ||
tādṛśīṃ varayetkanyāṃ gṛhārthī khagasattama || 43 ||
dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo.agraje sthite ||
parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ ||44 ||
parivittiḥ parivettā ca yayā sa parividyate ||
klībe deśāṃtarasthe vā patite vrajite tathā ||
yogaśāstrābhiyukte ca na doṣaḥ parivedane ||46||
jātyaṃdhe badhire mūke na doṣaḥ parivedane || 47 ||
na śrāddhaṃ tu kaniṣṭhasya vikulāya ca kanyakā ||
varaśca kulaśīlābhyāṃ na śuddhyeta kadācana ||
na maṃtrāḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na ca kanyā vṛtā bhavet || 48 ||
udvāhitā tu yākanyā na ca prāptā tu maithunam ||
punarabhyeti bhartāraṃ yathā kanyā tathaiva sā || 49 ||
samākṣipya matāṃ kanyāṃ pitā tvakṣatayonikām ||
kulaśīlavate dadyānna syāddoṣaḥ khagādhipa || 1.182.50 ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
ete.aṣṭau prabhavāḥ proktā vivāhā ye jagatpate ||
lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi caiteṣāṃ samāsāttimirāpaha || 51 ||
|| āditya uvāca || ||
śubhāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kulaśīlaguṇānvitām ||
alaṃkṛtyārhate dānaṃ vivāho brāhma ucyate || 52 ||
saha dharmakriyāhetordānaṃ samayabaṃdhanāt ||
alaṃkṛtyaiva kanyāyāḥ prājāpatyaḥ sa ucyate || 53 ||
pradānaṃ yatra kanyāyāḥ sahagomithunena tu ||
savarṇāyāḥ sagotrāyāstamārṣamṛṣayo viduḥ|| 54 ||
aṃtarvedyāṃ samānīya kanyāṃ kanakamaṃḍitām ||
ṛtvije caiva yaddānaṃ vivāho daivasaṃjñakaḥ || 55 ||
ete vivāhāścatvāro dharmakāmārthadāyakāḥ ||
aśulkā brahmaṇā proktāstārayaṃti kuladvayam || 56 ||
caturṣveteṣu dattāyāmutpanno yaḥ sutaḥ striyām ||
dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca punātyāsaptamānpitṛrn || 57 ||
vivikte svayamanyo.anyaṃ strīpuṃsoryaḥ samāgamaḥ ||
prītihetuḥ sa gāṃdharvo vivāhaḥ paṃcamo mataḥ ||58||
śulkaṃ pradāya kanyāyā haraṇaṃ vyasanādapi||
prasāda heturuktoyamāsuraḥ saptamastathā || 1.182.60 ||
suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati ||
sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaścāṣṭamodhamaḥ || 61 ||
etānsaśulkānsāmānyānvivāhāṃścaturo viduḥ ||
kevalaṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vīryaṃ chittvā hi rākṣasaḥ || 62 ||
prāpte pūrvavivāhe tu vidhirvaivāhikaḥ śivaḥ ||
kartavyastu tribhirvarṇaiḥ samayenāgnisākṣikaḥ || 63 ||
doṣavatyāḥ pradāne tu dātuḥ ṣaṇṇavatirdamaḥ ||
syāttu śulkapradāne ca kanyāyāścāpavarjane ||64||
mokṣopavartanaṃ dveṣaḥ strīdhanasya nivartanam ||
ākāṃkṣā tīrthasaṃrodhastyāgahetuśca vakṣyate || 65 ||
parasparasya saṃbaṃdhānmokṣaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ smṛtaḥ ||
na syādanyataraḥ prīto roṣātsāṃpratikādapi || 66 ||
bādhate cetpatirbhāryāṃ sa tu dveṣa iti smṛtaḥ ||
vṛttirābharaṇaṃ śulkaṃ lābhaśca strīdhanaṃ bhavet||67||
bhoktṛstu svayamevedaṃ pratijñāhananaṃ bhavet ||
vṛthā mokṣeṇa bhogena striyai dadyātsavṛddhikam ||68||
āpattisamaye jāte strīdhanaṃ bhoktumarhati ||
ākāṃkṣetāṣṭavarṣāṇi bhartāpi prasavaṃ striyāḥ || 69 ||
jāyante yadi no putrāstasyāṃ yatne mahatyapi ||
tato viṃdeta putrārthī dharmataḥ kulajāṃ striyam|| 1.182.70 ||
putralābhātparaṃ loke nāsti hi prasavārthinaḥ ||
etāṃ śulkasya tāṃ bhuktvā anyāṃ labdhuṃ yadīcchati ||
samastāstoṣayitvārthaiḥ sūryoḍhāṃ paramāṃ varet||71||
ekā śūdrasya vaiśyasya dve tisraḥ kṣatriyasya tu||
catasro brāhmaṇasya syurbhāryā rājño yatheṣṭataḥ || 72 ||
atīrthagamanātpuṃsastīrthe saṃgāhanātstriyāḥ ||
ubhayordharmalopaḥ syātsveṣveva tu viśeṣataḥ || 73 ||
yaugapadye tu tīrthānāṃ vivāhakramaśo vrajet ||
tatsāmyaṃ jīvaputrā vā grahaṇakramaśopi vā||74||
brāhmādibhirvivāhaistu saṃskṛtau tau khagādhipa ||
aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ vainateya uśaṃti vai || 75||
gāṃdharvaścāsuro rakṣaḥ paiśācastvaṣṭamo.adhamaḥ || 76 ||
praśastāḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ viprādīnāṃ tu mānataḥ ||
pratigrahādayo baddhā vivāhā brāhmaṇasya tu ||77||
kṣatriyasyāpi deyā tu pratigrahavivarjitā ||
pravṛttiṃ kecidicchaṃti dānamityapare striyāḥ ||
pāvanaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vivāhaṃ paricakṣate ||78||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe saptamīkalpe brāhme parvaṇi sūryāruṇasaṃvāde vivāhavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 182 |||7||
śrāddhavidhikathāvarṇanam
bhāskara uvāca||
kuryātpaṃcamahāyajñānadhikāro dvijasya saḥ||
sadā sadāna kṛtyānāṃ phalārthamapare sthitāḥ||
nityānitya miti prāhuranuṣaṃgātphalaṃ pare ||2||
atitheḥ paritoṣāya paricaryā vidhīyate ||
adṛṣṭaniyamādṛṣṭamārogyāntaṃ ca varjanam ||3||
tisroṣṭakāstu kartavyā madhyāvartī caturthikā||
śākapāyasapūpaistu māṃsena tu caturthikā||4||
pratipadi kriyate yattu catuṣpārvaṇamucyate ||
svagṛhyoktavidhānena tattu pakṣādi kīrtyate||5||
pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ goṣṭhaśuddhyarthamuttamam||
karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ vaidikaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam ||6|| ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvādaśadhā vibho ||
tasya sarvasya mā brūhi lakṣaṇaṃ vai pṛthakpṛthak || 7 ||
nityaṃ kimucyate śrāddhaṃ kiṃ vā naimittikaṃ bhavet ||
kāmyādi devadeveśa eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vada || 8 ||
|| āditya uvāca || ||
ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ tannityaṃ khaga kīrtitam ||
vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu || 9 ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate ||
tatsadaiva prakartavyamayugmānbhojayeddvijān || 1.183.10 ||
kāmayuktaṃ hi tatkāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye ||
pārvaṇena vidhānena tadapyuktaṃ khagādhipa || 11 ||
vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate ||
sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvāhṇe tūpavītinā ||12||
gaṃdhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayam||
ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetajjñeyaṃ sapiṃḍanam ||
nityena tulyaṃ śeṣaṃ syādekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api||14||
darśe vai kriyate yattu tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam ||
parvaṇi kriyate yacca tatpārvaṇamiti sthitiḥ ||
gobhyaśca kriyate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhaśrāddhamucyate || 15 ||
bahūnāṃ viduṣāṃ saṃpatsukhārthaṃ pitṛtṛptaye ||
kriyate śuddhaye yadvai brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ||
śudyarthamiti tatproktaṃ vainateya manīṣibhiḥ || 16 ||
niṣekakāle some ca sīmatonnayane tathā ||
jñeyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śrāddhaṃ tacca karmāṃgameva ca || || 17 ||

gaccheddeśāṃtare yastu śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu sarpiṣā ||
tadyatnārthamiti proktaṃ pradiśecca na saṃśayaḥ ||18||
śarīropacaye śrāddhamaśvavṛddhyarthameva ca ||
puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyamaupacārikamucyate || 19 ||

mṛte.ahani punaryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt ||
mātuśca khagaśārdūla vatsarāṃte mṛte.ahani || 21 ||
nāhaṃ tasya khagaśreṣṭha pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ ||
na brahmā na ca vai rudro na cānye devatāgaṇāḥ || 22 ||
tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte.ahani ||
nareṇa khagaśārdūla bhojakena viśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
bhojako yastu vai śrāddhaṃ na karoti khagādhipa ||
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ satataṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte.ahani |||27|
tato bhavati duṣṭātmā nagare sūkaraḥ khaga || 25 ||
anūruruvāca || ||
na jānāti dinaṃ yastu na māsaṃ vibudhādhipa ||
mṛtau yatra mahāprājña pitarau sa kathaṃ naraḥ ||
śrāddhaṃ karotu vai tābhyāṃ vidhivadvatsarātmakam || 26 ||
|| āditya uvāca || ||
na jānāti naro yastu mṛtānāṃ vinatātmaja ||
māsaṃ dinaṃ mṛtānāṃ tu pitṛrṇāṃ khagasattama || 27 ||
yathā kuryātkhagaśreṣṭha śṛṇu kṛtsnaṃ samāsataḥ ||
mṛtāhaṃ yo na jānāti mānavo vinatātmaja || 28 ||

māse mārgaśire vīra māghe vā vidhivatkhaga || || 29 ||
viśeṣato bhojanena yo māṃ pūjyate sadā ||
prītaye mama vai tena saṃpūjyāḥ pitaraḥ sadā || 1.183.30 ||
mameṣṭāḥ pitaro nityaṃ gāvo viprāśca suvrata ||
tasmācca te sadā pūjyā madbhaktena viśeṣataḥ || 31 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme śrāddhavidhikathanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ ||183|| ||
brāhmaṇadharmavidhivarṇanam
prakhyāte pratyayenaiva praśnapūrvaṃ pratigrahaḥ ||
yajane.adhyāpane vāde ṣaḍvidho vedavikrayaḥ || 1 ||
veda vikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā cāvarjitaṃ dhanam ||
na deyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klībātkhagādhipa || 2 ||
anuyogena yo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya pratigraham ||
sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇāstadanaṃtaram || 3 ||
vaiśvadevena yo hīna ādityasya ca karmaṇaḥ ||
yeṣāmadhyayanaṃ nāsti ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ||
akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte so.abudhaḥ khaga ||
vṛthā tenānnapākena yamayoniṃ vrajettu saḥ || 7 ||
vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāpte so.atithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ || 8 ||
naikagrāmīṇamatithiṃ viprasāṃgatikaṃ tathā ||
aciṃtyobhyāgato yasmāttasmādatithirucyate || 9 ||
aciṃtyaḥ sa tu vai nāmnā vaiśvadeva upāgataḥ ||
atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānna punaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ || 1.184.10 ||
yāvacca prāpnuyādannaṃ kṛtāśīḥ snātako dvijaḥ ||
tasyānnasya caturbhāgaṃ haṃtakāraṃ viduḥ khaga||11||
grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā catuṣkālaṃ caturguṇam ||
puṣkalāni ca catvāri haṃtakāro vidhīyate || 12 ||
ārūḍho naiṣṭhikaṃ dharmaṃ yastu pracyavate punaḥ ||
cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsamiti viddhi khagādhipa || 13 ||
ārūḍhapatitāpatyā brāhmaṇo vṛṣalena ca ||
brāhmaṇī kulaṭā nityaṃ svakaṃ tyaktvā patiṃ khaga ||
anyasya viśate gehe brāhmaṇasya khagādhipa||15||
utpadyate tu yastasyā brāhmaṇena mahāmate ||
sa cāṃḍālo mahānprokto mahācāṃḍāla ityuta||16||
yastu pravrajito bhūtvā punaḥ sevati maithunam||
paṃcagavyena śuddhiḥ syādityāha mama dehakṛt||17||
abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ vṛṣalena nimaṃtritam ||
brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadacchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadat ||
upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ ca paceddvijaḥ ||
abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ purohitaḥ ||1.184.20||
kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ || 22 ||
āyasena tu pātreṇa yadannamupadīyate ||
mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ ||
upavāse na duṣyaṃti daṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam ||27||
guṇanvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhavya tikramaḥ || 28 ||
brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite ||
jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate || 29 ||
bhojanenaiva dānena dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam || 1.184.30 ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
evameva jagannātha devadeva jagatpate ||
kiṃ tu yatte purā deva śrutaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 31 ||
gadato nāradasyaiva śṛṇu tvaṃ vibudhādhipa ||
gadato me suraśreṣṭha dharmyamarthaṃ sukhāvaham || 32 ||
satyaniṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ yastu śuklajātiṃ priyaṃvadam ||
mūrkhaṃ pākhaṃḍinaṃ vāpi vṛttihīnamathāpi vā || 33 ||
atikramya naro ghoraṃ narakaṃ pātayetkhaga||
sapta parānsapta pūrvānpuruṣānātmanā saha || 34 ||
tasmānnātikramedrājā brāhmaṇaṃ prātiveśikam ||
saṃbandhatastathāsannaṃ dauhitraṃ vidyate tathā || 35 ||

nātikramennarastvetānsumūrkhānapi gopate ||
atikramya mahadraudraṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 36 ||
|| āditya uvāca || ||
evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi khecara ||
mamāpyavagataṃ vīra brāhmaṇaṃ na parīkṣayet || 37 ||

madhu māṃsaṃ surāṃ somaṃ lākṣādyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ||
vikrīyānyatamaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 45 ||
guḍaṃ tilaṃ tathā nīlaṃ keśāngodhūmakānyavān ||

auṣṭramāvikadugdhaṃ ca annaṃ mṛtakasūtake ||
gavāṃ śṛṃgodake snāto mahānadyāśca saṃgame ||
samudradarśanādvāpi śunā daṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet || 48 ||

tiṣṭhanvāpyatha vā gacchañchunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ||
vajraṃ prāśya śuciḥ syādvai yathāha bhagavānmanuḥ || 1.184.50 ||
saghṛtaṃ ca tato bhuktvā vrataśeṣaṃ samācaret || 51 ||
brāhmaṇī tu śunā daṣṭā some dṛṣṭaṃ samācaret ||
yadā na dṛśyate somaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 52 ||
somamārgeṇa sā pūrvā pañcapūtena śudhyati || 53| ||
brāhmaṇasya brahmadvāre pūya śoṇitasaṃbhave ||
krimibhirdaśyate yaśca niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vacmi te || 54 ||
gavāṃ tatra purīṣeṇa trikālaṃ snānamācaret ||
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā kṛmidaṣṭo viśudhyati || 55 ||

etadvinirdiśetprājñaḥ prāyaścittaṃ khagādhipa || 56 ||
nābhikaṇṭhāṃtare vīra yadā cotpadyate kṛmiḥ ||
ṣaḍrātraṃ tu tadā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 57 ||
yadā daśaṃti śirasi kṛmayo vinatātmaja ||
kṛcchraṃ tadā caretprājñaḥ śuddhaye kaśyapātmaja || 58 ||

mātṛśrāddhavidhivarṇanam
|| || āditya uvāca || ||
rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā hi sā ||

|| anūruruvāca || ||

|| āditya uvāca || ||
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi mātṛśrāddhavidhiṃ khaga ||

savyena pāṇinā vīra vidhivatkhagasattama ||
mātre pramātre tanmātre nirvapetpūrvatomukhaḥ || 11 ||
piturmātre tu tanmātre nirvapedvidhiva tkhaga ||
vṛddhāyai prapitāmahyai tathānyaṃ nirvapedbudhaḥ || 12 ||
evamuddiśya vai mātṛrḥ ṣaṭ piṃḍānnirvapetkhaga ||
aṣṭāśayeddvijānvīra mātṛśrāddhe khagā dhipa ||
navamaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhojayedvidhivatkhaga || 13 ||
nāṃdīmukhāṃstānuddiśya pitṛrnpaṃca dvijottamān ||

yo hyagniḥ sa dvijo vīnda maṃtradarśibhirucyate|| || 17 ||

tenaiva saha bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate ||18||

|| vyāsa uvāca || ||

kartavyaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā evaṃ tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ ||
mahāpātakino.apyāśu labhaṃte ciṃtitaṃ phalam || 9 ||
dīptāyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya bhavānyā śiraso nyaset || 1.205.10 ||
digvidikṣu nyasedastramiṃdrādi diśottarāṃtikam ||
karṇikāyāṃ nyasennetraṃ svabījena tu vārcayeta ||1 1||
puṣpairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdayāni krameṇa tu ||
pūjayitvā tu vidhivadgarbhaṃ paścāttu maṃtravit || 12 ||
bāhyataḥ pūrvato maṃdaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā ||
viṣāṇaṃ paścime pūjya uttareṇa tu bhārgavam || 13 ||
āgneyyāṃ ca kujaṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ bhānudehajam ||
vāyavyāṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇamaiśānyāṃ vikacaṃ nṛpa || 14 ||
sugaṃdhairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva manoramaiḥ || 15 ||
krameṇa pūjayedbhānuṃ lokapālairgrahaiḥ saha ||
maṃtraiḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 16 ||
anena vidhinā yatra devaḥ saṃpūjyate raviḥ ||
na caurāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāpi narakādbhayam || 17 ||
varṣopalaviṣādibhyo bhayaṃ tatra na vidyate ||
sukhamārogyamānaṃdaṃ subhikṣamacalāṃ śriyam || 18 ||
tejobiṃbāṃtamadhyastha ādityaḥ paramārthataḥ ||
yaṣṭavyaḥ sādhakairnityaṃ na ratho na ca vājinaḥ || 19 ||
ityeṣa vidhirākhyāto mayā bhīṣma tavākhilaḥ ||
yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevo divākaram || 1.205.20 ||
itthaṃ pūjya vivasvantaṃ hṛdbījena visarjayet ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme bhīṣmavyāsasaṃvāde mahādevā rcanavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcādhikadviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 205 ||
sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanam
|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||
maṃtroddhāraṃ paraṃ brūhi mudrāśaktisamanvitam ||
rūpavarṇa samaṃ caiva paurāṇikamanuttamam || 1 ||
|| vyāsa uvāca || ||
śṛṇu bhīṣma mahābāho yathā vakṣyāmi tenagha ||
paurāṇikānāṃ maṃtrāṇāmuddhāraṃ vaidikādṛte ||2||
varṇarephasamāyuktaṃ vidrumenaiva bhūṣitam ||
aṃtasthānāṃ hi aṃtyaṃ vai brahmadaivatyamucyate ||3||
biṃdurephasamāyuktaṃ dīrghayā mātrayā tathā ||
dīkṣākṣaraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ||4||
tṛtīyaṃ tu tathā proktaṃ savisargaṃ janādhipa ||
sa tṛtīyo budhaiḥ prokto rudradaivata eva hi ||5||
bhāskaroyaṃ mahānsākṣānmaṃtramūrtistrirakṣaraḥ||
durlabhaḥ paramo guhyastridevo devapūjitaḥ ||6||
yastvidaṃ japate bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
tataśca mudrāṃ vakṣyāmi sānnidhya kāraṇaṃ param ||7||
aṃguliṃ kṣārayettasminvimudreti ca socyate ||8||
anayā baddhayā rājanbhāskarasya priyo bhavet ||
mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu mātṛvatparirakṣati || 9 ||
hṛdayaṃ tasya vijñeyaṃ yadakṣaravaraṃ smṛtam ||
vidrumopari saṃchannaṃ hṛdgataṃ tadgataṃ sadā || 1.206.10 ||
śirasyarkamiti proktaṃ devadevasya bhārata ||
aṣṭākṣarā tu vidyeyamādityasya mahātmanaḥ ||
yaḥ smaretsādhakastvenaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate || 12 ||
akāreṇa samāyuktaṃ biṃdurephasamanvitam ||
hakāramagnidaivatyaṃ kavacaṃ bhāskarapriyam|| 13 ||
ekākṣaramidaṃ proktamabhedyaṃ yaḥ smaredidam ||
duṣṭānāṃ caiva vighnānāṃ nāśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
savisargo repha iti astramekākṣaraṃ smṛtam ||
nāśayedduṣṭakarmāṇi sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
kaniṣṭhenāmike yojye tarjanyau madhyame tathā || || 16 ||
hṛcchiraḥ saśikhā carmā mudreyaṃ vyomasaṃjñitā ||
muṣṭivakrocchritaṃ kuryātsavyahastasya tarjanīm ||17||
mālaśabdakṛtādistu mudrā hyastrasya kīrtitā ||
trāsanī nāma vikhyātā sarvaviprabhayaṃkarī || 18 ||
karṇabiṃdusamāyuktaṃ yaṃ caturthaṃ mahāmate ||
bhāskarasya tvidaṃ netramagridaivatamucyate ||| || 19 ||
smaraḥ syātsādhakeṃdrāṇāṃ duraṃto nāśane dhruvam ||
madhyamā tarjanī caiva savyahastasya cocchritam|| 1.206.20 ||
kaniṣṭhānāmike kuṃcya aṃguṣṭhena tataḥ kramet ||
netrābhyāṃ sparśayedenāṃ netramudrā prakīrtitā || 21 ||
govṛṣā nāma vikhyātā darśayeddivyagocaram ||
rāṃ dīptāriṃ tataḥ sūkṣmārīṃ jayā bhīṣma ucyate || 22 ||
ubhāhvārūṃ vibhūtiśca vimalā reṃ prakīrtitā ||
aghahā ca mahābāho vidyutā rauṃ prakīrtitā || 23 ||
govṛṣā nāma raṃ sarvaṃ vīrabhadrakarī tathā ||
ityetā bījarūpāstu kathitāścaiva śaktayaḥ || 24 ||
uttānau tu karau kṛtvā savyākuṃcya tatoṃgulīḥ ||
kuryādupari cāṃguṣṭhau cālayeta punaḥpunaḥ || 25 ||
sarvāsāṃ caiva śaktīnāmetā mudrāḥ pradarśayet ||
nāmnā ca vidyutā caiva navamī sarvatomukhī || 26 ||
nāmānyetāni śaktīnāṃ samāsātkathitāni tu ||
sabījāni mahābāho mayā snehena bhārata || 27 ||
grahāṇāṃ śṛṇu bījāni rūpaṃ ca gadato mama ||
sarvatra bhaṃ tathā khaṃ ca kaṃjakūtuhalodvaha || 28 ||
oṃkārā dīpitāḥ sarve namaskārāṃtayojitāḥ ||
pūjākāle prayoktavyā japakāle tathaiva ca || 29 ||
homakāle tu svāhāṃtaṃ maṃtraṃ ṣaṭkārasaṃyutam ||
sarve biṃduyutā bhīṣma śikhā biṃduvibhūṣitāḥ || 1.206.30 ||
somādyāḥ ketuparyaṃtā grahā hyevaṃ prakīrtitāḥ ||
etā mudrāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhipradāyikāḥ || 31 ||
sumukhau tu karau kṛtvā śliṣṭau caiva prasāritau ||
iyaṃ mudrā namaskāre grahasānnidhyakārikā || || 32 ||
maṃtroddhārastavākhyāto rahasyo durlabho nṛpa ||
śṛṇuṣva rūpaṃ devānāṃ dhyānakāle hyupasthite || 33 ||
japāvarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitam||
tathaikavaktraṃ dvibhujaṃ somapaṃkajakaṃdharam ||
maṃḍalena ca rūpaṃ tu madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam || 35 ||
mārtaṃḍasya idaṃ rūpaṃ śuciḥ snāto jiteṃdriyaḥ||
trikālaṃ yaḥ smaredbhīma ekacitto vyavasthitaḥ || 36 ||
so.acirādbhavate loke vittena dhanadopamaḥ ||
mucyate sarvabhogaistu tejasvī balavānbhavet || 37 ||
hṛdayaṃ cottamāṃgaṃ ca śikhā vai vaktrameva ca ||
varadā.abhayahastāśca dhyātavyā sādhakena tu ||
taḍitpuṃjanibhaṃ śastraṃ raudraṃ caṃdrakarālinam || 39 ||
viśeṣaḥ kathito hyeṣa kāmarūpaḥ svabhāvataḥ ||
dīptā dīptaśikhākārā dhyātavyā mama śaktayaḥ || 1.206.40 ||
śvetavarṇaṃ smaretsomaṃ raktavarṇaṃ kujaṃ smaret ||
saumyamaṣṭāpadābhaṃ ca guruṃ ca pītavarṇakam || || 41 ||
śaṃkhakṣīranibhaṃ śvetaṃ kāṇaṃ cāṃjanasaṃnibham ||
rajāvartanibhaṃ rāhuṃ dhūmraṃ ca vikacaṃ smaret || 42 ||
vāmahastau kaṭinyastau dakṣiṇau cābhayapradau ||
raktabhrūraktanetrāsya ardhakāyakṛtāṃjaliḥ || 43 ||
iti bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ ye dhyāyaṃti nṛpottama ||
labhaṃte te mahāsiddhimacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ || || 44 ||
tavākhyātamidaṃ vaktraṃ grahāṇāṃ bhīṣma kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ || 45 ||
anena vidhinā bhīṣma sadā devaṃ divākaram||
itthaṃ pūjayamānastu sarvadevaṃ divākaram ||
brahmahatyāvinirmukto mahādevatvamāpnuyāt|| 47 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharmeṣu sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || || 206 ||
ādityapūjāvidhivarṇanam
|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ bhāskarasya tvayoditam ||
|| || vyāsa uvāca || ||
evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi bhārata ||
nāsti sūryasamaṃ brahma nāsti sūryasamaṃ hutam ||
nāsti sūryasamo dharmo nāsti sūryasamaṃ dhanam || 3 ||
nāsti sūryādṛte kāmo nāsti sūryādṛte padam ||
nāsti sūryasamo baṃdhurnāsti sūryasamaḥ suhṛt || 4 ||
nāsti sūryasamā mātā nāsti sūryasamo guruḥ ||
nāsti sūryasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na pavitraṃ tataḥ param || 5 ||
tamekaṃ daivataṃ vidyānnaivāpyarkaparāyaṇam ||
lokānāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṛrṇāṃ cāpi bhārata || 6 ||
te prapannāstu ye bhaktyā muktāste bhavasāgarāt|| 7 ||
rājā corā grahāḥ sarpā dāridryaṃ duḥkhasaṃpadaḥ ||
naite pīḍayituṃ śaktāḥ prasanne bhāskare sati || 8 ||
||vyāsa uvāca || ||
evaṃ tāta mahābāho devo bhāskaratatparaḥ ||
sa pūjyaḥ sa namaskāryaḥ sa hi dhyātavya eva ca || 9 ||
pratyakṣadevatā hyeṣā devadevoyamādarāt ||
atha kiṃ bahunoktena yadvakṣyāmi nibodha me || 1.207.10 ||
pūjayettanayaḥ pāpī tathādityadinairapi ||
prāpte sūryadine bhaktyā bhānuṃ saṃpūjya śraddhayā ||
naktaṃ karoti puruṣaḥ sa yātyamaraloktām || 12 ||
yastu pūrvaṃ raverbhaktyā pañcaratnasamanvitam||
nivedayati maṃtreṇa sa yātyamaralokatām || 13 ||
mārtaṃḍaprītaye yastu kuryācchrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
kṛtvopavāsaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ yastu mānavaḥ ||
karoti vidhivacchrāddhaṃ bhāskaraḥ prīyatāmiti||15||
sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
mānavo yastu saptamyāṃ yoṣidvāpi divākaram ||16||
viśeṣatastasya dine grahaṇe ca narādhipa || 17 ||
iti bhīṣma vijānīhi na devo bhāskarātpriyaḥ ||
ādityamekaṃ paramaṃ devadeveṣu pūjitam || 18 ||
ratnaparvatamāruhya yathā bhuvi narādhipāḥ ||
sattvānurūpaṃ gacchanti ratnabhāgānaśeṣataḥ || 19 ||
tathā bhānuṃ samārādhya prāpnuvaṃti narāḥ phalam||
mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnoti cātha vā.amaratāṃ vrajet ||
atha kiṃ bahunoktena śṛṇu tvaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 21 ||
brahmādayo devagaṇā bhānumārādhya bhārata ||
manoharāṇi divyāni divi sthānānyavāpnuvan || 22 ||
acalāni mahābhāgāḥ sarvapāpaharāṇi ca || 23 ||
|| sumanturuvāca || ||
ityuktvā bhagavānvyāsastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||
bhīṣmo.api pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā bhānuṃ vidhānataḥ ||24||
tathā tvamapi rājendra pūjayemaṃ divākaram ||
pūjayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā sthānaṃ yāsyasi śāśvatam ||25||
yathā gataḥ sa bhagavānvyāso bhīṣmaśca mānada ||
sakṛtprapūjya saptamyāṃ bhaktyā devaṃ divākaram || 26 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe vyāsabhīṣmasaṃvāde ādityapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptādhikadviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 207 ||
saptamīvratavarṇanam
|| śatānīka uvāca || ||
punarme brūhi saptamyāṃ prītaye bhāskarasya tu ||
upoṣito bhavatīha naro yastu dvijottama || 1 ||
|| sumanturuvāca || ||
kathitāḥ sapta saptamyaḥ punarasminmahāmate ||
bahavaḥ kuruśārdūla bhūyastvetāḥ śṛṇuṣva me || 2 ||
svayaṃ yāḥ kathitāḥ pūrvamādityena khagādhipa ||
aruṇasya mahābāho saptamyaḥ sapta pūjitāḥ || 3 ||
arkasaṃpuṭakairekā dvitīyā maricaistathā ||
tṛtīyā niṃbapatraiśca caturthī phalasaptamī || 4 ||
anodanā pañcamī syātṣaṣṭhī vijayasaptamī ||
saptamī kāmikā jñeyā vidhiṃ tāsāṃ nibodha me || 5 ||
śuklapakṣe ravidine dakṣiṇe cottarāyaṇe ||
sa tāṃ su brahmacārī syācchaucayukto jitendriyaḥ ||
sūryārcanarato dāṃto japahomaparastathā || 7 ||
pañcamyāmeva puruṣaḥ kuryānnitya manātmakam ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ na maithunaṃ gacchenmadhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet || 8 ||
arkasaṃpuṭakairekāṃ tathānyāṃ maricairnayet ||
tathāparāṃ niṃbapatraiḥ phalākhyāyāṃ phalaṃ caret || 9 ||
anodanāmannarahita upāsīta yathāvidhi ||
ahorātraṃ vāyubhakṣaḥ kuryādvijayasaptamīm || 1.208.10 ||
tathaikāṃ saptamīṃ kṛtvā pratimāsaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
kuryādyathāvidhi mudā tataḥ kurvīta kāmikām || 11 ||
āsāṃ likhitvā nāmāni patrakeṣu pṛthakpṛthak ||
tāni sarvāṇi patrāṇi kṣipedabhinave ghaṭe || 12 ||
tadarthaṃ yo na jānāti lokavāhyopi vā naraḥ ||
tena hyuddhārayedekaṃ na kuryācca vicāraṇām ||13||
tenaiva vidhinā yastu pratimāsaṃ ca tattapaḥ ||
saptaiva yāvatsaptamyo vijñeyā sā tu kāmikā || 14 ||
ityetāḥ sapta saptamyaḥ svayaṃ proktā vivasvatā ||
kurvīta yo naro bhaktyā sa yātyarkasado nṛpa || 15 ||
arkasaṃpuṭakairvittamacalaṃ saptapauruṣam ||
maricaiḥ saṃgamaḥ syādvai priyaiḥ putrādibhiḥ sadā || 16 ||
sarvarogāḥ praṇaśyaṃti niṃbapatrairna saṃśayaḥ ||
phalaistu putrapautrāśca dauhitraścāpi puṣkalaḥ || 17 ||
ato dhanaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā ||
tathā paśurhiraṇyaṃ ca ārogyaṃ satataṃ nṛpa || 18 ||
upoṣya vijayāṃ śatrūnrājañjayati nityaśaḥ ||
sādhayetkāmadā kāmānvidhivatsamupāsitā || 19 ||
putrakāmo labhetputramarthakāmorthamakṣayam ||
vidyākāmo labhedvidyāṃ rājyārthī rājyamāpnuyāt ||
kṛtsnānkāmāndadātyeṣā kāmadā kurunandana || 1.208.20 ||
naro vā yadi vā nārī yathoktaṃ saptamīvratam ||
karoti niyatātmā vai sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 21 ||
na teṣāṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcidastīti durlabham ||
ye bhaktyā lokanāthasya vratinaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 22 ||
vrataistu vividhairvīra tapobhirvā suduṣkaraiḥ ||
na tatphalamavāpnoti yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ || 23 ||
tīrthābhiṣecanairvāpi dānahomārcanaistathā ||
yatphalaṃ ca pūjayituṃ saptamyāṃ prāpya mokṣadam ||
mokṣārthī pārthivaśreṣṭha yathāha bhagavānraviḥ || 24 ||
kṛtvādityadine naktaṃ bhaktyā saṃpūjayedravim ||
acalaṃ sthānamāpnoti mānavaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
sūryaloke ca niyataṃ tasya vāso na saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
yastu pūjayate bhaktyā saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ naraḥ ||
brahmeṃdrarudralokeṣu tasyāpratihatā gatiḥ ||26 ||
nāṃdho na kuṣṭhī na klībo na vyaṃgo na ca nirdhanaḥ ||
kule tasya bhavedvīra yaścaretsaptamīvratam || 27 ||
bhāryārthī rūpasaṃpannāṃ striyaṃ putrāṃśca bhārata || 28 ||
lobhātpramādānmohācca vratabhaṃgo yadā bhavet ||
tadā trirātraṃ nāśnīyātkuryādvā keśamuṃḍanam |||29||
saptaiva yāvatsaptamyo bhavaṃti ca khageśvara||1.208.30||
abhyarcya sūryasaptamyāṃ mālyadhūpādibhirnaraḥ ||
bhojayitvā dvijāñchaktyā prāpnuyātsvargamakṣayam||31||
saptamyāṃ vipramukhyebhyo hiraṇyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati||
sa tadakṣayyamāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati ||32||
itīdaṃ kīrtitaṃ vīra saptamīvratamuttamam||
bhūya evābhidhāsyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa ||33||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme sūryāruṇasaṃvāde saptasaptamīvratavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādhikadviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
saptamīvratavarṇanam
|| sumanturuvāca || ||
yaḥ kṣipedgomayāhāraḥ śuklā dvādaśa saptamīḥ ||
athavā yāvakāhāraḥ śīrṇaparṇāśano.api vā || 1 ||
kṣīrāśī caikabhakto vā bhikṣāhārotha vā punaḥ ||
jalāhāropi vā vidvānpūjayitvā divākaram || 2 ||
puṣpopahārairvividhaiḥ padmasaugandhikotpalaiḥ ||
nānāprakārairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpairguggulucaṃdanaiḥ || 3 ||
kṛṣṇagaṃdhapāyasādyairvicitraiḥ suvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
arcayitvā dvijāñcchreṣṭhānhiraṇyānnādibhirnaraḥ || 4 ||
sa tatphalamavāpnoti kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ||
yadeha tapyate vīra prāpyate kevalaṃ raveḥ || 5
evaṃ bhaktyā vivasvaṃtaṃ pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā nāmāni parikīrtayet || 7 ||
caitrike māsi viṣṇuśca mādhave hyaryameti vai ||
śukre vivasvān māse tu śucau māse divākaraḥ || 8 ||
parjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi nabhasye varuṇastathā ||
mārtaṃḍeti ca vijñeyaḥ kārtike bhārgavaḥ punaḥ || 9 ||
mārgaśīrṣepi mitrastu kīrtitaḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ ||
māghe bhageti vijñeyastvaṣṭā caivātha phālgune ||
evaṃ krameṇa nāmāni kīrtayetprītaye raveḥ || 11 ||
dhūpārcanavidhimimaṃ saptamyāṃ susamāhitaḥ ||
yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 12 ||
tataste sarvamākhyātaṃ yathāguhyatamaṃ vibhoḥ ||
na ca pāpakṛte deyaṃ na deyaṃ nāstikāya vā||
kṛtaghne nāstike vīra na deyaṃ krūrakarmaṇi || 14 ||
paṭhedyaścāpi niyataḥ śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ || 15 ||
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya sūryaloke mahīyate ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sūryāruṇasaṃvāde pratimāsasaptamīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma navādhikadviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 209 ||

|| sumanturuvāca || ||

sumanturuvāca

rakṣobhūtapiśācāśca yoginyopi palāyitāḥ ||

pracchannaṃ rocate rājanyā nārī bhavadoṣataḥ ||
jñeyā sā svairiṇī rājankule bhavati nāśinī ||39||
yo.asyāṃ rato bhavedvipraḥ sa jñeyaḥ svairiṇīrataḥ ||
raṃgopajīvī kathako yaśca prākṛtanartakaḥ || 1.210.40 ||

dve ete nāmanī rājankathakasya prakīrtite ||

|| śatānīka uvāca || ||
aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ bhavato yaddvijānprati ||

|| sumaṃturuvāca || ||

guruvarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nānyo baṃdhuḥ pracakṣate ||
ṛte piturdvijaśreṣṭhā itīyaṃ naigamī smṛtiḥ || 1 ||
trayo.api guravaḥ śreṣṭhāstābhyāṃ mātā paro guruḥ ||
ye sodarā jyeṣṭhaśreṣṭhā uttarottarato guruḥ || 2 ||
dvādaśyāṃ tu āmavāsyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame ||
vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇā deyā maṇimuktā yathāruci || 3 ||
ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā ||
prāpte cāparapakṣe tu bhojayeccāpi śaktitaḥ || 4 ||

vidhivadvaṃdanādeva sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 5 ||

yasmādvijayate lokastasmāddharmaḥ pravartate |||

namāmi jananīṃ devīṃ parāṃ prakṛtirūpiṇīm ||9|||
kṛcchreṇa mahatā devyā dhārito.ahaṃ yathodare ||
tvatprasādājjagaddṛṣṭaṃ mātarnityaṃ namo.astu te || 2.1.6.10 ||

gurudevaprasādena labdhā vidyā yaśaskarī ||
śivarūpa namastasmai saṃsārārṇavasetave || 12 ||

ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmagrajanmannamo.astu te || 13 ||

mātāmahaṃ ca tadanu ācāryamatha ṛtvijam || 15 ||

yathāgrajastathā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyo.api dvijottamāḥ || 16 ||

dṛṣṭādṛṣṭastṛtīyaḥ syātsūryo.agniścaṃdra eva ca ||17||
maṃtradātā guruḥ khyātassaptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kabhojanaguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svargāpavargahetukaḥ ||18||
dṛṣṭadevaṃ ca yo hitvā adṛṣṭaṃ ca niṣevate ||
pāpātmā paramaḥ saikastiryagyoniṃ ca gacchati ||19||
yathā pitā jyeṣṭhapitā kanīyāṃśca tathā dvijāḥ ||
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛtulyo mānyaḥ satkārabhāgyataḥ ||2.1.6.20||

sa cāpi dṛṣṭadevaḥ syāttadājñāṃ paripālayet || 22 ||
pitāmahaṃ ca pitragre havyakavyaiśca tarpayet ||

tādṛśaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ pitāmahapradakṣiṇe || 25 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
śravaṇepi ca dharmātmañchrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā || 1 ||

sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ ||

pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ||
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām||5||

āgamānāṃ śivo devastaṃtrādīnāṃ ca śāradā || 8 ||

śuddhaudanaṃ yavakṣīraṃ pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathā ||
kṛśarānnaṃ ca vā dadyātkramādbaligaṇaṃ viduḥ || 12 ||

śītodakaṃ madhu kṣīraṃ sitekṣvośca raso guḍaḥ||
sagarbhaśca paro jñeyaḥ ṣaṇmayaścāparo baliḥ || 15 ||
śālitaṃḍulaprasthaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam ||

kṣīraṃ bhāgāṣṭakaṃ grāhyaṃ saptabhāgena saṃsthitam||

samutthāya ca gṛhṇīyātpraṇamya vinivedayet || 2.1.7.20 ||
pūrvasthaḥ śrāvako vipro vikhyātastasyadakṣiṇe ||

prastareṇāpi hastena vinyāsaḥ paṃḍitaiḥ sadā ||

yamadiksaṃmukhe śrotā vācakaścottarāmukhaḥ ||

drutalekhī ca tejasvī yo lekhayati lekhakaḥ ||
asaṃvalitabhāvena ūrdhvordhve syātsamākṣaram ||93||
lipiyuktaḥ samāyuktaḥ evāgamalekhakaḥ ||

anāyuṣyakaraṃ yasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet || 2.1.7.100 ||

na kalau dhārayeddeha anāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet || 101 ||

sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ khyāto dhāraṇācca kuto.apyalam || 102 ||
catuviśāṃgulaṃ yacca tadvai svadhanamucyate ||

tasmādbrahmamayaṃ jñeyaṃ trivarga phaladāyakam || 104 ||

etyāḥ patrakṛte mānaṃ bhūrje mānaṃ na vidyate || 105 ||

aṃgulānāṃ pramāṇaṃ yattenāpi jñānapustakam || 106 ||
hastasaṃsthāpite tasya tenāyuṣyakaraṃ bhavet ||
dharmaśāstrasya sāhasre dharmaśāstrasya vetanam || 107 ||
svargamārgasya gamane bhārate ca tadardhakam ||
harivaṃśe svarṇamāne kṛte mūlyasahasrake || 108 ||
yugeyuge pādahīnaṃ dharmaṃ kuryādyathāruci ||
praṇamya śirasā sarvānvyāsādīnsaṃhitāśrutān || 109 ||
jaiminiṃ ca tato vyāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā harim |||
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu ādimadhyāvasānake || 2.1.7.110 ||
tataḥ pravācayedvipro dharmaśāstrārthakovidaḥ ||
alakṣitamanāstadvadyadrūpaṃ spaṣṭamuccaran|| 111 ||
asaṃyuktākṣarapadaṃ spaṣṭabhāgasamanvitam ||
saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ saptanādavibhūṣitam || 112 ||
sāmagāthāḥ samāśritya rāgayuktāṃtaraṃ paṭhet||
maṇivāro dhanaṃ yatsyādgaurāṃdhāṃ saṃtikastathā || 113 ||
śrīrāgaścaiva hillolarāgo vājāvikastathā ||
evaṃ prakramamāṇena śṛṇuyāddharmasaṃhitāḥ || 114 ||
pāpaiḥ pramucyate sarvairmahāpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati || 115 ||
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyo vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriyaḥ paraḥ ||
kṣatriyāṃte tathā viprāḥ śṛṇuyuścāgrataḥ sadā || 116 ||
na śūdraḥ kathayeddharmāṃstapādhyāpane tathā ||
naihikatvaṃ paratvaṃ ca na śubhaṃ na parāṃ gatim || 117 ||
śūdreṇādhigataṃ nāsti viśeṣācchabdalakṣaṇam ||
yaddvijasya kṛto dāso brahmaṇā.avyaktayoninā ||118||
śvaśṛgālakharīkṣīramapeyaṃ hi yathā bhavet ||
evaṃ śūdramukhāddharmā na grāhyāḥ śabdasaṃskṛtāḥ ||119||
amedhyaṃ śudhyate toyaiḥ śūdraḥ śrotā hi śudhyati ||
evaṃ śūdro.apyaśuciḥ syādyadi vyākaraṇārthavit ||2.1.7.120||
yaḥ śūdra uddiśeddharmaṃ tathā cāgamavaidikam ||
sa vai vadhyo nareṃdreṇa jihvāṃ cakreṇa chedayet || ||| 121 ||
budhyamānaḥ sadā hyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnameva ca ||
ya evaṃ kathayetsamyaksa vipro vyāsa ucyate || 122 ||
vasetsa pattane grāme puṇye deśe sa kīrtitaḥ ||
vasaṃti pattane tasminvyākhyātā yatra saṃvaset || 123 ||
yathārkahīnaṃ divasaścaṃdrahīnā yathā niśā ||
na rarāja sabhā tadvadvyāsena rahitā dvijāḥ||124||
yadgṛhe naiva śiśavo na rarāja gṛhaṃ kvacit ||
yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatastu divākaraḥ ||
tathaiva sodara gehe dṛṣṭvā puṣkaradarśanam || 125 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge saptamo.adhyāyaḥ || 7 || a ||
aṅkamāhātmyavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yacchrutvā mucyate pāpātpuruṣo brahmahatyayā||1||
tṛtīyaṃ śaivamākhyātaṃ tato bhāgavataṃ param||
paṃcamaṃ ca tathā mātsyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhamucyate ||2||
asāmarthye ca mātsyoktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca bhaviṣyakam ||
bhārate cāpi parvaṃ ca śāṃtibhaiṣmīyakaṃ tathā || 3 ||
parāśaramataṃ gṛhyaṃ gobhiloktāni yāni ca ||
kātyāyanoktamaparamabhyasennigamāditaḥ || 4 ||
aṃtareṇāgate martye śāstraṃ nādhyāpayetkvacit ||
ekarātraṃ gate martye trirātramajameṣayoḥ || 5 ||
maṃḍūke paṃcarātraṃ tu sarpe rātricatuṣṭayam ||
saṃvatsaraṃ tu turage gaje dvādaśavatsarān || 6 ||
māsamekaṃ khare kāke sthānatyāgānna kutracit ||
kerave vā rave caiva ahorātraṃ pracakṣate ||7||
trirātramapi mārjāre nakule mūṣake khare ||
haṃse dinamanadhyāyaṃ kṣudrajaṃtau na dūṣaṇam || 8 ||
adhyāpayedguroḥ putraṃ jñāninaṃ dhārmikaṃ śucim ||
bhaktaṃ śāṃtaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca jitakrodhaṃ jiteṃdriyam || 9 ||
adhyātmādhyāpayedebhyaḥ śaṭhaṃ pāpaharaṃ dviṣam ||
anyāyenaiva yacchatamabhayaṃ dāṃbhikaṃ dviṣam||2.1.8.10||
nirarthakaṃ maṃtharaṃ ca viśuśrūṣumayājakam ||
ṣaṇḍaṃ caivānṛjuṃ kruddhaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vyasanārthinam|| 11 ||
apracchannanataṃ brūyātputrapautrādikādṛte || 12 ||
vidyayā saha martavyaṃ na dadyācca pṛthagjane ||
ato vidyā vadatyevaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ dvijottamam ||13||
mā dadyādbhaktihīnāya durjanāya durātmane ||
apramādāya viprāya śucaye brahmacāriṇe || || 14||
sārthakāya vidhijñāya sādhave dehi sattama ||
dadyādyadi niṣiddhāya vidyādhanamanuttamam || 15 ||
tayorekataro gacchedacireṇa yamakṣayam ||
anyāyena grahaṃ vidyāmanyaṃ pāṭhayate sukhāt || 16 ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ vidyāvarjyaḥ sa ucyate ||
mānamādau praṇamyātha tato.adhīyīta suvrataḥ ||
karmakāṃḍaṃ jyotiṣasya tadvinā na samabhyaset || 18||
cūtabhogasamabhyāsāddaridraścābhijāyate ||
vādabhāgasamabhyāsāddhananāśāya jāyate ||19||
nidhibhāgasamabhyāsājjāyate nārake kule||
yānyanuktāni śāstrāṇi mānanīyāni yāni ca ||2.1.8.20||
mlecchoktāni mahimnāni nābhyaseddūratastyajet ||
lokānāṃ jñānavṛddhyarthaṃ yaḥ kuryāddharmasaṃgraham || 21 ||
pravartayitvā sa gururbhavejjānapradaḥ pitā ||
jñānadātā ca lokānāṃ teṣu dharmaḥ pravartate||22||
nigamānāṃ jyotiṣāṇāṃ vedānāṃ nāṭakasya ca ||
vyākhyānasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā kalau nāśamavāpnuyāt ||23||
mīmāṃsājyotiṣāṃ caiva nāṭakānāṃ viraṃcinī||24||
bhāgāvasāne kathitaḥ purāṇādhyāya eva ca ||
puṣpakaśca paricchedaḥ khaṃḍaśca pratikhaṃḍakaḥ ||25||
vyavahāraścārthaśāstramaśvaśāstrasya caiva hi ||
yasya bhāgāvasāne tu prayoktavyaḥ sa eva hi|| ||26||
tatsaṃgrahepi kavinā niyoktavyaḥ sa eva hi||
yasya nātropadeśe tu pravartayati saṃgrahaḥ ||27||
tattadakṣarasakhyānāṃ brahmalokānna taccyutiḥ ||
na saṃgrahastaṃtramaṃtre vedamaṃtre ca varjayet ||28||
mohātkṛtvā homadhenuṃ dattvā śuddhirbhaviṣyati ||
kṛtvā cākhyāyikāgraṃthasvarūpānsa divaṃ vrajet || 29 |||
dharmaśāstrasya gamyasya vyavahārasya caiva hi ||
kalau yaḥ saṃgrahaṃ kuryātprasupte caiva keśave || 2.1.8.30 ||
yāvatpravartate lokastāvatsvarge mahīyate ||
siṃhe pauṣe ca caitre ca na kuryātsaṃgrahaṃ kvacit || 31 ||
prātaḥkāle na kurvīt tathā madhyaṃdine dvijāḥ ||
pakṣāṃte bhūbhidāhe ca bhuvaḥ kaṃpe dinakṣaye || 32 ||
malamāse viśeṣeṇa sandhyayośca vivarjane ||
amedhyāktaṃ ca patraṃ ca lipyakṣaravibhūṣitam || 33 ||
pūtaṃ syāttatkṣaṇādviprāścatuḥ paṃcākṣareṇa vā||
nārasiṃhasya vinyāse pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 34 ||
māyāvibhavavinyaste mahāpāpakalevare ||
muhūrtārdhena pūtatvaṃ prabhoryāṃti parāṃ gatim || 35 ||
striyo vā niṃdito vāpi mleccho yāti parāṃ gatim ||
yo mūḍho manyate doṣaṃ tasya śaucaṃ samācaret ||
sa gardabhīṃ kharīṃ yoniṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ|| || 36 ||
ekamevātmakaṃ brahma tatprakṛtyātmakaṃ dvayam ||
navātmako bhairavaśca daśamaśca janārdanaḥ || 37 ||
rudra ekādaśaścaiva arkārkaścāpi dvādaśaḥ ||
trayoviṃśe ca bhūtātmā ṣaḍviṃśe manurīritaḥ || 38 ||
tithyātmakaṃ paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśākhyā kalāparā ||
vātātmakaḥ saptadaśo mantraḥ samanuvartate ||39||
aṣṭādaśākṣaro maṃtraḥ purāṇātmaka eva ca ||
ūnaviṃśaścaṃdramāḥ syādviṃśo nārāyaṇo vapuḥ ||2.1.8.40||
jyotirmayaścaikaviṃśo dvāviṃśe keśavārcanam ||
nakṣatrāṇi trayoviṃśe caturviṃśe ca tānakam || 41 ||
paṃcaviṃśe ca tīrthāni ṣaḍviṃśe ca triyaṃbakaḥ ||
aṣṭāviṃśe dhaneśaśca ūnatriṃśe sarasvatī || 42 ||
triṃśadyoge śivaḥ proktaḥ pātālamekatriṃśake ||
ahorātraśca dvātriṃśe catustriṃśe ca jāhnavī || 43 ||
paṃcatriṃśe tadaṃtaḥ syācchate pūrṇe divākaraḥ ||
sahasre ca śivo jñeyaścāyute merurucyate || 44 ||
lakṣe brahmā tathā koṭyāṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||
puṃprakṛtyātmakaṃ cānyacchāradālipimātṛkā ||45||
śuddhabrahmamayaṃ nityaṃ jñānarūpaṃ paraṃ mahat ||
yasminna vyasanādeva śucau cāpyaśucisthale ||
kṣaṇe brahmamayaṃ yāti ityāha bhagavānmanuḥ || 46 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāgeṃ.akamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo.adhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
aṃtarvediṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇoktaṃ yugāṃtare ||
bahirvedaṃ tathaivoktaṃ śastaṃ syāddvāpare kalau || 1 ||
jñānasādhyaṃ tu yatkarma aṃtarvedīti kathyate ||
devatāsthāpanaṃ pūjā bahiveṃdirudāhṛtā || 2 ||
prapāpūrtādikaṃ caiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam ||
gurubhyaḥ paricaryā ca bahirvedī dvidhā matā || 3 ||
akāmena kṛtaṃ karma karma ca vyasanādikam ||
aṃtarvedī tadevoktaṃ bahirvedī viparyayaḥ || 4 ||
dharmasya kāraṇaṃ rājā dharmametadbhavennṛpaḥ ||
tasmānnṛpaṃ samāśritya bahirvedī tato bhavet || 5 ||
saptāśītirbahirvedī sārameṣāṃ tṛtīyakam ||
taḍāgakaraṇaṃ caiva tṛtīyaṃ na caturthakam ||
paṃcamaṃ pitṛpūjā ca gurupūjāpuraḥsarā || 7 ||
adhivāsaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca devatānāmavikriyā ||
pratimākaraṇaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāmatha ropaṇam || 8 ||
trividhā sā vinirdiṣṭā uttamā cātha madhyamā ||
kaniṣṭhā śeṣakalpaśca sarvakāryeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 9 ||
tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ ||
pūjāhomādibhirdānairmānataśca tribhāgataḥ || 2.1.9.10 ||
tryahasādhyavidhānena aṣṭāviṃśatidevatāḥ ||
tridhā bhavati sarvatra pratiṣṭhādividhirmataḥ || 11 ||
pratyahaṃ pūjayettatra jāpakāstatra ṣoḍaśa ||
uttamo.asau vidhiḥ kṛtsno hyaśvamedhaphalapradaḥ || 12 ||
catvāro yājakāstatra trayoviṃśatidevatāḥ ||
brahadikpāla vāruṇyaṃ pṛthivī ca śivastathā || 13 ||
ekāhenaiva pūjā ca madhyamaḥ kathito vidhiḥ ||
gaṇeśagrahadikpālānvaruṇaṃ ca śivaṃ tathā || 14 ||
saṃpūjya pūjyate yatra kaniṣṭho.asau vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ekavṛkṣaścaikarūpaiḥ pratimākṣudradevatāḥ || 15 ||
nalinīdīrghikāgartavāpīmalaprapādikam ||
eṣāṃ saṃskārakāryeṣu pratimānāṃ pariṣkriyā || 16 ||
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā na kuryādvidhivistaram ||
gaṇeśagrahadikpālānpūjayedupacārataḥ || 17 ||
vāpyādeḥ puṣkariṇyāśca kṣipedgaṃgājalaṃ tataḥ ||
ulūkhaladvayenāpi jīrṇānāṃ tu kadācana || 18 ||
setuprāsādavāpīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet ||
prāsādaḥ setavaścaiva taḍāgādyāstathaiva ca || 19 ||
tribhirvarṇaiḥ pratiṣṭhārhā jīrṇānāṃ tu samudgatāḥ ||
munayo mānamicchaṃti amānaṃ na hi dṛśyate || 2.1.9.20 ||
tasmānmānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ phalam ||
ṣaṣṭihastapramāṇena taduktaṃ vāraṇoditam || 21 ||
ekaṣaṣṭihastamitaṃ prāsādaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ ||
madhyaṃ tadardhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tatparaṃ smṛtam || 22 ||
atha vā devamānena kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ||
sarvaṃ kulaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaloke mahīyate ||
punaḥ punaśca saṃskāryo labhate mauktikaṃ phalam ||
dviśatena śatenāpi prāsādasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ||
sahasrahastavistāraṃ dairghyeṇāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet || 26 ||
taḍāgaṃ taṃ vijānīyātprathamaṃ mānamīritam ||
madhyaṃ catuḥśatenāpi prastāve daśahīnakam || 27 ||

tadardhena kalau jñeyaṃ tadardhena tadardhakam || 28 ||
taḍāgamānaṃ vijñeyaṃ trivargaphaladāyakam ||
atha puṣkariṇīpakṣe dve śate mānamuttamam || 29 ||
taḍāge dviguṇā nemī mānārdhe gartamīritam ||
tatkṣetraṃ vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ tryuditaṃ tadbahiḥ smṛtam || 2.1.9.30 ||
caturthaṃ caiva gāṃdharvaṃ paiśācaṃ paṃcamaṃ viduḥ ||
yakṣasthānamitā bhāge evaṃ sarvakramāṇi hi || 31 ||
aśītihastamānena nalinyā maṇirucyate ||
pañcahīnaṃ ca prastāve evaṃ mānavido viduḥ || 32 ||
ṣaṣṭihastena nalinī prastāve turyahīnakam ||
catuḥṣaṣṭihastamitā dīrghikā ca prakīrtitā || 33 ||
turyahīnaṃ ca prastāve garte mānaṃ na vidyate || 34 ||
agnau rogo baṃdhunāśaśca yāmyāṃ mṛtyuścograḥ prāpyate rākṣase ca ||
bhītiścogrā prāpyate vāyavīye tasmādetā varjanīyāḥ prayatnāt || 35 ||
viprādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samāje merusthāne yatra tatraiva kuryāt ||
nadyāstīre varjayedvā smaśāne taḍāgādvai āśramādīñjanānām || 36 ||
yadā pratiṣṭhāṃ na karoti mūḍhaḥ prāsādavāpyādiṣu pāpacetāḥ ||
bhayaṃ samāpnoti ca pāpamugraṃ pade.ahinā vai vadhabhāgitāṃ vrajet || 37 ||
yadā tu dīrghāsarasītaḍāgaprāsādakūpādiṣu nirmitāni ||
kurvaṃti cānyāni yadā makhāni bhavaṃti naivāsya phalapradāni ||38||
yadapratiṣṭheṣu nipānakeṣu prāsādakūpeṣu vanādikeṣu ||
pratiṣṭhite yatphalamāpnuvaṃti phalaṃ tadālpālpakamāhurasya ||39 ||
tasmātpratiṣṭhāṃ vidhinā jalādeḥ kuryādyatheṣṭaṃ prayato manuṣyaḥ ||
puṇyārjanenaiva dhanena kāle svavittasādhyena śubhāśayena || 2.1.9.40 ||
prasāde mṛnmayaṃ puṇyaṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ dvijāḥ ||
tasmāccaturguṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhamaye tathā || 41 ||
tṛṇamaye śatamayaṃ tadardhaṃ navavalkale ||
tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛte dārumaye bhavet|| 42 ||
tato daśaguṇaṃ proktamiṣṭikāracite śubhe ||
tasmācchataguṇaṃ śaile sahasraṃ tāmraraupyake || 43 ||
tataśca śatasāhasraṃ sauvarṇe dvijasattamāḥ ||
anaṃtaphalamāpnoti ratnādi racite tathā || 44 ||
hastānāṃ poḍaśairyāvatprasthe syātkarahīnakam||
tṛṇavaṃśamaye mānaṃ madhyaṃ cārkakaraṃ bhavet || 47 ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ tārahastaṃ syāduttamaṃ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ ||
sarvottamaṃ ca dvātriṃśaccatuṣkoṇe mahāphalam || 48 ||
puradvāraṃ ca kartavyaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ bhavet ||
aṣṭakoṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ tripuraṃ ca kalau yuge || 49 ||
suraveśmani yāvaṃto dvijendrāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || 2.1.9.50 ||
karturdaśaguṇaṃ proktamāpānaparipālakaḥ ||
patitānyuddharedyastu sa sarvaṃ phalamaśnute || 51 ||
patitaṃ patamānaṃ ca tathārddhasphuṭitaṃ tathā ||
samuddhṛtya harerveśma dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 52 ||
patitasya tu yaḥ kartā patamānasya rakṣitā ||
viṣṇoradhitalasyaiva mānavaḥ svargabhāgbhavet || 53 ||
yaḥ kuryādviṣṇuprāsādaṃ jyotirliṃgasya vā kvacit ||
sūryasyāpi viriṃceśca durgāyāḥ śrīdharasya ca || 54 ||
svayaṃ svakulamuddhṛtya kalpakoṭiṃ vaseddivi ||
smaratvaṃ prāpnuyālloke pūjito divi sarvadā || 56 ||
svargaṃ gacchetsa narakaṃ na kadācidavāpnuyāt || 58 ||
kulāni tārayettasya sapta sapta parāṇi ca || 59 ||
pūrvaṃ pitṛkule sapta tadvanmātṛkule dvijāḥ ||
caturdaśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śatalekhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu || 2.1.9.60 ||
piturūrdhvaṃ kulaṃ viṃśaṃ māturūrdhva kulaṃ tathā ||
tadvatparaṃ vijānīyādbhāryāyāḥ paṃca eva ca || 61 ||
paṃca vai mātṛtaścāsya piturmātāmahe kule ||
paṃca paṃca vijānīyānmāturmātāmahasya ca || 62 ||
guroḥ pitṛkule paṃca tasya mātṛkule tathā ||
ācāryasya kule dvaṃdvaṃ daśarājakulasya ca || 63 ||
rājño mātāmahakule paṃca caiva prakīrtitāḥ ||
ekottaraṃ śatakulaṃ parisaṃkhyātameva ca ||64||
ātmanā saha vipreṃdrā uddhāraḥ saṃmataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kuryāddevārcanaṃ tīrthe svavimukte daśārṇave ||65||
samuddharetkulaśataṃ śṛṇu viṃśakulaṃ dvija ||
paṃca paṃca ca pitrośca piturmātāmahasya ca || 66 ||

guroḥ saṃtānake dvaṃdvaṃ tadvadyādavasāttvatau ||67||
parapakṣasya caikaṃ syādekaviṃśaṃ kulaṃ kramāt||
pānīyametatsakalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| || 68 ||
pānīyena vinā vṛttirloke nāstīti karhicit||

tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge cānte brahmatvamāpnuyāt ||
tasmāttoyopari gṛhaṃ prasādopari varjayet||2.1.9.70||
sūryaraśmiyutaṃ yadvai tattoyaṃ tu viniṃdatam||

tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kuṃḍe tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ hrade||
devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryādavimuktaphalaṃ śubham ||72||
cālanādrauravaṃ yāti na svargaṃ na ca svargabhāk ||73||
ucchannagaragrāme sthānatyāge ca viplave ||
punaḥ saṃsāradharmeṇa sthāpayedavicārayan||74||

na cālayetsthāpite ca vipravṛkṣaṃ na cālayet ||4||
keśavaṃ harivṛkṣaṃ ca madhūkaṃ kiṃśukaṃ tathā||
nākāle sthāpayejjātu cālanādbrahmahā bhaveta||76||
devālayasya purataḥ kuryātpuṣkariṇī dvijāḥ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ samāje ca rājadvāre catuṣpathe||77||
devātheṃ brāhmaṇārthe ca mukhaṃ kuryācca sarvataḥ ||
paścime puṣṭikāmaṃ tu uttare sarvakāmadam || 78 ||
yāmye svārthaṃ na kurvīta koṇe tu narakaṃ bhavet ||
mukhaṃ prakalpayenmadhye keciduttaralaṃghanam || 79 ||
kuryāddakṣiṇapūrve tu arkahastapramāṇataḥ ||
taḍāge tu phalāhastaṃ hastikaṃ hrāsayetkramāt || 2.1.9.80 ||
tṛpye hastaṃ nalinyādāvato hīnaṃ na kārayet ||
gartatṛṇaṃ kalāhastaṃ taḍāge.atra pracakṣyate || 81 ||
hīne hīnataraṃ kuryāddhastamānena hrāsayet ||
yūpastathā khādira eva kāryaḥ śraiparṇiko dhātrisamudbhavaśca ||
mānastathā ṣoḍaśahastasammito ratnātsagaṇḍīyugakāmayojitaiḥ || 82 ||
ānāhabhagne ca bhavecca tasya viṃśāṃ gulo dviguṇo madhyagaśca ||
madhyeṃ.agulaiśca hīnaḥ kāryaḥ śubhadaḥ sarvadā syāt || 83 ||
evaṃvidhaścaiva taḍāgayūpo madhye tathā ṣoḍaśahastasaṃmitaḥ ||
kūpe ca yūpopyatha hastamātrastataścaturhastamitaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 84 ||
ārāmayoge.apyatha maṇḍape ca kāryaścaturhastamito.atha yūpaḥ ||
saṃpūrṇamāne kathitaṃ pramāṇaṃ hīne tu hīnaṃ pravadaṃti tajjñāḥ ||
hastadvayaṃ prāpitavyaṃ taḍāge hastaḥ sārdhaḥ puṣkariṇyāṃ praropaḥ ||85||
prādeśaṃ vai hastamānaṃ kūpayūpasya ropataḥ ||
na kuryājjalamagnaṃ ca yūpaṃ sarvatra sattamāḥ || 86 ||
taḍāge cāpi ārāme sthāpayecca jalopari ||
hastamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ syānmānenānena dāpayet ||
vāpyāṃ garte puṣkariṇyāṃ prakuryājjalasaṃmitam || 87 || yāvatpratolīgatareṇusaṃgasaṃkhyāgaṇo no jaratāmupaiti ||
tāvatsureśaḥ suralokavāsī prāsādakṛjjātu na jāyate hi ||88||
kiṃ vā vācyaḥ puṣkariṇyā prabhāvaḥ kartā yaḥ syādvāruṇo brahmalokāt ||
yāvatkālo bāhumātroddhatā syād dṛṣṭiḥproktā na nivartetkadācit || 89 || lakṣaikamārāmamayottamaḥ syānmadhyaṃ tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhamānam ||
tadardhaṃ vā praśastaṃ tadananyaṃ munayo vadaṃti ||
vinārjunairbadaraiḥ śailukaiśca hīnaṃ kuryācchānalaiḥ pātilaiśca || 2.1.9.90 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge pūrtanirṇayo nāma navamo.a dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||. |||7|||
pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||

tantrātmakapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
|| || sūta uvāca || ||
atha taṃtravidhiṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣvapi gīyate ||

yajñamānavidhānavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yasya yajñasya yanmānaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ||

homaṃ yathābhirucitaṃ pauṣṭike kāmyakarmaṇi || 7 ||

anyaḥ śatādikaṃ kuryādayutaṃ vibhave sati || 8 ||

nidhihomaṃ cābhicāraṃ tanna kuryādgṛhāśramī || 9 ||
yatra yatra japaḥ kāryo homo vā yatra kutracit ||
mānaṃ naiva ca kartavyaṃ mānādau cāṣṭakaṃ nyaset || 2.1.14.10 ||
yugmasādhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ yugmato bhayamādiśet ||
lakṣe saptatālasaṃkhyā koṭihome ca viṃśatiḥ || 11 ||
ekatriṃśaddinairvāpi na kuryādvyatyayaṃ kvacit ||
āraṃbhastrisahasraḥ syāddvitīye.aṣṭasahasrakaḥ || 12 ||
tṛtīye tu sahasraṃ syādgrahasādhyaḥ smṛto vidhiḥ ||
pañcāhe ca samāraṃbhe sahasraṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ || 13 ||
dvitīye.ahni dvisāhasraṃ tṛtīye tu sahasrakam ||
guṇasāhasrakaṃ turye pañcāhe śeṣamīritam || 14 ||
navāhe kalpayellakṣamekaikāṃgaṃ dine dine ||
paṃcame ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe kule bhāgadvayādhikam || 15 ||
koṭihome ca tithyaṃge śatabhāgena kalpayet ||
na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kāryametanmānamudāhṛtam || 16 ||
nityamekaṃ dine dadyātpṛthaṅnityaṃ na cācaret ||
sa samāje japennityaṃ pañcatāreṇa sviṣṭakṛt || 17 ||
ayute lakṣahome ca koṭihome ca sarvadā ||
prathame divase kuryāddevatānāṃ ca sthāpanam || 18 ||
mahotsave dvitīye tu balidānaṃ tathaiva ca ||
tryahasādhye trirātre ca pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā visarjayet || 19 ||

varāhaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ caiva gaṃdhādyaiḥ sādhu pūjayet || 4 ||
dattvāsanaṃ svāgataṃ ca dadyātpādyādikatrayam || 5 ||
ataḥ pūrvādipātreṣu yāvatā ca hutāśanam ||
suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham || 6 ||
mahodaraṃ mahājihvamākāśatvena pūjayet ||
tārakādīnsamāpte ca gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 7 ||
tatraiva jihvāstrividhā dhyāyenmaṃtrapuraḥsarāḥ ||
paramajyotīrūpastvamāsanaṃ saphalī kuru || 9 ||
dadyādāsanametena puṣpagucchatrayeṇa tu ||
puṭāṃjaliṃ tato baddhvā pṛcchetkuśalapūrvakam || 2.1.16.10 ||
vaiśvānara namaste.astu namaste havyavāhana ||
svāgataṃ tu suraśreṣṭha śāṃtiṃ kuru namo.astu te || 11 ||
namaste bhagavandeva āponārāyaṇātmaka ||
nārāyaṇaparaṃ dhāma jyotīrūpa sanātana ||
jagadādityarūpeṇa prakāśayati yaḥ sadā ||
tasmai prakāśarū pāya namaste jātavedase || 14 ||
dhanaṃjaya namaste.astu sarvapāpapraṇāśana ||
śaraṇaṃ te prayacchāmi dehi me paramaṃ padam || 16 ||
jyotiṣāṃ jyotīrūpastvamanādinidhanācyuta ||
mayā dattamalaṃkāramalaṃkuru namostu te || 17 ||
devīdevā mudaṃ yāṃti yasya samyaksamāgamāt ||
sarvadoṣopaśāṃtyartha gandho.ayaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 18 ||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ hi brahmā ca jyotiṣāṃ gatirīśvara ||
gṛhāṇa puṣpaṃ deveśa sānulepaṃ jagadbhavet || 19 ||
dhūpo.ayaṃ devadeveśa gṛhyatāṃ me dhanaṃjaya || 2.1.16.20 ||
paramātmā parākāraḥ pradīpaḥ pratigṛhyatām || 21 ||
namo.astu yajñapataye prabhave jātavedase ||
sarvalokahitārthāya naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 22 ||

lokanātha namaste.astu namaste jātavedase || 23 ||
ityanena tu mantreṇa dadyāddivye.apyadhītakam ||
sarvasvaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca paramānnaṃ samākṣikam ||24||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge ṣoḍaśo.adhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||

agnivarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yajñabhedaṃ tribhedaṃ ca vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā ||
yathāvedānusāreṇa yathāgrahaṇa yojanam || 1 ||
śatārdhe vahniruddiṣṭaḥ śatārdhe kāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ghṛtapradīpake viṣṇustilayāge vanaspatiḥ || 2 ||
sahasre brāhmaṇo nāma ayute hariru cyate ||
lakṣahome tu vahniḥ syātkoṭihome hutāśanaḥ ||3||
varuṇaḥ śāṃtike jñeyo māraṇe hyaruṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nityahome.analo nāma prāyaścitte hutāśanaḥ || 4 ||
lohitaścānnayajñe yo grahāṇāṃ pratyanukramāt ||
devapratiṣṭhāyāge tu lohitaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 5 ||
prajāpatirvāstuyāge maṃḍape cāpi padmake ||
prapāyāṃ caiva nāgākhyo mahādāne havirbhujaḥ ||6||
godāne ca bhavedrudraḥ kanyādāne tu go.ajakaḥ ||
tulāpuruṣadāne ca dhātāgniḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 7 ||
vṛṣotsarge bhavetsūyo.avasānāṃte raviḥ smṛtaḥ ||
pāvako vaiśvadeve ca dīkṣāpakṣe janārdanaḥ || 8 ||
trāsane ca bhavetkālaḥ kravyādaḥ śaradāhane ||
parṇadāhe yamo nāma hyasthidāhe śikhaṃḍikaḥ || 9 ||
garbhādhāne ca marutaḥ sīmaṃte piṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
puṃsave tviṃdra ākhyātaḥ praśasto yāgakarmaṇi || 2.1.17.10 ||
nāmasaṃsthāpane caivamupanyaste ca pārthivaḥ ||
niṣkame hāṭakaścaiva prāśane ca śucistathā || 33 ||
ṣaḍānanaśca cūḍāyāṃ vratādeśe samudbhavaḥ ||
vītihotraścopanaye samāvarte dhanaṃjayaḥ || 12 ||
udare jaṭharāgniśca samudre vaḍavānalaḥ ||
śikhāyāṃ ca vibhurjñeyaḥ svarasyāgniḥ sarīsṛpaḥ || 13 ||
aśvāgnirmaṃtharo nāma rathāgnirjātavedasaḥ ||
gajāgnirmaṃdaraścaiva sūryāgnirviṃdhyasaṃjñakaḥ || 14 ||
toyāgnirvaruṇonāma brāhmaṇāgnirhavirbhujaḥ ||
parvatāgniḥ kratubhujo dāvāgniḥ sūrya ucyate || 15 ||
dīpāgniḥ pāvako nāma gṛhyāgnirdharaṇīpatiḥ ||
ghṛtāgniśca nalo vāyuḥ sūtikāgniśca rākṣasaḥ || 16 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāge.agnināmavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo.adhyāyaḥ || 17 |||cha|||

homadravyakathanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
athāto homadravyāṇāṃ pramāṇamabhidhīyate ||
pramāṇe cāpramāṇe ca niṣphalaṃ bhavati dhuvam ||1||
karṣamātraṃ ghṛtaṃ home śuktimātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam ||
tatsamaṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ tathā madhu || 2 ||

śarkarā muṣṭimātrā ca śarkarātolakaṃ viduḥ || 3 ||
tritolakaṃ guḍaṃ vidyādikṣuparvavi dhirbhavet ||

ekalagne na juhuyānna pṛthagjuhuyātkvacit ||
savṛṃtakaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ keśaraṃ tatsavṛṃtakam || || 5 ||
ekaikaśaśca padmānāṃ jalajānāṃ tathaiva ca ||
jīvaṃtyāḥ phalamānena piṣṭakānāṃ prasaṃkhyayā || 6 ||

ekaikaśaḥ phalānāṃ ca mātuliṃgatrikheḍakam ||7||
aṣṭadhā nālikerasya panasaṃ daśadhā bhavet||
padmabījapramāṇena kūṣmāṃḍaṃ cāṣṭadhā bhavet ||8||
urvārukaṃ cāṣṭadhā ca guḍūcī caturaṃgulam ||
pūgamānaṃ ca māṃsasya saguḍaṃ tatra dṛśyate ||9||
anyatra badarīmānaṃ tiṃdukaṃ ca tridhā kṛtam ||
kāṣṭhaṃ prādeśamātraṃ syāddūrvā yāśca tripatrakam || 2.1.18.10 ||
bhūrjapatraṃ ca gṛhṇīyācchamīṃ prādeśamātrikām ||
vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syuḥ śuktimānena sarṣapāḥ || 11 ||
maricāḥ syurvimā nena mṛṇālaṃ cātha mūlakam ||
saptakhaṃḍaṃ ca vārtākaṃ tripuṣṭaṃ ca tridhoditam ||12||
tittiḍībījamānena samuddi ṣṭāni deśikaiḥ || 13 ||
samidāplavane tryaṃgatilānāmapi madhyataḥ||
daśakaṃ plāvanenaiva sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vinā || 14 ||
evaṃ vrīhiplāvane ca kāṣṭhavadi kṣudaṃḍakam ||
prokṣaṇaṃ mṛdupuṣpāṇāṃ latādīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 15 ||
pāyasānne tathānne ca modake piṣṭake.api ca ||
śālyāsaktena juhuyādvyatyaye vyatyayaṃ phalam || 16 ||
bilvapatrasya plavanaṃ daṃḍaṃ hitvā ca plāvayet ||
vṛṃtasaṃplāvanādeva phalaṃ harati rākṣasaḥ || 17 ||
bilvapatrasya pūrvārdhaprāptamātreṇa yoja yet ||
patratrayaṃ tathā home chinnebhinne.atidūṣaṇam || 18 ||

tasmācca putraśiṣyādyairbrāhmaṇaistattvakovidaiḥ || 19 ||
pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pāvayecca yathākramāt ||
na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kuryācchāṃtipakṣa udaṅmukhaḥ || 2.1.18.20 ||

iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāgeṣṭādaśo.adhyāyaḥ || 18 || cha ||
sruvadarvīnirṇayavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
śrīparṇī śiṃśapā kṣīrī bilvaḥ khadira eva ca ||
sruve praśastāstaravaḥ siddhidā yāgakarmaṇi || 1 ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ praśastāstu dhātrīkhadirakeśarāḥ ||
saṃskāre śaśibhinnau ca dhātrī dhātrā vinirmitā || 2 ||

sruvaṃ caturviṃśatibhirbhāgaiśca racayeddhruvam ||
dvitriṃśaṃ syātkuṃḍamānamadaive tasya kīrtitam || 2.1.19.10 ||

aṃgadvayena vilikhetpaṃke mṛgamadākṛtim ||11||

sauvarṇasya ca tāmrasya kāryā darvī pramāṇataḥ ||12||
śraivarṇikodbhavaṃ yacca iṃduvṛkṣasamudbhavam||
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ dvādaśāṃgulasaṃmitam||13||
dvayaṃgulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ tasya darvī sā yajñasādhane||
catvāriṃśattolikābhiriti tāmramayasya ca||14||

annādipāyasavidhau darvī yajñasya sādhane||15||
daśatolakamānena sā ca darvī udāhṛtā ||
ājyasaṃśodhanārthaṃ tu sā tu tāmramayasya ca || 16 ||
ṣoḍaśāṃgulamānena sarvābhāve ca paippalīm ||
ājya sthālīṃ ghṛtamayīṃ mṛnmayīṃ ca samāśrayet || 17 ||
atha tāmramayī kāryā na ca tāṃ tatra yojayet || 18 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyama parvaṇi prathamabhāge sruvadarvīnirṇayo nāmaikonaviṃśo.adhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha ||
pūrṇavidhivarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha pūrṇavidhiṃ vakṣye yathā caṃdrārthavedinām ||

pūrṇā tvekasahasraṃ tu dadyādyajñaphalepsayā || 9 ||
mṛdupuṣpākṛtau tvekā kevale cekṣuhomake ||
śataṃ dve ca śate caiva garbhādhānānnaprāśane || 2.1.20.10 ||
sīmaṃtonnayane caiva prāyaścittākṛtīṣu ca ||
evaṃ srucau samau kṛtvā uparyupari vinyaset ||

dehi meti ca maṃtrasya prajāpatirṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
anuṣṭup ca bhavecchaṃdo devatāsya prajāpatiḥ || 15 ||

chaṃdo.api jagatī khyātaṃ devatāgniśca kīrtitaḥ || 17 ||

ṛtvikchaṃdaḥ spṛśansamyagdakṣiṇāṃgamathāpi vā ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
athāto maṃḍalaṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣu yathoditam ||

harivallabhaṃ rājasūye somayāgeṣu śasyate || 14 ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ subhadraṃ ca sarvatobhadrameva ca ||
jalāśayapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vighnarājaṃ praśasyate || 15 ||
ghaṭaprasthāpane caiva gajāhvaṃ turagāsanam ||
śatapatraṃ lakṣahome ayute caturasrakam || 16 ||
yasya yajñasya yadbiṃbaṃ tattu tenaiva yojayet ||
ito.anyathā bhaveddoṣo viparīteṣvadhogatiḥ || 17 ||
dvihastā caturasrā ca vedikā parikīrtitā ||
caturaṃgulocchrāyamitā ṣaḍaṃgulā hyathāpi vā ||18||
ṣaḍaṃgulā navavyūhe vardhayedyajñakovidaḥ ||
ekāṃgulasamutsedhaḥ kartavyassusamāhitaiḥ|| ||| 19 ||
krauṃcaprāṇe turyahastaṃ muṣṭihastaṃ samucchritam ||
madhyadvaye hīnakaraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tryaṃgulādhikam || 2.1.21.20 ||
kuryāddvitrikramāddhīnamucchrāye dvijasattamāḥ ||
pārijātaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ sūryakāṃtaṃ ca śekharam || 21 ||
grahāṇāṃ pauṣṭike pakṣe bāhyagrāmādisādhane ||
niyojayettatratatra vedikācakrakatrayam || 22 ||
prathame muṣṭihastaḥ syātsaṃpūrṇe śeṣamānakaiḥ ||
navalābhe ca paṃcābjaṃ karatrayamudāhṛtam || 23 ||
śeṣā caiva variṣṭhā ca lavalī bhitti vedikā ||
vijñeyā dvijaśārdūlā yathākāmyeṣu yojayet || 24 ||
ayathāvyatyaye doṣastasmādyatnena sādhayet ||
daśahaste cāṣṭahaste aṣṭahaste ca ṣoḍaśam ||25||
muṣṭibāhuñca prādeśaṃ vardhayetṣoḍaśāṃśake ||
hastotsedhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ hīne hīnaṃ ca hrāsayet || 26 ||
darpaṇākārakaṃ kuryādyāgake śāṃti karmaṇi ||
hīnaṃ kuryātprayatnena vaprākāraṃ paristave || 27 ||
niśāraṇairgomayaiśca vedikāṃ ca pralepayet ||
svarṇaratnamayaistoyairabhiṣicya kuśodakaiḥ || || 28 ||
hīnavīryagavānāṃ ca purīṣaṃ dhenukaṃ tathā ||
kapilāyāśca yatnena kuṃḍamaṃḍalalepane || 29 ||
varjayetsarvayāgeṣu sthaṃḍileṣu prayatnataḥ ||
vinā sūtraiḥ kīlake na maṃḍale naiva sūtrayet || 2.1.21.30 ||
tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryaṃ yatsūtraṃ yacca kīlakam ||
arkahastamitaṃ sūtraṃ mṛdu lākṣāmayaṃ tathā || 31 ||
pītakāryasrajaṃ caiva kīlakaṃ svarṇanirmitam ||
raupyatāmramayaṃ kuryādvaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi || 32 ||
gaṇanāyake supraśastaṃ śaiṣepāmārgameva ca ||
grahapakṣe tatheśasya kacchapasya dvijottamāḥ || 33 ||
ṣoḍaśe cārkahaste ca tatra nemiyutaṃ bhavet || 34 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi prathama bhāge ekaviṃśatitamo.adhyāyaḥ || 21 || || cha || ||
|| iti madhyamaparvaṇi prathamabhāgaḥ samāptaḥ || 1 || cha || || || ||

maṇḍaladevaracanāvarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
athoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturasrādikasya ca ||
arkāṃgulamitaṃ kṣetraṃ caturasraṃ prakalpayet||1||
guṇāṃgulaṃ pratidiśaṃ vardhayetsuvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
caturasraṃ samaṃ kuyādiṣṭeraṣṭādaśāṃgulam || 2 ||
dvihaste caiva sūtrāgre tryaṃgulāni samaṃtataḥ ||
caturasrīkṛte paścāddvihastamapi jāyate || 3 ||
evaṃ poḍaśahastāṃtaṃ vardhayetkramataḥ svayam ||
haste vinirṇayaṃ viprā racayenmaṃḍala sudhīḥ || 4 ||
dvādaśāṃgulakalpābhyāṃ madhuhaste ca maṃḍale ||
dvihaste hastamātraṃ syāddvihastaṃ tu catuṣkare || 5 ||
padmamānaṃ caturddhā tu vṛttaṃ kuryātsamaṃtataḥ ||
karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena śuddhena paṃkajaṃ likhet ||7||
keśarāstrividhāḥ proktā mūlamadhyāgradeśataḥ ||
mūle śuklāruṇā madhye pītāścāgre pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 8 ||
pātrasaṃdhirbhavecchyāmaḥ koṇe raktena raṃjayet ||
devāstrāṇi likhedbāhye puramadhye ca koṇake || 9 ||
aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇaṃ yadyathāvarṇaṃ vināditaḥ ||
sīmarekhāṃgulocchrāyaṃ tattadardhena yojayet ||
śivaviṣṇvormahāyāge śaṃbhumārabhya dāpayet || 11 ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca rāmāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇāṃtaṃ ca jalāśaye ||
durgāyāge ca śrīpakṣe brahmādīnparikalpayet || 12 ||
grahayāge ca pītādīnkuryācca na tadanyathā ||
navavyūhamatho vakṣye purāṇamatasammatam || 13 ||
sarvaṃ ca pūrvavatkāryaṃ paṃkajaṃ sulikhetsudhīḥ ||
tāvatsaṃkhyāharaṇayorveṣṭayetprakramādapi || 14 ||
śuklāruṇaistathā pītaiḥ pītāruṇasitairapi ||
pītāruṇasitairevaṃ svabhāve pratibhāgake || 15 ||
kalāyaṃtraṃ tadaṃte ca guhyapatrā grakeṇa tu ||
ṣoḍaśairviṃśamāne tu saliṅgaṃ cāṣṭapatrake ||16||
evaṃ maṃḍalamaṃtrāṇāṃ varjayetparamārthataḥ ||
tadvanmūleṣu koṇeṣu keśarāṇi prakalpayet||17||
daśadaṃḍasamākāraṃ trivarṇaṃ pratiraṃjitam ||
araṃ dadyāddaśāgre tu sarvāṃgulapramāṇataḥ || 18 ||
pītenāraṃ ca sarvatra tanmadhye śoṇatuṃḍakam ||
navavyūhamidaṃ proktaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam || 19 ||
na śūdro maṃḍalaṃ kuryānna kuryādbrāhmaṇabruvaḥ ||
kuryācca saṃgame tīrthe devatāyataneṣu ca || 2.2.1.20 ||
likhitvā nārcayedya stu agnikāryavihīnakaḥ ||
aviddho jāyate so.api yato janmanijanmani || 21 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge prathamo.adhyāyaḥ || 1 || cha ||
krauñcamānavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca ||
krauñcamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvedārthavādinām ||
saṃmataṃ sarvataṃtreṣu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 1 ||
ātmano.aratnimānena dviguṇaṃ parikalpayet ||
madhye vṛddhyā tu tatsūtraṃ bhrāmayetkīlakopari || 2 ||
catuṣṭayaṃ nyasedvṛttaṃ madhyamādhamabhāvataḥ||
karṇikā prathame vṛtte dvitīye tvatha keśaram || 3 ||
tṛtīye padmapatrāṇi caturthe ṣoḍaśacchadāḥ ||
śobhopaśobhe kuryācca caturasre same śubhe || 4 ||
taddakṣiṇāgraṃ sulikhetpārśvayoḥ pakṣakadvayam ||
tatra padmayugaṃ kuryānmadhye cāṃgulamaṃtaram||5||
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lohitasannibham ||
saṃkhyātaṃ tāmraparṇaṃ ca śyāmalaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ rajaḥ || 6 ||
śuklaṃ taṃḍulacūrṇotthaṃ pītaṃ tu niśayā smṛtam ||
raktaṃ tu niśayā yogācchaṃkhacūrṇādibhāvitam || 7 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ pulakādidagdhaṃ raktaṃ pītāsyayogataḥ ||
kuṃkumābhaṃ pāṃḍuraṃ ca raktaśvetairvinirmitam || 8 ||
tāmravarṇaṃ kusuṃbhena śyāmalaṃ bilvapatrajam ||
yavagodhūmacūrṇādiyogena tu rajaḥ smṛtam || 9 ||
sarvarekhāsu vibhajecchuklaṃ madhye tu pītakam ||
karṇikāyāṃ keśareṣu śubhrameva nipātayet || 2.2.2.10 ||
pūrvādikramayogena śuklādīni prayoja yet ||
patrasaṃdhau tu vibhajedrajaḥ sekāṃtarakramāt ||11||
tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu pūrvādikramato bhavet ||
śuklaṃ pītaṃ tathā tāmraṃ tataḥ saṃkhyātameva ca ||12||
śyāmalaṃ kuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ ca kṛṣṇakam ||
pītaṃ tāmraṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ śyāmaṃ kuṃkumaraktakam || 13||
evaṃ dadyādvijaḥ pūrve īśānāṃtaṃ vibhāvayet ||
krauṃcamṛrghni bhavedraktaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥ||14||
tuṃḍabhāge bhavetpītaṃ grīvāyāṃ śuklameva ca ||
pucche viṃśatipatrāṇi ādau paṃca rajaḥkramāt ||15||
ṣaḍaṃguleṣvaṃḍabhāge pītena parikalpayet ||
grīvāyāṃ śuklarajasā bhāvitāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||16||
tatra pītādikaṃ lekhyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca yathā bhavet ||
śuklādikaṃ pradadyānu pātreṣvekaikaśaḥ pṛthak || 17 ||
caturaṃgulake pāde jānorūrdhve tu pītakam ||
adhastāttu bhavedraktaṃ tadeva caturaṃgulam ||18||
dvyaṃgulena bhavecchyāmamaṃgulīṣvapi vinyaset ||
evaṃ pakṣadvayenāpi likhecchuklaṃ vibhāvayet || 19 ||
pade śuddhaṃ cāṃgulīṣu raktaṃ śyāmena bhāvayet ||
pūrvapaścimadigbhāge śuklaṃ syādvāradeśataḥ ||2.2.2.20||
dakṣiṇottarataścaiva raktavarṇaṃ vinirdiśet ||
mahākrauṃcamidaṃ jñeyaṃ madhyakraucamidaṃ śṛṇu || 21 ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidyānāṃ saptamuttamam ||
raktapītaṃ raktapītaiḥ kuryātpucchacatuṣṭayam ||
pūrvādikramayoge tu patrāṃte dharaṇītale || ||23||
sulikhenmūlasaṃlagnaṃ bahiṣkoṇacatuṣṭayam ||
kaniṣṭhe.aṣṭakulaṃ kuryātpucchaṃ kuryāccaturvidham ||24||
trivṛttaṃ veṣṭayetpaścātsitaraktāsitaiḥ kramāt ||
dṛṣṭaṃ janmaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ||25||
pītaṃ vā vilikhedviprā naśyaṃti sakalāpadaḥ||
ataścakraṃ bahiścakraṃ kṣetre ca pratidarśanam ||26||
tasya kalpaśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayate dhuvam ||
mayūraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ krauṃcaṃ ca vai kapim ||27||
pramādādvā gṛhe kṣetre vṛkṣāgre cāpi bho dvijāḥ ||
utthāya vaṃdanaṃ kuryādbrahmahatyāśataṃ dahet || 28 ||
poṣaṇātkīrtimāpnoti darśanātpāpavicyutiḥ ||
darśanādvardhate lakṣmīrāyurvṛddhiśca jāyate || 29 ||
mayūro brahmaṇo mṛrtirvṛṣabhaśca sadāśivaḥ|| .
siṃhe ca saṃbhaveddurgā vaiṣṇavo vidhirucyate ||2.2.2.30||
krauṃco nārāyaṇo devo vyāghrastripurasuṃdarī ||
kālikā kṛṣṇavyāghraśca lakṣmīścitrakapotakaḥ ||31||
snātaḥ paśyati pratyahni grahadoṣo na jāyate ||
tasmātprayatnato bhūtvā dhārayetpoṣayedgṛhe || 32 ||
rajodravyapramāṇaṃ ca yathoktaṃ yatnavarjanam || 33 ||
taṃḍulotthaṃ yavotthaṃ vā varjyaṃ makararopaṇam ||
yadbālyaśrāvaṇe jātaṃ hiṃgulaṃ gaṃdhakaṃ tathā ||34||
haritālaṃ subhadraṃ ca sadā vighnaṃ vivarjayet ||
haimaṃtikodbhavaṃ yacca sitapāṣāṇameva ca ||35||
kāṃcanyāśca prabhedaṃ yacchastaṃ śuklaguṇaṃ dvijāḥ ||
śephālivṛttaṃ niśayā atasīkusumāni ca ||36||
kiṃśukasya ca puṣpāṇi śastaṃ pītaṃ guṇaṃ bhavet ||
nāgajaṃ gairikaṃ caiva kusuṃbha kusumāni ca ||37||
kuśītaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva maṃjiṣṭhāṃ paṃcaraṃgakam ||
vijayāpatrakaṃ caiva bilvapatraṃ tathaiva ca||38||
punarnavāyāḥ patraṃ ca keśarasya bakasya ca||
kṛṣṇapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva kṛṣṇābhraṃ samayūthakam||39||
nāgapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva punnāgaṃ dagdhapaṃcakam ||
śaṃkhacūrṇaṃ lohaviṣṭhāṃ nāgaviṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet||2.2.2.40||
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva rocanārocanāṃ śrayet ||
yavaśālīyakairbhinnaṃ śuklaṃ ca kārayetsudhīḥ ||41||
lākṣāṃ ca yadi gṛhṇīyāttadbharjitvā pradāpayet ||
dharaṇīṃ sadanasthāne pañcadhā vibhajedbahiḥ ||
padmamullikhya prathamaṃ karṇikāṃ tadanantaram ||43||
tarjanyamadhyā pūrvotthaṃ vibhajedvā samāhitaḥ ||
tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogairvā tṛṇamārabhya yadbhavet || 44 ||
tṛṇamārabhya sāmānye śakto vā madhyamāditaḥ ||
rākṣasādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahapakṣe.agnimāditaḥ || 45 ||
aṃgulyagre ca vibhajetsarvakāmārthasiddhaye ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ grahamakhe kāmyeṣu parivarjayet || 46 ||
subhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye śubhadaṃ śubhamādiśet ||
ataḥ subhadramuddiṣṭaṃ svargamokṣapradāyakam || 47 ||
sārdhahastena mānena kuryānmaṃṇḍalamuttamam ||
caturviśāṃgulaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sarvatra hastamādiśet || 48 ||
karturmadhyasahasrasya madhyamā madhyaparvaṇi ||
madhyamā dīrghamānena mānāṃgulamiti smṛtam || 49 ||
rekhādvayāṃtaraṃ yacca mūlarekhāṃ na cāśrayet ||
vaddhāṃguṣṭhanakhadvaṃdvaṃ mānāṃgulamathāpi vā ||2.2.2.50||
madhye nibadhya śaṃkuṃ ca muṣṭibāhupramāṇataḥ ||
trivṛttaṃ kārayenmadhye jyeṣṭhottarakanīyasam || 51 ||
prakalpya karṇikādīni madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ likhet ||
bahiścārkadalaṃ kuryādvarṇānāṃ kramakeṇa tu ||52||
paṃcamaṃ śvetavarṇena bahiḥ kuryāttriveṣṭanam ||
sitapītāruṇaṃ kuryātpaścādvedāṃgulāṃtare || 53 ||
veṣṭayecchuklavarṇena madhye kalpalatāṃ likhet ||
subhadraṃ maṇḍalātpūrvaṃ sarvatobhadrakaṃ śṛṇu || || 54 ||
maṃḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvayajñeṣu puṣṭidam || 55 ||
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya īśvareṇaiva bhāṣitam ||
caturviṃśatyaṃgulena hastaḥ prathamato bhavet || 56 ||
koṇe sūtradvayaṃ dadyānmadhye sūtradvayaṃ punaḥ ||
tato matsyānviracayetkarṇe sūtrāṇi sādhakaḥ ||57||
catuḥ sūtraṃ pātayecca pūrvāparavibhāgataḥ ||
punardadyāccatuḥsūtraṃ karṇasūtraṃ punardadet || 58 ||
śatadvayapadaṃ yāvatṣaṭpaṃcāśādhikaṃ tathā ||
pātayecca tathā sūtramevaṃ saptadaśaṃ bhavet || 59 ||
ūrdhvapaṃktyā padayugaṃ cādye padacatuṣṭayam ||
dvārapārśve bhavedyāvaddaṃtapaṃktyā padatrayam || 2.2.2.60 ||
rekhāṃ sarvatra śuklena racayedyajñiyottamaḥ ||
paṅkajaṃ śuklavarṇena vaiṣṇavo yāgakarmaṇi || 61 ||
śaktiyoge bhavedraktaṃ śaive pītaṃ vinirdiśet ||
pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvāsu śuklameva praśasyate || 62 ||
pītena karṇikā kāryā caturbhāgena mānataḥ ||
śubhaṃ cakorāvasthāne tāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 63 ||
karṇikāmūlamārabhya rekhāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalpayet ||
rekhāmūle bhavecchuklaṃ madhye raktaṃ nipātayet || 64 ||
agre pītaṃ bhavedevaṃ kṛtvā paṃkajaveṣṭanam ||
śubhravarṇena taddadyātpītavarṇena sarvataḥ || 65 ||
madhye raktaṃ bhavettacca evaṃ ṣoḍaśakalpayet ||
koṇeṣu raktaṃ dadyācca padmaṃ kṣetreṣu nirdiśet || 66 ||
śuklena pīṭhagātrāṇi pīṭhakoṇe padatraye ||
pītavarṇena racayeddvidhā paṃktidvaye tathā || 67 ||
śuddhena racayetpādau punaḥ pītādivarṇakaiḥ||
citraṃ suśobhanaṃ kāryaṃ tatra kalpalatāṃ nyaset || ||68||
mānaṃ kalpalatāyāstu dvyaṅgulaṃ parikīrtitam ||
dvedve śastaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ śaṃkhāvartakramāttrayam ||69||
graṃthaugraṃthau puṣpaphale nānāvarṇena bhāvayet ||
vaiṣṇave gāruḍaṃ śastaṃ śaive kīśavṛṣaṃ likhet ||
śākte vyāghraṃ tathaiśe ca śarabhaṃ harimālikhet ||71||
śobhāṃ pītena racayedupaśobhāṃ ca pītakaiḥ ||
koṇeṣu kṛṣṇavarṇena bahiḥ syādveṣṭanatrayam || 72 ||
śuklapītāruṇaiḥ kāryaṃ maṇḍalaṃ syānmanoramam ||
sarvatobhadramaparaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 73 ||
sarvajñānamayaṃ śuddhaṃ dharmakāmārthadāyakam ||
caturasraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā digbhyo dvādaśadhā dvijāḥ || 74 ||
pātayettatra sūtrāṇi koṣṭhānāṃ dṛśyate śatam ||
catuścatvāriṃśadādyaṃ paścātṣaṭtriṃśadaṃbujam || 75 ||
koṣṭhaṃ prakalpayetpīṭhaṃ paṃktyā caivātra vīthikām ||
dvāraśobhe yathāpūrvamupaśobhaṃ ca dṛśyate || 76 ||
avaśiṣṭaiḥ padaiḥ kuryātsadbhistaṃtrāṇi mantravit ||
vidadhyātpūrvavaccheṣamevaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ bhavet || 77||
pūrvoktamaṇḍale vidvandharaṇīsadanaṃ bahiḥ ||
madhye kalpalatā kāryā bahiṣkoṇeṣu sattamāḥ || 78 ||
gulālītūryavarṇena mahāmatta iti smṛtaḥ ||
śobhopaśobhe śobhāgrāṃ kuryādvai maṇḍalaṃ bhavet || 79 ||
etaddhi sarvatobhadraṃ rāśiyuktamataḥ param ||
śatapatraṃ vajranābhaṃ biṃbanābhaṃ sahasrakam || 2.2.2.80 ||
gajāhvaṃ ca gajākāraṃ madhye tu samalaṅkṛtam ||
catuścandre candrabimbaścandrakāṃtamudāhṛtam || 81 ||
bahirdvādaśabhiḥ sūryaiḥ sūryākrāṃtaṃ prakīrtitam ||
śekharī tripuṭaṃ caiva śatapatraṃ ca prakramāt || 82 ||
sahasrameva viprendrāḥ padmānte yasya svastikam ||
svastikaṃ tadbhavedviprāḥ puṣkaraṃ vajrasaṃmatam || 83 ||
cintāmaṇiṃ kuṃkumāṃśaṃ khātaṃ ca harivallabham ||
pañcasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pañcasiṃhāsanaṃ viduḥ || 84 ||
tadvadvṛṣāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ śikhirūpaṃ śikhidhvajam ||
nārasiṃhaṃ padmagarbhaṃ kapotāsyaṃ tathā bhavet || 85 ||
gāruḍaṃ merugarbhaṃ ca nīlakaṇṭhaṃ narākṛtim ||
śatakratugajārūḍhaṃ śrībiṃbanavasūtrakam || 86 ||

kāmadvayena puṭitaṃ sahasraṃ padmaveṣṭitam || 87 ||

dattāni vidhivatpuṃsāṃ devadānāni yāni hi ||

mūlyadānavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||

setubaṃdhe ca paṃkile ca paṇadvayaṃ ca kākiṇī || 15 ||

kalaśanirṇayavarṇanam
sūta uvāca ||
yasyārpite ca māṃgalye yātrāsiddhiśca jāyate ||1||
saptāṅgaṃ kalaśe jñeyaṃ pañcāṅgamatha vā punaḥ ||
atha vākṣatapuṣpeṣu devamāvāhya pūjayet ||
na cānyatra yajeddevānviphalaṃ parikīrtitam||3||

syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa kuryādbhūbhiparigraham ||
madhyamānānikābhyāṃ ca nyasyetpātālasaṃmukham ||
