asya mantrasya ca ṛṣirgautamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
anuṣṭupca bhavecchando devatāsya guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 15 ||
ājighraṃ kalaśaṃ mahyāṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ ||
kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhāgre udare.api ca || 16 ||
vinyāsaścaiva kartavyastryaṃgule brahmamudrayā ||
ājighrasya ca mantrasya ṛṣirbharga udāhṛtaḥ ||
paṃktiśchandaśca uddiṣṭo devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 17 ||
kalaśasthāpane caiva somayāge ca yojayet ||
paṃcanadyetimantreṇa kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ tataḥ || 18 ||
devatā paramā triṣṭubdevatā somabhāvitaḥ ||
viniyogaḥ pallave ca vinyasetparikīrtitaḥ || 19 ||
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtreṇa pradadyātsaphalākṣatam ||
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ kamalasaṃjñakaḥ ||
badaraṃ nāgaraṃ caiva dhātrī ca picumardakam ||
jīvaṃtī pīvaraṃ caiva phalānyetāni varjayet || 21 ||
hiraṇyagarbheti ṛcā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ||
ṛṣirhiraṇyagarbhosya chandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam ||
savitā devatā cāsya ratnanyāseti yoja yet ||22||
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāddaivaśulbanameva ca ||
varuṇasya tveti ṛṣirvaruṇāṃtare yojayet ||23||
śrīśca te iti mantreṇa dadyātpuṣpaṃ sacandanam ||
gandhadvāreti maṃtreṇa dadyādgandhaṃ viloḍitam || 24 ||
kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ ||
vrīhayaśceti mantreṇa pañca vrīhīṃśca nikṣipet ||25||
tilāśca māṣā mudgāśca śyāmākāḥ śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
pañca dhānyagaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ || 26 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyama parvaṇi dvitīyabhāge pañcamo.adhyāyaḥ|| 5 || cha ||
māsavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha māsāśrayaṃ karma kartuṃ māsanirūpaṇam ||
kriyate tadvidhaṃ saṃkhye bhavenmāsa ścaturvidhaḥ || 1 ||
cāndraḥ sauraḥ sāvanaśca nākṣatraśca tathāparaḥ ||
śuklapratipadaṃ prāpya yāvaddarśa ca aindavaḥ || 2 ||
ekarāśau raviryāvatsa māsaḥ saura ucyate ||
triṃśatā divasairmāsaḥ sāvanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
nākṣatramāso.aśvinyādirevatyanto hi viśrutaḥ||
udayādudayaṃ yastu sāvano divaso raveḥ || 4 ||
taṃtreṇaikatitherbhāgakālo divasa aindavaḥ ||
rāśestriṃśadbhāgakālaḥ kālastvekasya bhāsvataḥ ||5||
ahorātraṃ tu tannaivaṃ saure.api bhāgamānataḥ||
ahorātraṃ sādhanasya mukhyavṛttvaiva labhyate || 6 ||
saure cāndre tūpagaṇau triṃśadbhāge tvadarśanāt ||
sāvanā divasā grāhyā ṛṣīṇāṃ samaye gṛhe || 7 ||
atibhāgavyavasthāyāṃ prāyaścittakriyāsu ca||
mantropāsanakārye ca annasya prāśane śiśoḥ||8||
karasya grahaṇe rājño vyavahāreṣu māḥsu ca||
yajñeṣu dinasaṃ khyāyāṃ grāhyo māsastu sāvanaḥ ||9||
sauramāso vivāhādau yadādyaiḥ supragṛhyate ||
yajñeṣvapi vrate vāpi vihite snānakarmaṇi ||2.2.6.10||
cāndrastu pārvaṇe grāhyo vārṣikeṣvaṣṭakāsu ca ||
śrāddheṣu tithikāryeṣu tithyukteṣu vrateṣu ca ||11||
nākṣatraḥ somapādīnāmāryabhāgavicāraṇe ||
karagrahavidhau rājñāṃ nāyaṃ sarvajanākṛtiḥ || 12||
tadvaccaitrādimāsoktaṃ tithyuktaṃ karma dṛśyate ||
tattu cāndreṇa kartavyaṃ sā hi caitrādinocyate ||13||
rājoktau sāvanaḥ prokte tithisaṃbhāgakarmaṇi||
tatra sauro bhavedvācyaḥ sauraśabdapravartanāt ||14||
citrānakṣatrayogena caitrī sā pūrṇimā smṛtā||
tayopalakṣito māsaścaitra ityabhidhīyate || 15 ||
sa ca tithyātmako māsaścāndraḥ śravaṇabhāskaraḥ ||
cāndraścaitryaṃtiko māso mukhyaścaitrādisaṃjñakaḥ || 16||
gauṇo.apyasau yugādyāderanurodhena vardhanāt ||
mukhyaḥ śuklādidarśāṃto māso lākṣaṇiko mataḥ || 17 ||
caitrādyāścāndramāsā ye dvādaśāpi tu yogataḥ ||
paurṇamāsīyutābhistu na carkṣatvaṃ na rebhire || 18 ||
viśākhayādyeṣu yā vā tathā bhādrapadena vā ||
yatra na pūrṇimāyogo māsaḥ sa syādvināśakaḥ || 19 ||
yo.asau yadyapi caitrādau naiṣṭhiko.api pralabhyate ||
yathā saure.api yāto.asau yogo.ayamatidurghaṭaḥ || 2.2.6.20 ||
tathā ca māsasāmānye yogenāyaṃ bhavetkvacit ||
yadi varṣasahasrānte tadakṣeṇaiva pūrṇimā || 21 ||
saṃyuktā labhyate yatra bhavedrājyavināśanam ||
sūryācandramasau nityaṃ kurvāte tithibhojanam || 22 ||
daṇḍadvaye bhuktaśeṣe na bhuñjīta kadācana ||
atikramyāparāṃ bhoktuṃ tithiṃ yatra ubhāvapi ||23||
yatra viṃśattithistasmātsañcitaikā bhavediti ||
triṃśatā cāndramāsau tu candreṇaiko hi varddhate || 24||
sa cādhiko yato māsastataḥ syādadhimāsakaḥ ||
samarātriṃ divaṃ kṛtvā vaivasvatapurīgatim || 25 ||
gaśe rāśyaṃtare sūryo yāvadgacchati bhānumān ||
gacchanvardhayati pūrvaṃ tithayastāstu saṃcitāḥ || 26 ||
vardhate tithayo yāvattulāṃ yāti divā karaḥ ||
tulādirāśiṣaṭke tu na varddhate kadācana || 27 ||
svabhāvātsamagatyā tu yataḥ saṃkramate raviḥ ||
saṃcayamānātvekaikā pratimāsaṃ vivarddhate ||
niśāsvapi tu saure tā ekasmiṃstisra ityapi || 28 || saṃpūrṇatriṃśattithibhirmāsyekasminyadā bhavet ||
sa cāndro malino māsaḥ koṇapādyaiḥ samīhitaḥ || 29 ||
bhuktocchiṣṭā tu tanmāsādasaṃspṛṣṭadivākaraḥ ||
yadā saṃkramate laṃghya tadā jñeyo malimlucaḥ || 2.2.6.30 ||
sārdhavarṣadvaye pūrṇe patatyevaṃ niśākaraḥ ||
parityaktāśca yāvaṃtyo vyutkramiṇyaśca yāḥ punaḥ ||
tithayaste niyoktavyā naro na syātsa pūraṇaḥ || 31 ||
nairṛtyāṃtaṃ hitārthāya jalaketurnigacchati ||
nirmamaṃ malinaṃ māsaṃ pretānāṃ ca hitāya ca ||32||
ataḥ pretakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryā malimluce.api ca||
yatkartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ malamāse dvijottamāḥ ||33||
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi kathitaṃ ca prasaṃgataḥ ||
yacchrāddhaṃ pretasaṃbaṃdhi sarpiḍīkaraṇāvadhi ||
malamāse.api tatkāryaṃ viśi naṣṭi sapiṃḍanam || 34 ||
yadā tu dvādaśo māso daivānmalimluco bhavet|
tatraiva yatnātkartavyā kriyā pretasya vārṣikī || 35 ||
māsāṃtare tu patite tasminneva malimluce ||
tadā trayodaśe māsi kartavyaṃ tatsapiṃḍanam|| 36 ||
varjyaṃ māsikayā śrāddhamekaṃ tasmiṃstrayodaśe ||
triṃśatā ghaṭikaiḥ śrāddhaṃ vardhate.adyāpi saṃmitam || 37 ||
kuryātpatyābdikaṃ karma prayatnena malimluce ||
naimittikaṃ ca kurvīta nādhikārastayorbhavet || 38 ||
tīrthasnānamalabhyaṃ tattadādyaṃ devadarśanam ||
upavāsādikaṃ karma sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā || 39 ||
ārtavarjaṃ puṃsavanaṃ putrādimukhadarśanam ||
malamāsepi kurvīta śukre cāstamupāgate ||2.2.6.40||
malamāsepi kurvīta nṛpāṇāmabhiṣecanam||
vratāraṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca cūḍākarma ca mekhalām||41||
maṃtropāsāṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahādānaṃ sumaṅgalam ||
vivāhaṃ ca gṛhāraṃbhaṃ praveśaṃ navaveśmanaḥ || 42 ||
upagrahaṃ gavādīnāmāśramāṃtarasaṃkramam ||
dīrghamātrāsu nejyaṃ vai tīrthayātrāvasecanam|| 43 ||
varṣavṛddhivṛṣotsargakanyā dvirnayanādi ca ||
yajñaṃ ca kāmikaṃ vidvānmalamāse vivarjayet ||44||
evamastaṃ gate śukre vṛddhabālye ca saṃtyajet||
pādāstaṃ ca mahāstaṃ ca dvividhaṃ cāstamasya tu || 45 ||
dvisaptatirdinānyasya mahāstaṃ pūrvato bhavet ||
pṛthivyāmeva pādāstaṃ bhaveddvādaśa vatsarān || 46 ||
ūnapañcāśadadhikaṃ divasānāṃ śatadvayam ||
pratīcyāmuditaḥ kāvyo dṛśyo bhavati sarvadā || 47 ||
ekarkṣe guruṇā yukto yāvattiṣṭhati bhārgavaḥ ||
malamāsavatkarmāṇi prāhustyājyāni sarvaśaḥ ||48||
ṛkṣabhede tvekarāśau saṃparke yadi vānayoḥ ||
guro rāhorapi tathā tyajedvidvānna saṃśayaḥ || 49 ||
siṃhe rāśau sthite sūrye jīve cāstamupāgate ||
heyāni yāni karmāṇi niṣiddhāni malimluce || 2.2.6.50 ||
mithunasthe yadā bhānau malamāsaḥ patatyasau ||
dvirāṣāḍha iti khyāto gauṇe śabdavivartanāt || 51 ||
phalaṃ cātra mṛtasyaurdhvadehikaṃ karma kurvatā ||
āṣāḍhakīrtanaṃ kāryamevaṃ varṣāṃtare.api ca || 52 ||
āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktapūrṇamāsīdvayaṃ tathā ||
yugmakarkaṭayo rāśyo dvirāṣāḍhastadā bhavet || 53 ||
bhavedgauṇo dvirāṣāḍho rāśistatraiva saṃyute ||
pūrvatrike tu patite tadeva bhagavānhariḥ || 54 ||
karkaṭe śayanaṃ kuryādāgamiṣyaṃ paratrake ||
karkiṇyarke suptaharau śakrapūjāśvine bhavet || 55 ||
durgotthānaṃ tulāyāṃ tu viṣṇurnidrāṃ jahātyasau || 56 ||
tithividhānavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ karma kālamāśritya vartate ||
kāle tānyeva karmāṇi phalaṃ yacchaṃti kurvatām || 1 ||
muhurbālye karmaphalaṃ trikāle.api na vidyate ||
vyayo vā mukhyabhāvena phaladaḥ karmaśālinām || 2 ||
kālastu guṇabhāvena sarvakālāśritā kriyā ||
ataḥ kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nimittaṃ karmaṇāmiha |
kāle hyamūrtirbhagavāneka eva tu yadyapi ||
tathāpyupādhibhedena bhidyate kālabhedibhiḥ ||4||
tithinakṣatravārādau rātriyogādayopi ye ||
te.api kālāḥ pakṣamāsarāśivarṣāṃtare.api ca ||
sādhanāni bhavantyete svātantryeṇa na kasyacit ||5||
dharmasya vāpyadharmasya mukhyo vyāpāra eva saḥ ||
tithyādikālabhāveṣu niṣiddhaṃ nihitaṃ hi tat || 6 ||
pālayansvargamāpnoti hitvā prāpnotyadhogatim ||
sādhayaṃtyapi karmāṇi parasparamavekṣyate || || 7 ||
kālabhāgo niḥsahāyo ye.api syuḥ karmasādhanāḥ ||
tithau pūrvāhṇavyāpinyāṃ kurvīta karma vaidikam || 8 ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ hi samācaret||
parāhṇavyāpinīṃ prāpya tithiṃ kuryāttu pārvaṇam || 9 ||
na tu pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnaparāhṇeṣu yathocitam ||
apradhāne tu kurvīta karma daivādikaṃ ca yat||2.2.7.10||
eko hi kālaḥ prātastu vṛddhiśrāddhādisādhane ||
nāpekṣate sāhāyyaṃ tattithyādiviṣuvādiṣu ||11||
devebhyo brahmaṇā dattaḥ pūrvāhṇastithibhiḥ saha ||
pitṛbhyo hyaparāhṇastu pārvaṇaṃ tu paraṃ vinā || 12 ||
pūrvāhṇamātrasaṃprāptau tato devānprapūjayet ||
pūrvāhṇasparśamātre.api tithikhaṇḍena cārpayet ||13||
kharvā darpā tathā hiṃsrā tithiśca trividhā bhavet ||
kharvādi laṃghayettulyā darpā bhavati varddhitā ||14||
hiṃsrā tu kṣayajā jñeyā kālabhedena gṛhyate ||
kharvā darpā pare grāhyā hiṃsrā grāhyā tu pūrvataḥ || 16||
śuklapakṣe parā grāhyā kṛṣṇe pūrvā praśasyate ||
snānadānavrate caiva viṣayogo nidarśitaḥ || 17 ||
tithau codeti savitā kālamātraṃ ca vā yadi ||
anyāpi saiva vijñeyā tithistasminnaharniśam || 16 ||
yathāvāste ravirbhāti ghaṭikā daśa vāpi vā||
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti pitṛkārye ca sā tithiḥ || 2.2.7.20 ||
dinadvaye.api kutape astagāṃ tithimāśrayet ||
śrāddhakālādikaṃ yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate ||
vrate ca vṛddhigāminyāṃ yatrodayo raverbhavet ||21||
amāvāsyapārvaṇe ca sā tithiḥ pitṛpūjane ||
amāvasyāmṛtasyaiva pārvaṇaṃ yatra kutracit ||22||
astagāmitithiryatra sā tithiḥ pitṛmaṃdiram||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ carettatra nodaye ca kadācana||23||
śuklapakṣe ca kṛṣṇe ca yo yogaḥ parapūrvayoḥ||
pūrvedyurvā paredyurvā trisaṃdhyavyāpinī tithiḥ||
sā pūjyā ca svakṛtyeṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi ||24||
pūjyā hi vyastaṃ saṃtyajya pūrvaṃ caikādaśīyugam ||
dvitīyā vahninā yuktā caturthī paṃcamīyutā || || 25 ||
etā upoṣyāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ syurdharmavedibhiḥ ||
etadvyastāstu puṇyāni ghnaṃti pūrvakṛtānyapi || 26 ||
bāṇena viddhā yā ṣaṣṭhī munividdhā tathāṣṭamī ||
daśamyekādaśīviddhā trayodaśyā caturdaśī || 27 ||
amāvāsyā bhūtaviddhā nopoṣyā munināpi ca ||
haṃti putrakalatrāṇi dhanāni samupoṣitā || 28 ||
viddhā ye nābhinindyāḥ syuryuktāstenābhinanditāḥ ||
vyastasya saṃbhave yugmaṃ viddhā bhavati sarvaśaḥ ||29||
tāmastāṃ tu tithiṃ prāpya yugmānyapūjyatāmiyuḥ ||
yugmāni ca divāyoge grāhyāṇi vyastaniṃdanam || 2.2.7.30 ||
naktādivratayoge tu divāsaṃvarddhamarkarān ||
rātriyogaścaturthyostu viśiṣya parigṛhyate || 31 ||
rātriyogaṃ vināpi syādekādaśyādikaṃ vratam ||
naktaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ caiva vināyoge.api śasyate || 32 ||
ekādaśyupavāsaṃ tu dvādaśīyogataścaret ||
divāyoge tu saṃpūrṇāṃ tyajedubhayapūrvataḥ || 33 ||
rātriyoge tu saṃpūrṇā sopāsyaikādaśī sadā ||
saptamī śukla pakṣe.api pūjyā ṣaṣṭhyā samanvitā || 34 ||
niśi tu syādyadā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī navamī divā ||
upoṣya kevalāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ toṣayedbhāskaraṃ naraḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ trayodaśīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vidhiprāptāṃ vinā dvijāḥ ||
upoṣya pārvatīnāthaṃ toṣayedyaśca kevalam ||36 ||
divā trayodaśīyuktā kṛṣṇopoṣyā caturdaśī ||
pareṇāpi caturdaśyā na tu kuryādamātithau ||37||
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī prāpya yadi kuryādupauṣaṇam ||
pāraṇaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣayet||38||
caturdaśīmatikramya sinīvālyāṃ tu pāraṇāt||
vratāni tasya naśyaṃti prākṛtāni caturdaśīm ||39||
saptamī lalitā bhādre śaktotthānaṃ ca vāruṇī ||
pūjyāścaitāḥ parāḥ kuryāttrisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ||2.2.7.40||
trisaṃdhyāvyāpinī pūrve parato varddhate yadi ||
saṛkṣā ṛkṣayoge tu ṛkṣābhāve parā yutā||41||
ṛkṣābhāve parā grāhyā trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ||
śrāvaṇe cādyapāde tu praśastā śakrapūjane ||42||
abhāve cottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā ca viśiṣyate ||
daṇḍārdhaṃ daṇḍamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ palameva vā ||43||
udaye saṃyutā grāhyā sā tithiścottamā bhavet ||
trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṃ hitvā pūjyā śuklāṣṭamī parā ||44||
ravicakravatā grāhyā rathe tithyāderapi ca ||
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī yā tu palamekaṃ pare dine ||45||
apare.api ca sarvatra halānāṃ vāhanaṃ tyajet||
śuklaikādaśyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ||46||
narāśvagogajādīnāṃ vāhanātpātakī bhavet ||47||
karturgomahiṣādīnāṃ gardabhoṣṭrakharasya ca ||
na vāhayeddāsa dāsī vāhanenāsti dūṣaṇam || 48 ||
bahukālikayajñe ca yajñaśrāddhe tathaiva ca ||
grāmāṃtare na doṣaḥ syāddivi nadyaṃtare.api ca || 49 ||
nityaśrāddhe.apyambughaṭe yacchrāddhaṃ māsikaṃ bhavet ||
tatra gomahiṣādīnāṃ vāhane nāsti dūṣaṇam || 2.2.7.50 ||
kuryādaṃbughaṭaśrāddhaṃ na kālaniyamaṃ kvacit ||
na cānnaniyamaṃ kuryādaśmapātraṃ ca varjayet || 51 ||
taijasairnirmitaṃ kumbhamatha vā vṛkṣapatrajam ||
na yojayenmṛnmayaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ mṛnmaye vidhiḥ || 52 ||
nivedayecca māsāṃte mṛnmayaṃ vṛkṣamūlake ||
āsphālayetpareṇaiva na vastraṃ tu kathañcana ||
parvaśrāddhe daivalakaṃ tathā raṇḍāśramaṃ tyajet || 53 ||
mātāpitṛparityāgī tailahavyādivikrayī ||
catvāriṃśadutsavānāṃ sāṣṭānāṃ ca caredyadi || 54 ||
striyā vimucyate kaścitsa tu raṇḍāśramī mataḥ ||
aṣṭacatvāriṃśadabdaṃ vayo yāvanna pūryate || 55 ||
putrabhāryāviyuktasya nāsti yajñādhikāritā || 56 ||
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya samudeti divākaraḥ ||
snānādhyayanadāneṣu sā tithiḥ sakalā smṛtā || 57 ||
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti kṛṣṇapakṣe tu sā tithiḥ ||
pitṛrṇāṃ sakalā jñeyā snānadānādikarmasu || || 58 ||
saptamī śuklapakṣe yā yāvadicchecca khaṇḍitā ||
ādyabhāge raveḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parādau yāṣṭamīyutā ||
yadyakhaṇḍā bhavetsaiva tadā jñeyā bhavātmikā || 59 ||
māghamāsena sāpyevaṃ pūrveṇa ravitoṣiṇī ||
manvaṃtarā pareṇaiva snānapānādikarmasu || 2.2.7.60 ||
uttamatithinirṇayavarṇanam
||sūta uvāca || ||
pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipādya navodyate || 1 ||
kārtikāśvayujoścaitre māghe cāpi viśeṣataḥ ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śivaviṣṇvośca pūjanam || 2 ||
agnimiṣṭvā ca kṛtvā ca pratipadyāmiti smṛtam ||
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ dhanam || 3 ||
bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vidhipūjanam ||
kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāllabhate bhūtimīpsitām ||4||
mithune karkaṭe caiva govipradamanāṃtaram ||
dvitīyā yā tu vipreṃdāstāmupoṣya hariṃ yajet ||
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī na saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
amūlyaśayanaṃ māsaṃ daṃpatī pratipūjayet ||
māghe tu rohiṇīyuktā vṛṣe cāśvayuje tathā || 8 ||
tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiñcittadakṣayamudāhṛtam ||
viśeṣato haviṣyānnaṃ modakādisamāyutam ||9||
toyadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
guḍakarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate || 2.2.8.10 ||
caturthībharaṇīyoge bhaveccaradinaṃ yadā ||
tadābhyarcya yamaṃ devaṃ mucyate sarvakilibiṣaiḥ || 12 ||
śivā śāṃtā sukhā caiva caturthī trividhā smṛtā ||
sāpi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke supūjitā || 13 ||
kārttike tu bhavecchāyā tathā māghe tu kīrtyate ||
bhavetsahasraguṇitaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 14 ||
caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmaprasiddhaye || 15 ||
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
snāpayennavanāgāṃśca gaṃdhatoyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || 16 ||
teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 17 ||
dvādaśyobhayalekhe ca gomayena viśeṣataḥ ||
pūjayeddadhidugdhādyaiḥ siṃdūrairapi bhaktitaḥ || 18 ||
supte janārdane kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ bhavanāṃgaṇe ||
pūjayenmanasādevīṃ vāmāṃ snuhīti saṃśrayām || 19 ||
picumaṃdasya patrāṇi sthāpayedbhavanodare ||
pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpabhayamāpnu yāt || 2.2.8.20 ||
yeyaṃ bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhī ca dvijasattama ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano viprā viśeṣānmāghakārtike ||
iha cāmutra mukhyāṃ ca labhate khyātimuttamām || 22 ||
śuddhe pakṣe ca saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ ||||
mahājayā tadā syādvai saptamī bhāskarapriyā || 23 ||
aparājitā tu bhādrasya mahāpātakanāśinī ||
lalitā kevalā jñeyā putrapautra vivarddhinī || 24 ||
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tu vā ||
āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ yajet ||
kārttike śuklapakṣe vā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 26 ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca caṃḍikām ||
prātaḥ snātvārcayedbhaktyā rātrau saṃsnāpayeddvijāḥ || 27 ||
arcayenmṛnmayīṃ devīmaśokārthaṃ ca sarvadā || 28 ||
satyaṣṭamamuhūrte vā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī ||
śrāvaṇe māsi siṃhārke kvacitsāpi ca śasyate || 29 ||
ato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛtvaitatphalamāpnuyāta || 2.2.8.30 ||
aśakto.anyakriyāṃ kartumupavāsaṃ tu kevalam ||
kṛtvā vimucyate pāpātsaptakṛtyakṛtāṃ varaḥ ||31||
na kālaniyamastatra na vāraniyamaḥ kvacit ||
nāpi nakṣatradoṣo.asti vāradoṣo na gaṇyate || 32 ||
trikālaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ divā rātrau viśeṣataḥ ||
ardharātre viśeṣeṇa puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ||33||
divā titheralābhe tu na kuryādvidhivadvratam ||
rātrisparśe yadi paraṃ rajanyāmapi cāṣṭamī ||34||
saptamī sārdhayāmaṃ ca rohiṇī vā na saṃspṛśet||
vratī saṃkalpayettatra na ca rātrau kadācana||35||
prāgāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta adhimātrādhike vratī ||
viśvanāthādidevānāṃ darśanaṃ prāgvivarjayet||36||
yatra tatropavāsī syādyāmāṣṭakavrataṃ caret||
yāmārdhaṃ tatparaṃ yāme pāraṇaṃ vicaredvratī||37||
tatpare cā.annajanyaṃ vā na kuryātpāraṇaṃ gṛhī || 38 ||
nakṣatrayoge grahaṇe pūjayetparameśvaram ||
japahomādikaṃ kuryādgṛhī nopavasetkvacit || 39 ||
divāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vā prājāpatyena saṃyutam ||
tathāpi ca divākṛtyaṃ samāpya ca vrataṃ caret || 2.2.8.40 ||
muhūrtāṃte ca māsāṃte aṣṭamyāmapi rohiṇī ||
upavāse ca yo doṣaḥ pūjāhomaḥ praśasyate || 41 ||
navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyāḥ pratimāse.ayutaṃ dvijāḥ ||
gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ caiva yathā karma phalapradam || || 42 ||
kārtikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣikā ||
tasyāṃ yuktāśanā viprā brahmalokamavāpnuyuḥ || 43 ||
daśamī jyeṣṭhamāsasya sā ceddaśaharā smṛtā ||
āśvinasya mahāpuṇyā kārtike vijayā smṛtā || 44 ||
daśamyāmekabhaktastu saṃyataḥ syājjitendriyaḥ ||
dvādaśa dvādaśīrhanti tasmāttathācaredbudhaḥ ||
pūrvedyurekādaśī pūrṇā parehani ca vardhate || 47 ||
na vardhate dvādaśī tu tadā tvevaṃ vyavasthitiḥ ||
vanavāsī parāṃ kuryātpūrvāṃ kuryādgṛhāśramī ||48||
pūrvevaikādaśī tyājyā vardhate cettithidvayam ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā parā tithiḥ || 49 ||
yadā tu pāraṇā yogyā dvādaśī nopatiṣṭhate ||
tadā pūrvaiva saṃgrāhyā tyājyā vṛddhā pare.ahani || 2.2.8.50 ||
ekādaśī kalāyuktā sakalā dvādaśī yadi ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca pare.ahani na labhyate ||
nopoṣyā sā mahādoṣā putrapautradhanakṣayāt || 52 ||
dvādaśī pāraṇāyogyā vardhate cāpare.ahani ||
tadā dinadvaye tyājyā pāraṇaṃ ca niyogataḥ || 53 ||
ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvādaśī luptapāraṇā ||
caṇḍātithau vrataṃ caiva haṃti puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam || 54 ||
trayodaśyāṃ yadvihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ na tu puṇyadam ||
gṛhāśramī na kuryādvā daśamīdvādaśīkṣayāt || 55 ||
yadi rudrā daśamitrā pare.ahniravisaṃkramaḥ ||
vajrālokanamātraṃ tu daśamī saṃviśedyadi ||
ekādaśī na bhoktavyā parā hyekādaśī tadā || 57 ||
tadā ceddaśamīviddhā samupoṣyā na dūṣaṇam|| 58 ||
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ ||
upoṣya daśamīmitrāṃ mohādekādaśīṃ naraḥ ||
nirayaṃ yāti sa pretya dharmasaṃtatisaṃkṣayāt || 2.2.8.60 ||
ravivāre śukravāre saṃkrāntyāṃ tu dinakṣaye ||
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta pāraṇaṃ tu vivarjayet || 61 ||
śuklāṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitāmapi ||
ekādaśīṃ sadā kuryānna vai kṛṣṇettarāṃ kvacit ||62||
naktena vartayetkṛṣṇāmiti śāstraviniścayaḥ ||
māse caikādaśī yatra labhyate śuklapakṣake ||
tatra kuryātkṛṣṇapakṣe parā tithirna gṛhyate ||63||
śrāvaṇī dvādaśī śuklā cāṃdrabhadre yadā harau ||
tatropoṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || 64 ||
śrāvaṇe cāśvine caiva labhyate dvādaśīdine ||
śravaṇena samāyuktā mahatī sā prakīrtitā || 65 ||
puṣyeṇa drādaśīyuktā phālgune vijayā smṛtā ||
kārtike cetparityājyā māghe tu nārakī bhavet ||66||
yā bhādre vijayā proktā śravaṇena samāyutā||
viśeṣaḥ kathyate tatra yathāvadvratamācaret ||67||
ekādaśyāmuttarato dvādaśī ca divānvitā ||
dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuviddhāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ||
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu vrataṃ kuryādbahuduḥkhaṃ samācareta || 2.2.8.70 ||
dvādaśī kāmaviddhā cenmanyate nāpyupoṣaṇam ||
prahareprahare snānaṃ śarvaryāṃ ca vidhīyate ||
pūjanaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca ṣaṭsu kāryaṃ vratī caret ||72||
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca prāpnoti śravaṇe yadi ||
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī cenna labhyate ||
āmiṣānnaṃ na bhuñjīta haviṣyānnena pāraṇam ||74||
yadā tu pāraṇāyogyā labhyate dvādaśī tadā ||
tasyāṃ nātikramo yuktastadabhāve trayodaśī||75||
viṣṇuśṛṃkhalako nāma budhavāre viśiṣyate ||76||
daśamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā prātarekādaśīdine ||
kṛtvā tu saṅgame snānaṃ prahareprahare dvijāḥ ||77||
anena vidhinā kṛtvā vijayāyāṃ vratottamam ||
caturyugānāṃ divyānāṃ yāvatsyādviṣṇurūpadhṛka ||
tāvadeva hi sarvatra sārvabhaumo bhavennaraḥ || 79 ||
tretāyāṃ daśajanmāni madhyadeśeṣu bho dvijāḥ ||
tataśca bhārate varṣe vedavedāṃtasāravit ||
putrapautradhanairyukto lakṣado nṛpasannibhaḥ || 2.2.8.80 ||
jāyate daśa janmāni tretāyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
sapatnīkaśca dīrghāyurdharmakarmasu pūjitaḥ || 81 ||
śatrumutthāpayetprāhṇe śubhalagne śubhakṣaṇe || 82 ||
śalyaśālmalikasyāpi saptaparṇīyakasya ca ||
eṣāmanyatamaṃ vṛkṣaṃ caṃpakasyārjunasya vā || 83 ||
dvātriṃśadaṃgulairvāpi mānadvayamathāpi vā ||
trivyāyāmaṃ ca prathamaṃ dvāviṃśahastameva vā || 84 ||
hastaḥ ṣoḍaśavārasya gṛhasthasya viśiṣyate ||
hastatrayeṇa viprasya dvādaśa kṣatriyasya tu || 85 ||
aṣṭahastaṃ tu vaiśyasya śūdrasya pañcahastakam ||
abhrataḥ śvetacchatraṃ syātpatākā ca purepure || 86 ||
ghanasārasamāyuktāṃ karpūramaṃḍanānvitām ||
raktavastraparicchannāṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtām || 87 ||
mañcasthāṃ kārayetpūjāṃ bhaktyā ca sudṛḍho naraḥ ||
saptarātraṃ caretpūjāmaindramantreṇa mantravit || 88 ||
kākādīnna spṛśejjātu vairapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
patākāyā nipāte tu rāṣṭrahāniṃ samādiśet || 89 ||
patāke nissṛte bhagne mahiṣāṇāṃ vināśanam ||
sthūṇāpāte ca bhagne vā cāśvahāniṃ samādiśet || 2.2.8.90 ||
taskaraśca kule tasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
tadviṣṇoriti maṃtreṇa śatapadmasamanvitam || 91 ||
viṣṇumuddiśya juhuyādayutaṃ pippalasya ca ||
grahāṇāṃ ca tribhāgena cāyutaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ || 92 ||
ādityasyādbhutamidaṃ dvijapāte tu bho dvijāḥ ||
kapotapāte śukrasya kākādau bhaumamādiśet || 93 ||
bhūkaṃpe jāyate viṣṭaṃ guroradbhutamādiśet ||
kīṭaviddhe kṛte viprāścandrasyādbhutamādiśet || 94 ||
patāke nissṛte bhagne rāhoradbhutamādiśet|| 95 ||
śivā ruvaṃti cāndrasya vānaro vā spṛśetkvacit ||
ketoradbhutamuddiṣṭaṃ bhūmikaṃpe tu te dvijāḥ || 96 ||
trayodaśīṃ sitāṃ prāpya puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ||
kāmadevaṃ samabhyarcedgandhādyaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ || 97 ||
seyaṃ mahāvāruṇīti khyātā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī ||
asyāṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ vākṣayamucyate || 99 ||
madhumāse site pakṣe dambhabhañjī caturdaśī ||
tasyāṃ madanamūle ca akṣaraṃ kāmamarcayet || 2.2.8.100 ||
jugupsitavacobhistu samyaktuṣṭo manobhavaḥ || 101 ||
anantaṃ sukhamāpnoti yaḥ kuryādbhaktimānnaraḥ || 102 ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjite śakre dhvajake vāstuyaṣṭiṣu ||
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddharim || 103 ||
pūjayeccandanairgandhairnaivedyairvividhairapi || 104 ||
caturdaśa phalairmūlairjalajaiḥ kusumairapi ||
yavagodhūmaśālīnāṃ cūrṇairnaikatamasya ca || 105 ||
kṛtvā pūpāhvayaṃ tasmai dadyādekaṃ śrutekṣitam ||
svayamekaṃ tu bhuñjīta dadyātsatrasya dorakam || 106 ||
caturdaśagranthiyutaṃ kuṃkumena vilepitam ||
caturdaśasūtramayaṃ sūtraṃ kārpāsameva ca || 107 ||
ataḥ preta caturdaśyāṃ bhojayitvā tapodhanān ||
dānaṃ dattvā dvijebhyaśca yamalokaṃ na gacchati || 108 ||
tataḥ pretakathāṃ śrutvā śākairnaktaṃ samācaret ||
caturdaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ vā saptamaṃ vāpi pañcamam || 109 ||
māghe māsi vaṭāpāyaḥ kasya pāpaṃ punīmahe ||
snātvā tatra caturdaśyāṃ samaye tārakāmaye || 111 ||
saṃbhavetphālgune māsi yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī ||
śivarātririti khyātā sā jagatsarvakāmadā || 112 ||
divā tasyā alābhe tu rātriyoge vrataṃ caret ||
caturdaśī amāviddhā tadvrataṃ parivarjayet || 113 ||
tithiyoge ca śarvaryāṃ saṃpūrṇe vratamācaret ||
kāmaviddhā sā ca pūjyā rātriyoge caredvratī || 114 ||
prahareprahare snānaṃ svayaṃ snātvā śivasya ca ||
kārayedvidhivadbhaktyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 115 ||
atha vakṣyāmi caitrādimāse tu pūrṇimā yathā ||
citrānakṣatrasaṃyukto gurupūrṇo vidhuryadi ||
mahācaitrīti sā jñeyā pūrṇimākṣayapuṇyadā || 116 ||
viśākhādiṣu bhedeṣu pūrṇacandro guruścaret ||
mahāvaiśākhikādyāstu pūrṇimā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 117 ||
mahājyaiṣṭhī viśeṣo.ayaṃ prājāpatye yathā raviḥ ||
gurupūrṇacandro jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mahājyaiṣṭhīti sā smṛtā || 118 ||
vināpi guruṇā candraḥ kṛttikā pūrṇimā tathā ||
tathā mahākārttikī sā tithiḥ puṇyatamā bhavet || 119 ||
rohiṇyāṃ tu sthitaścandraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kārttike ||
mahākārttikī tathāpi syātsvargaloke.api durlabhā || 2.2.8.120 ||
citrā vā yadi vā pūrṇā yadā syātpūrṇimātithiḥ ||
mahācaitrī tathāpi syādaśvamedhaphalapradā || 121 ||
raviṇā kṛttikāyogādravivāre ca pūrṇimā ||
mahācaitrī tathāpi syāddattasyākṣayakārikā || 122 ||
evaṃ gurau guroryoge mahācaitrī prakīrtitā ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japo niyama eva ca || 123 ||
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti phalaṃ caivāśvamedhikam ||
pitarastarpitā yāṃti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamakṣayam || 124 ||
bharaṇyāṃ kārttike māsi yadi syātpūrṇimā tithiḥ ||
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā || 125 ||
śālagrāme mahācaitrī kṛtapuṇyā mahātithiḥ ||
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā || 126 ||
mahāśrāvaṇī kedāre mahāpuṇyatamā matā || 127 ||
mahābhādrī badaryāṃ ca kujo.api syānnarastathā ||
mahākārttikī puṣkare ca kānyakubje tathottaraṃ || 128 ||
mahatī mārgaśīrṣe syādayodhyāyāṃ tathottare ||
mahāpauṣī puṇyatamā mahāmāghī prayāgataḥ || || 129 ||
mahāphālgunī naimiṣe ca nirdiṣṭāḥ syurmahāphalāḥ || 2.2.8.130 ||
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti varddhate cādhikaṃ phalam || 131 ||
āśvine paurṇamāsī tu kaumudīti prakīrtitā ||
asyāṃ candrodaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || 132 ||
nirvatayenna yaḥ śrāddhaṃ prabhāte paitṛkaṃ dvijaḥ ||
indukṣaye māsimāsi prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ || 133 ||
candrāśvine tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ yathāvidhi ||
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ karma sopavāso dinaṃ nayet ||134||
pradoṣasamaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
dīpavṛkṣānyathā vṛkṣā~mllakṣmīprītyai samutsṛjet || || 135 ||
nadītīre girau goṣṭhe śmaśāne vṛkṣamūlataḥ ||
catuṣpathe nijāgāre catvare tānnidhāpayet || 136 ||
dvirbhojanamamāvāsyāṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ||
śarvaryāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa māghaphālgunayornaraiḥ ||137|| ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge.aṣṭamo.adhyāyaḥ || 8 || || ||
pravaravicāravarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
vakṣye pravarasaṃtānaṃ yathākramamiti dvijāḥ ||
yadvinā vyatyayo yasmāttasmācchāstrānusārataḥ || 1 ||
pravaratrayaṃ kāśyapasya kāśyapāśāvanairdhruvam ||
pañcāśvagautamasyādya gautamaścoya eva ca || 2 ||
cyavano jāmadagnyaśca āplavāyanameva ca ||
mokunyāṃgirasabhāsyājjāmadagnyāplavāyanam || 3 ||
śāṃḍilyāsitadaivalāḥ pravaratrayameva ca ||
parāśarasya ca tathā svayaṃ śāṃbavaśiṣṭhakam || 4 ||
ātreyamācāryaṇasyābālapravarameva hi ||
vātsyavāsyāyanau caiva urukaṃṭaka eva ca || 5 ||
arthakṣīramitrāvaruṇaṃ pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam||
autathyasya trayaṃ vidyādvālmīko.avarameva hi || 6 ||
autathyasya ca vāśiṣṭhamaindre cakraṃ ca krauñcāyanaṃ tathā ||
autathyeti samākhyātaṃ māhiṣyaṃ cyavanaṃ tathā || 7 ||
urukaṃṭatrayaṃ vidyātkauśikasya trayaṃ tathā ||
yadgālo devarāṭ khyātaḥ kuśikādyāśca bho dvijāḥ ||8||
viśvāmitro devarāṭca svayaṃ caiva trayaṃ matam ||
ghṛtakauśikasya kuśikā viśvāmitrāghamarṣaṇam || 9
caṇḍakauśikasya ca tathā devarāṭ devarātakam||
viśvāmitre tu vikhyātaḥ sumantoreva eva hi || 2.2.9.10 ||
taruṃkaśākaṭāyanaḥ svayameva pravaratrayam ||
bhramadvayaṃ jaimineśca svayaṃ vāśiṣṭhameva ca || 11 ||
śaṃkhamāṃgirasacyavanaṃ śaṃkhabhasya trayaṃ matam||
vātsyasya cyavano nāma āplavāyanakastathā || 12 ||
sāvarṇasya tu sāvarṇyacyavanajāmadagnibhārgavam ||
āplavāyaneti pāṭhīne eka eva tu sattamāḥ || 13 ||
kṛṣṇājinasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ viśvāmitrasya jaiminam ||
kātyāyanasya kātyāyanagārgyāyaṇatrayaṃ tathā || 14 ||
vātsyāyaneti vikhyātaṃ kuśikasya ca paṃcamam ||
amuṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ ca jāmadagnyāplavāyanam || 15 ||
gārgyasya gārgyasāmuṃca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ||
bārhaspatyabharadvāja iti paṃca prakīrtitam || 16 ||
vaśiṣṭhasya ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca tathāṃgirasa eva ca ||
mitrāvaruṇasaṃyuktaṃ tāvattasya prakīrtitam|| 17 ||
jāhvakarṇabhavakarṇau pravarau parikīrtitau ||
upamanyurupamanyostathendraḥ saha eva ca || 18 ||
taduttameti tritayaṃ mitrāvaruṇasya ca trayam ||
ātreyagautamāṃgirasapravaratrayameva hi || 19 ||
kamaṃḍalotpalamitrāmitrāvaruṇa eva ca ||
kamaṃḍaluśceti tritayaṃ pravaratrayameva ca || 2.2.9.20 ||
cyavanasya tathā jñeyamūrvacyavanāplavāyanam ||
atha sa kasyāṃgirasabārhaspatya eva trayam || 21 ||
āgastyasya agastiśca māhaśca cyavaneti ca ||
viśvāmitre devarāta autathyeti tathaiva ca || 22||
ye noktā ye .apyavijñātāste proktāḥ kāśyapājjagat || 23 ||
iti śrībhaviṇye mahāpurāṇe madhyama parvaṇi dvitīyabhāge navamo.adhyāyaḥ || 9 || cha ||
vāstuyāgavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
vāstuyāgamatho vakṣye balimaṇḍalapūrvakam ||
aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kuryācca maṃḍalam || 1 ||
trihastā piṃḍikā kāryā caturasrā udakplavā ||
prādeśamātra utsedho darpaṇāṃtarnibho bhavet || 2 ||
madhye saṃmārjayedvidvānpādānnava yathākramāt||
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ jñeyaṃ dikṣu tripadakaṃ kramāt || 3 ||
pañcakaṃ yugmapādena caturdikṣu tataḥ param ||
koṇe catuṣpadaṃ sthāpyaṃ catuṣkoṇe vibhāvayet || 4 ||
catuṣkoṇaṃ bahiḥ kuryātkoṇe cāpi catuṣṭayam ||
dvātriṃśacca bhavedbāhye cātaścāpi trayodaśa || 5 ||
catvāriṃśatpañcayutā militvā vāstudevatāḥ ||
dauvāriko.atha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto jalādhipaḥ || 8 ||
asuraḥ paśupāśau ca rogo hi mokṣa eva ca ||
bhallāṭaḥ somasarpau ca aditiśca ditistathā || 9 ||
bahirdvādaśa ityetānīśānādīnyathākramam ||
āpaścaivātha sāvitro jayo rudrastathaiva ca ||
aryamā savitā caiva vivasvānvibudhādhipaḥ || 11 ||
pūrvādiṣu tathā pūjyā gandhapuṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
paṃcacatvāriṃśadetaccarakyā ca caturthakam || 13 ||
militvā ūnapañcāśaduttamā vāstudevatāḥ ||
nānyatra yojayedviprāḥ prāsāde ca viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
bahiḥ koṇe carakyādi carakaṃ ca vidārikām ||
svaiḥsvairmaṃtraiśca gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayetkusumādinā ||
yathoktena baliṃ dadyātpāyasānnena vā punaḥ|| 16 ||
rekhāḥ sarvatra śuklena padmaṃ raktena bhāvayet ||
rañjayedeva varṇena bahiṣpañcarajena tu || 17 ||
devavarṇānatho vakṣye yathāvadanuvarṇitāḥ ||
rakto gaurastathā śoṇaḥ sitaraktaḥ sitastathā || 18 ||
pītaḥ śuklaśca dharmaśca pūṣā raktaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
śyāmaḥ śukraśca kṛṣṇaśca pītaḥ śuklo yathākramam || 19 ||
pīto bhṛṃgaḥ punaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklastathaiva ca ||
raktaḥ śuklaśca śoṇaśca kṛṣṇaraktastathaiva ca || 2.2.10.20 ||
dhūmrapīto raktapītaḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca śyāmakaḥ ||
raktavarṇena dvātriṃśaddaśa varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 21 ||
śuklaśoṇaṃ punaḥ śvetaṃ siṃdūrābhaṃ prakīrtitam ||
pāṃḍurakuṃkumābhaṃ ca raktaṃ jñeyaṃ ca pītakam || 22 ||
śuklapītaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca gauraṃ cetyaṣṭavarṇakam ||
pītaṃ raktaṃ ca śyāmaṃ ca gauraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam|| 23 ||
dharaṇīmadanaṃ vādye śaṃbhuvarṇādiprakramāt ||
śuklena rañjayeddvārānpuradvāraṃ ca madhyame || 24 ||
madhyeṃte ūnapañcāśatsarvaṃ ca vāstukarmaṇi ||
catvāriṃśaddvārayutaṃ gṛhadevakule.api ca || 25 ||
mahākūpe tathā śveto anyatrāpi praśasyate ||
sulipte ca śucau deśe sārdhahastapramāṇataḥ || 26 ||
sarvavāstuvibhāgena vijñeyā navakā nava ||
caturdikṣu ṣaṭpadaṃ tu tripadaṃ tu catuṣpadam ||
padaikaṃ tu catuṣkoṇe eṣa vāstuvinirṇayaḥ ||
carakyādi tato hitvā catvāriṃśacca paṃcakam|| || 2.2.10.30 ||
navarekhāprayogeṇa navakoṣṭhānprakalpayet || 31 ||
dvicatuṣkoṣṭhakairdikṣu yajetāryamaṇaṃ tataḥ ||
vivasvaṃtaṃ tato mittraṃ mahīdharamataḥ param || 32 ||
koṇeṣu koṣṭhadvaṃdveṣu bāhyādiparikīrtitam ||
sāvitraṃ savitāraṃ ca śakramindraṃ jayaṃ punaḥ || 33 ||
rudraṃ rudrajayaṃ caiva vāyuṃ jṛṃbhakameva ca ||
pilipicchaṃ ca medhāvī vidārī pūtanā tathā || 34 ||
kramādīśānaparyaṃtāṃ jayaṃtaḥ śakrabhāskarau ||
satyovṛṣāṃtarikṣau ca diśi prācyāmavasthitāḥ || 35 ||
agniḥ pūṣā ca vitadho yamaśca gṛharakṣakaḥ || gaṃ
dharvo bhṛṃgarājaśca mṛgo dakṣiṇamāśritāḥ || 36 ||
nirṛtirdauvārikaśca sugrīvavaruṇau tataḥ ||
puṣpadaṃtasvarau śoṣarogau pratyagdiśi sthitāḥ || 37 ||
prāṇavāyuśca nāgaśca somo bhallāṭa eva ca ||
mudgalākhyo dityaditī kuberasya diśi sthitāḥ || 38 ||
militvā ca tripañcāśattebhyaḥ pūrve baliṃ haret ||
piṇyākaiḥ paramānnairvā pūrvoktairvā yathā kramāt|| 39 ||
raktamaryamaṇaṃ dhyāyeccaturbhirbahubhirvṛtam ||
śvetāśvavāhanaṃ divyaṃ kirīṭaiḥ svairvibhūṣitam || 2.2.10.40 ||
ākṛṣṇeneti mantrasya svarṇa ṛṣijagatīchandaḥ savitraryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 41 || vivasvaṃtaṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham ||
meṣasthaṃ ca mahākāyaṃ devagandharvasevitam ||42||
etātaviṣaṃtīti maṃtrasya kardama ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ kamalādevatāvivasvatprītaye viniyogaḥ || 43 ||
mitraṃ dhyāyecchuklavarṇaṃ śvetahaṃsoparisthi tam ||
trinetraṃ tribhujaṃ caiva śvetāṃbaradharaṃ śubham || 44 ||
kayānaścīti maṃtrasya jayaṃta ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā mitraprītaye viniyogaḥ || ||45||
prītaṃ mahīdharaṃ dhyāyedvṛṣabhopari saṃsthim||
tribhujaṃ padmahastaṃ ca vyālayajñopavītinam ||46||
tryambakamiti maṃtrasya gargaṛṣistriṣṭup chando haro devatā mahīdharaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 47 ||
dvibhujāṃ pītavastrāṃ ca śvetasiṃhāsane sthitām || 48 ||
tadvarṣaṃ iti maṃtrasya gautama ṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ sūryo devatā savitṛprītaye viniyogaḥ || 2.2.10.50 ||
śakraṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ śuklakairāvatasthitam ||
trātāramiti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣistriṣṭup chando narasiṃho devatā indrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 52 ||
rudraṃ dhyāyecchvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhavigraham ||
namaste rudreti maṃtrasya gāyatrī chaṃdastryaṃbako devatā rudraprītaye viniyogaḥ || 54 || raktaṃ rudraṃ jayaṃ dhyāyedraktapadmopari sthitam ||
raktaśyāmāṃbaradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam || 55 ||
tryaṃbakamiti mantrasya gāyatrīcchando maheśo devatā rudrajayaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 56 ||
api śvetaṃ tato dhyāyedvarābhayakaraṃ param ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitam || 57 ||
īśāna iti maṃtrasya marīcirṛṣiḥ paṃkticchando vāyurdevatā apāṃ prītaye viniyogaḥ|| āpavatsaṃ pītavarṇaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ caturbhujam ||58||
padmaśaṃkhadharaṃ vāme varābhayakaraṃ param || 59||
varuṇasyottaṃbhanamasīti mantrasya narottama ṛṣirvirāṭ chando varuṇo devatā āvayaḥ prītaye viniyogaḥ ||2.2.10.60||
koṇasūtrasyobhayataḥ śvetakoṣṭhadvaye punaḥ||
śarvaṃ dhyāyedraktavarṇaṃ vṛṣabhopari saṃsthitam ||61||||
dvibhujaṃ ca trinetraṃ ca jaṭābhāropaśobhitam ||62||
mālā svāheti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando mahādevo devatā śarvaprītaye viniyogaḥ|||63|
guhaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ pītapadmāsanasthitama ||
sa bodha iti mantrasya agastirṛṣirgāyatrī chando haro devatā guhaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 65 ||
aryamṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyopaśobhitam||
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca devagandharvasevitam || 66 ||
vāto vāreti maṃtrasya kāśyapa ṛṣiranuṣṭupchando vāyurdevatā aryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ||67||
dhyāyecca jambhakaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuṭilānanam ||
karālavadanaṃ ghoraṃ varāhopari saṃsthitam || 68 ||
kuvidogavaya iti mantrasya viśvāmitra ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ somo devatā jaṃbhakaprītaye viniyogaḥ ||69||
pilapicchaṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktamālyairalaṅkṛtam ||
raktapadmāsanasthaṃ ca raktābharaṇaśobhitam || 2.2.10.70 ||
devasya heti mantrasya paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ śacī devatā pilapicchaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 71 || pītāṃ ca carakīṃ dhyāyedraktamālyairalaṃkṛtām ||
sucāruvadanāṃ bhavyāṃ guñjāhāropaśobhitām || 72 ||
tadvarṣaṃ iti mantrasya jaṭila ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā carakīprītaye viniyogaḥ || 73 ||
śyāmāṃ vidārikāṃ dhyāyettrinetrāṃ ca caturbhujām||
nānāgaṇayutāṃ devīṃ paṅkajadvayadhāriṇīm || 74||
śrīśca te iti mantrasya varuṇa ṛṣirnṛsiṃho devatā vidārikāprītaye viniyogaḥ || 75 ||
raktāṃ ca pūtanāṃ dhyāyetpaṅkajasthāṃ suśobhanām ||
mayi gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya vivasvānṛṣirnārāyaṇo devatā pūtanāprītaye viniyogaḥ || 77 ||
pūrvādidikṣu sarvāsu sārdhādyaṃtapadeṣu ca ||
īśānaṃ jaṭilaṃ śvetaṃ śūlahastaṃ mahābhujam ||78||
trinetraṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ nāgahāro paśobhitam || 79 ||
āyuḥśīrṣāṇa iti maṃtrasya vāmadeva ṛṣirbṛhatī chando dharaṇīdharo devatā īśānaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 2.2.10.80 ||
raktaṃ dhyāyecca parjanyaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ||
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ dhyāyedoṃkāraṃ ca tathāpare || 81||
kayānaśceti mantrasya dharma ṛṣirbṛhatī chando bhavo devatā parjanya prītaye viniyogaḥ ||82||
jayantaṃ śvetaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā||
mānastoketi mantrasya śaktyṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṅkaro devatā jayaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 83 ||
śuklaṃ pītaṃ dvibhujamairāvatasthaṃ vajradharaṃ dhyātvā mūlabījena sthāpayet || 84 ||
bhāskaraṃ raktadvibhujaṃ raktāśvasthaṃ dhyātvā māyābījena pūjayet ||85||
satyaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ pītavāsasaṃ mandakuṃdabījena pūjayet||
vṛṣaṃ pītaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhamākāśabījena pūjayet ||86||
ṛkṣaṃ nīlaṃ caturbhujaṃ mahiṣārūḍham ||
ācchīma iti mantrasya hotā yakṣa ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā ṛkṣaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 87 ||
agnimārabhya pūjayet ||
agniṃ raktaṃ saptajihvaṃ raktavāsasaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ dhyātvā ||
agnidūtamiti maṃtrasya bharadvāja ṛṣistriṣṭucchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā agniprītaye vini yogaḥ || 88 ||
vitathaṃ raktamajavāhanaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyātvā gāyatryā pūjayet || 89 ||
gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣirgāyatrīchandaḥ savitā devatā vitathaprītaye viniyogaḥ ||2.2.10.90||
yamaṃ kṛṣṇamahiṣārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dhyāyet ||
acchiya iti mantrasya triṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā yamaprītaye viniyogaḥ ||91||
gṛhe kṣetraṃ raktamūrdhvakeśaṃ mahābhujaṃ raktavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ||92|| gandharvaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā yamabījena pūjayet ||93||
bhṛṅgarājaṃ raktasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ divyayajñopavītinaṃ dhyāyet || 94 ||
hotā yasketi mantrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando yaśo devatā bhṛṃgarājaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 95 ||
mṛgaṃ pītaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
kadācaneti mantrasya vāmadevaṛṣirbṛhatī chando vāmadevo devatā mṛgaprītaye viniyogaḥ ||96||
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca ||
nirṛtiṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ||
kaidācaneti mantrasya paṃktiśchandaḥ savitā devatā nirṛtiprītaye viniyogaḥ ||97|| nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca dauvārikaṃ śvetaśarabhārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ dhyātvā ||
hotasveti mantrasya narasiṃhaṛṣirbṛhatī chando gaṇeśo devatā dauvārikaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 98 ||
śyāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ kṛṣṇameṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
svādityeti mantrasya triṣṭupchando vāmano devatā sugrīvaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 99 || sumitriyā na iti mantrasya kandarpaṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchandaḥ sūryo devatā varuṇaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 2.2.10.100 ||
puṣpadaṃtaṃ pītaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
yā oṣadhīriti mantrasya manmatha ṛṣirjagatī chando vāyurdevatā puṣpadaṃtaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 101 ||
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamālyairalaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā ||
ākṛṣṇeti mantrasya hiraṇyavarṇa ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ savitā devatā asuraprītaye viniyogaḥ || || 102 ||
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāgahārānvitaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ||
ābrahmanniti maṃtrasya nalina ṛṣistriṣṭupchando bhavānī devatā somaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 103 ||
rogaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlendīvaradharaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ||
namaste rudra iti mantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ śrīrdevatā rogaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 104 ||
vāyukoṇādārabhya pūjayet ||
vāyuṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhvajahastaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ||
devā iti mantrasya bṛhatī chando yamo devatā nāgaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 105 ||
śvetaṃ somaṃ śvetavarṇāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā bhadrabījena pūjayet || || 106 ||
raktaṃ bhallāṭaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ||
pītavāsasamajavāhanaṃ hārakeyūrānvitaṃ vāyubījena maṃdarādyaiḥ pūjayet || || 107 || raktāṃ ditiṃ nāgahārānvitāṃ raktapadmāsanasthāṃ dhyātvā ||
mānārthaṃ iti mantrasyeti pūjayet || 108 ||
māno tvā iti maṃtrasya bhārgava ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ pṛthivī devatā ditiprītaye viniyogaḥ || 109 ||
aditiṃ pītavarṇāṃ siṃhārūḍhāṃ pītāṃbaradharāṃ dhyātvā ||
hiraṇyavarṇa iti maṃtrasya janārdana ṛṣirbṛhatī chandaḥ somo devatā aditiprītaye viniyogaḥ || 2.2.10.110 ||
homāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkāñcanaṃ hemasaṃyutam || 111 ||
taḍāgayāgapakṣe tu suvarṇaṃ cārdhameva vā || 112 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge daśamo.adhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
pūjākramavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha pūjākramaṃ vakṣye purāṇasmṛticoditam ||
uttare paścime vātha pūrve cāpi samācaret || 1 ||
nadītīre nemiprāṃte daśadvādaśasaṃkhyayā ||
maṃḍalaṃ racayedviprāścarukadvayasaṃyutam || 2 ||
tribhāgaṃ vibhajetkṣetraṃ madhyabhāgadvayena tu ||
trihastavedikāṃ kuryāttālotsedhāmudakplavām || 3 ||
uttarāśe dakṣiṇe cāratnihastāṃtare.api ca ||
trimekhalāṃ hastamātrāṃ guṇavedīsamanvitām|| 4 ||
mūle sārdhaṃ ca śuklāṃ ca mekhalāṃ tu tathaiva ca ||
caturaṃgulikāṃ vediṃ madhyonnatāṃ prakalpayet || 5 ||
ṣaṭsaptāṃgulikāṃ yoniṃ paścime mekhalopari ||
vinyasennābhisaṃyuktamevaṃ kuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 6 ||
śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ kuryātsaṃkalpaṃ mānasaṃ caret ||
śrāddhārthaṃ naiva saṃkalpettathā vai devadarśane || 7 ||
gayāśrāddhārthakaṃ cāṣṭatīrthaśrāddhārthameva ca ||
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ pūjayedgaṇanāyakam || 8 ||
madhye kuṇḍe mahāṃścaiva viṣṇudevaṃ digīśvarān||
brahmāṇaṃ cāgnikuṇḍe tu svaiḥ svairmantraiḥ prapūjayet || 9 ||
prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyātha bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ||
dhyāyedvāṭavīśapuruṣaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 2.2.11.10 ||
śvetaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāṃtaṃ kuṇḍalādyairalaṃkṛtam ||
pustakaṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca varābhayakaraṃ param || 11 ||
pitṛvaiśvānaropetaṃ kuṭilabhrūpaśobhitam ||
karālavadanaṃ caiva ājānukaralaṃbitam || 12 ||
pṛthvīdharoryamā caiva tathāṣṭavaneṣṭitau || 13 ||
vakṣasthale .aparāṃ saṃdhyāṃ yajeccaiva yathāvidhi ||
netrayorditiparjanyau śrotre ditījyaputrakau || 14 ||
sarpendrāvāsanasthau ca vāme dakṣaṃ vibhāvayet ||
satyasomāgnayastatra rāhoḥ paṃca ca paṃca ca || 15 ||
rudraśca rājayakṣmā ca vāmahaste vyavasthitau ||
ubhau jñeyau tathā jānvorubhau gandharvapuṣpakau ||
jaṃghayorbhṛṃgasugrīvau sphicordauvāriko gaṇaḥ || 17 ||
jayaśakrau tathā meḍhre padayoḥ pitarastathā ||
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ some naivaṃ viciṃtayet || 18 ||
tāvadvīryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ brahmaṇeti ca || 19 ||
āsanaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ dharmeṇāpi svaśaktitaḥ ||
ādau tu bhāskaraṃ sūryaṃ śacīnāthaṃ gaṇādhipam || 21 ||
ādhāraśaktiṃ pṛthivīṃ pūjayettatra paṅkajam ||
baṃdīśāsanamityuktaṃ pūjayedāsanaṃ tataḥ || 22 ||
sitacandanayuktena śvetapuṣpaṃ pragṛhya ca ||
harerdhyānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpayenmadhyamaṇḍale ||23||
āvāhya cāsanaṃ dadyāttataḥ pādyādikatrayam ||
madhuparkaṃ tato dadyādvāstoṣpatimatheśvaram || 24 ||
asya mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando gāyatramīritam ||

gṛhebhyaścaiva somāya tvaṣṭre caiva ca śūline ||
imaṃ me varuṇetyādi pratyekaṃ syādgatitrayam || 11 ||
tatorghyadānaṃ vidhivatkṣīreṇa haviṣā madhu ||
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ kuṃbhaṃ kukṣau nidhāya ca||12||

chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devatā ca jalādhipaḥ||13||
varuṇasyottaṃbhaneti maṃtrasya jalakuṃbhaṃ nivedayet ||
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirnāradaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
virāṭchandaśca īśāno devatā samudāhṛtā ||14||
mocayenmīnayugmaṃ ca meṣayugmaṃ tathaiva ca ||
saṃbhave pakṣiyugmaṃ ca āḍīṃ vā cakravākakam ||15||
mocayennāgayugmaṃ ca āyuvṛddheśca hetave ||
dikṣu jīvaṃtikāṃ dadyādrākṣasebhyo baliṃ haret || 16 ||
nirmitaṃ māṣabhaktena raktapuṣpairalaṃkṛtam ||
kṣātrako lakṣmaṇaścaiva maṇibhadro gaṇeśvaraḥ ||
sabiṃdukena haṃtena dikṣu madhye yathā kramāt || 17 ||
ye bhavā bhāvino bhūtā ye ca teṣu mayāsinaḥ ||
āharaṃ tu baliṃ tuṣṭyā prayacchaṃtu śubhaṃ mama || 18 ||
ityuktvā ca baliṃ dadyānnamaskuryādanaṃtaram ||
dadyātpayasvinīṃ gāṃ ca ācāryāya viśeṣataḥ || 19 ||
anyeṣāṃ hi hiraṇyaṃ ca gāṃ ca dadyāddvijanmane ||
vyāhṛtidvitayaṃ caiva tato vāruṇapaṃcakam || 2.2.12.20 ||
prājāpatyaṃ sviṣṭakṛcca juhuyāttadanaṃtaram ||
ghṛtaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ nāsti tathā rasavisārakaiḥ || 21 ||
padmotpalairmātuliṃgaiḥ panasairmātuluṃgakaiḥ ||
madhūkairviśvapuṣpaiśca tathāmrātakakāśakaiḥ || 22 ||
abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryātsuvāstviti ca vai japan ||
pañcadoṣaṃ puraskṛtya brāhmaṇānumatena ca ||
gṛhaṃ praviśya ca tato brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet || 24 ||
jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta dadhikṣīrāmiṣaṃ vinā || 25 ||
na kṣīraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca bharjitaṃ śākameva ca ||
na kāṇḍaṃ ca na puṣpaṃ ca karīraṃ ca kadācana || 26 ||
śālyannaṃ mūlakaṃ caiva panasāmraphalāni ca ||
mastaṃ madhughṛtaguḍaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ sasaiṃdhavam || 27 ||
badaraṃ dhātakiphalaṃ kunda puṣpaṃ tathā tilam ||
etatpraśastaṃ jānīyānmarīcāni viśeṣataḥ || 28 ||
trirātramatha saptāhaṃ parityajya khale tataḥ ||
pañcāṃgakaṃ tataḥ kuryātsthāpa yenneti yugmakam || 29 ||
prathamā cārkahastena dvitīyā daśahastikā ||
vitaste tu bhavecchataṃ dviguṇaṃ tadanaṃtaram || 2.2.12.30 ||
śatārdhaṃ tataḥ paścātṣaṣṭihastamanaṃtaram || 31 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāge.arghyadānavidhau dvādaśo.adhyāyaḥ ||12||a||
agnihotravidhānavarṇanam
||sūta uvāca|| ||
svagṛhyāgnividhiṃ vakṣye yogabhedeṣu sattamāḥ ||
na paroktaṃ vidhānena bhayadaṃ kīrtidhvaṃsanam || 1 ||

gṛhyā iti samākhyātā yajamānasya dāyadāḥ || 2 ||

ācāryavihitaḥ kalpastasmāccakṣa iti smṛtaḥ || || 3 ||

uttarāgrāṃ likhedrekhāmanyathā.amaṃgalaṃ bhavet || 14 ||
āpyāyasveti mantrasya dhanvatari ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tallagnaṃ dakṣiṇe caikaṃ pūrvārddhadvādaśāṅgulam ||
anyāṃgulāṃtaraṃ caikaṃ tataḥ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavet || 16 ||

aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca saṃjyotīti ca saṃjapan || 17 ||
saṃsmarenmitrā varuṇau ṛṣirautathyasaṃjñakaḥ ||
paṃktiśchandaḥ śivo devo rekhāmatha ca yojayet || 18 ||
tenaivorddhvakarau kuryāddakṣavāme sakṛtsakṛt ||
bhāsvarāya kṣipedagnau tata ūrdhvaṃ raṇaṃ smṛtam || 19 ||
sadasaṃpadṛṣiḥ karṇo virāḍiti udāhṛtaḥ ||
chanda indro devatā ca pṛthivyā devatā bhavet || 2.2.13.20 ||
kuśapuṣpodakenāpi devatīrthena sattamāḥ ||
paṃcagavyena matimānpañcaratnodakena ca ||
pañcapallavatoyena mahāyoge viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||
athonasya ca mantrasya variṣṭhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kīśādagniṃ samādāya me gṛhṇāmīti saṃpaṭhan ||
me gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya ṛṣirgautama īritaḥ ||
chandonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vāmadevo.atha devatā || 23 ||
kravyādagniṃ parityajya kravyādamagnimīrayan ||
mantreṇānena matimāndakṣiṇasyāṃ vinikṣipet || 24 ||
asya mantrasya hārīta ṛṣiḥ syācchanda iṣyate ||
devatā vāmadevo.api dāhepi viniyojayet || 25 ||
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsaṃsarakṣeti saṃjapan||
saṃsarakṣeti maṃtrasya ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ||
virāṭ chando.atha vijñeyo devatā ca śatakratuḥ || 26 ||
vaiśvānara iti ṛcā agnisthāpanamīritam||

anuṣṭup ca bhavecchando devatā havyavāhanaḥ || 27 ||
badhnāsīti ca maṃtreṇa agniṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ||
ṛṣiḥ svayaṃbhūrākhyāto virāṭchanda udāhṛtam ||
devatā paramātmā ca namaskāreṇa yojayet || || 28 ||
tatognidakṣiṇe bhāge prāgagrakuśakubjake ||

brahmayajñānṛcā dogdhrī dhenuriti tvṛcā ||2.2.13.30||

śakro.asya trāyatāmeti śṛṇu ṛgbhyāmṛṣīdvijāḥ ||31||

agneruttarabhāge ca hastamānāṃtarepi ca ||

jagatī ca bhavecchando devatā ca śatakratuḥ || 34 ||
śrīparṇīsahakārotthaṃ varuṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||

prayojanādikaṃ dravyaṃ tata āsādayetkramāt ||

makhe sarvatra brahmāṇamṛtvijaṃ varayedatha ||
kuśakaṇḍīṃ svagṛhyena kṛtvāgniṃ cārcayettataḥ || 1 ||
āghārājyabhāgau tu mahāvyāhṛtayastrayaḥ ||
sarvaṃ prāyaścittasaṃjñakaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛt || 2 ||
etannityaṃ hi sarvatra home karmaṇi nirdiśet ||

agnaye caiva somāya ājyabhāgau prakīrtitau||
bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayaścaiva mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||4||
ayāścāgne iti tathā ye te śatamanuttamam ||

prājāpatyāhutiścaikā sviṣṭakṛccāparā smṛtā ||

naimittikaṃ vinā nityaṃ viphalaṃ yāti nānyathā || || 8 ||
nityaṃ varjyaṃ śatārdhena vaiśvadeve tathaiva ca || trya
hasādhyādiyāgeṣu yannideśaṃ śṛṇu dvijāḥ || 9 ||
ekāhe vāghārārajyau kṛtvā naimittikīṃ kṛtīḥ ||
samā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ vidyādākṛtyādyāstataḥ param || 2.2.14.10 ||
viśeṣatastryahādau tu aghārāvājyapūrvakam ||
paścānnaimittikaṃ kuryātsamāptidivase pyatha || 11 ||
āghārārājyapūrveṇa tato naimittikaṃ caret ||
sviṣṭakṛdvyāhṛtiścaiva vāruṇādyāstathā hi ṣaṭ || 12 ||
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ ||
ekasmindivase kuryātsomayāge ca śaiśave || 13 ||
dvijātīnāṃ vivāhe tu naityikaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet ||
ekasmindivase kuryādagnikāryaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 14 ||
dadyādekaṃ ca nityaṃ ca pṛthaṅ nityaṃ na cācaret ||
dvijātiḥ patito yatra dvitrikaṃ ca catuścatuḥ || 15 ||
ekasmindivase kuryāttatrāpi naittikaṃ tyajet ||
home brahmā stute viṣṇuḥ sruve caiva maheśvaraḥ || 16 ||
ajasyāniyame cendro.adhiśrayaṇaṃ vivasvataḥ ||
paryagnikaraṇe caiva udvāhe mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 17 ||
candrādityau cotpavane vīkṣaṇe ca diśastathā ||
prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpane durgā ime lakṣmī pratiṣṭhitā || 18 ||
homaṃ kuryāddvijaśreṣṭhā vidhiṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ||
eteṣu devatāḥ proktā dvijātīnāṃ hitāya ca||19||

devatāḥ sarvā jñātavyā etā yajñe samāhitaiḥ ||2.2.14.20||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha vakṣyāmi saccaiṣāṃ devānāṃ dhyānamuttamam ||
asya yajñe parijñānājjihvā samyakphalapradā ||1||
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ prathamāṃ vahnijihvāṃ mahādyutim ||
kanakāḍhyakarāṃ devīṃ hiraṇyākhyeṣṭasiddhaye || 2 ||
kanakāṃ dvibhujāṃ śuklāṃ hastābhyāṃ darbhasaṃyutām ||
kamaṃḍaluṃ ca bibhrāṇāṃ numaḥ sādhakasiddhidām || 3 ||
udyadindunibhāṃ raktāṃ caturbhirbhujapa llavaiḥ ||
śaṃkhacakrābhayavarāndadhatīṃ praṇamāmyaham || 4 ||

dakṣiṇena varāraktāṃ dhārayaṃtīṃ namāmyaham || 9 ||
suprabhāmaṇḍalābhā ca karābhyāṃ tatkṛtāñjaliḥ ||
padmāsanasthā kauśeyavasanā me prasīdatu || 6 ||
japākusumasaṃkāśā bahurūpā sakhe mama ||
śubhadā syādbhujaiḥ śubhrā sahasraṃ dadhatī parān || 7 ||
nīlotpalanibhe devi vahnivarṇaparābhave ||
japāpuṣpadhare nityaṃ satīrūpe prasīda me || 8 ||

trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ kuryāccatuḥsūtraṃ nipātayet || 9 || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvadine kuryāddevādhivāsanam ||

dadyādgandhaṃ tailayutaṃ gandhadvāretyṛcā punaḥ || 2.2.16.20 ||
yāḥ phalinīti ca phalaṃ pūgatānāmavarjanam ||
kauśikīruttamosīti dadyātkhaḍgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam || 21 ||
rūpena veti mantreṇa mudgaraṃ ca nivedayet ||
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ viśvānīti ca saṃpaṭhan || 22 ||
nirmathanaṃ tataḥ kāryamiti sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ ||
tatodhivāsakalpe tu pradeśe tu samācaret || 23 ||

sthaṃḍile hasta mātreṇa vālukānirmite.api ca ||

ekaikāṃgulako viprāḥ pīṭhe nāsti vicāraṇā ||
navapañcaka kuṇḍe ca lakṣādāvapi śaṃkayā || 27 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
gato yāgagṛhādanyanmaṇḍalāṃtaramāśritaḥ ||
yajamānastathā nityaṃ karma kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 1 ||
paṃca devānnamaskṛtya tathā yajñeśvaraṃ harim ||

saṃsthāpyājyāhutiṃ dadyāttamīśāna ṛcā punaḥ||
āsadyairmaṃtrasaṃyuktairdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yajet || 126 ||
varuṇātmakaṃ tato dhyātvā tato nīrājanaṃ paṭhet ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā paṭhejjñānāmṛtaṃ stavam || 127 ||
dharmo vaṃśaṃ tataḥ kuryādutsargāṃte vidhīyate ||
tato devīṃ punaḥ kṛtvā dattvā puṣpāñjalitrayam || 128 ||
sarvasattvopakārāya samutsṛjettu vai janam ||
utsṛṣṭaṃ sarvasattvebhyo dṛśyate jalamūrjitam || 129 |||
ramaṃtīṃ sarvabhūtāni snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ ||
varuṇaṃ ca tato devaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ ca nikṣipet || 2.2.20.130 ||
jale varuṇamantreṇa matsyādīnprakṣipettataḥ ||
pakṣiṇaśca śubhāṃstatra bhekaṃ kūrmaṃ ca kardamam ||131||
śaivālaṃ prakṣipeccaiva dakṣiṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram ||
suvarṇaṃ dhānyaratnaṃ ca ācāryāya pṛthagdadet||132||
brāhmaṇebhyo gāyanebhyo vasubhyaśca pṛthakpṛthak || 133 ||
nityaṃ samāpya vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ ||
dadyādarghyaṃ ca sūryāya hastāsa iti saṃjapan || 134 ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaṃ saṃveṣṭya kṣīradhārayā ||
prāsādapakṣe prāsādamārāme atha maṃḍapam ||135||
śatādhidhārayā śaktyā trivāraṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ||
vikīrya lājakusumaṃ vrīhīścaiva kapardakān || 136 ||
tūryaghoṣeṇa mahatā tato viprapuraḥsaram ||
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkaḥ praviśetsvagṛhaṃ punaḥ || 137 ||
tato gṛhārcanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānatha bhojayet ||
kumārīśca kumārāṃśca dīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi ||138||
nārāyaṇaṃ tato dadyādvipramuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || 139 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāga viṃśo.adhyāyaḥ|| 20 || cha || iti madhyamaparvaṇi dvitīyabhāgaḥ samāptaḥ || 2 ||

upavanādipratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
|| || sūta uvāca || ||
ārāmādau viśeṣo yo vakṣyate.atra mayādhunā ||
aiśānyāṃ kalaśe devaṃ tatra nāthaṃ prapūjayet ||
madhyame kalaśe pūjā grahāṇāṃ ca tataḥ param || 2 ||
svadikṣu dvāradeśe tu paścimadvāradeśayoḥ ||
brahmāṇaṃ cāpyanantaṃ ca madhyato varuṇaṃ yajet ||3||
varuṇaṃ codakumbhasthaṃ bhūtaśākhāsu śobhanam ||
tena cāvāhayāmi tvāṃ vibho svargāya vai bhava ||4||
pūrvagaṃ mandaraṃ sthāpya toraṇopari sattamāḥ ||
viṣvaksenaṃ samabhyarcya arcanaṃ svargasaṃyutam ||5||
caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmavibhūṣitam || 6 ||
dakṣiṇe kamalā tasya vāme puṣṭivyavasthitiḥ || 7 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā viṣṇorarāṭa ityṛcā || 8 ||
dale saṃkarṣaṇādīṃśca vimalādyāśca nāyikāḥ ||
saṃpūjya dhūpadīpādyairupahārairanuttamaiḥ || 9 ||
ghṛtapradīpo devasya gugguluḥ saralastathā ||
dhūpo devabaliḥ kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ ghṛtaplutam || 2.3.1.10 ||
dhyāyetsomaṃ karṇikāyāṃ dakṣiṇe padmasaṃsthitam ||
śuklābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ keyūrādyupaśobhitam|| 11 ||
praśasyaṃ devayakṣāṇāṃ varadābhayahastakam ||
imaṃ devā iti ṛcā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 12 ||
pūjayecca niśānāthaṃ ghṛtabhaktaṃ nivedayet ||
indraṃ jayantamākāśaṃ varuṇaṃ cāgnimeva ca || 13 ||
īśānaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ caiva vāyuṃ pūrvādidikṣvapi ||
karṇikāyā vāmabhāge varadābhayahastakam ||14||
dvibhujaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ ca mahādevaṃ prapūjayet ||
tryaṃbakeṇa ca maṃtreṇa dadyācca ghṛtapiṣṭakam || 15 ||
vāsudevāya devāya juhuyādaṣṭa āhutīḥ ||
paramānnena saumyasya juhuyādaṣṭaviṃśatim || 16 ||
śivāya paramānnena juhuyādāhutidvayam ||
gaṇeśasya tathājyena dadedekāhutiṃ budhaḥ || || 17 ||
brahmaṇo varuṇasyātha ekaikāmāhutiṃ tathā ||
grahāṇāṃ svoktasamidhā digīśānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 18 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādājyena ca yathākram ||
karālī dhūmalī śvetā lohitā kanakaprabhā || 19 ||
atiraktā padmarāgā vahnijihvā prakīrtitāḥ ||
tāsāṃ maṃtrāḥ krameṇaiva sādivāsāṃta bindavaḥ || 2.3.1.20 ||
yakārasthāśca vijñeyā aṣṭasvaravibhūṣitāḥ ||
ghṛtamadhvājyasiktābhirhomayecca pṛthakpṛthak || 21 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāddattvā caiva samāhitaḥ ||
agnīṣomaṃ tathendraṃ ca pṛthivīmantarikṣakam || 22 ||
sthālīpākena juhuyānmadhukṣīrayavānvitam ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ teṣāṃ samuddiśya pṛthakpṛthak || 23 ||
yāvakairgaṃdhapuṣpādyairarcitvā saparāvakam ||
japasva tvaṃ mahābhāga śraddhayā caiva vāgyataḥ || 24 ||
jāpako vidhinānena prajapettatra ruddhakam ||
maṅgalaṃ paramānnaṃ ca saurasūktaṃ tathā japet || 25 ||
tataḥ saṃmṛjya vidhinā snāpayitvā yathāvidhi ||
yūpaṃ garbhe vinikṣipya tatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||26||
dhvajānāropya prāṃteṣu dadyātsomaṃ vanaspatim ||
ko.adāditi paṭhitvā ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ karṇavedhanam ||27||
sūcyā sutīkṣṇayā kāryaṃ dvipātre vāmadakṣiṇe ||
navagrahāṇāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ yāvakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā || 28 ||
piṣṭakaṃ ca pṛthagdadyātkumārībālakeṣu ca ||
niśāraṃjitasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya ca sacūrṇakam || 29||
pradadyāddohakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
prāśayeccaiva tānvṛkṣānimaṃ mantramudāharet || 2.3.1.30 ||
vṛkṣāgrātpatitasyāpi ārohātpatitasya ca||
maraṇe vāsthibhaṅge vā kartā pāpairna lipyate ||31||
dhenuṃ suvarṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca ācāryāya pradakṣiṇam||
dattvā ca ṛtvije dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 32 ||
dhānyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadyādghṛtabhojyaṃ saśarkaram ||
iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsadasyāya tathaiva ca || 33 ||
adhikalaśaṃ samānīya snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ ||
kṛtvā caivāniśaṃ kuryāddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tathā ||34||
sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ prokṣya trivāraṃ kṣīradhārayā ||
saṃveṣṭya triścaturvāraṃ brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram || || 35 ||
gṛhaṃ vrajettato vipraiḥ kuryāccaiva gṛhārcanam ||
taṃtau viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi varā evedamityṛcā || 36 ||
vāsudevaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ tato nārāyaṇaṃ yajet||37||
dadhibhaktaṃ baliṃ dadyātpañcagavyasamudbhavam||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet||38||
śuddhakāṃñcanavarṇābhāṃ varābhayakarāṃ śubhām ||
maṃḍūkasthāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ sarvālaṅkārasundarīm ||39||
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyātsaśarkaram || 2.3.1.40 ||
vāmato viśvakarmāṇaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham ||
śūlaṭaṃkadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ saṃyajedupacārakaiḥ || 41 ||
viśvanniti ṛcā taṃ ca baliṃ ca madhu piṣṭakam ||
dadyājjapecca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca |||45|||
madhupāyasayuktena homānaṣṭau vidhāya ca||
ekaikaṃ homayetpaścā tpṛthivīhomakarmaṇi ||43||
samutsṛjya tataḥ setumimaṃ mantraṃ paṭhettataḥ ||
picchile patitānāṃ ca ucchritenāṃgasaṃgataḥ || 44 ||
pratiṣṭhite dharmasetau dharmo me syānna pātakam ||
setorasya prabandhasya śraddhayā parayā tathā || 45 ||
ye cātra prāṇinaḥ saṃti rakṣāṃ kurvati setavaḥ ||
vedāgamena yatpuṇyaṃ yathaiva hi samarpitam || 46 ||
gartaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ tadanantaram ||
saṃsthāpya ca tato yūpaṃ saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi || 47 ||
ācāryāya tato dadyādiṣṭāṃ ca varadakṣiṇām ||
poṭikāṃ ca tataḥ śayyāṃ dadyādiṣṭārthasiddhaye ||
setau vṛkṣa sthitā ye syū ropayetkadalīṃ śubhām || 49 ||
teṣāṃ pārśvadvayepyevamārāme ca pṛthakpṛthak || 2.3.1.50 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe madhya maparvaṇi tṛtīyabhāge prathamo.adhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||

gopracāravaiśiṣṭyavarṇanam
|| sūta uvāca || ||
gopracāraṃ punarvakṣye viśeṣaṃ tatra me śṛṇu ||
upacāraiśca brahmāṇaṃ rudraṃ caiva karālikām ||
varāhaṃ somasūrye ca mahādevaṃ yathākramam || 2 ||
homaṃ caiva yathā viṣṇoḥ kamalāyāstrayaṃtrayam ||
ājyena kṣetrapālānāmanyeṣāṃ madhumiśritaiḥ || 3 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāllājādiṣu pṛthakpṛthak ||
samutsṛjya vidhānena yūpaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 4 ||
trihastamāttraṃ racitaṃ kuryānnāgaphaṇānvitam ||
ropayedekahastena garbhe homaṃ prayojayet ||5||
lājāsaṃyuktavidhinā viśveṣāmiti sañjapan ||
nāgādhipataye tadvadacyutāya tṛtīyakam || 6 ||
bhaumāyeti caturthaṃ ca tato yūpaṃ nivedayet ||
mayi gṛbhṇāmīti sampūjya yūpaṃ ca rudradaivatama || 7 ||
saṃpūjya rudraṃ pañcāṃgaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
ācāryāya tathā hotre anyeṣāmiṣṭadakṣiṇām || 8 ||
gopracāre ca śaileyaṃ yūpaṃ hastadvayānvitam ||
pañcaśīrṣānvitaṃ kuryāddhastamātraṃ praropayet || 9 ||
yūpaṃ ca caitravṛkṣaṃ ca kuṇḍalīmaṭhapīṭhikām ||
saṃspṛśyācamya vai viprāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 2.3.2.10 ||
caturhastapramāṇena śatakuṇḍena saṃmitam ||
tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhena aṣṭakāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet || 11 ||
bhūmau ratnaṃ ca saṃsthāpya imaṃ mantramudāharet ||
śivalokastathā gāvaḥ sarvadevasupūjitāḥ || 12 ||
gobhya eṣā mayā bhūmiḥ sampradattā śubhārthinā ||
evaṃ nivedayedyastu gopracāraṃ samāhitaḥ || 13 ||
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca || 14 ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
pūrve sīmāṃ nibadhnīyātkṛtvā vṛkṣasya ropaṇam || 15 ||
setuṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ paścimeṃgāraropaṇam ||
uttare khānayetkūpaṃ tasya sīmāṃ na laṃghayeta||16||
tataḥ sahasradhārāṃ ca śasyena paripūritām ||
pradadyādvā tato viprāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||17||
nagaragrāmapūrve vā uttare paścimepi vā ||
na kuryādagnidigbhāge dakṣiṇāṃ vā tataḥ śubhām || 18 ||
gopracāraṃ khanedyastu vāhayedvā kathaṃcana ||
kulāni pātayatyāśu brahmahatyāśca viṃdati || 19 ||
svargaṃ nayati gocarma samyagdattaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||
yāvattṛṇāni tadbhūmau saptasaṃkhyāni saṃkhyayā || 2.3.2.20 ||
mahāyāgāvasāne ca yo na tarpayati dvijān ||
nirarthakaṃ tasya karma prayāsaphalamātrakam || 22 ||
vṛṣotsargā vasāne tu pradadyādyo mahīṃ dvijāḥ ||
na yāti viprāḥ pretatvaṃ tasmādviprādamatsarāḥ || 23 ||
tatra mānaṃ pṛthakcaiva śṛṇutātra samāgatāḥ ||
amānena dadedyastu narakaṃ yāti rauravama || 24 ||
tadgocarmeti vikhyātaṃ dattaṃ sarvāghanāśanam || 25 ||
gopracārasya devasya brāhmaṇasya ca bho dvijāḥ ||
yāvatkālāvadhe sīmā atīte nāsti pātakam || 26 ||
maṇḍapaṃ pūjayetsūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam||
homastila guḍābhyāṃ ca aṣṭāvaṣṭau pṛthakpṛthak || 27 ||
dehi meti ca mantreṇa vinyasenmaṃḍapopari ||
yatnasiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śulkaghaṭacatuṣṭayam|| 28 ||
samutsṛjejjapetpaścātsauraṃ sūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||
vaṭapatre tu saṃlikhya citraṃ nirmāya vā punaḥ || 29 ||
dikpālānsaṃnyasetsvāsu svāsu dikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhenmaṃtrāniṃdrādīnāṃ yathākramam || 2.3.2.30 ||
vajrahasto mahendra tvaṃ dharmatastrātumarhasi ||31||
bho vahne meṣavāhastvaṃ catuḥśṛṃgavirājita ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 32 ||
yama tvaṃ dakṣiṇāśeśa mahāmahiṣavāhana ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 33 ||
mañcastho rākṣasendrastvaṃ khaḍgapāṇirmahābalaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 34 ||
vārirāṭ dhvajahasto.asi pavano mṛgavāhanaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 35 ||
dhanādhyakṣo gadāhastaḥ piṃgākṣo naravāhanaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 36 ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 37 ||
anaṃto nāgarājo yo dharāmuddhṛtya tiṣṭhati ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatasrātumarhasi || 38 ||
caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ sthityarthaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām ||
prītaye vāsudevasya evaṃ maṇḍapamutsṛjet || 39 ||
bhagne stambhe tṛṇe jīrṇe punastṛṇapradāpane ||
sthāpane ca tathaivāsya pratiṣṭhā syādyathākṣayā || 2.3.2.40 ||
ghātāpāyādidoṣeṇa mriyaṃte yadi jantavaḥ ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tu dharmo me syānna pātakam || 41 ||

svasti cāstu sadā teṣāṃ tvatprasādātkila prabho || 42 ||
tatastriguṇasūtreṇa sutrāmāṇeti vai ṛcā ||

upānahau tathā chatramācāryāya nivedayet ||
maṇḍape bhojayedviprāṃsteṣāṃ dadyādyathepsitān || || 44 ||
dīnebhyaśca pṛthagdadyādgṛhaṃ viprapuraḥsaram ||
praviśettūryaghoṣeṇa prakuryācca gṛhārcanam || 45 ||
evaṃ prapāyāṃ vijñeyo viśeṣo varuṇaṃ vrajet ||
vāsudevena sahitaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 46 ||
sthālīpākavidhānena prakuryāddeśikottamaḥ ||
ācāryāya gṛhaṃ dadyātparicchedasamanvitam || 47 ||
ṛtvije tāmrapātraṃ ca jalapūrṇaṃ ca dhānyakam ||
dikpālāndvāradeśe tu kūpayāge viśeṣataḥ || 48 ||
brahmāṇaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dvārapālau ca paścime ||
yajenmantraiḥ pṛthagdevānmantrairebhiryathākramam || 49 ||
balidānaṃ vidhānena kṛtvā dadyādyathāvidhi ||
vajrī ca dhūmalī kṛṣṇā pītā caivātha vāruṇī ||
śīghrā gaurī umā caiva pītā śuklā prakīrtitā ||51||
kuṃbheṣu pūjayeddevānmaheśaṃ prathamaṃ budhaḥ ||
vedikāpūrvabhāge tu uttare kalaśe śivam ||
dakṣiṇe kalaśe viṣṇuṃ karṇikāyāṃ jaleśvaram || 53 ||
kalaśe vidhivadbhaktyā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
saṃpūjya vaṭapatre ca nāgānsaṃlikhya nāgajaiḥ || 54 ||
yo nāgāstānpravakṣyāmi anaṃto vāsukistathā ||
tathā karkoṭakaścaiva padmaśca kulikastathā ||
padmaścaiva mahāpadmo mantrairebhiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 55 ||
puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubhakarṇāṃtalocana ||
phaṇāsahasrasaṃyukta śaṃkhābjakṛtalocana || 56 ||
anaṃta nāgarājendra ihāgaccha namo.astu te ||
sita kuṃdenduvarṇābha visphuradbhogamaṃḍala || 57 ||
sarvanāgasya śūrasya kṛtasvastikalāṃchana ||
nāgendratakṣaka śrīmannihāgaccha namostu te || 58 ||
navīnajaladaśyāma śrīmankamalalocana ||
viṣadarpabalonmatta grīvāyāmekaśekhara || 59 ||
śaṃkhapāla iti khyāta jalādhārapratīkṣaka ||
adhyakṣe nāgalokānāmihāgaccha namo.astu te || 2.3.2.60 ||
atipīta suvarṇābha candrārdhāṃkitamastaka ||
kulīra nāgarājeṃdra sarvasattvahite rata ||
tiṣṭheha yajñasiddhyarthaṃ kāmarūpa namostu te || 62||
paṃcabiṃdukṛtābhogo grīvāyāmekaśekharaḥ ||
tasmai te padmanāgendra tīvrarūpa namo.astu te || 63 ||
sarve te prītamanasaḥ pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu me sadā || 64 ||
ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya juhuyāddigīśānāṃ yathākramam || 65 ||
ādityādigrahāṃścaiva brahmāṇaṃ kṛṣṇameva ca ||
madhupiṣṭena ca śivaṃ varuṇaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || 66 ||
prādeśamātraṃ saṃprokṣya yūpaṃ cāsya pramāṇakam ||
caturasraṃ śūlayuktaṃ gaṇānānīya pūjayet || 67 ||
kūpe nikṣipya tānnāgānpañcaratnaṃ kṣipettataḥ ||
sutrāmāṇeti maṃtreṇa tridhā saṃveṣṭya sūtrakaiḥ || 68 ||
rañjitaḥ kadalīvṛkṣaṃ varuṇāya samutsṛjet ||

iti bhāvaṃ ca sā kṛtvā.a.alibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau gṛham || 14 ||
tīrthārthaṃ ca samaṃ pitrā saṃprāptā girijāvane ||
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ sa nṛpo mārabāṇena pīḍitaḥ || 15 ||
mahatīṃ mānasīṃ pīḍāṃ prāptavānmohamāgataḥ ||
unmādīva tato bhūtvā khādyapānavivarjitaḥ || 16 ||
dhyātvā padmāvatīṃ bālāṃ maunavratamacīkarat ||
tadā kolāhalo jātaḥ pratāpamukuṭāṃtike || 17 ||
kumāraḥ kāṃ daśāṃ prāpta iti hāheti sarvataḥ ||
tridināṃte maṃtrisuto buddhi dakṣo viśāradaḥ || 18 ||
abravīdvajramukuṭaṃ satyaṃ kathaya bhūpate ||
sa āha kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ yathā jātaṃ sarovare || 19 ||
tacchrutvā buddhidakṣaśca viha syāha mahīpatim ||
mahākaṣṭena sā devī mitratvaṃ hi gamiṣyati || 3.2.1.20 ||
karaṇāṭakabhūpasya daṃtavaktrasya sā sutā ||
padmāvatīti vikhyātā dadhatī tvāṃ svamānase || 21 ||
puṣpabhāvena jñātvāhaṃ tvāṃ nayāmi tadaṃtike ||
ityuktvā tasya pitaraṃ pratāpamukuṭaṃ prati || 22 ||
āhājñāṃ dehi bhūpāla yāsyehaṃ kāraṇāṭake ||
tvatsutasya cikitsārthaṃ sa vajramukuṭo.aciram || 23 ||
āyāmi nā.atra sandeho yadi jīvayase sutam ||
tatheti matvā sa nṛpaḥ prādātputraṃ ca mantriṇe || 24 ||
hayārūḍhau gatau śīghraṃ daṃtavaktrasya pattane ||
kācidvṛddhā sthitā tatra tasyā gehaṃ ca tau gatau || 25 ||
bahudravyaṃ dadau tasyai buddhidakṣo viśāradaḥ ||
ūṣaturmaṃdire tasminrātriṃ ghoratamovṛtām || 26 ||
prātaḥkāle tu sā vṛddhā gacchatī rājamandiram ||
tāmāha mantritanayaḥ śṛṇu mātarvaco mama || 27 ||
padmāvatīṃ ca saṃprāpyaikāṃte madvacanaṃ vada ||
jyeṣṭhaśuklasya pañcamyāmiṃduvāre sarovare || 28 ||
yo dṛṣṭaḥ puruṣo ramyastvadarthe samupāgataḥ||
iti śrutvā yayau vṛddhā padmaṃ tasyai nyavedayat || 29 ||
ruṣṭā padmāvatī prāha caṃdanārdrāṃgulīyikā ||
gaccha gaccha mahāduṣṭe talenorasyatāḍayat ||3.2.1.30 ||
aṃgulībhiḥ kapolau ca tasyāḥ spṛṣṭvā yayau gṛham ||
sā tu vṛddhā buddhidakṣaṃ sarvaṃ bhāvaṃ nyavedayat || || 31 ||
samitraṃ duḥkhitaṃ prāha śṛṇu mitra śucaṃ tyaja ||
tvāmāha bhūpateḥ kanyā prāṇapriya vacaḥ śṛṇu || 32 ||
tvadarthe tāḍitaṃ vakṣaḥ kadā mitraṃ bhaviṣyasi||
śrutvā tanmadhuraṃ vākyaṃ rajo dehe samāgatam || 33 ||
rajasvalāṃte bho mitra tavāsyaṃ cuṃbitāsmyaham ||
iti śrutvā bhūpasutaḥ paramā nandamāyayau || 34 ||
tridināṃte tu sā vṛddhā padmāvatyai nyavedayet ||
taṃ bhajasvādya suśroṇi saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ kuru ||
iti śrutvā mahāhṛṣṭā sā masyārdrāṃgulīyakam || 36 ||
gavākṣadvāri niṣkāsya tale pṛṣṭhe ca tāḍitā ||
tathaiva vṛddhā taṃ prāpya mantriṇaṃ cābravīdvacaḥ || 37 ||
prasanno buddhidakṣaśca mitraṃ prāha śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ||
paścime diśi bhoḥ svāmingavākṣaṃ tava nirmitam || 38 ||
arddharātre tu saṃprāpya bhaja māṃ kāmavihvalām ||
śrutvā tadvajramukuṭaḥ priyādarśanalālasaḥ || 39 ||
yayau śīghraṃ mahākāmī ramaṇīṃ tāmarāmayat ||
māsāṃte kāmaśithilo mitradarśanalālasaḥ || 3.2.1.40 ||
padmāvatīṃ priyāṃ prāha śṛṇu vākyaṃ varānane ||
yena prāptavatī mahyaṃ tvaṃ subhrūḥ suradurlabhā || 41 ||
tanmitraṃ buddhidakṣaśca kiṃ nu tiṣṭhati sāṃpratam ||
ājñāṃ dehi priye mahyaṃ dṛṣṭvāyāsyāmi teṃ.atikam || 42 ||
iti śrutvā vacastasya niṣṭhuraṃ kuli śopamam ||
miṣṭānnaṃ saviṣaṃ kṛtvā maṃtriṇe sā nyavedayat || 43 ||
tadā tu buddhidakṣaśca citraguptaprapūjakaḥ ||
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ na tu bhakṣita vānsvayam || 44 ||
etasminnantare prāpto bhūpatistvarayānvitaḥ ||
vivekavantaṃ mitraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha ruṣānvitaḥ || 45 ||
kasmānna khāditaṃ mitra bhojanaṃ matpriyākṛtam ||
vihasya buddhidakṣastu sārameye dadau hi tat || 46 ||
bhuktvā sa maraṇaṃ prāptaḥ sa dṛṣṭvā vismito nṛpaḥ ||
strīcaritraṃ ca vijñāya snehaṃ tyaktvā.abravīttu tam ||47||
mitra gaccha gṛhaṃ śīghraṃ mayā tyaktā ca pāpinī ||
sa āha śṛṇu bhūpāla gaccha śīghraṃ priyāṃtikam ||48||
tadalaṃkāramāhṛtya triśūlaṃ kuru jānuni ||
prasuptāṃ tyaja bho mitra yā hi tvaṃ mā vicāraya || 49 ||
iti śrutvā yayau bhūpastathā kṛtvā samāgataḥ ||
svamitreṇa yayau sārdhaṃ smaśāne rudramaṇḍape || 3.2.1.50 ||
śiṣyaṃ kṛtvā nṛpaṃ taṃ sa yogirūpo hi bhūṣaṇam ||
vikrayārthaṃ dadau tasmai svamitrāya sa buddhimān || 51 ||
sa vajramukuṭo matvā tadājñāṃ nagaraṃ gataḥ ||
coroyamiti taṃ matvā baddhvā rājño hi rakṣiṇaḥ || 52 ||
śīghraṃ nivedayāmāsurdantavaktrastamabravīt ||
kva prāptaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaṃ kathaya pūruṣa || 53 ||
jaṭilaḥ prāha bho rājanśmaśāne madguruḥ sthitaḥ ||
tena dattaṃ vikrayārthaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ svarṇaguṃṭhitam || 54 ||
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatistūrṇamāhūya tadgurum ||
bhūṣaṇaṃ pṛṣṭavānrājā yogī prāha śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ || 55 ||
smaśāne saṃdhitaṃ maṃtraṃ mayā yogisvarūpiṇā ||
piśācī prāpitā kācittasyāścihnaṃ mayā kṛtam || 56 ||
vāmajānuni śūlena tayā dattaṃ hi bhūṣaṇam ||
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ rājā sutā niṣkāsitā gṛhāt || 57 ||
sa vajramukuṭastāṃ tu gṛhītvā gṛhamāyayau ||
vihasya prāha vaitālaḥ śṛṇu vikramabhūpate || 58 ||
kasmai pāpaṃ mahatprāptaṃ caturṇā me vadādhunā ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
iti śrutvā vacastasya vikramo nāma bhūpatiḥ || 59 ||
vihasya bhārgavaṃ prāha prāptaṃ pāpaṃ hi bhūpateḥ ||
mitrakāryamamātyena svāmikāryaṃ ca rakṣibhiḥ || 3.2.1.60 ||
bhūpa putreṇārthasiddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmācca bhūpateḥ ||
mahatpāpaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ tenāsau narakaṃ gataḥ || 61 ||
rajovatīṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā na vivāheta yo naraḥ ||
sa pāpī narakaṃ yāti ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam || 62 ||
gāṃdharvaṃ ca vivāhaṃ vai kāminyā ca kṛtaṃ yayā ||
tasyā vighnakaro yo vai sa pāpī yamapīḍitaḥ || 63 ||
adṛṣṭadoṣāṃ yaḥ kanyāṃ vivekena vinā tyajet ||
sa pāpī narakaṃ yāti lakṣavarṣapramāṇakam || 64 ||
iti śrutvā? sa vaitālo dharmagāthāṃ nṛperitām ||
prasannahṛdayaḥ prāha bhūpatiṃ dharmatatparam ||65 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye nāma prathamo.adhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
prasannamanasaṃ bhūpaṃ mahāsiṃhāsane sthitam ||
dvijavaryaḥ sa vaitālo vacaḥ prāha prasannadhīḥ ||1||
ekadā yamunātīre dharmasthalapurī śubhā ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktā caturvarṇasamanvitā || 2 ||
guṇādhipo mahīpālastatra rājyaṃ cakāra vai ||
hariśarmā purodhāstu snānapūjanatatparaḥ ||3 ||
satyaśīlaḥ suto jāto vidyādhyayanatatparaḥ || 4 ||
dvādaśābdavayaḥprāpte vivāhārthaṃ pitā yadā || 5 ||
bhrātā? babhrāma tau sarvaṃ cinutaśca sutāvaram ||
kadācidrājaputrasya vivāhe samato dvijaḥ || 6 ||
paṭhanārthe tu kāśyāṃ vai sattvaśīlaḥ svayaṃ gataḥ ||
vāmano nāma vikhyāto rūpaśīlavayovṛtaḥ ||
sutā madhumatī taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kāmāturā.abhavat || 8 ||
bhojanaṃ chādanaṃ pānaṃ svapnaṃ tyaktvā ca vihvalā ||
cakorīva vinā caṃdraṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā || 9 ||
dṛṣṭvā suśīlā taṃ bālā vāmanaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ||
vārayāmāsa tāṃbūlaiḥ svarṇadravyasamanvitaiḥ || 3.2.2.10 ||
hariśarmā prayoge ca dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā trivikramam ||
vedavedāṃtattvajñaṃ sutārthe.avarayattadā || 11 ||
satyaśīlastu kāśyāṃ vai guruputraṃ ca keśavam ||
varitvā taṃ bhaginyarthe yayau gehaṃ mudānvitaḥ || 12 ||
māghakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ bhṛgau lagnaṃ śubhaṃ smṛtam ||
trayo viprāstadā prāptāḥ kanyārthe rūpamohitāḥ || 13 ||
tasminkāle tu sā kanyā bhujagenaiva daṃśitā ||
mṛtā pretatvamāpannā pūrvakarmaprabhāvataḥ || 14 ||
tadā te brāhmaṇā yatnaṃ kārayāmāsuruttamam ||
na jīvanavatī bālā garalena vimohitā ||15||
hariśarmā tu tatsarvaṃ kṛtvā vedavidhānataḥ ||
āyayau maṃdiraṃ rājantsutāguṇavimohitaḥ || 16 ||
trivikramastu bahudhā duḥkhaṃ kṛtvā smarānugaḥ ||
kaṃthādhārī yatirbhūtvā deśāddeśātaraṃ yayau || 17 ||
keśavastu mahāduḥkhī priyāsthīni gṛhītavān ||
tīrthāttīrthāṃtaraṃ prāptaḥ kāmabāṇena pīḍitaḥ || 18 ||
bhasmagrāhī vāmanastu virahāgniprapīḍitaḥ ||
tasthau citāyāṃ kāmārtaḥ patnīdhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||19||
ekadā sarayūtīre lakṣmaṇākhyapure śubhe ||
trivikramastu bhikṣārthe saṃprāpto dvijamaṃdire || 3.2.2.20 ||
tasmindine rāmaśarmā śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yatinaṃ varayāmāsa bhojanārthaṃ svamaṃdire || 21 ||
tasya patnī viśālākṣī racitvā bahubhojanam ||
āhūya yatinaṃ rājanpātramālabhamākarot || 22 ||
tasminkāle ca tadbālo mṛtaḥ pāpavaśaṃgataḥ ||
arodīttasya sairaṃdhrī viśalākṣyapi bhartsitā || 23 ||
na rodanaṃ tyaktavatī putraśokāgnitāpitā ||
rāmaśarmā tadā prāpto maṃtraṃ saṃjīvanaṃ śubham || 24 ||
japitvā mārjanaṃ kṛtvā jīvayāmāsa bālakam ||
vinayāvanato viprastaṃ ca saṃnyāsinaṃ tadā|| || 25 ||
bhojanaṃ kārayitvā tu maṃtraṃ saṃjīvanaṃ dadau ||
trivikramastu taṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhitvā yamunātaṭe ||26||
prāptavānyatra sā nārī dāhitā hariśarmaṇā||
etasminnantare tatra rājaputro mṛtiṃ gataḥ || 27 ||
dāhitastanayaḥ pitrā śokakartrā tadāmunā ||
jīvanaṃ prāptavānbālastasya maṃtraprabhāvataḥ || 28 ||
guṇādhipasya tanayo rājño dharmasthalīpateḥ ||
trivikramaṃ vacaḥ prāha vīrabāhurmahābalaḥ ||29||
jīvanaṃ dattavānmahyaṃ varayādya varaṃ mama ||
sa vipraḥ prāha bho rājankeśavo nāma yo dvijaḥ || 3.2.2.30 ||
gṛhītvāsthi gatastīrthe tamanveṣaya mā ciram ||
vīrabāhustathā matvā dūtamārgeṇa taṃ prati || 31 ||
prāptastaṃ kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaṃ hi jīvanam ||
iti śrutvā vacastasya keśavo.asthisamanvitaḥ |32||
pragatyāsthīni sarvāṇi dadau tasmai dvijātaye ||
punaḥ saṃjīvitā bālā keśavādīnvaco.abravīt||33||
yogyā dharmeṇa yasyāhaṃ tasmai prāyāmi dharmiṇe||
atastvaṃ vikramāditya dharmajña kathayasva me ||
kasmai yogyā ca sā bālā nāmnā madhumatī śubhā || 35 ||
||sūta uvāca || ||
vihasya vikramādityo vaitālaṃ prāha namradhīḥ||
yogyā madhumatī nārī vāmanāya dvijanmane||36||
prāṇadātā tu yo vipraḥ piteva guṇatatparaḥ ||
asthidātā tu yo vipro bhrātṛtulyassa vedavit || 37 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye dvitīyo.adhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
vipravarya mahābhāga śṛṇu gāthāṃ manoramām||
vaitālo bhūpatiśreṣṭhaṃ punarvikramamabravīt ||1||
varddhavannagare ramye nānājananiṣevite||
vidvanmālā priyā tasya patisevāparāyaṇā ||
ekadā kṣatriyaḥ kaścinnāmnā vīravaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 3 ||
putrakanyāsapatnīko vṛttyarthaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
kiṃcicchrutvā dadau svarṇaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ nṛpa ||
vīrasenastu tallabdhvā vahnau tīrthe dvijātiṣu ||5||
vyayaṃ kṛtvā tu taccheṣaṃ sa kulye bhuktavānsvayam ||
evaṃ varṣe gate rājanrājalakṣmīḥ śivājñayā ||6||
parīkṣārthaṃ smaśāne ca rodanaṃ bahu kurvatī ||
ardharātre tadā rājā buddhvā prāha svasevakam || 7 ||
gaccha vīravara tvaṃ vai yato.asau śrūyate ravaḥ ||
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ mahyaṃ śīghraṃ nivedaya || 8 ||
iti śrutvā vīravaraḥ śastrāstrakuśalo balī ||
sa tatra gatvā yatrāste rājalakṣmīḥ śubhānanā || 9 ||
ślakṣṇaṃ vacaśca tāmāha kimarthaṃ rodane sthitā ||
mahatkaṣṭaṃ ca kiṃ prāptaṃ kāraṇaṃ devi me vada || 3.2.3.10 ||
iti śrutvā rājalakṣmīrvīrasenaṃ tamabravīt ||
rājalakṣmīṃ ca māṃ viddhi rūpasenasya bhūpateḥ || 11 ||
māsānte pralayaṃ yāsye tasmācchocāmi bho balin ||
sa āha śṛṇu bho devi tvadalpāyussa mīritam ||
kena puṇyena dīrghāyustvaṃ bhaveḥ kāraṇaṃ vada || 12 ||
devyuvāca ||
mahābāho mahāprājña yadi te tanayasya vai || 13 || ||
kapālamarpaya tvaṃ ca caṃḍikāyai tadānagha ||
dīrghāyurbhavitā cāhaṃ svāmikāryaṃ prasādhaya||14||
iti śrutvā vīravaro maṃdiraṃ svayamāgataḥ ||
patnīṃ prāha prasannātmā sutaṃ devyai nivedaya || 15 ||
tathetyuktvā tu sā sādhvī tanayaṃ prāha nirbhayā ||
rājño.arthe tava dehaṃ vai putra pāsi kuruṣva tat || 16 ||
tathā matvā tu tatputro bhaginyā mātṛsaṃyutaḥ||
caṃḍikābhavanaṃ prāpyābravītsvapitaraṃ tadā || 17 ||
bhostāta me kapālaṃ ca caṃḍikāyai samarpaya ||
dīrghāyuryena yatnena rājalakṣmīśca tatkuru || 18 ||
iti śrutvā vīrasenaḥ śiraśchittvā samārpayat ||
tasyānujā mṛtā tatra tathā mātā tathā pitā || 19 ||
dṛṣṭvā tadrūpa senastu kāraṇaṃ sarvamāditaḥ ||
sevakaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ ca matvā tu svaśiro.arpayat || 3.2.3.20 ||
tadā prasannā sā devī nṛpamujīvya sābravīt ||
sa āha vīrasenastu sakulo jīvamāpnuyāt ||
tathetyuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāṃtarhitābhavat || 22 ||
rūpasenaḥ prasannātmā svasutāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm ||
dadau sutāya vaitālo nṛpatiṃ prāha vismitaḥ||
mukhyasnehaṃ kṛtaṃ kena teṣāṃ madhye vadasva me ||23||
|| rājovāca ||
mukhyasnehaṃ kṛtaṃ rājñā dāsārthe svatanuṃ dadau ||
svarṇasnehī vīravaro dhamarprītiḥ pativratā ||
baṃdhuprītiśca bhaginī pitṛsnehī tu putrakaḥ || 24 ||
mahānsnehaḥ kṛto rājñā rūpasenena dhīmatā || 25 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṃḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye tṛtīyo.adhyāyaḥ || 3 ||cha||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
kācidbhogāvatī nāmnā nagarī paramādbhutā ||1||
rūpavarmā ca nṛpatistatra rājyaṃ karoti vai ||
cūḍāmaṇiriti khyātaḥ śuko buddhiviśāradaḥ ||2||
tasya bhūpasya gehe ca nivasanañcchubhapaṃjare ||
kadācidrūpavarmā ca triṃśadabda urūrjitaḥ || 3 ||
papraccha mama yogyā vai śuka kācidvarāṃganā ||
cedasti tarhi me brūhi śrutvā taṃ cābravīcchukaḥ || 4 ||
magadheśvarabhūpasya kanyā candravatī śubhā ||
tava yogyā hi bho rājansāṃprataṃ tāṃ gṛhāṇa vai || 5 ||
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatirgaṇeśaṃ dvijasattamam ||
preṣayitvā dadau dravyaṃ yathodvāhyā tathā kuru || 6 ||
gaṇeśopi gatastūrṇaṃ deśe māgadhake śubhe ||
mahādevaṃ ca saṃpūjya cakāra stavanaṃ mudā || 7 ||
bhavāya śaṃkarāyaiva rudrāya satataṃ namaḥ || 8 ||
mṛḍāyānaṃdarūpāya sarvaduḥkhaharāya ca || 9 ||
ityuktavati vipre ca tadā candravatī śubhā ||
kāmāturābravīccaināṃ nāmnā madanamañjarīm || 3.2.4.10 ||
mama yogyaśca puruṣaḥ kaścidasti mahītale ||
sāha bho rūpavarmā ca yogyo bhogāpurīpatiḥ || 11 ||
iti śrutvā tu sā devī durgāṃ vāñchitadāyinīm ||
tuṣṭāva manasā subhrūryayā jātamidaṃ jagat || 12 ||
namonamo jaganmātarmama kāryapradāyini ||
triliṃgajananī tvaṃ vai varṇamūrtiḥ sanātanī ||13||
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā saṃdhyā namastasyai namonamaḥ ||
nṛpatiṃ rūpavarmāṇaṃ matpatiṃ kuru bhoḥ śive||14||
iti stutyā prasannābhūjjagadaṃbā jaganmayī||
pitaraṃ magadheśaṃ ca mohayitvā ca mātaram ||15||
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa māsānte siddharūpiṇī ||
rūpavarmā caṃdravatī bubhujāte paraṃ sukham ||16||
ekasmindivase rājanmenāṃ madanamaṃjarīm||
nṛpaḥ prāha vivāhaṃ tvaṃ suśukena kuruṣva bhoḥ || ||17||
mrenakā prāha bho rājanvivāhāścedṛśo matāḥ ||
uttamādhamamadhyāśca puruṣāstrividhāḥ smṛtāḥ||18||
tathaiva trividhā nārī yathā yogyo varo bhavet||
uttamā yo bhavennārī yogyāyā cādhamāya vai ||19||
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ rājanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā.abhavat ||
ilāpure vasatyeko vaiśyo lakṣapatirdhanī|| 3.2.4.20 ||
anapatyo devayājī tasya patnī pativratā ||
bahuyatnena tanayastasya jāto mahādhamaḥ || 21 ||
dyūtakrīḍāparo nityaṃ surāpāne ratassadā ||

tasya dharmaṃ ca pitarau samālokya vanaṃ gatau ||
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā paramaṃ padamāpatuḥ || 23 ||
madapālastu tanayaḥ kṛtvā sarvadhanavyayam ||
anyadeśe ca vṛttyarthaṃ jagāma dhanavarjitaḥ ||24||
prāptaścaṃdrapure ramye yatra hemapatiḥ sthitaḥ||
devayājī suto.ahaṃ vai svalpaṃ vai dhanamāhṛtam ||
deśāntare vikrayārthe sindhumārgeṇa prāptavān || 26 ||
mahāvāyu prabhāvena dravyaṃ tanmagnamaṃbhasi ||
tallajjayā na yāsye.ahaṃ pitaraṃ prati māriṣa || 27 ||
iti śrutvā hemapatiḥ svapatnīṃ kāmamaṃjarīm ||
vacaḥ prāha prasannātmā saṃyogo vidhinā kṛtaḥ || 28 ||
caṃdrakāṃtiṃ sutāṃ dāsye tadvarāya tvadājñayā ||
saṃmaṃtrya daṃpatī rājandadau kanyāṃ vidhānataḥ || 29 ||
svagṛhe vāsayāmāsa madapālaṃ sutāpatim ||
māsamekamuṣitvā taṃ śvaśuraṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 3.2.4.30 ||
ājñāṃ dehi dhanādhyakṣa svagehaṃ yāmi mā ciram ||
iti śrutvā hemapatiḥ svasutāṃ svarṇabhūṣitām ||31||
caṃdrakāṃtiṃ sadāsīṃ ca tasmai dattvā gṛhaṃ yayau ||
narānvisṛjya duṣṭātmā śibikāvāhakānnṛpa ||| || 32 ||
dāsīṃ hatvā tadā patnīṃ visṛjya dhanavarjitām ||
ekākī prāptavāngehaṃ madapālo mahādhamaḥ || 33 ||
varṣāṃtare ca tatsvarṇaṃ vyayaṃ kṛtvā kumārgake ||
bubhukṣitaḥ punaḥ śokaṃ cakāra bahudhā nṛpa || 34 ||
punaśca śvaśurasyaiva gṛhe saṃprāptavānkhalaḥ ||
caṃdrakāṃtistu taṃ dṛṣṭvā svapatiṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 35 ||
mayā niveditaṃ pitre dhanaṃ cauraiśca luṃṭhitam ||
atastvaṃ tyaja saṃtāpaṃ ciraṃ vasa gṛhe mama || 36 ||
tathetyuktvā mahādhūrta uvāsa katiciddinam ||
jñātvā vimohitā patnīmarddharātre tamovṛte || 37 ||
hatvā tāṃ sa yayau gehaṃ gṛhītvā bahubhūṣaṇam ||
ayogyoyamato rājanvivāhaḥ śukamenayoḥ || 38 ||
iti śrutvā śukaḥ prāha bhūpatiṃ karuṇānidhim ||
vivāhaṃ na kariṣyāmi nāryyā cādhamayā saha || 39 ||
adhamā menakā nārī śyāmāṃgā ca kurūpiṇī ||
uttamo.ahaṃ śuko rājanpuruṣaśca harettanum || 3.2.4.40 ||
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ bhūpa mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahottamam ||
nagare kāṃcanapure vaṇikchaṃkhapatiḥ śrutaḥ || 41 ||
tasya putrastu medhāvī sindhugupto guṇī dhanī ||

vivāhamakarottasya jayaśrīpattane śubhe ||
