ūrdhvarekhādvayormadhye sūkṣmarekhā ca pītikā | |
lalāṭe tu tathā kaṇṭhe mālā tulasikā śubhā | | 66
ujjayinyāṃ ca samprāpto barāhamihiro guṇī |
tadyantraṃ niṣphalaṃ kṛtvā narāñchaivāṃścakāra ha | | 67
citābhasmasthitaṃ bhāle kaṇṭhe rudrākṣamālikā |
śiveti maṅgalaṃ nāma teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha | | 68
kānyakubje svayaṃ prāpto vāṇībhūṣaṇa eva hi |
arddhacandrākṛtiṃ puṇḍraṃ raktacandanamālikā | |
devyāśca nirmalaṃ nāma teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha | | 69
dhanvantariḥ prayāge ca gatvā tadyantramuttamam |
vilomaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra tadadho ye gatā narāḥ | | 3.4.21.70
arddhapuṇḍraṃ smṛtaṃ raktaṃ sabindu ca lalāṭake |
raktacandanajā mālā kaṇṭhe teṣāṃ babhūva ha | | 71
bhaṭṭojiḥ sa gato dhīmānutpalāraṇyamuttamam |
tripuṇḍraṃ ca tathā raktaṃ kaṇṭhe rudrākṣamālikā | |
viśvanāthetitanmantraṃ teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha | | 72
ropaṇaścaiṣṭikāṃ prāptastadyantraṃ caiva niṣphalam |
kṛtvā jane jane tatra brahma mārgam dadarśa ha | | 73
jayadeva svayaṃ prāpto dvārakāṃ viṣṇubhaktimān |
tadyantraṃ niṣphalaṃ yātaṃ tadadho ye gatā narāḥ | | 74
raktarekhā sthitā bhāle caikā kaṇṭhe tu mālikā |
padmākṣā mantragovindastatra teṣāṃ babhūva ha | |
evaṃ te vaiṣṇavāḥ śaivāḥ śāktakā bahudhā.abhavan | | 75
nirguṇāḥ śāktakā jñeyāḥ saguṇā vaiṣṇavāḥ smṛtāḥ |
nirguṇāḥ saguṇā ye tu śaivā jñeyā budhaistadā | | 76
samādhisthāstrayastriṃśaddevāḥ puṇyā babhūvire |
nityānandaḥ śāntipure nadīhāpattane hariḥ | | 77
kabīro māgadhe deśe raidāsastu kaliñjare |
sadhano naimiṣāraṇye samādhistho babhūva ha | | 78
adyāpi saṃsthito vipra vaiṣṇavānāṃ gaṇo mahān |
yajñabhāgamahāvṛddhiḥ sañjātā merumūrddhani | | 79
yacchrutvā ca narā nāryo mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyuḥ | |
mayādyā niṣphalā daityā balipārśvamupāgatāḥ | | 3.4.21.80
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye kṛṣṇacaitanyacaritraṃ nāmaikaviṃśo.adhyāyaḥ | 21
guruṇḍamaunarājyavarṇanam
sūta uvāca
iti śrutvā balirdaityo devānāṃ vijayaṃ mahat |
roṣaṇaṃ nāma daityendraṃ samāhūya vaco.abravīt | | 1
sutastimiraliṅgasya saruṣo nāma viśrutaḥ |
tvaṃ hi tatra samāgamya daityakāryaṃ mahatkuru | | 2
iti śrutvā sa vai daityo hṛdi viprāptaroṣaṇaḥ |
nanāśa vedamārgasthāndehalīdeśamāsthitaḥ | | 3
pañcavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatsuto bābarobhavat |
viṃśadabdaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ homāyustatsuto.abhavat | | 4
homāyuṣā madāndhena devatāśca nirākṛtāḥ |
te surāḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyaṃ nadīhopavane sthitam | | 5
tuṣṭuvurbahudhā tatra śrutvā kruddho hariḥ svayam |
svatejasā ca tadrājyaṃ vighnabhūtaṃ cakāra ha | | 6
tatsainyajanitairlokairhomāyuśca nirākṛtaḥ |
mahārāṣṭraistadā tatra śeṣaśākaḥ samāsthitaḥ | | 7
dehalīnagare ramye mleccho rājyaṃ cakāra ha |
dharmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tadrājyaṃ pañcahāyanam | | 8
brahmacārī mukundaśca śaṅkarācāryagotrajaḥ |
prayāge ca tapaḥ kurvanviṃśacchiṣyairyutaḥ sthitaḥ | | 9
bābareṇa ca dhūrtena mleccharājena devatāḥ |
bhraṃśitā sa tadā jñātvā vahnau dehaṃ juhāva vai | | 3.4.22.10
tasya śiṣyā gatā vahnau mlecchanāśanahetunā |
godugdhe ca sthitaṃ romaṃ pītvā sa payasā muniḥ | | 11
mukundastasya doṣeṇa mlecchayonau babhūva ha |
homāyuṣaśca kāśmīre saṃsthitasyaiva putrakaḥ | | 12
akasmācca varo jātaḥ putro.ayaṃ sarvabhāgyavān | | 13
ataḥ so.akabaro nāma homāyustanayastava | | 14
śrīdharaḥ śrīpatiḥ śambhurvareṇyaśca madhuvratī |
vimalo devavānsomo varddhano vartako ruciḥ | | 15

devāpiḥ somapāḥ śūro madano yasya śiṣyakāḥ | | 16
sa mukundo dvijaḥ śrīmāndaivāttvadgehamāgataḥ |
ityākāśavacaḥ śrutvā homāyuśca prasannadhīḥ | | 17
dadau dānaṃ kṣudhārtebhyaḥ premṇā putramapālayat |
daśābde tanaye jāte dehalīdeśamāgataḥ | | 18
śeṣaśāṅkaṃ parājitya sa ca rājā babhūva ha |
abdaṃ tena kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatputraśca nṛpo.abhavat | | 19
samprāpte.akabare rājyaṃ saptaśiṣyāśca tatpriyāḥ |
pūrvajanmani ye mukhyāste prāptā bhūpatiṃ prati | | 3.4.22.20
keśavo gānasenaśca vaijavāksa tu mādhavaḥ |
mlecchāste ca smṛtāstatra haridāso madhustathā | | 21
madhvācāryakule jāto vaiṣṇavaḥ sarvarāgavit |
pūrvajanmani devāpiḥ sa ca vīrabalo.abhavat | | 22
brāhmaṇaḥ pāścimātyo vai vāgdevīvaradarpitaḥ |
somapā mānasiṃhaśca gautamānvayasambhavaḥ | | 23
senāpatiśca nṛpaterāryabhūpaśiromaṇeḥ |
sūraścaiva dvijo jāto dakṣiṇaścaiva paṇḍitaḥ | | 24
bilvamaṅgala evāpi nāmnā tannṛpateḥ sakhā |
nāyikābhedanipuṇo veśyānāṃ sa ca pāragaḥ | | 25
madano brāhmaṇo jātaḥ paurvātyaḥ sa ca nartakaḥ |
anyadeśe gatāḥ śiṣyāsteṣāṃ pūrvāstrayodaśa |
anapasya suto jātaḥ śrīdharaḥ śatruveditaḥ | | 27
vikhyātastulasīśarmā purāṇanipuṇaḥ kaviḥ |
nārīśikṣāṃ samādāya rāghavānandamāgataḥ | | 28
śiṣyo bhūtvā sthitaḥ kāśyāṃ rāmānandamate sthitaḥ |
śrīpatiḥ sa babhūvāndho madhvācāryamate sthitaḥ | | 29
sūradāsa iti jñeyaḥ kṛṣṇalīlākaraḥ kaviḥ |
śambhurvai candrabhaṭṭasya kule jāto haripriyaḥ | | 3.4.22.30
rāmānandamate saṃstho bhaktakīrtiparāyaṇaḥ |
vareṇyaḥ sograbhuṅnāmā rāmānandamate sthitaḥ | | 31
jñānadhyānaparo nityaṃ bhāṣāchandakaraḥ kaviḥ |
madhuvratī sa vai jāto kīlako nāma viśrutaḥ | | 32
rāmalīlākaro dhīmānrāmānandamate sthitaḥ |
vimalaśca sa vai jātaḥ sa nāmnaiva divākaraḥ | | 33
sītālīlākaro dhīmānrāmānandamate sthitaḥ |
devavānkeśavo jāto viṣṇusvāmimate sthitaḥ | | 34
kavipriyādiracanāṃ kṛtvā pretatvamāgataḥ |
rāmajyotsnāmayaṃ granthaṃ kṛtvā svargamupāyayau | | 35
somo jātaḥ sa vai vyāso nimbādityamate sthitaḥ |
rahaḥ krīḍāmayaṃ granthaṃ kṛtvā svargamupāyayau | | 36
varddhanaśca sa vai jāto nāmnā caraṇadāsakaḥ |
jñānamālāmayaṃ kṛtvā granthaṃ raidāsamārgagaḥ | | 37
vartakaḥ sa ca vai jāto ropaṇasya mate sthitaḥ |
ratnabhānuriti jñeyo bhāṣākartā ca jaimineḥ | | 38
ruciśca rocano jāto madhvācāryamate sthitaḥ |
nānāgānamayīṃ līlāṃ kṛtvā svargamupāyayau | | 39
māndhātā bhūpatirnāma kāyasthaḥ sa babhūva ha |
madhvācāryo bhāgavataṃ cakre bhāṣāmayaṃ śubham | | 3.4.22.40
mānakāro nāribhāvānnārīdehamupāgataḥ |
mīrānāmeti vikhyātā bhūpatestanayā śubhā | | 41
mā śobhā ca tanau yasyā gatirgajasamā kila |
sā mīrā ca budhaiḥ proktā madhvācāryamate sthitā | | 42
evaṃ te kathitaṃ vipra bhāṣāgranthaprakāraṇam |
prabandhaṃ maṅgalakaraṃ kalikāle bhayaṅkare | | 43
sa bhūpo.akabaro nāma kṛtvā rājyamakaṇṭakam |
śatārddhena ca śiṣyaiśca vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ yayau | | 44
salomā tanayastasya kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam |
khurdakastanayastasya daśābdaṃ ca kṛtaṃ padam | | 45
catvārastanayāstasya navaraṅgo hi madhyamaḥ |
pitaraṃ ca tathā bhrātṛrñjitvā rājyamacīkarat | | 46
pūrvajanmani daityo.ayamandhako nāma viśrutaḥ |
karmabhūmyāṃ tadaṃśena daityarājājñayā yayau | | 47
tenaiva bahudhā mūrtīrbhraṃśitāśca samantataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā devāstadāgatya kṛṣṇacaitanyamabruvan | | 48
bhagavandaityarājāṃśaḥ sa jātaśca mahīpatiḥ |
bhraṃśayitvā surānvedāndaityapakṣaṃ vivarddhate | | 49
iti śrutvā sa yajñāṃśo nadīhopavane sthitaḥ |
śaśāpa taṃ durācāraṃ yathā vaṃśakṣayo bhavet | | 3.4.22.50
rājyamekonapañcāśatkṛtaṃ tena durātmanā |
sevājayo nāma nṛpo devapakṣavivarddhanaḥ | | 51
mahārāṣṭradvijastasya yuddhavidyāviśāradaḥ |
hatvā taṃ ca durācāraṃ tatputrāya ca tatpadam | | 52
datvā yayau dākṣiṇātye deśe devavivarddhanaḥ |
alomā nāma tanayaḥ pañcābdaṃ tatpadaṃ kṛtam | | 53
tatpaścānmaraṇaṃ prāpto vidradhena rujā mune |
vikramasya gate rājye saptatyuttarakaṃ śatam | | 54
jñeyaṃ sapta daśaṃ vipra yadālomā mṛtiṃ gataḥ |
tālanasya kule jāto mlecchaḥ phalaruṣo balī | | 55
mukulasya kulaṃ hatvā svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra ha |
daśābdaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena bhūpena bhūtale | | 56
śatrubhirmaraṇaṃ prāpto daityalokamupāgamat |
mahāmadastattanayo viṃśatyabdaṃ kṛtaṃ padam | | 57
tadrāṣṭre nādaro nāma daityo deśa upāgamat |
hatvāryāṃśca surāñjitvā deśaṃ khurajamāyayau | | 58
mahāmatsyo hi madasya tanayastatpituḥ padam |
gṛhītvā pañcavarṣāntaṃ sa ca rājyaṃ cakāra ha | | 59
mahārāṣṭrairhato duṣṭastālanānvayasambhavaḥ |
dehalīnagare rājyaṃ daśābdaṃ mādhavena vai | | 3.4.22.60
kṛtaṃ tatra tadā mleccha ālomā rājyamāptavān |
tadrāṣṭre bahavo jātā rājāno nijadeśajāḥ | | 61
grāmapā bahavo bhūpā deśe deśe babhūvire |
maṇḍalīkapadaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ jātaṃ mahītale | | 62
triṃśadabdamato jātaṃ grāme grāme nṛpe nṛpe |
tadā tu sakalā devāḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyamāyayuḥ | | 63
yajñāṃśaśca hariḥ sākṣājjñātvā duḥkhaṃ mahītale |
muhūrtaṃ dhyānamāgamya devānvacanamabravīt | | 64
purā tu rāghavo dhīmāñjitvā rāvaṇarākṣasam |
kapīnujjīvayāmāsa sudhāvarṣaissamantataḥ | | 65
vikaṭo vṛjilo jālo varalīno hi siṃhalaḥ |
javassumātraśca tathā nāmnā te kṣudravānarāḥ | | 66
rāmacandraṃ vacaḥ prāhurdehi no vācchitaṃ prabho |
rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmāñjñātvā teṣāṃ manoratham | | 67
devāṅganodbhavāḥ kanyā rāvaṇāllokarāvaṇāt |
dattvā tebhyo harissākṣādvacanaṃ prāha harṣitaḥ | | 68
bhavannāmnā ca ye dvīpā jālandharavinirmitāḥ |
teṣu rājño bhaviṣyanti bhavanto hitakāriṇaḥ | | 69
nandinyā gośca ruṇḍādvai jātā mlecchā bhayānakāḥ |
guruṇḍā jātayasteṣāṃ tāstu teṣu sadā sthitāḥ | | 3.4.22.70
jitvā tāṃśca guruṇḍānvai kurudhvaṃ rājyamuttamam |
iti śrutvā hariṃ natvā dvīpeṣu prayayurmudā | | 71
vikaṭānvayasambhūtā guruṇḍā vānarānanāḥ |
vāṇijyārthamihāyātā gauruṇḍā bauddhamārgiṇaḥ | | 72
īśaputramate saṃsthāsteṣāṃ hṛdayamuttamam |
satyavrataṃ kāmajitamakrodhaṃ sūryatatparam | | 73
yūyaṃ tatroṣya kāryaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ kuruta mā ciram |
iti śrutvā tu te devāḥ kuryurārcikamādarāt | | 74
nagaryyā kalikātāyāṃ sthāpayāmāsurudyatāḥ |
vikaṭe paścime dvīpe tatpatnī vikaṭāvatī | | 75
aṣṭakauśalamārgeṇa rājamantraṃ cakāra ha |
tatpatistu pulomārciḥ kalikātāṃ purīṃ sthitaḥ | | 76
vikramasya gate rājye śatamaṣṭādaśaṃ kalau |
catvāriṃśaṃ tathābdaṃ ca tadā rājā babhūva ha | | 77
tadanvaye saptanṛpā guruṇḍāśca babhūvire |
catuṣṣaṣṭimitaṃ varṣaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā layaṃ gatāḥ | | 78
guruṇḍe cāṣṭame bhūpe prāpte nyāyena śāsati |
kalipakṣo balirdaityo muraṃ nāma mahāsuram | | 79
āruhya preṣayāmāsa devadeśe mahottame |

sa muro vārḍilaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśīkṛtya hṛdi sthitaḥ | | 3.4.22.80
āryadharmavināśāya tasya buddhiṃ cakāra ha |
mūrtisaṃsthāstadā devā gatvā yajñāṃśayoginam | | 81
namaskṛtyābruvansarve yathā prāpto muro.asuraḥ |
jñātvā śaśāpa kṛṣṇāṃśo guruṇḍānbauddhamārgiṇaḥ | | 82
kṣayaṃ yāsyanti te sarve ye murasya vaśaṃ gatāḥ |
ityukte vacane tasminguruṇḍā kālanoditāḥ | | 83
svasainyaiśca kṣayaṃ jagmurvarṣamātrāntare khalāḥ |
sarve triṃśatsahasrāśca prayayuryamamandire | | 84
vāgdaṇḍaissa ca bhūpālo vārḍilo nāśamāptavān |
guruṇḍo navamaḥ prāpto bhekalo nāma vīryavān | | 85
nyāyena kṛtavānrājya dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ |
āryadeśe ca tadrājyaṃ babhūva nyāyaśāsati | | 86
laḍilo nāma vikhyāto guruṇḍo daśamohitaḥ |
dvātriṃśābdaṃ ca tadrājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tenaiva dharmiṇā | | 87
laḍile svargate prāpte makarandakulodbhavāḥ |
āryāḥ prāptāstadā maunā himatuṅganivāsinaḥ | | 88
babhruvarṇāḥ sūkṣmanaso vartulā dīrghamastakāḥ |
evaṃ lakṣāśca samprāptā dehalyāṃ bauddhamāgiṇaḥ | | 89
ārjiko nāma vai rājā teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha |
tasya putro devakaṇo gaṅgotragirimūrddhani | | 3.4.22.90
dvādaśābdaṃ tapo ghoraṃ tepe rājyavivṛddhaye |
tadā bhagavatī gaṅgā tapasā tasya dhīmataḥ | | 91
svarūpaṃ svecchayā prāpya brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha |
kuberaśca tadāgatya dattvā tasmai mahatpadam | | 92
maṇḍalīko devakarṇo babhūva janapālakaḥ | | 93
ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tena rājñā mahītale |
tadanvaye.aṣṭabhūpāśca babhūvurdevapūjakāḥ | | 94
dviśatābdaṃ padaṃ kṛtvā svargalokamupāyayuḥ |
ekādaśaśca yo maunaḥ pannagāririti śrutaḥ | | 95
catvāriṃśacca varṣāṇi rājyaṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ |
svargalokaṃ gato rājā pannagairmaraṇaṃ gataḥ | | 96
evaṃ ca mauryajātīyaiḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahītale | | 97
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye guruṇḍamaunarājyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo.adhyāyaḥ | 22
kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccayavarṇanam
sūta uvāca
vaikrame rājyavigate catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ mune |
dvāviṃśadabdaśatakaṃ bhūtanandistadā nṛpaḥ | | 1
kuberayakṣakānmaunāndhanadhānyasamanvitān |
sārddhalakṣānkalairghorairjitvā tānyuddhakāriṇaḥ | | 2
kilkilāyāṃ svayaṃ rājyaṃ nāgavaṃśaiścakāra ha |
āgneyyāṃ diśi vikhyātā puṇḍarīkeṇa nirmitā | | 3
purī kilakilā nāma tatra rājā babhūva ha |
puṇḍarīkādayo nāgāstasminrājyaṃ praśāsati | | 4
gehe gehe janaissarvaiḥ pūjanīyā babhūvire |
tyaktvā devānupāgamya saṃsthitā merumūrddhani |
śakrājñayā kuberastu śūkadhānyaṃ samantataḥ | | 6
yakṣaiḥ ṣaḍaṃśānādāya devebhyaḥ pradadau prabhuḥ |
maṇisvarṇādivastūni maunarājyeṣu yāni vai | | 7
dattāni tāni kośeṣu punardevaścakāra ha |
maṇḍalīkaṃ padaṃ tena satkṛtaṃ bhūtanandinā | | 8
śatārddhaṃ tu tato rājā śiśunandirbabhūva ha |
nāgapūjāṃ puraskṛtya tiraskṛtya surānbhuvi | | 9
cakāra rājyaṃ viśābdaṃ yaśonandistato.anujaḥ |
bhrātrāsanaṃ svayaṃ prāpto nāgapūjāparāyaṇaḥ | | 3.4.23.10
pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇi sa ca rājyamacīkarat |
tatastattanayo rājā sa babhūva pravīrakaḥ | | 11
ekādaśābdaṃ tadrājyaṃ karmabhūmyāṃ prakīrtitam |
kadācitsa ca bāhlīke senayā sārddhamāgataḥ | | 12
tatra tairabhavadyuddhaṃ paiśācairmlecchadāruṇaiḥ |
māsamātrāntare mlecchā lakṣasaṃkhyā mṛtiṃ gatāḥ | | 13
tathā ṣaṣṭisahasrāśca nāgabhaktā layaṃ gatāḥ |
bādalo nāma tadrājā romajastho mahābalaḥ | | 14
yaśonandinamāhūya dadau jālavatīṃ sutām |
gṛhītvā mleccharājasya sutāṃ gehamupāgataḥ | | 15
garbho jātastatastasyāṃ babhūva tanayo balī |
bāhlīko nāma vikhyāto nāgapūjanatatparaḥ | | 16

tvatsaṃdeśaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāvadatko na vedmi tam ||18||
vidyayā kalayā cāpi pauruṣeṇa vratena ca ||
tapasā vā pumāmartyo divi vijñāyate ciram || 19 ||
brāhmaṇastamathovāca mugdhā dagdhāgnisaṃbhavā ||
na bhakṣayāmi śakaṭaṃ vratenaitena vetti mām || 4.7.20 ||
tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa siddhaḥ suviśuddhadhīḥ ||
prahasyāmaṃtrya taṃ vipraṃ jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ || 21 ||
kadācicca ratā tena svargamārgaṃ yadṛcchayā ||
dṛṣṭvā raṃbhāṃ dvijaproktaṃ sarvameva niveditam || 22 ||
|| raṃbhovāca || ||
ko na jānāmi taṃ vipraṃ śakaṭavratacāriṇam ||
mūlajālairvartayaṃtaṃ mahākālavanāśrayam || 23 ||
darśanādatha saṃbhāṣādupakārātsahāsanāt ||
caturdhā snehanirbaṃdho nṛṇāṃ saṃjāyate.adhikaḥ || 24 ||
na darśanaṃ na saṃbhāṣā kadācitsaha tena me ||
nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa snehaḥ saṃdarśito mahān || 25 ||
ityevamuktvā raṃbhorū raṃbhā jaṃbhāriṇoṃtikam ||
vismayotphullanayanā jagāma gajagāminī ||26||
gatvā nivedayāmāsa snehavrataviceṣṭitam ||
purato ruddhahṛdayā brāhmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ || 27 ||
śakraḥ provāca cārvaṃgīṃ gīrvāṇahṛdayaṃgamām ||
kimānayāmi taṃ vipraṃ samīpaṃ tava suvratam || 28 ||
divyamālyāṃbaradharaṃ divyasragunulepanam ||
vimānavaramāropya darśayāmāsa taṃ punaḥ || 29 ||
tatrasthaḥ sa dvijo bhogīvibhunakti saha raṃbhayā ||
śakaṭavratamāhātmyamityetatte mayoditam || 4.7.30 ||
rājyaśriyaṃ jagati sarvajanopabhogyāmāpnoti śakraśivakeśavayornivāsam||
nāprāpyabhasti bhuvane sudṛḍhavratānāṃ tasmātsadā vratapareṇa nareṇa bhāvyam || 31 ||
iti śrībha viṣye mahāpurāṇe uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde śakaṭavratamāhātmyakathanaṃnāma saptamo.adhyāyaḥ || 7 || cha ||

tilakavratavarṇanam
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
brahmeśa keśavādīnāṃ gauryā gaṇapatestathā ||
durgāsūryāgnisomānāṃ vratāni madhusūdana || 1 ||
śāstrāṃtareṣu dṛṣṭāni tava buddhigatāni ca ||
tāni sarvāṇi me deva vada devakiranandana || 2 ||
pratipatkramayogena vihitā yasya yā tithiḥ ||
devasya tasyāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kīrtaya || 3 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
vasaṃte kiṃśukāśokaśobhane pratipattithiḥ ||
śuklā tasyāṃ prakurvīta snānaṃ niyamatatparaḥ|| 4 ||
piṣṭātakena vilikhedvatsaraṃ puruṣākṛtim ||
tataścandanacūrṇena puṣpadhūpādinārcayet ||6|
dīpaiścāpi sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayedvatsaraṃ tadā ||
māsartunāmabhiḥ paścānnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ ||
pūjayedbrāhmaṇānvidvānmaṃtrairvedoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 7 ||
saṃvatsaro.asi parivatsarosīḍā vatsaro.abhitsaro.asi uṣasaste kalpaṃtāmahorātrāste kalpaṃtāmardhamāsaste kalpatāṃ māsāste kalpatāmṛtavaste kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaraste kalpatām || || 8 ||
evamabhyarcya vāsobhiḥ paścāttamabhiveṣṭayet ||
kālodbhavairmūlaphalainairvedyairmodakādibhiḥ || 9 ||
tatastaṃ prārthayetpaścātpuraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ||
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena varṣa śubhadamastu me || 4.8.10 ||
evamuktvā yathāśakti dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ||
lalāṭapaṭṭe tilakaṃ kuyaccāṃdanapaṅkajam ||11||
tataḥ prabhṛtyanudinaṃ tilakālaṃkṛtaṃ mukham ||
dhāryaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvacchaśineva nabhastalam || 12 ||
sadaiva puruṣa vyāghra bhogānbhuvi bhunaktyasau || 13 ||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca durvārā vairiṇo grahāḥ ||
nirarthakā bhavaṃtyete tilakaṃ vīkṣya tatkṣaṇāt || 14 ||
pūrvamāsīnmahīpālo nāmnā śatruṃjayo jayī ||
citralekheti tasyābhūdbhāryā cāritrabhūṣaṇā || 15 ||
tayā vratamidaṃ caitre gṛhītaṃ dvijasannidhau ||
saṃvatsaraṃ pūjayitvā dhṛtvā hṛdi janārdanam 16||
asūyuḥ kṣeptukāmo vā samāgacchati yaḥ puraḥ ||
prayāti priyakṛttasyā dṛṣṭvā mukhamadhomukhaḥ||17||
sapatnīdarpāpaharā vaśīkṛtamahītalā ||
bharturiṣṭā prahṛṣṭā ca sukhamāste nirākulā ||18||
tāvatkareṇābhibhūto bhartā putraḥ savedanaḥ ||
śiro.artyā nāśaṃ prayātaḥ suhṛdāṃ duḥkhadāyakaḥ ||19||
dharmarājapuraṃ prāptuṃ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ||
tasminkṣaṇe mahārājaḥ dharmarājasya kiṃkarāḥ||4.8.20||
tasya dvāramanuprāptāḥ praveṣṭuṃ gṛhamañjasā ||
śatruṃjayaṃ samānetuṃ kālamṛtyupuraḥsarāḥ ||21||
pārśvasthitāṃ citralekhāṃ tilakālaṃkṛtānanām ||
dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭasaṃkalpāḥ parāvṛtya gatāḥ punaḥ||22||
gateṣu teṣu sa nṛpaḥ putreṇa saha bhārata ||
nīrujo bubhuje bhogānpūrvakarmārjitāñchubhān || 23 ||
etadvrataṃ mahābhāga kīrtitaṃ te mahodayam ||
śaṃkareṇa samākhyātaṃ mama pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||24||
etattrilokatilakālakabhūṣaṇaṃ te khyātaṃ vrataṃ sakaladuḥkhaharaṃ paraṃ ca ||
itthaṃ samācarati yaḥ sa sukhaṃ vihṛtya martyaḥ prayāti padamāpadi padmayoneḥ || 25 || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde tilakavratakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo.adhyāyaḥ || 8 || ||9|||
aśokavratavarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
āśvayucchuklapakṣasya prathame.ahni dinodaye ||
aśokaṃ pūjayedvṛkṣaṃ prarūḍhaśubhapallavam || 1 ||
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca guṇa kairmodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
phalaiḥ kālodbhavairdivyairnnālikeraiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ || 2 ||
puṣpadhūpādinā tadvatpūjayettaddine.anagha ||
aśokaṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śokaṃ nāpnoti kutracit || 3 ||
pitṛbhrātṛpatiśvaśrūśvaśurāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
aśoka śokaśamano bhava sarvatra naḥ kule || 4 ||
ityuccārya tato dadyādarghyaṃ śraddhāsamanvi tam ||
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya pracchādya śubhavāsasā || 5 ||
damayantī yathā svāhā yathā vedavatī satī ||
tathāśokavratādasmājjāyate pativallabhā || || 6 ||
vane vrajaṃtyā saddharmaḥ sītayā saṃpradarśitaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā.aśokaṃ vane pārtha pallavālaṃkṛtāṃbaram || 7 ||
kṛtvā samīpe bhartāraṃ devaraṃ ca tilākṣataiḥ ||
dīpālaṃkṛtanaivedyadhūpasūtraphalārccanaiḥ || 8 ||
arcayitvā hyarthito.asau raktāśoko yudhiṣṭhira ||
maithilyā prāñjalirbhūtvā śṛṇvato rāghavasya ca || 9 ||
ciraṃ jīvatu me vṛddhaḥ śvaśuraḥ kośaleśvaraḥ ||
bhartā me devarāścaiva jīvaṃtu bharatādayaḥ ||
kauśalyāmapi jīvantīṃ paśyeyamiti maithilī || 4.9.10 ||
yayāce taṃ mahābhāgā drumaṃ satyopayācanam ||
evamanyāpi yā nārī pūjayedbhuvi taṃ nagam ||
tila taṃḍulasaṃmiśrairyavagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ || 12 ||
kṣamāpya vandayenmūlaṃ pādapaṃ raktapallavam ||
mantreṇānena kauṃteya praṇamya strī pativratā || 13 ||
yāḥ śokanāśanamaśokataruṃ taruṇyaḥ saṃpūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ ||
tāḥ prāpya saukhyamatulaṃ bhuvi bhartṛ jātaṃ gaurīpadaṃ pramuditāḥ punarāpnuvaṃti || 16 || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde aśokavratavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo.a dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
karavīravratavarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe prathame.ahni dinodaye ||
devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayeta ||1||
raktataṃtuparīdhānaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
guṇakairghaṭakairdivyairnālikeraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ||
karavīra viṣāvāsa namaste bhānuvallabha ||
maulimaṃḍanasadratna namaste keśaveśayoḥ || 4 ||
ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca ||
hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan || 5 ||
anasūyayā ca kṣamayā sāvitryā satyabhāmayā || 7 ||
damayantyā sarasvatyā gāyatryā gaṃgayā tathā ||
anyābhirapi nārībhirmartyaloke.apyanuṣṭhitam ||
karavīvrataṃ pārtha sarvasaukhyaphalapradam || 8 ||

bhuktvā mano.abhilaṣitānbhuvi bhavyabhogānaṃte prayāti bhavanaṃ bharatāgrya bhānoḥ|| || 9 || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde karavīravratavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo.adhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha || || ||
kokilāvratavarṇanam
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
svabhartrā saha saṃbaddhamahāsneho yathā bhavet ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīvaśiṣṭha uvāca || ||

patrairvā dhūpanaivedyadīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ||
tila tanduladūrvāgraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ||

tilasahe tilasaukhye tilavarṇe tilapriye ||
saubhāgyaṃ dravyaputrāṃśca dehi me kokile namaḥ || 14 ||
ityuccārya tataḥ paścādgṛhamabhyetya saṃyataḥ ||
kṛtvāhāraṃ svapetpārtha yāvanmāsaḥ samāpnute ||15||
māsāṃte tāmrapātryāṃ tu kokilāṃ tilapiṣṭajām ||
vastrairddhanairguḍairyuktāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ kuṃḍale.atha vā ||
śvaśrūśvaśuravarge vā daivajñe vā purohite ||
vyāse vā saṃpradātavyā vratibhiḥ śubhakāmyayā ||17||
sapta janmāni saubhāgyaṃ sā prāpnoti suvistaram || 18 ||
niḥsāpatnyaṃ patiṃ bhavyaṃ sasnehaṃ prāpya bhūtale ||
mṛtā gaurīpuraṃ yāti vimānenārkavarcasā || 19 ||
etadvrataṃ vaśiṣṭhena muninā kathitaṃ purā ||
tathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ pārtha samastaṃ kīrtimālayā || 4.11.20 ||
tasyāśca sarvaṃ saṃpannaṃ vaśiṣṭhavacanādiha ||
putrasaubhāgyasaṃmānaṃ śatrughnasya prasādajam|| 21 ||
evaṃ yānyāpi kauṃteya kokilāvratamādarāt ||
kariṣyati dhruvaṃ tasyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||22||
ye kokilāṃ kalaravāṃ kalakaṃṭhapīṭhāṃ yacchaṃti sājyatilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ ||

bṛhattapovratavarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca|| ||
atha pāpāpahaṃ vakṣye bṛhadvratamanuttamam ||

pūjayedgandhakusumairdīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ||

daśame māsi vikhyātā devi saubhāgyadāyinī ||
umā tvekādaśe māsi gaurī tu dvādaśe parā || ||4.21.30||
kuśodakaṃ payaḥ sarppirgomūtraṃ gomaya phalam ||
niṃbapatraṃ kaṃṭakārī gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ dadhi ||31||
pañcagavyaṃ tathā śākaḥ prāśanāni kramādamī ||
māsimāsi sthitā hyevamupavāsaparāyaṇā ||32||
dadāti śraddhayaitāni vācake brāhmaṇottame ||
kusuṃbhamājyaṃ lavaṇaṃ jīrakaṃ guḍameva ca ||33||
dattairebhiḥ sūryasthā tvaṃ sūryasthā tuṣyasi priye ||
māsimāsi bhavenmantro gakāro dvādaśākṣaraḥ || 34 ||
oṅkārapūrvako devi namaskārāṃta īritaḥ ||
ebhistvaṃ pūjitā maṃtraistuṣyasi vratataḥ priye || 35 ||
tuṣṭā tvabhīpsitānkāmāndadāsi prītipūrvakam ||
samāpte tu vrate tasminbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam || 36 ||
sahitaṃ bhāryayābhyarcya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
dvijaṃ maheśvaraṃ kṛtvā umāṃ bhāryāṃ tathaiva ca || 37 ||
annaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī ||
raktaṃ vāsoyugaṃ dadyāttvāmuddiśya harapriye || 38 ||
brāhmaṇe śraddhayā yuktastasyāṃ phalamidaṃ śṛṇu ||
modate bhartṛsahitā yatheṃdreṇa śacī tathā ||
mānuṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya svena bhartrā sahaiva sā || 4.21.40||
puṇye kule śriyā yuktā nīrogā sukhamaśnute ||
sapta janmāni yāvacca na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt ||41||
putrānbhogāṃstathā rūpaṃ saubhāgyārogyameva ca ||
ekapatnī tathā bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo.apyadhikā bhavet||42||
śṛṇuyādvācyamānaṃ tu bhaktyā yā lalitāvratam ||
mayā snehena kathitaṃ sāpi tatphalabhāginī || 43 ||
saṃpūjya lakṣalalitāṃ lalitāṃgayaṣṭiṃ gaṃdhodakāmṛtaghaṭīṃ śirasi kṣipedyaḥ||
sā svargametya lalitāsu lalāmabhūtā bhūpādhipaṃ patimavāpya bhuvaṃ bhunakti || 44 || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde lalitātṛtīyāvratamāhātmyaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatitamo.adhyāyaḥ || 21 || cha ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

kārtikāṃte tato māsi mārgaśīrṣe samudyamet || 11 ||

etatpāraṇamuddiṣṭaṃ mārgādau mārgagocaram ||
bhavaṃ caiva bhavānīṃ ca māsi māghe prapūjayet ||

jyeṣṭhe vīreśvaraṃ devamekavīrāsamanvitam ||
āṣāḍhe paśunāthaṃ ca śaktyā sārddhaṃ trilocanam || 17 ||
śrīkaṃṭhaṃ śrāvaṇe devaṃ sutānvitamathārcayet ||
bhīmaṃ bhādrapade māsi durgayā sahitaṃ yajet ||
īśānaṃ kārttike māsi śivādevīyutaṃ yajet || 18 ||
japyadhyānārcanāyaiva nāmānyetāni suvrata ||
smṛtāni vidhinā rājanvratasiddhirbhaved dhuvam ||19||
pratimāsaṃ tu puṣpāṇi yāni pūjāsu yojayet ||
tāni kramātpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ prītikarāṇi vai || 4.22.20 ||
ādau nīlotpalaṃ yojyaṃ tadabhāve.aparāṇyapi ||
pavitrāṇi sugaṃdhīni yojayedbhaktito.arcane || 21 ||
karavīraṃ bilvapatraṃ kiṃśukaṃ kubjamallikā ||
pāṭalābjakadaṃbaṃ ca tagaraṃ droṇamālatī || 22 ||
etānyuktakrameṇaiva māseṣu dvādaśasvapi ||
bhaktyā yojyāni rājendra śivayostuṣṭihetave || 23 ||
vatsarāṃte vitānaṃ ca dhūpotkṣepaṃ saghaṃṭikam ||
dhvajaṃ dīpaṃ vastrayugaṃ śaṅkarāya nivedayet||24||
snāpayitvā ca liptvā ca sauvarṇaṃ mūrdhni paṅkajam ||
pūpayugmaṃ ca purataḥ śālipiṣṭamayaṃ nyaset || 25 ||
naivedyaṃ śaktito datvā nattvā ca vidhivacchivam ||
kuryānnīrājanaṃ śambhostato gacchetsvakaṃ gṛham || 26 ||
tatra gatvā trikoṇaśca caturasraṃ ca kārayet ||
trikoṇe brāhmaṇī bhojyā caturasre dvijottamāḥ || 27 ||
vratino bhojayetpaścādvādaśaiva dvijottamān ||
mithunāni ca tāvaṃti śaktyā bhaktyā ca pāṇḍava || 28 ||
mauktikāni catuḥṣaṣṭistāvato.api pravālakāḥ ||
tāvaṃti puṣparāgāṇi tāmrapātropari nyaset || 25||

dīnāndhaduḥkhitānāṃ ca taddine vā nivāritam ||

aviyogakaraṃ caitadrūpasaubhāgyavittadam ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

śivaṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā umāṃ haimamayīṃ tathā ||
ārūḍhau vṛṣabhe raupye sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau || 17 ||

arcayetkusumaiḥ paścātsugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ || 18 ||

bhaktebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā bhaktyā śāṭhyavivarjitā || 4.23.20 ||
umāmaheśvarau devau sarvalokapitāmahau ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

anaghāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

vaśiṣṭhagotre cotpannaḥ surūpaśca bhṛgoḥ sutām ||
dīkṣāṃ nāmopayeme tāṃ vedoktavidhinā tataḥ ||13||
tasyāḥ kālena saṃjātā duhitānaṃtalakṣaṇā ||
śīlā nāma suśīlā sā vardhate pitṛsadmani || 14 ||
mātā ca tasyāḥ kālena haradāhena pīḍitā ||
vinanāśa nadītīre mṛtā svargapuraṃ yayau||15||
sumaṃtopi tatonyāṃ vai dharmapuṃsaḥ sutāṃ punaḥ ||
duḥśīlāṃ karkaśāṃ caṃḍīṃ nityaṃ kalahakāriṇīm ||
sāpi śīlā piturgehe gṛhārcanaratā vibho || 17 ||
kuḍyastaṃbhatulādhāradehalītoraṇādiṣu ||
cāturvarṇakaraṃ vaiśyanīlapītasitāsitaiḥ ||18||
svastikaiḥ śaṃkhapadmaiśca arcayantī punaḥpunaḥ ||
pitrā dṛṣṭā sumantena strīcihnā yauvane sthitā ||19||
kasmai deyā mayā śīlā vicāryaivaṃ suduḥkhitaḥ ||
pitā dadau munīndrāya kauṃḍinyāya śubhe dine || 20 ||
smṛtyuktaśāstravidhinā vivāhamakarottadā ||
nivartyodvāhikaṃ sarvaṃ proktavānkarkaśāṃ dvijaḥ || 21 ||
kiñcidāyādikaṃ deyaṃ jāmātuḥ pāritoṣikam ||
tacchrutvā karkaśā kruddhā proddhṛtya gṛhamaṇḍapam||22||
kapāṭe susthiraṃ kṛtvā gamyatāmityuvāca ha ||
bhojyāvaśiṣṭacūrṇena pātheyaṃ ca cakāra sā ||23||
kauṃḍinyopi vivāhyaināṃ pathi gacchañchanaiḥśanaiḥ||
śīlāṃ suśīlāmādāya navoḍhāṃ gorathena hi || 24 ||
madhyāhne bhojyavelāyāṃ samuttīrya sarittaṭe ||
dadarśa śīlā sā strīṇāṃ samūhaṃ raktavāsasām|| || 25 ||
caturdaśyāmarcayantaṃ bhaktyā devaṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||
upagamya śanaiḥ śīlā papraccha strīkadaṃbakam|| 26 ||
nāryaḥ kimetanme brūta kiṃnāma vratamīdṛśam ||
tā ūcuryoṣitaḥ sarvā ananto nāma viśrutaḥ || 27 ||
sābravīdahamapyevaṃ kariṣye vratamuttamam ||
vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatra kiṃ dānaṃ kasya pūjanam || 28 ||
|| striya ūcuḥ || ||
śīle pakvānnaprasthasya punnāmnaḥ sukṛtasya tu ||
arddhaṃ viprāya dātavyamarddhamātmani bhojanam || 29 ||
anaṃtānaṃtamabhyarcya maṃḍale gaṃdhadīpakaiḥ || 30 ||
dhūpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pītālaktaiścatuḥśataiḥ ||
tasyāgrato dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sudorakam || 31 ||
caturdaśagraṃthiyutaṃ vāme strī dakṣiṇe pumān ||
maṃtreṇānena rājendra yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate || 32 ||
anaṃta saṃsāramahāsamudre magnānsamabhyuddhara vāsudeva ||
anaṃtarūpe viniyojitātmā hyanaṃtarūpāya namonamaste || 33 ||
anena dorakaṃ baddhvā bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ ||
bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma hīdaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ tava ||
sāpi śrutvā vrataṃ cakre śīlā baddhvā sudorakam || 35 ||
bhartā tasyāḥ samāgatya tāṃ dadarśa mahādhanām ||
pātheyaśeṣaṃ viprāya dattvā bhuktvā tathaiva ca || 36 ||
punarjagāma sā hṛṣṭā gorathena svamāśramam ||
bhartrā sahaiva śanakaiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tatkṣaṇādabhūt ||
tenānaṃtaprabhāveṇa śubhagodhanasaṃkulaḥ || 37 ||
gṛhāśramaḥ śriyā yukto dhanadhānyasamāyutaḥ ||
ākulo vyākulo ramyaḥ sarvatrātithipūjanaḥ || 38 ||
sāpi māṇikyakāñcībhirmuktāhāravibhūṣitā ||
divyāṃgavastrasaṃchannā sāvitrīpratimābhavat || 39 ||
kadācidupaviṣṭena dṛṣṭaṃ baddhaṃ sudorakam ||
śīlāyā hastamūle tu sākṣepaṃ troṭitaṃ ruṣā || 40 ||
godhanaṃ taskarairnītaṃ gṛhaṃ cāgnividāhitam || 41 ||
yadyadevāgataṃ gehe tatra tatraiva naśyati ||
svajanaiḥ kalaho mitrairvacanaṃ na janaistathā || 42 ||
anaṃtākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ||
na kaścidvadate lokastena sārddhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 43 ||
tato jagāma kauṃḍinyo nirvedādvanagahvaram ||
manasā dhyāyatenaṃtaṃ kadā drakṣyāmi keśavam || 44 ||
vrataṃ niraśanaṃ gṛhya brahmacaryaṃ japanharim ||
vihvalaḥ prayayau pārtha araṇyaṃ janavarjitam||45||
tatrāpaśyanmahāvṛkṣaṃ phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā ||
tamapṛcchattvayānaṃtaḥ kaccidṛṣṭo mahādruma ||
tadbrūhi sopyuvācedaṃ nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija || 46 ||
evaṃ nirīkṣitastena gāṃ dadarśa savatsakām ||
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvantīmitaścetaśca pāṃḍava ||47||
sobravīddhenuke brūhi yadyanaṃtastvayekṣitaḥ ||
gauruvācātha kauṃḍinya nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ vibho || 48 ||
tato jagāmātha vane govṛṣaṃ śādvale sthitam ||
dṛṣṭvā papraccha gosvāminnanaṃto lakṣitastvayā || 49 ||
govṛṣastamuvācātha nānanto vīkṣito mayā ||
tato vrajandadarśāgre ramyaṃ puṣkariṇīdvayam || 50 ||
anyonyajalakallolavīcibhiḥ pariśobhitam ||
channaṃ kumudakahlāraiḥ kumudotpalamaṃḍitam || 51 ||
sevitaṃ bhramarairhaṃsaiścakraiḥ kāraṃḍavairbakaiḥ ||
te apṛcchaṃ dvijonanto bhavadbhyāṃ nopalakṣitaḥ || 52 ||
ūcatuḥ puṣkariṇyau taṃ nānaṃtaṃ vidvahe dvija ||
tato brahmandadarśāgre gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā || 53 ||
tāvapyuktau sumaṃtena tasyāpi viniveditam ||
nāvābhyāṃ vīkṣitonaṃtastacchrutvā niṣasāda ha || 54 ||
tasminkṣaṇe munivare kauṃḍinye brāhmaṇottame ||
kṛpayānaṃtadevopi pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata || || 55 ||
praveśayitvā svagṛhaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 56 ||
tāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa divyanārīnarairyutām ||
tasyāṃ niviṣṭamātmānaṃ varasiṃhāsane nṛpa || 57 ||
pārśvasthaśaṃkhacakrāsigadāgaruḍaśobhitam ||
darśayāmāsa viprāya pūrvoktaṃ viśvarūpiṇam|| 58 ||
vibhūtibhedaiścānantamanantaṃ parameśvaram ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dvijonantamuvāca parayā mudā || 59 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ||
cūtavṛkṣo vṛṣaḥ kastu kā gauḥ puṣkariṇīdvayam ||
gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ caiva deva me brūhi tattvataḥ || 61 ||
|| anaṃta uvāca || ||
cūtavṛkṣo hi viprosau vidvānyo vedagarvitaḥ ||
vidyādānaṃ nopakurvañchiṣyebhyastarutāṃ gataḥ || 62 ||
sā gaurvasundharā dṛṣṭā niṣphalā yā tvayekṣitā ||
sa harṣo vṛṣabho dṛṣṭo lābhārthaṃ yastvayā vṛtaḥ || 63 ||
dharmādharmavyavasthānaṃ tacca puṣkariṇīdvayam ||
kharaḥ krodhastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ kuṃjaro dharmadūṣakaḥ ||
brāhmaṇosāvanaṃtohaṃ guhāsaṃsāragahvare || 64 ||
ityuktaṃ te mayā sarvaṃ vipra gaccha punargṛham || 65 ||
tatastuṣṭaḥ pradāsyāmi nakṣatrasthānamuttamam || 66 ||
bhuktvā ca vipulānbhogānsarvānkāmānyathepsitān ||
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtastato mokṣamavāpsyasi||67||
iti dattvā varaṃ devastatraivāṃtarhito.abhavat||
kauṃḍinyopyāgato gehaṃ cacārānaṃtasadvratam || 68 ||
śīlayā saha dharmātmā bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān||
aṃte jagāma ca svargaṃ nakṣatraṃ ca punarvasum ||
kalpasthānī ca saṃbhūto dṛśyatedyāpi sa jvalan| ||
anaṃtavratadharmeṇa samyakcīṇeṃna kaurava || 70 ||
etatte kathitaṃ pārtha vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ||
ye ca śṛṇvaṃti satataṃ vācyamānaṃ narottama ||
saṃsārasāgaraguhāṃ susukhaṃ vihartuṃ vāṃchaṃti ye kurukulodbhava śuddhasattvāḥ ||
saṃpūjya te tribhuvaneśamanaṃtadevaṃ badhnaṃti dakṣiṇakare varadorakaṃ me || 73 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahā.apurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde.ānaṃtacaturdaśīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma caturnavatitamo.adhyāyaḥ || 94 || cha ||
śabdakalpadruma ---
araṇyavāsamuṣito yudhiṣṭhiranṛpo vaśī |
prāptastrailokyanāthena kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ||
kathopakathanaṃ jātaṃ tayostatra priyāpriyaṃ |
viśeṣeṇa ca govindaṃ papraccha ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kena vratena deveśa vāñchitaṃ prāpyate phalaṃ |
niṣpāpāḥ sakalā lokāḥ bhavanti janmajanmani ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
asti vratamanantākhyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ surasadmani |
indrādyairlokapālaiśca tanma kathayataḥ śṛṇu |
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kṛṣṇa ko.ayaṃ tvayākhyāto yo.ananta iti saṃjñitaḥ
ko.ayaṃ śeṣaśca nāgaśca anantastakṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
paramañcottamaṃ vāpi utāho brahma ucyate |
ka eṣo.anantasaṃjño vai tanme brūhi janārddana ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ananta ityahaṃ pārtha mama rūpaṃ nibodha tat |
ādityagatirūpeśa yaḥ kāla upapadyate ||
pakṣo māsa ṛturvvarṣaṃ yugakalpavyavasthayā ||

so.ahaṃ kālo.avatīrṇo.asmi bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt |
anantaṃ viddhi māṃ pārtha kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivaṃ
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ śeṣaṃ sarvvavyāpinamīśvaraṃ |
pratyayārthaṃ mayā pārtha viśvarūpaṃ nibotha tat |
pūrvameva mahābāho yogidhyeyamanuttamaṃ || ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
anantavratamāhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ vidhividāṃ vara |
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya anuṣṭhānañca tasya kiṃ ||
kena vā tatkṛtaṃ pūrvvaṃ loke kena prakāśitaṃ |
tatsarvvaṃ bahu.a vistāryya brūhi nārāyaṇa prabho ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
vaśiṣṭhagotrajo vidvān śīlavān vijitendriyaḥ ||
patnī tasyābhavaddīkṣā satī satyavrate sthitā |
cāritraśīlasampannā surūpā bhṛguvaṃśajā ||
tasyāḥ kālena saṃjātā duhitā sarvvalakṣaṇā |
śīlā nāmnā suśīlā sā varddhate pitṛveśmani ||
mātā tasyāstu kālena jvaradāhaprapīḍitā |
samāgatya nadītoye mṛtā svargapuraṃ yayau ||
kṛtaṃ sumantunā tasyāḥ karmma yat pāralaukikaṃ |
tataḥ sumantuḥ saṃtyajya duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ kramāt punaḥ
nāpatnīko gṛhī dharmmaṃ karttumarhati vai kvacit |
iti sañcintya manasā vivāhotsukamānasaḥ ||
devalasya muneḥ kanyāṃ karkaśāṃ pariṇītavān |
sā karkaśātiduḥśīlā sadā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇī ||
kopanā pratikūlā ca nirlajjā kalahapriyā |
adakṣā gṛhṛkṛtyeṣu dakṣā bhojanakarmmaṇi ||
kalahena tu santuṣṭā ruṣṭā bandhujanān prati |
sā tu śīlā piturgehe varddhitā ca dine dine ||
karoti sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiśukrīḍāmanuttamāṃ |
gṛhāntarasthaladvāradehalītoraṇādiṣu |
svastikaṃ padmaśaṅkhau ca maṇḍayantī punaḥ punaḥ ||
kurvvantī pratyahaṃ bālā devatātithipūjanaṃ |
gṛhakṛtye sadā dakṣā pituratyantavallabhā ||
kālena kiyatā viprastāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanodgatāṃ |
kasmai deyā mayā kanyā iti cintānvito.abhavat||
tato davavaśāttatra kauṇḍinyaḥ samupāgataḥ |
muniśreṣṭho mahābhāgaḥ kulīno dharmatatparaḥ ||
manasā cintayāmāsa sumantuḥ sutapāḥ sudhīḥ |
asmai bhāgyavaśācchīlā pratipādyā prayatnataḥ ||
iti kṛtvā matiṃ vipro dadau kanyāṃ śubhe dine |
kanyāmalaṅkṛtāṃ sādhvīṃ śīlāṃ candranibhānanāṃ ||
gṭahyoktavedavidhinā vivāhamakarottadā |
tato homādikaṃ karmma samāpya samaye muniḥ ||
sumantuḥ karkaśāṃ prāha jāmātre dehi dakṣiṇāṃ
saphalaṃ kuru me dānaṃ priye munikulodbhave |
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ karmma niṣphalaṃ jāyate yataḥ |
sumantuṃ bhartsayāmāsa karkaśairvvacanaiḥ patiṃ |
alaṅkāraṃ samānīya svakīyañcāpi bandhanaṃ ||
nikṣipya nibhṛte sthāne karkaśānyagṛhṛṃ yayau |
sumantuścātidīnātmā lajjitaścābhavattadā ||
yatkiñcidarthayogyañca dravyamānīya yautukaṃ |
jāmātre pradadau vipraḥ paricāryya punaḥ punaḥ ||
tato vivāhaṃ nirvvartya kauṇḍinyo.api nijāśramaṃ |
goyāne tāṃ samāropya śīlāmādāya vai yayau
tataḥ sā pathi gacchantī śīlā candranibhānanā
madhyāhne bhojyavelāyāṃ samuttīryya sarittaṭe ||
dadarśa śīlā nārīṇāṃ samūhaṃ vratacāriṇāṃ |
puṃsāṃ vṛndañca tatreva raktapītāmbarāsanaṃ ||
caturddaśyāmarcayantaṃ bhaktyānantaṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
dṛṣṭvā samūhaṃ nārīṇāṃ satī papraccha sādaraṃ ||
kimidaṃ kriyate kāryyaṃ bhavatībhistaducyatāṃ ||
striya ūcuḥ |
bhādre māsi site pakṣe utthite vāsavadhvaje |
natvā sarasi yaḥ snātvā anantārccanamārabhet |
ehyehi bhagavan kṛṣṇa tava yajñaḥ pravarttate ||
vāridhānyāṃ tathānantaṃ bhagavantaṃ niyojayet |
maṇḍale puṣpanevedyaṃ dhūpavastrānulepanaṃ ||
dattvā ca pūjayedbhaktyā anantaṃ viśvarūpiṇaṃ |
piṣṭakārthaṃ vrīhicūrṇaṃ yavagodhūmayośca vā ||
eteṣāṃ prāpyate yattu tadgrāhyaṃ prasthasaṃjñitaṃ |
arddhaṃ viprāya dātavyamarddhamātmani yojayet ||
śrutvā kathāṃ tatastasya kuṅkamāktaṃ suḍorakaṃ ||
caturdaśagranthiyuktaṃ nārī vāmakare nyaset |
pumāṃstu dakṣiṇe bāhau tadānantaṃ prapūjayet ||
nirvvarttya pūjāṃ devasya pūpaṃ bhuktvā yathāsukhaṃ |
visṛjya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇamya ca yathāsukhaṃ ||
śīlā śrutvā vacastāsāṃ yathā tābhirudāhṛtaṃ |
vrataṃ cakāra sā bāhau vaddhā ḍorakamuttamaṃ |
pūpaprasthañca sāṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā caiva tathaiva ca |
punarjagāma tenaiva gorathena samanvitā ||
tenānantaprasādena gṛhaṃ godhanasaṅkulaṃ |
tadāśramaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitaṃ ||
vividhātithisampūrṇaṃ nānāratnairvibhūṣitaṃ |
varāśvamattamātaṅgamahiṣairgodhanānvitaṃ ||
śīlā ca maṇikāñcībhirmuktābharaṇabhūṣitā |
divyāṅgī śīlasampannā sāvitrīpratimā yathā ||
kadācidupaviṣṭā sā vahnikuṇḍaṃ samāgatā |
kauṇḍinyo.api viśedroṣāt dṛṣṭvā ḍoramanantakaṃ |
śolāyāḥ karamūle ca baddhameva prayatnataḥ |
papraccha krodhavacasā bhṛkuṭīkuṭilaṃ mukhaṃ ||
kimidaṃ ḍorakaṃ haste baddhvā bhāryye.atra tiṣṭhasi |
prameyaḥ kasya devasya durbbuddhe brūhi satvaraṃ |5||
śīlovāca |
anantaṃ devadevasya prameyaṃ ḍorakaṃ śubhaṃ |
kare baddhaṃ vidhānena śṛṇu me vacanaṃ prabho ||
prasādād yasya devasya bhuṅkte suvipulaṃ dhanaṃ |
na jānāsi kathaṃ nātha tadevaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ ||
śīlāvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā kauṇḍinyaḥ kupito.abhavat |
ko.asāvanantasaṃjño vai na śruto.api varānane |
ityutvākṛṣya kupito bhujāḍḍoramanantakaṃ |
kṣiptaṃ jvālākule vahnau nirbhartsya bahudhā priyāṃ ||
tataḥ sā saṃbhramāt śīlā hāhā kṛtvā pradhāvitā
vahneḥ sūtraṃ samādāya kṣīramadhye tato.akṣipat ||
tatastayā kare vāme punarbaddhaṃ suḍorakaṃ |
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ||
na kaiścit varṇyate lokaiḥ so.api vipro yudhiṣṭhira |
gātre malinatā prāptā cakṣurnidrāṃ tathaiva ca ||
śūnyāni gṛharūpāṇi dagdhāni vahninā kvacit |
nirīkṣya svapuraṃ vipraścintayāmāsa cetasā ||
atha śīlā vivarṇā sā duḥkhitā patidoṣataḥ;
vicacāra purīṃ sarvvāṃ śūnyāgārasamanvitāṃ ||
atha kauṇḍinyaviprasya saṃjātā buddhiruttamā |
mamāpi duṣkṛtaṃ karmma kṛtaṃ vā me vigarhitaṃ ||
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa mamāpi gatirīdṛśī |
anantaṃ yatra paśyāmi tatra yāsyāmi durmatiḥ ||
tato jagāma kauṇḍinyo vanaṃ vyāghrādisaṅkulaṃ |
vratasyānveṣaṇaṃ karttuṃ pādau draṣṭuṃ tathā hareḥ ||
vihvalaḥ sa yayau mārge janajantuvivarjjite |
tatrāpaśyacca taṃ vṛkṣaṃ phalapuṣpasamanvitaṃ ||
varjitaṃ pakṣisaṅghātaiḥ kīṭaiścaiva viśeṣataḥ |
tamapṛcchat tvayānantaḥ kvaciddṛṣṭo mahādruma ||
sa covāca mahāvṛkṣo nānantaṃ vedmi bho dvija
tato gacchan dadarśāgre tṛṇamadhye savatsikāṃ ||
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvanto na khādati na jighrati |
he mahādhenuke brūhi kimanantastvayekṣitaḥ ||
savatsā tamuvācātha nānantaṃ vedmi he dvija |
tato gacchan dadarśāgre vṛṣaśreṣṭhaṃ vane sthitaṃ ||
tamapṛcchadayaṃ vipraḥ ananto vīkṣitastvayā |
vṛṣabhastamuvācedaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati ||
yadyanantamahaṃ jāne tadā me gatirīdṛśī |
tato vrajan dadarśāgre gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā ||
nānāmāyāpracarantaṃ madagarjjanadarpitaṃ |

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃjātaḥ saṃgrāmo jayalakṣaṇaḥ ||
somasyāribudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram || || 2 ||
tārāyāṃ candramāḥ saktastasyā bhartā bṛhaspatiḥ ||
tayorabhūnmahāyuddhaṃ bhāryākṛtyeṣu vai purā || 3 ||
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ||
tārā kasya sutā kasmātsa kruddhaḥ sasurārihā ||
somena saha saṃgrāmaṃ cakre cakragadādhara || 4 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
prajāpaterabhūtkanyā tārā vṛtrasya cānujā ||
tāṃ bṛhaspataye prādātpṛthivyāmekasuṃdarīm || 5 ||
devācāryāya sā bhāryā tvanirdeśyā tathāvidhā ||
rūpeṇābhyāṃ rūpavatī sā nirdhūya vyavasthitā || 6 ||
bṛhaspatiṃ paryacaradyathā cānyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit ||
tāṃ dadarśāyatāpāṃgīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ cāruhāsinīm || 7 ||
śītāṃśurdarśanādeva kāmasya vaśamīyivān ||
ābabhāṣe ca madhuraṃ tāre ehyehi mā ciram || 8 ||
iṃgitākārakuśalā tārā somasya ceṣṭitam ||
buddhvā śuddhimatho tanvī prāhedaṃ madhurākṣaram || 9 ||
muneraṃgirasaḥ putrastvaṃ ca saumyo.asi somarāṭ ||
aṃgiraso munervīra snuṣāhamucitaṃ na te ||
saha saumyena yo yogastava siddho.a dbhuto mahān || 4.99.10 ||
aṃgirāstvāṃ kila purā sasurāsurarākṣasaiḥ ||
rājatve sthāpayāmāsa naitatsmarasi kiṃ vidho || 11 ||

evamuktastathā cāsau na caitatkṛtavāṃstataḥ ||
gṛhītvākarṣayāmāsa somo.anaṃgavaśīkṛtaḥ || 13 ||

evaṃ cireṇa vijñāya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ||
nāsasāda svakāṃ bhāryāṃ roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ || 15 ||
ācakhyau sarvamindrāya somasyedaṃ viceṣṭitam ||
na somo gaṇayāmāsa tato.abudhyata devarāṭ ||
ākāryaṃ tridaśānsarvānācakhyau candraceṣṭitam || 17 ||
tacchrutvā devagaṃdharvāḥ krodhāndhāḥ kṣubdhamānasāḥ ||
pragṛhītapraharaṇā rathānāruruhuḥ svakān|| 18 ||
somo.api devānsodyogāñjñātvā sukṛtaniścayān ||
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi samānīya vyavasthitaḥ || 19 ||
āruhya ca rathaśreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe ||
pravṛttaṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ śaratomarakaṃpanaiḥ || 4.99.20 ||
kauṇapaiḥ kṣmāsuraiḥ śūlairdevadānavadāraṇam ||
sa teṣāṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ dattvā tārāgaṇādhipaḥ|||
babhaṃja devānsendrāṃśca hemavṛṣṭyā kṣapākaraḥ || 21 ||
sa jitvā devagandharvānsomo rājanyasattama ||
śriyā paramayā yukto yathā nānyo havirbhujām || || 22 ||
devāśca nirjitāstena somenāmitatejasā ||
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svargavāsinām || 23 ||
indraḥ sarvaṃ samācakhyau somasyedṛgviceṣṭitam ||
śrutvā kruddho hṛṣīkeśa āruhya garuḍaṃ ruṣā ||
gṛhītvā cāyudhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe || 24 ||
prakartuṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ cakraśārṅgagadā dharaḥ ||
jagāma vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ somasyopari roṣitaḥ || 25 ||
viṣṇuṃ viditvā saṃprāptaṃ somo daityagaṇaiḥ saha ||
yuddhāya samarāmarṣī sthitaḥ pradhmāya vārijam || 26 ||
sa jitvā devasaṃghātaṃ seṃdraṃ vāyupurassaram ||
viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ śastrāstrairasubhojanaiḥ || 27 ||
yadā nāsāvuparamedyuddhāya saha viṣṇunā ||
tadā.a.adade ruṣā viṣṇuścakaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ || 28 ||
athāha brahmā deveśamajitaṃ viṣṇumavyayam ||
yo.asau meghaprapuṣṭāṃgaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi nibodha tat || 29 ||
nāsti vadhyaṃ tribhuvane cakrasyāsya tavānagha ||
somo dvijādhipatye ca mayā samabhiṣecitaḥ || 4.99.30 ||
tasmādyadyujyate devakārye.asmiṃstadvidhīyatām ||
athāha bhagavānviṣṇuḥ surabrahmarṣisannidhau || 31 ||
sinīvālī kuhūrnāma tasyāṃ naṣṭaḥ kṣapākaraḥ ||
vinaṣṭo.api punarjanma prāpsyatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||
rākāṃ cānumatiṃ prāpya vṛddhirasya bhaviṣyati ||
āpyāyitaśca śrutyuktaiḥ pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtrakaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇairhavyakavyāni devebhyaḥ prāpayiṣyati || 33||
vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇena caivāsya na ca jātasya bhūyasī ||
evameva vidhirdṛṣṭastasyāpyāya nameva me || 34 ||
amoghasya na moghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati kadācana ||
śaptaśca somo dakṣeṇa sa cāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 35 ||
sudarśanasya ca prītirevameva bhaviṣyati ||
evamastviti deveśa yadbhavānprabravīti vai || 36 ||
brahmā provāca somaṃ tu vinītavadupasthitam ||
arpayasva gurorbhāryāṃ na kāryaṃ punarīdṛśam || 37 ||
sa tathoktaḥ samānīya dadau tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||
punarūce śaśī spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām ||38 ||
asyāṃ garbho madīyo.ayaṃ yadapatyaṃ mamaiva tat ||
kṣetre madīye cotpannastasmātsa mama putrakaḥ||
uktaṃ ca vedaśāstrajñairṣibhirddharmadarśibhiḥ || 4.99.40 ||
uptaṃ vātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati ||
kṣetriṇastasya tadbījaṃ na bījī phalabhāgbhavet || 41 ||
samyaguktaṃ na bhavatā śaśāṃkaḥ prāha tattvavit ||
iti paurāṇikāḥ prāhurmunayo nayacakṣuṣaḥ || 42 ||
vivadaṃtau nivāryātha brahmā provāca tāṃ vadhūm ||
śanairekāṃtamānīya garbhoyaṃ kasya śaṃsa me || 43 ||
evamuktā tu sā tārā hriyā novāca kiṃcana ||
utsasarja kṣaṇādgarbhaṃ bhābhāsitasurālayam || 44 ||
tamuvāca tato brahmā putra kasya suto bhavān ||
somasyāhaṃ suto brahmanniti tathyaṃ mayoditam || || 45 ||
budho.ayaṃ vibudhāḥ prāhuḥ sarvajñānavidāṃ varaḥ ||
gṛhītvā putrakaṃ somo jagāma svaṃ niveśanam || 46 ||
gururgṛhītvā svāṃ bhāryāṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ śanaiḥ ||
somo.api tanayaṃ labdhvā harṣavyākulamānasaḥ || 47 ||
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā prāptapūrṇamanorathā ||
prāptaḥ putro mayā hyasyāṃ labdhaśca vi jayastathā ||48||
tasmādenāmupāsiṣye vidhinā vratatatparaḥ||
evamanyo.api pūrṇārthaḥ pūrṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||49||
yo māmakyāṃ tithau bhaktyā vidhivatpūjayiṣyati ||
tasya prasādābhimukhaḥ sarvakāmaprado hyaham || 4.99.50 ||
evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha somasya dayitā śubhā ||
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā pūrṇo māso bhavedyathā || 51 ||
ālikhya maṃḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum || 52 ||
pūjayetkusumairhṛdyairnaivedyairghṛtapācitaiḥ ||
śuklākṣataiḥ śuklavastraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet||
śākāharaṇamunyannairnaktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 53 ||
vasaṃtabāṃdhava vidho śītāṃśo svasti naḥ kuru ||
pakṣepakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe.api yaḥ kaścicchraddhāvānvai vratī bhavet || 55||
tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ||
āmāvāsyā tithiriyaṃ pitṛrṇāṃ dayitā sadā ||
asyāṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitṛrṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet || 56 ||
amāvāsyā mahārāja prayatnairyairupoṣitā ||
tairakṣayyaṃ bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastīrthamuttamam || 57 ||
yaḥ kaścitkurute tasminpitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām ||
yadā tu iha kālāṃte tasyātrāgamanaṃ bhavet || 59 ||
evaṃ janmani rājendra bhaveddhanasamanvitaḥ || 4.99.60 ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam ||
somaṃ nakṣatrasahitaṃ viprāya pratipādayet || 61 ||
upadeśaṃ prayacchedyastasmai vratakṛte naraḥ ||
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairmaṃtreṇetthaṃ nivedayet ||
māsemāse vidhirayaṃ vratasyāsya narādhipa || 62 ||
yo na śaknoti vā kartuṃ pakṣaṃ vātha niraṃtaram ||
sa ekāmapyupoṣyaiva kuryādudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ || 63 ||
yaścaitatkurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaścandravaddivi rājate || 64 ||
putrapautradhanopeto yajvā dātā priyaṃvadaḥ ||
saṃtatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhajet || 65 ||
tataścaivākṣayā~mllokānprāpnoti surasevitān ||
āste saṃpūrṇasarvāṃgo yāvatkalpāyutatrayam || 66 ||
abhyarcayaṃti sitapañcadaśīṣu somaṃ kṛṣṇāsu ye pitṛgaṇaṃ jalapiṃḍadānaiḥ ||
teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi dhana dhānyasutādisaṃpatpūrṇāni pārthiva bhavaṃti vidhervidhānāt || 67 || || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde vijayapaurṇa māsīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma navanavatitamo.adhyāyaḥ || 99 || || cha ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
saṃvatsare ca yāḥ kāścittithayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ ||
tā me vada yaduśreṣṭha snāne dāne mahāphalāḥ || 1 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayo.atīva pūjitāḥ ||
snānadānavihīnaistā na neyāḥ pāṃḍunandana || 2 ||
tīrthasnānaṃ tadā śastaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ||
vaiśākhyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā dyotanikā matā || 3 ||
kārttikyāṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ māghyāṃ vārāṇasī smṛtā ||
snānenodakadānena tārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn ||4||
vaiśākhyāṃ brāhmaṇo dattvā na śocati kṛte vrate || 5 ||
madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇānbhājanānkanakojjvalān ||

māghyāṃ maghāsu ca tathā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
tilapātrāṇi deyāni tilāṃśca palalaudanam || 7 ||
kārpāsadānamatraiva tiladānaṃ ca śasyate ||
kaṃbalājinaratnāni mocakau pāpamocakau ||8||
upānaddānamatraiva kathitaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
yatra vā tatra vā snānaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ ||9||
kalikālodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śasyate pāṃḍunandana ||
kārtikyāṃ tu vṛṣotsargo vivāhaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇaḥ ||
kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha harernīrājanaṃ tathā || 4.100.10 ||
gajāśvarathadānaṃ ca ghṛtadhenvādayastathā ||
pradeyāḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca tāstāḥ saṃkalpya devatāḥ || 11 ||
phalāni yāni vidyaṃte sugandhimadhurāṇi ca ||
kharjūrīṃ nālikerāṃśca kadalyāśca phalāni ca ||
dāḍimānmātuluṃgāṃśca karkoṭāṃstrapusāṃstathā || || 13 ||
vṛṃtākānkāravellāṃśca biṃbānkūṣmāṃḍakarburān ||
apradānena yeṣāṃ tu tithayo yāṃti bhārata ||
te vyādhitā daridrāśca jāyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ || || 14 ||
na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dānaṃ sarvasya śasyate ||
bhaginībhāgineyānāṃ mātulānāṃ pitṛṣvasuḥ ||
daridrāṇāṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ dānaṃ koṭiguṇotta ram || 15 ||
mitraṃ kulīnaścāpanno vadhurdāridryaduḥkhitaḥ ||
āśayābhyāgato dūrātsotithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ ||16||
vanaṃ prasthāpite rāme sasīte saha lakṣmaṇe ||
sā sarveḥ śrāvitānekaiḥ kośalyā bharatena vai || 17 ||
yadā na pratyayaṃ yāti kathaṃcitkośalātmajā ||
tadā viśuddhabhāvena tithayaḥ śrāvitāḥ punaḥ || 18 ||
vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayomarapūjitāḥ ||
apradānavato yāṃti yasyāryyonumate gataḥ || 19 ||
etacchrutvā tu kauśalyā sahasā pratyayaṃ gatā ||
aṃkamānīya bharataṃ sāṃtvayāmāsa duḥkhitam || 4.100.20 ||
etattithīnāṃ māhātmyamākhyātaṃ bahuvistaram ||
bhūyastu kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tava rājanmahāmate || 21 ||

tasyāṃ jalānnakanakāṃbaramātapatraṃ dattvā prayāti puruṣaḥ puruhūtalokam || 22 || ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde vaiśākhīkārtikīmāghīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma śatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 100|| || a ||
yugāditithivratamāhātmyavarṇanam
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
punarme brūhi deveśa tvadbhaktyā bhāvitātmanaḥ ||
kathyamānamihecchāmi śubhadharmapadaṃ mahat || 1 ||
yatrāṇvapi narairddattaṃ japtaṃ vā sumahadbhavet || 2 || |||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
śṛṇu pāṃḍava te vacmi rahasyaṃ devanirmitam||
yanmayā kasyacinnoktaṃ supriyasyāpi bhārata || 3 ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā tu samā kṛtayutena tu||
navamī kārtike yā tu tretāyugasamāgatā || 5 ||
trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samāgatā ||
māghe pañcadaśī rājankalikālādirucyate|| 6 ||
etāścatasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavādyathā ||

upavāsastapo dānaṃ japahomakriyāstathā ||

kāryā kurukulaśreṣṭha caturbhāgeṇa vatsakaḥ || 4.101.10 ||
avicarmopari sthāpya kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
śāstroktakramayogena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet || 11 ||

tathaiva kārtike māsi navamyāṃ naktabhuṅnaraḥ ||
snātvā nadītaḍāgeṣu devakhāteṣu vā punaḥ || 13 ||
umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ nīlakaṃṭhamathārcayet ||
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyairaniṃdyaiḥ śaṃkaraṃ śivam || 14 ||
aṣṭamūrtirnīlakaṃṭhaḥ prīyatāmiti ciṃtayet || 15 ||
yadatra prāpyate puṇyaṃ pārtha tatkena varṇyate ||
dattvā tilamayīṃ dhenuṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 16 ||
trayodaśī nabhasi yā kṛṣṇamasyāṃ samarcayet ||
pitṛrnpāyasadānena madhunā ca ghṛtena tu ||
pitṛrnuddiśya dātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanī ||
pratyakṣā gaurmahārāja taruṇī supayasvinī || 18 ||
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
prīyatāṃ gopradānena iti dattvā visarjayet || 19 ||
kṛtenānena rājendra yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ ||
gāyatryā sahitaṃ devaṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitam || 22 ||
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ phalairnānāvidhairyutām ||
yatsvarge yacca pātāle yacca martye sudurlabham ||
tadavāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ padmayoni prasādataḥ || 24 ||
yugādiṣu mahārāja akṣayāni bhavaṃti hi || 25 ||
alpamalpaṃ hi yaḥ kaścitpradadyānnirddhanopi san ||

bhūrhiraṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ vāsaḥ śayanānyāsanāni ca ||
chatropānatsuyugmāni pradeyāni dvijātiṣu || 28 ||
paścādbhuñjīta sumanā vāgyataḥ svajanaiḥ saha || 29 ||
yatkiñcinmānasaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ tathā ||
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti yugāditithipūjanāt || 4.101.30 ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
smarayāmi hṛṣīkeśa yannoktaṃ bhavatā kvacit ||
tatsāvitrīvrataṃ brūhi mamopari dayāṃ kuru || 1 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
pārthivośvapatirnāma paurajānapadapriyaḥ || 3 ||
kṣamāvāṃśca kṣitipatiḥ satyavāṃśca jitendriyaḥ ||
sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ cacāra nṛpatiḥ svayam || 4 ||
sāvitrīvratasiddhaṃ tatsarvakāmapradāyakam ||
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā ||
uvāca duhitā hyekā tava rājanbhaviṣyati ||
kālena sā tathā rājanduhitā devarūpiṇī ||
sāvitrī sukumārāṅgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha || 9 ||
cacāra sā ca sāvitrīvrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam || 11 ||
hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayitveṃduparvaṇi || 12 ||
sādhvī pativratābhyetya devaśrīriva rūpiṇī || 13 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaṃ prāptāṃ svacchāṃ tāṃ devarūpiṇīm ||
uvāca rājā saṃmaṃtrya smṛtyarthaṃ saha maṃtribhiḥ ||15||
vicārayitvā paśyāmi varaṃ tulyaṃ mahātmanaḥ||16||
boddhayamānā mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu gaccha tam || 17 ||

evaṃ stutvā tathābhyarcya candrāyārghyaṃ nivedya ca||
upoṣitavyaṃ naktaṃ vā bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam || 7 ||
pāraṇatritaye caiva cāturmāsikamucyate || 4.105.10 ||
viśeṣapūjā dānaṃ ca tathā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ||
viśeṣeṇaiva kartavyaṃ pāraṇepāraṇe gate || 11 ||
pāraṇepāraṇe pārtha yugmānevārccayeddvijān ||
upavāsavrataparā samuddhṛtya rasātalāt || 17 | |
tasmātprasādamatulaṃ karomi tava suvate || 18 ||
tathaiva tava kalyāṇi praṇato yaḥ kariṣyati | | 1 9| |
sarvabādhāvinirmukto janmajanmāṃtarāṇyapi ||
yathā tvameva vasudhe saṃprāptā nirvṛteḥ padam | |
tathā sa parama~mlloke sukhaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ | | 21 ||
viśokākhyaṃ vratavaraṃ tatkuruṣva mahāvratam || 22 ||
samyagviśokakaraṇī nṛpapūrṇimā te khyātā mayā manumahendrasamānakīrte ||
evaṃ karoti kurupuṃgava yaḥ prayatnācchoko na tasya bhavatīha kulepi puṃsaḥ || 23 | | iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde viśokapūrṇimāvrataṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 105 || cha | |

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca | | ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| maitreyyuvāca || ||

yasminyasmindine pūjā tatratatra tadā dine ||

namo.astvanaṃtāya śiraḥ pādau sarvātmane namaḥ || 38 ||
śeṣāya jānuyugalaṃ kāmāyeti kaṭiṃ namaḥ ||
saṃkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ bhujaṃ sarvāsudhāriṇe ||
kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya mukhamiṃdumukhāya ca || 4.106.40 ||
halaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva svanāmnā pūjayedbudhaḥ ||
evaṃ sampūjya govindaṃ sitavastravibhūṣitam || 41 ||
chatropānatsusaṃyuktaṃ sragdāmālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā ||
nakṣatradevatāḥ pūjyā nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ || 42 ||

dvādaśātra ghaṭānkuryātsa toyāṃścānnasaṃyutān || 43 ||

karṇāṃgulaiḥ pavitraiśca śāṃtaṃ dāṃtaṃ jitendriyam ||
purāṇajñaṃ dharmanityamavyaṃgaṃ supriyaṃvadam || 45 ||
tasmai deyaṃ samastaṃ tadanantaḥ prīyatāmiti ||
anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca deyaṃ śaktyā yathepsitam || 46 ||
anena vidhinā pārtha vrataṃ caitatsamāpyate ||

tatkuruṣvaiva devi tvaṃ vrataṃ śīladhane param ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

dadau śauryadhane cāpi sakalānyāyudhāni ca ||
sa vavre ca vadho deva mama tvatto bhavediti ||57||
smaraṇādupakārittvaṃ jagato.asya jagatpate ||58||
sarvametanmahābhāga tava bhūyo bhaviṣyati || 59 ||
namo.astu kārtavīryāyetyabhidhāsyati caiva yaḥ ||
tilaprasthapradānasya naraḥ puṇyamavāpsyati || 4.106.60 ||

sāṃbharāyaṇīvratavarṇanam
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
aprāptairna tathā duḥkhamaiśvaryādyairnarottama ||
yathā manorathaiḥ svaiḥ svairnānāduḥkhaṃ bhavennṛṇām || 1 ||
yathā manorathairlabdhairna syādduḥkhabhayaṃ nṛṇām ||
aiśvaryādvicyuto vāpi saṃtaterdevalokataḥ || 2 ||
tanmamācakṣva bhagavanyena nābhyeti vicyutim || 3 || ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
aiśvaryodayacittasya baṃdhuvargasukhasya ca ||
puṣpairdhūpaistathāṃbhobhirabhīṣṭairaparairapi || 7 ||

pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ tasyaiva prāśanācchuciḥ || 4.107.10 ||
samyaksaṃpūjya rājendra tameva puruṣottamam ||
namonamaste.acyuta me kṣayostu pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyam ||
yathācyutastvaṃ parataḥ parasmātsa brahmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātmā ||
acyutānaṃta govinda prasīda yadabhīpsitam ||
tadakṣayamameyātmankuruṣva puruṣottama || 14 ||
evamevaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayitvā tathā śivam ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte sukhasuptotthite.acyute ||
tatastu saptame varṣe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ || 17 ||

tadagre brāhmaṇī sthāpyā sthavirā sāṃbharāyaṇī || 18 ||
mahāsatī raupyamayī samānārhā sadevatā ||
tatastau pūjayitvā ca mālyavastravilepanaiḥ || 19 ||
maṃtreṇānena rājendra praṇipatya vidhānataḥ ||
prativarṣaṃ ca dattaṃ cettāmraṃ pātraṃ dvijātaye || 4.107.20 ||
tadevahelayā dadyātsahiraṇyāśvasaṃyutam ||
gāśca pradadyātsaṃ pūjya savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ || 21 ||
ekāṃ vā śaktito dadyādbhaktyā tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||
ghaṭāḥ satpātranirdiṣṭāḥ sānnāḥ pūrṇajalojjvalāḥ ||22||
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārdhamevaṃ dattvā visarjayet ||
śayyāṃ satūlikāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ copaskaraiḥ saha || 23 ||
śriyā ca saha viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayedbhūṣayetprabhum ||
vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva praṇipatya kṣamāpayet || 24 ||
saṃtateḥ svargavittāderaiśvaryasya tathaiva ca ||
yadvābhimatamanyacca tato na cyavate naraḥ || 25 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena māsanakṣatrapūjanaiḥ ||
yajetākṣayakāmastu sadaiva puruṣottamam || 26 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| sāṃbharāyaṇyuvāca || ||
yo vai pūrvaṃ sureṃdrasya tataśca prathamo hi yaḥ||

dānavaḥ śakraśayane tasminnupaviveśa ha ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

rudrasnānavidhivarṇanam
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

devapūjāvidhivarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvaṃti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||

|| yudhiṣṭir uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

.a.āgre tvāṃ kāmyayā girā tubhyaṃ tā girasastu viśvāḥ ||

vṛṣotsargavidhivarṇanam
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
kārttikyāmatha vā māghyāmayameva yudhiṣṭhira || 1 ||
caitryāmatha tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ dvādaśe.ahni vā ||
khaṃḍanīlaṃ śaṃkhapādaṃ sapauṃḍraṃ dhautapuṣpakam || 2 ||
gobhiścaturbhiḥ sahitaṃ sṛjeccaiva vidhiṃ śṛṇu ||
yaduvāca purā gargo gokule.anagha pāṃḍava || 3 ||
tattehaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ gargapracoditam || .
mātaraṃ sthāpayitvāgre pūjayetkusumākṣataiḥ || 4 ||
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tataḥ kuryātsadābhyudayakārakam ||
akālamūlaṃ kalaśamaśvatthadalaśobhitam || 5 ||
tatra vidvāñjapitvā tu sthāpayedrudradevatām ||
susamiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vahnimaṃtrapuraḥsaram || 6 ||

aparāyāṃ tṛtīye.ahni sthāpayedrathamuttamam || 61 ||

sthāpayeduttarasyāṃ tu caturthe divase ratham || ||62 ||

rathayātrāprasaṃgena kathitā rathasaptamī || 64 ||

gaurī pūjyā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ vighnanāyakaḥ || 65 ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
gaurīṃ vivāhya jagrāha haraḥ pāśupataṃ vratam ||

brahmādibhiḥ samāmaṃtrya vibudhaiḥ putralabdhaye ||

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
rājā saṃvaraṇaḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāne purottame ||
babhūva sa mahābhāgaḥ śāstrārthakuśalo balī ||1||
pūjayitvārghyapādyādyairātmānaṃ vinivedya ca ||
itihāsapurāṇoktāścakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ ||4||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇāṃ ca caritāni yathārthavit ||
tataḥ kathāṃtare rājā kāryaṃ manasi saṃsthitam ||5||
hitāya pṛthivīśānāṃ jagataścātmanastathā ||
papraccha vinayopeto yogācāryaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 6 ||
|| saṃvaraṇa uvāca || ||
bhagavanmahadutpātasaṃbhave bhūprakaṃpane ||
nirghāte pāṃśuvarṣe ca gṛhabhaṃge tathaiva ca || 7 ||
janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu anāvṛṣṭibhayeṣu ca ||
jvareṣu grahapīḍāsu durbhikṣe rāṣṭravigrahe || || 8 ||
vyādhīnāṃ saṃbhave jāte śarīre cātipīḍite ||
kleśe mahati cotpanne kiṃ kartavyaṃ narottamaiḥ || 9 ||
svargasya sādhanaṃ yacca kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā ||
prabrūhi me dvijaśreṣṭha tathārogyapradaṃ nṛṇām || 4.142.10 ||
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || ||
koṭihomākhyamatulaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 11 ||

śubhanakṣatrayoge ca vāre pūrvaguṇānvite || 14 ||

tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvaṃ me syānmanogatam || 17 ||
āpadvimokṣāya ca me kuru yajñamanuttamam||
koṭihomārthamatulaṃ śāṃtyarthaṃ sārvakāmikam || 18 ||
purohitastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ||
brāhmaṇairvedasaṃvṛttaiḥ puṇyairyuktaḥ samāhitaiḥ || 19 ||

puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpūrvaṃ kṛtvā viprānsupūjitān || 4.142.20 ||
tatastu mahitairvipraḥ sūtrayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham ||
uttamaṃ śatahastaṃ tu tadardhena tu madhyamam ||
jaghanyaṃ tu tadardhena śaktikālādyapekṣayā ||21||
madhye tu maṇḍapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
aṣṭahastapramāṇena āyāmena tathaiva ca || 22 ||
mekhalātritayaṃ tasya dvādaśāṃgulavistatam ||
tatpramāṇāṃ tathā yoniṃ kurvīta susamāhitaḥ || 23 ||
kuṃḍasya pūrvabhāge tu vediṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
caturhastāṃ samāṃ caiva hastamātrocchritaḥ nṛpa || 24 ||
sthānaṃ tatsarvabhūtānāṃ kuryādyatnena buddhimān || 25 ||
udalipya tato bhūmiṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ ||
vinyasetkalaśāṃstatra jalapūrṇāṃścaturdaśa || 26 ||
aśvatthaplakṣacūtādyaiḥ pallavairupaśobhitān||
vitānamupariṣṭācca maṃḍapasya prakalpayet || 27 ||
sthāpayeddikṣu sarvāsu toraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraiḥ purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ || 28 ||
puṇyāhajayaghoṣeṇa homakarma samārabhet ||
sthāpayitvā surānvedyāṃ vakṣyamāṇānariṃdama || 29 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvabhāge tu madhye devaṃ janārdanam||
paścime tu tathā rudraṃ vasūnuttaratastathā || 4.142.30 ||
aiśānyāṃ ca grahānsarvānāgneyyāṃ marutastathā ||
vāyuṃ saumyāṃ tathaiśānyāṃ lokapālānkrameṇa tu || 31 ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vibudhānyathāsthānaṃ nṛpottama ||
pūjayedvidhivadvastragandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 32 ||
vedoktamaṃtraistalliṅgaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || ||
brahmā janārdanaścaiva śūlapāṇirbhagākṣihā ||
atra saṃnihitāḥ sarve bhavaṃtu sukhabhāginaḥ || 34 ||
pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu sarvetra mayā bhaktyopapāditām ||
kurvaṃtu ca śubhaṃ sarve yajñakarma samāhitāḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tāndevānyatnena śuddhadhīḥ||
naivedyairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ patraistathaiva ca || 36 ||
tatastu tairdvijaiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃḍasya vidhipūrvakam ||
kuryātsaṃskārakaraṇaṃ yathoktaṃ vedacintakaiḥ || 37 ||
tataḥ samāhvayedvahniṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ ghṛtārciṣam ||
niyojayeddvijāṃstatra śatasaṃkhyānnṛpottama ||
alābhe tu bahūnā ca yathālābhaṃ niyojayet || 38 || vidyāvṛddhānvayovṛddhāngṛhasthānsaṃyatendriyān|| svakarmaniyatāñjñānaśīlāñchāntāndvijottamān || 39 ||
ciṃtayettatra deveśaṃ paṃcāsyaṃ nṛpa pāvakam ||
mukhāni tasya catvāri sapta jihvāśca pārthiva || 4.142.40 ||
ekajihvamathaikaṃ tu tatsmṛtaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
dhūmāyamāne mana vṛthā hotavyaṃ jvalite nale || 41 ||
ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāmukhairhomo yajurbhiścottarāmukhaiḥ|
sāmabhiḥ paścime kāryo.atharvabhirdakṣiṇāmukhaiḥ || 42 ||
āghārāvājya bhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
paritotha paristīrṇe kalpitai ca tathāsane || 43 ||
brahmāṇaṃ pūrvamapyetatsarvaṃ paścātsamācaret ||
homo vyāhṛtibhiścaiva sarvastatra vidhīyate || 44 ||
praṇavādibhistalliṃgaiḥ svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ||
juhuyātsarvadevānāṃ vedyāṃ ye copakalpitāḥ ||45||
evaṃ prakalpaye dyajñaṃ koṭihomākhyamuttamam ||
tilāḥ kṛṣṇā ghṛtābhyaktāḥ kiñcidyavasamanvitāḥ || 46 ||
hotavyāḥ koṭihome tu samidhaśca palāśajāḥ ||
pūrṇe pūrṇesahasre tu dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śubhām ||
pañcame tanmukhe rājansarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 47||
pūrṇāhutyaḥ samākhyātāḥ koṭihome narādhipa ||
sahasrāṇi nṛpaśreṣṭha daśa śāstraviśāradaiḥ || 48 ||
bhāvyaṃ sayajamānaistu athavā sapurohitaiḥ || 49 ||
yajamānena rājendra savargakāmānabhīpsitā || 4.142.50 ||
|| saṃvaraṇa uvāca || ||
bahutvātkarmaṇo brahmankoṭi homaḥ suduṣkaraḥ ||
kālena mahatā caiva śakyaḥ prāptuṃ kathaṃcana || 51 ||
niyamādbrahmacaryādvā duṣkaro hīti me matiḥ ||
nirodho.atra brāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛśayyādiṣu duṣkaraḥ ||52||

etadvijñāyate brahmanyadi śāstreṣu kathyate ||
koṭihomasya saṃkṣepaṃ vada me brahma saṃbhava || 53 ||
|| sanatkumāra uvāca || ||
śatānano daśamukho dvimukhaikamukhastathā ||
caturvidho mahārāja koṭihomo vidhīyate || 54 ||
kāryasya gurutāṃ jñātvā naiva kuryādaparvaṇi ||
yathā saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomastathā śṛṇu || 55 ||
kṛtvā kuṃḍaśataṃ divyaṃ yathoktaṃ hasta saṃmitam ||
ekaikasmiṃstataḥ kuṃḍe śataṃ viprānniyojayet || 56 ||
sadyaḥ pakṣe tu viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ parikīrtitam ||
ekasthānapraṇītegnau sarvataḥ paribhāvite || 57 ||
homaṃ kuryurdvijāḥ sarve kuṇḍe kuṇḍe yathoditam ||
yathā kuṃḍabahutve.api rājasūye mahākratau || 58 ||
na ca vahnibahutvaṃ syāttatra yajñe vidhīyate ||
tathā kuṃḍaśate.apyatra ghṛtārciṣi vitānite || 59 ||
eka eva bhavedyajñaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ yatkriyate kṣipraṃ vyākulaiḥ kāryagauravāt ||
śatānanaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ || 4.142.60 ||
svalpairahobhiḥ kāryaḥ syādvarṣākālādike.api vā ||
tadā daśaguṇaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vijānatā || 61 ||
viprāṇāṃ dve śate tatra suvibhajya niyojayet ||
te.api vijñānaśīlāḥ syurvratavaṃto jitendriyāḥ || 62 ||
bhūpa kuṃḍadvayaṃ kṛtvā vibhajya ca vibhāvasum ||
homaṃ kuryurdvijā bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtya vidhipūrvakam || 63 ||
śataṃ tatra niyojyaṃ syādviprāṇāṃ pravibhajya vai ||
māse vātha dvimāse vā yathākāle hyupasthite || 64 ||
evaṃ ca dvimukhaṃ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 65 ||
yadā tu svecchayā yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ samāpayet ||
kālena bahudhā rājaṃstadā caikamukho bhavet || 66 ||
ekakuṃḍasthito vahnirekacittaiḥ samāhitaiḥ ||
yathālābha sthitairviprairjñānaśīlairvicakṣaṇaiḥ ||67||
na saṃkhyāniyamaścātra brāhmaṇānāṃ narottama ||
na kālaniyamaścaiva svecchāyajñaḥ sa ucyate || 68 ||
āvṛttyā sarvakāmasya cāturmāsyānukarmavat ||
tadaprasaktau kartavyo yajño.ayaṃ sārvakālikaḥ || 69 ||
ayamekamukho rājankālena bahunā bhavet ||
bahuvighnaśca kālena tasmātsaṃkṣepamācaret || 4.142.70 ||
yato hi cittavittādyamāyuścaivāsthiraṃ sadā ||
ataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ praśasyate || 71 ||
tataḥ samāpte yajñe tu kārayetsumahotsavam ||
śaṃkhatūryaninādena brahmaghoṣasvanena ca || 72 ||
tatastu dīkṣayedvinprānhotṛrṃśca śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
niṣkaiśca kaṃkaṇaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvividhairnṛpa || 73 ||
gośataṃ caiva dātavyamaśvānāṃ ca śataṃ tadā ||
sahasraṃ ca suvarṇasya sarveṣāmapi dāpayet || 74 ||
grāmairgajai rathairaśvaiḥ pūjayecca purohitam ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānsarvānvastrādyaiścāpi pūjayet || 79 ||
tataścāvabhṛthaṃ snāyāttairghaṭaiḥ pūrvakalpitaiḥ ||
lakṣahomoktamaṃtreṇa sadā vijayakāriṇā || 76 ||
evaṃ samāpayedyastu koṭihomamakhaṃ śubham ||
tasyārogyaṃ vittaputrarāṣṭravṛddhistathaiva ca || 77 ||
sarvapāpakṣayaścaiva jāyate nṛpasattama ||
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ caiva utpātabhayameva ca || 78 ||
durbhikṣaṃ grahapīḍā ca praśamaṃ yāti bhūtale ||
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
sanatkumāramuninā pārthivāya niveditum || 79 ||
sarvopasargaśamanaṃ bhavane vane vā ye kārayanti manujā nṛpakoṭihomam ||
bhogānavāpya manasobhimatānprakāmaṃ te yāṃti śakrasadanaṃ suviśuddhasattvāḥ || 4.142.80 || || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde koṭihoma vidhivarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 142 || || cha ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
mahāśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahādevena bhāṣitām||
pārthivānāṃ hitārthāya mahādustaratāriṇīm|| 1 ||
nṛpābhiṣeke sā kāryā yātrākāle nṛpasya tu ||
duḥsvapne durnimitte ca grahavaiguṇyasaṃbhave || || 2 ||
vidyudulkānipāte ca janmarkṣe grahadaivate ||
ketūdaye.atha saṃjāte nirghāte kṣitikampane || 3 ||
prasūtau mūlagaṇḍānte yamalasya tu saṃbhave ||
chatrāṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ ca svasthānātpatane bhuvi ||
kākolūkakapotānāṃ praveśe veśmanastathā || 4 ||
krūragrahāṇāṃ vakratve janmādiṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
janmani dvādaśe caiva caturthe vāṣṭame tathā || 5 ||
yadā syurgurumandā.a.arāḥ sūryaścaiva viśeṣataḥ ||
yuddhe grahāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sūryaśītāṃśukīlake || 6 ||
vastrāyudhagavāśveṣu maṇikeśavināśane ||
yadyagre paridṛśyeta rātrāviṃdradhanustathā || 7 ||
veśmanaśca tulābhaṃge garbheṣvaśvatarīṣu ca||
ravīndvoruparāgeṣu mahāśāṃtiḥ praśasyate || 8 ||
sarvāṇi durnimittāni praśamaṃ yānti sarvathā ||
tāṃ kuryurbrāhmaṇāḥ paṃca kulaśīlasamanvitāḥ || 9 ||
caturvedāstrivedāśca dvivedāścāpi pāṃḍava ||
ātharvaṇā viśeṣeṇa bahvṛcā yajusaṃyutāḥ || 4.143.10 ||
śucayaḥ śrutasaṃpannā japahomaparāyaṇāḥ ||
kṛcchrapārākanaktādyaiḥ kṛtakāya viśodhanāḥ || 11 ||
pūrvamārādhya maṃtraistu prārabheta kriyāṃ tataḥ ||
daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā maṃḍapaṃ kārayecchubham || 12 ||
tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryāccaturhasta pramāṇataḥ ||
āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṃḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam || 13 ||
mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyā cāpi vibhūṣitam ||
baddhacandanamālaṃ ca toraṇālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā || 14 ||
gomayenopalipte ca maṃḍape tu dvijātayaḥ ||
tataśca pañca kalaśāṃstasyāṃ vedyāṃ niyojayet ||
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu pañcamaṃ madhyatastathā || 16 ||
aṣṭāsrālaṃkṛte padme cūtapallavaśobhite ||
brahmakūrcavidhānena paṃcagavyaṃ tu kārayet || 17 ||
auṣadhīḥ pañcaratnāni rocanāṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
siddhārthakāñchamīdūrvāḥ kuśānvrīhiryavāṃstathā || 18 ||
plakṣāśvatthakapitthāṃśca priyaṃgucūtapallavān || 19 ||
hastidaṃtamṛdaṃ caiva koṇakumbheṣu nikṣipet ||
puṇyatīrthodakānnaṃ ca dhānyaṃ gavyaṃ ca madhyame || 4.143.20 ||
kūrcaṃ vācamitīdaṃ ca vahnikumbhābhimantraṇam ||
āśuḥ śiśāno mantreṇa mantraṇaṃ vāyugocare|| || 21 ||
īśāvāsyaṃ caturthasya kumbhasya cābhimaṃtraṇam ||
madhyame japitavyāstu rudrakumbhe bhavodbhavāḥ ||22|| gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvastrairnaivaidyairghṛtapācitaiḥ||
phalaiśca nārikelādyairdīpakaiḥ kuṃbhapūjanam || 23 ||
svastivācanakaṃ caiva kārayettadanaṃtaram ||
krameṇānena śanakairagnikāryaṃ prayojayet|| 24 ||
agniṃ dūtamiti hyagniṃ pūrvameva nidhāpayet ||
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samiti brahmāsananiyojanam || 25 ||
kapotasupraṇītena maṃtreṇa viniśeṣayet ||
kṛtvā cāvaraṇaṃ vahnerājyasaṃskārameva ca || 26 ||
atha cāsādayeddravyaṃ yathāvatsaprayojanam ||
tataḥ puruṣasūktena pāyasaśrapaṇaṃ bhavet || 27 ||
abhighāryātha saṃsiddhaṃ tathā saṃsthāpayedbhuvi ||
aṣṭādaśapramāṇedhmāndadyādatha śamīmayān || 28 ||
pālāśī samidhaḥ sapta tathā sapteti dāpayet ||
juhuyādāhutīḥ sapta jātavedasa ityṛcā ||
sthālīpākasya juhuyātpunarvai jātavedasā || 4.143.30 ||
taratsamaṃdī sūktena catasro juhuyāttataḥ ||
yamāyeti ca saptānyāḥ svāhāṃtā juhuyāttataḥ || 31 ||
idaṃ viṣṇustataḥ sapta juhuyādāhutīrnṛpa ||
nakṣatrebhyastataḥ svāhā saptaviṃśada thāhutīḥ || 32 ||
yatkarmaṇaiti juhuyāttataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
grahahomastataḥ kāryastilairājyapariplutaiḥ || 33 ||
prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā homakarma samāpayet ||
tatastu tūryanirghoṣaiḥ kāhalāśaṃkhaniḥsvanaiḥ || 34 ||
yajamānasya kartavyo hyabhiṣeko dvijottamaiḥ ||
kāśmaryavṛkṣasaṃbhūte bhadre bhadrāsane sthitam || 35 ||
vedimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā durnimittapraśāṃtaye ||
paṃcabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ pūrṇairmaṃtrairebhiryathākramam || 36 ||
sahasrākṣeṇa prathamaṃ tataścaiva śatā yuṣā ||
sajoṣasā ca indreti viśvānītyṛgbhireva ca || 37 ||
ṛtamastviti ca tataḥ snāpayeyuḥ samāhitāḥ ||
tato diśāṃ baliṃ dadyādvicitrānna samāyutam || 38 ||
namostu sarvabhūtebhya iti mantramudāharan ||
snātasya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paṭheyuḥ śāṃtimuttamām || 39 ||
śāṃtitoyena dhārāṃ ca pātayitvā saṃmatataḥ ||
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śāṃtikarma samāpayet || 4.143.40 ||
kṣitiṃ hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanāni ca ||
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaśca dāpayet ||
bhojanaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā tataḥ sarvaṃ prasiddhyati || 42 ||
āyuśca labhate dīrghaṃ śatrūnvijayate kṣaṇāt ||
ahiṃsakasya dāṃtasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca ||
dayādākṣiṇyayuktasya sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ|| 45||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||

sukhāsīno janastatra viśīto vijvarastathā || 6 ||
yaḥ karoti kathāḥ pārtha na tāḥ śakyā mayoditum ||
rājavārtā janavārtā yadi kaścinnijecchayā || 7 ||
vadellokaḥ sukhāsīno na kenāpi nivāryate ||
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādagnīṣṭikāṃ naraḥ || 8 ||

vimāne cārkasaṃkāśe samārūḍho mahādhane || 9 ||

vidyādānavidhivarṇanam
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
bahupradānaṃ godānaṃ tvatto vidvañchrutaṃ mayā ||
bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ vidhiścaivāvadhāritaḥ || 1 ||
sāṃprataṃ yaduśārdūla vidyādānasya yo vidhiḥ ||
tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva janārdana || 2 ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
vidyādānavidhiṃ vakṣye yāthātathyena te.adhunā ||
yathā deyaṃ phalaṃ yacca dattena kurunaṃdana || 3 ||
śubhe.ahni viprakathite gomayena suśobhanam ||
kārayenmaṃḍalaṃ divyaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ || 4 ||
puṣpaprakarasaṃchannaṃ svastikādi vibhūṣitam||
pustakaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 5 ||
sauvarṇīṃ lekhanī kāryā raupyaṃ ca maṣibhājanam ||
lekhakaṃ pūjayitvā tu āraṃbhaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ || 6 ||
vinītaścāpramattaśca tataḥ prabhṛti lekhakaḥ ||
mātrānusvārasaṃyuktaṃ padacchedasamanvitam || 7 ||
samāni samaśīrṣāṇi vartulāni dhanāni ca ||
lekhayedakṣarāṇīha tadgatenāṃtarātmanā || 8 ||
niṣpādayitvā tacchāstraṃ śaivaṃ vāpyatha vaiṣṇavam ||
niṣpādite tataḥ pūjyo lekhako vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 9 ||
saṃpūjayitvā tacchāstraṃ deyaṃ guṇavate tadā ||
śāstrasadbhāvaviduṣe vācake ca priyaṃvade || 4.174.10 ||
vastrayugmena saṃvītaṃ pustakaṃ pratipādayet ||
sāmanyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sthāpayedatha vā maṭhe || 11 ||
anena vidhinā dattvā yatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ||
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tat || 12 ||
yatpuṇyaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ yajvanāṃ tathā ||
kapilānāṃ sahasreṇa samyagdattena yatphalam ||
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pustakasya pradāyakaḥ || 14 ||
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate || 15 ||
prātarutthāya yaḥ śiṣyānadhyāpayati yatnataḥ ||
vedaśāstraṃ nṛtyagītaṃ kastena sadṛśaḥ kṛtī || 16 ||
upādhyāyasya yo vṛttiṃ dattvā.adhyāpayate janaḥ ||
kiṃ na dattaṃ bhavettena dharmakāmārthadarśinā || 17 ||
chātrāṇāṃ bhojanābhyaṃgaṃ vastraṃ bhikṣāmathāpi vā ||
dattvā prāpnoti puruṣaḥ sarvakāmānna saṃśayaḥ || 18 ||
viveko jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ dharmakāmārthasaṃpadaḥ ||
sarvaṃ tena bhaveddattaṃ chātrāṇāṃ poṣaṇe kṛte || 19 ||
śāstraṃ śastrakalāśilpaṃ yo yadicchedupārjitum ||
tasyopakārakaraṇe pārtha kāryaṃ sadā manaḥ || 4.174.20 ||
vājapeyasahasrasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalam ||
yaḥ kārayati dharmātmā sadā pustakavācanam || 22 ||
pratyahaṃ tena dattāni bhavaṃti bharatarṣabha || 23 ||
dharmādharmaṃ na jānāti vidyayā rahitaḥ pumān ||
tasmātsadaiva dharmātmā vidyādānarato bhavet || 24 ||
caturyugāni rājeṃdra ekasaptatisaṃkhyayā ||
hastyaśvarathadānāḍhyo dātā bhoktā vimatsarī || 27 ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyurnīrujo bhavet ||
putraiḥ pautre parivṛto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam || 28 ||
dānaṃ viśeṣaphaladaṃ jagatīha nānyādvidyāṃ vihāya vadanābjakṛtādhivāsām || gobhūhiraṇyagajavājirathādisarvaṃ tāṃ yacchatāṃ kimiha pārtha bhavenna dattam || 29 || || iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde vidyādānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 174 || || cha ||

suvarṇadhenuśca tathā devakāryaṃ cikīrṣubhiḥ || 34 ||
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde saṃkṣiptānukramaṇikākathanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo.adhyāyaḥ || 208 || || cha || || || iti caturthamuttaraparva || 4 ||
samāpto.ayaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇagranthaḥ |

athottaraparvasthaviṣayānukramaṇikā || 4 ||

3.94 anantavratam
śabdakalpadruma ---
araṇyavāsamuṣito yudhiṣṭhiranṛpo vaśī |
prāptastrailokyanāthena kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ||
kathopakathanaṃ jātaṃ tayostatra priyāpriyaṃ |
viśeṣeṇa ca govindaṃ papraccha ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kena vratena deveśa vāñchitaṃ prāpyate phalaṃ |
niṣpāpāḥ sakalā lokāḥ bhavanti janmajanmani ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
asti vratamanantākhyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ surasadmani |
indrādyairlokapālaiśca tanma kathayataḥ śṛṇu |
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kṛṣṇa ko.ayaṃ tvayākhyāto yo.ananta iti saṃjñitaḥ
ko.ayaṃ śeṣaśca nāgaśca anantastakṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
paramañcottamaṃ vāpi utāho brahma ucyate |
ka eṣo.anantasaṃjño vai tanme brūhi janārddana ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ananta ityahaṃ pārtha mama rūpaṃ nibodha tat |
ādityagatirūpeśa yaḥ kāla upapadyate ||
pakṣo māsa ṛturvvarṣaṃ yugakalpavyavasthayā ||

so.ahaṃ kālo.avatīrṇo.asmi bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt |
anantaṃ viddhi māṃ pārtha kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivaṃ
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ śeṣaṃ sarvvavyāpinamīśvaraṃ |
pratyayārthaṃ mayā pārtha viśvarūpaṃ nibotha tat |
pūrvameva mahābāho yogidhyeyamanuttamaṃ || ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
anantavratamāhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ vidhividāṃ vara |
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya anuṣṭhānañca tasya kiṃ ||
kena vā tatkṛtaṃ pūrvvaṃ loke kena prakāśitaṃ |
tatsarvvaṃ bahu.a vistāryya brūhi nārāyaṇa prabho ||
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
vaśiṣṭhagotrajo vidvān śīlavān vijitendriyaḥ ||
patnī tasyābhavaddīkṣā satī satyavrate sthitā |
cāritraśīlasampannā surūpā bhṛguvaṃśajā ||
tasyāḥ kālena saṃjātā duhitā sarvvalakṣaṇā |
śīlā nāmnā suśīlā sā varddhate pitṛveśmani ||
mātā tasyāstu kālena jvaradāhaprapīḍitā |
samāgatya nadītoye mṛtā svargapuraṃ yayau ||
kṛtaṃ sumantunā tasyāḥ karmma yat pāralaukikaṃ |
tataḥ sumantuḥ saṃtyajya duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ kramāt punaḥ
nāpatnīko gṛhī dharmmaṃ karttumarhati vai kvacit |
iti sañcintya manasā vivāhotsukamānasaḥ ||
devalasya muneḥ kanyāṃ karkaśāṃ pariṇītavān |
sā karkaśātiduḥśīlā sadā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇī ||
kopanā pratikūlā ca nirlajjā kalahapriyā |
adakṣā gṛhṛkṛtyeṣu dakṣā bhojanakarmmaṇi ||
kalahena tu santuṣṭā ruṣṭā bandhujanān prati |
sā tu śīlā piturgehe varddhitā ca dine dine ||
karoti sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiśukrīḍāmanuttamāṃ |
gṛhāntarasthaladvāradehalītoraṇādiṣu |
svastikaṃ padmaśaṅkhau ca maṇḍayantī punaḥ punaḥ ||
kurvvantī pratyahaṃ bālā devatātithipūjanaṃ |
gṛhakṛtye sadā dakṣā pituratyantavallabhā ||
kālena kiyatā viprastāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanodgatāṃ |
kasmai deyā mayā kanyā iti cintānvito.abhavat||

tato davavaśāttatra kauṇḍinyaḥ samupāgataḥ |
muniśreṣṭho mahābhāgaḥ kulīno dharmatatparaḥ ||
manasā cintayāmāsa sumantuḥ sutapāḥ sudhīḥ |
asmai bhāgyavaśācchīlā pratipādyā prayatnataḥ ||
iti kṛtvā matiṃ vipro dadau kanyāṃ śubhe dine |
kanyāmalaṅkṛtāṃ sādhvīṃ śīlāṃ candranibhānanāṃ ||
gṭahyoktavedavidhinā vivāhamakarottadā |
tato homādikaṃ karmma samāpya samaye muniḥ ||
sumantuḥ karkaśāṃ prāha jāmātre dehi dakṣiṇāṃ
saphalaṃ kuru me dānaṃ priye munikulodbhave |
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ karmma niṣphalaṃ jāyate yataḥ |
sumantuṃ bhartsayāmāsa karkaśairvvacanaiḥ patiṃ |
alaṅkāraṃ samānīya svakīyañcāpi bandhanaṃ ||
nikṣipya nibhṛte sthāne karkaśānyagṛhṛṃ yayau |
sumantuścātidīnātmā lajjitaścābhavattadā ||
yatkiñcidarthayogyañca dravyamānīya yautukaṃ |
jāmātre pradadau vipraḥ paricāryya punaḥ punaḥ ||
tato vivāhaṃ nirvvartya kauṇḍinyo.api nijāśramaṃ |
goyāne tāṃ samāropya śīlāmādāya vai yayau
tataḥ sā pathi gacchantī śīlā candranibhānanā
madhyāhne bhojyavelāyāṃ samuttīryya sarittaṭe ||
dadarśa śīlā nārīṇāṃ samūhaṃ vratacāriṇāṃ |
puṃsāṃ vṛndañca tatreva raktapītāmbarāsanaṃ ||
caturddaśyāmarcayantaṃ bhaktyānantaṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
dṛṣṭvā samūhaṃ nārīṇāṃ satī papraccha sādaraṃ ||
kimidaṃ kriyate kāryyaṃ bhavatībhistaducyatāṃ ||
striya ūcuḥ |
bhādre māsi site pakṣe utthite vāsavadhvaje |
natvā sarasi yaḥ snātvā anantārccanamārabhet |
ehyehi bhagavan kṛṣṇa tava yajñaḥ pravarttate ||
vāridhānyāṃ tathānantaṃ bhagavantaṃ niyojayet |
maṇḍale puṣpanevedyaṃ dhūpavastrānulepanaṃ ||
dattvā ca pūjayedbhaktyā anantaṃ viśvarūpiṇaṃ |
piṣṭakārthaṃ vrīhicūrṇaṃ yavagodhūmayośca vā ||
eteṣāṃ prāpyate yattu tadgrāhyaṃ prasthasaṃjñitaṃ |
arddhaṃ viprāya dātavyamarddhamātmani yojayet ||
śrutvā kathāṃ tatastasya kuṅkamāktaṃ suḍorakaṃ ||
caturdaśagranthiyuktaṃ nārī vāmakare nyaset |
pumāṃstu dakṣiṇe bāhau tadānantaṃ prapūjayet ||
nirvvarttya pūjāṃ devasya pūpaṃ bhuktvā yathāsukhaṃ |
visṛjya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇamya ca yathāsukhaṃ ||
śīlā śrutvā vacastāsāṃ yathā tābhirudāhṛtaṃ |
vrataṃ cakāra sā bāhau vaddhā ḍorakamuttamaṃ |
pūpaprasthañca sāṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā caiva tathaiva ca |

punarjagāma tenaiva gorathena samanvitā ||
tenānantaprasādena gṛhaṃ godhanasaṅkulaṃ |
tadāśramaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitaṃ ||
vividhātithisampūrṇaṃ nānāratnairvibhūṣitaṃ |
varāśvamattamātaṅgamahiṣairgodhanānvitaṃ ||
śīlā ca maṇikāñcībhirmuktābharaṇabhūṣitā |
divyāṅgī śīlasampannā sāvitrīpratimā yathā ||
kadācidupaviṣṭā sā vahnikuṇḍaṃ samāgatā |
kauṇḍinyo.api viśedroṣāt dṛṣṭvā ḍoramanantakaṃ |
śolāyāḥ karamūle ca baddhameva prayatnataḥ |
papraccha krodhavacasā bhṛkuṭīkuṭilaṃ mukhaṃ ||
kimidaṃ ḍorakaṃ haste baddhvā bhāryye.atra tiṣṭhasi |
prameyaḥ kasya devasya durbbuddhe brūhi satvaraṃ |5||
śīlovāca |
anantaṃ devadevasya prameyaṃ ḍorakaṃ śubhaṃ |
kare baddhaṃ vidhānena śṛṇu me vacanaṃ prabho ||
prasādād yasya devasya bhuṅkte suvipulaṃ dhanaṃ |
na jānāsi kathaṃ nātha tadevaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ ||
śīlāvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā kauṇḍinyaḥ kupito.abhavat |
ko.asāvanantasaṃjño vai na śruto.api varānane |
ityutvākṛṣya kupito bhujāḍḍoramanantakaṃ |
kṣiptaṃ jvālākule vahnau nirbhartsya bahudhā priyāṃ ||
tataḥ sā saṃbhramāt śīlā hāhā kṛtvā pradhāvitā
vahneḥ sūtraṃ samādāya kṣīramadhye tato.akṣipat ||
tatastayā kare vāme punarbaddhaṃ suḍorakaṃ |
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ||
na kaiścit varṇyate lokaiḥ so.api vipro yudhiṣṭhira |
gātre malinatā prāptā cakṣurnidrāṃ tathaiva ca ||
śūnyāni gṛharūpāṇi dagdhāni vahninā kvacit |
nirīkṣya svapuraṃ vipraścintayāmāsa cetasā ||
atha śīlā vivarṇā sā duḥkhitā patidoṣataḥ;
vicacāra purīṃ sarvvāṃ śūnyāgārasamanvitāṃ ||
atha kauṇḍinyaviprasya saṃjātā buddhiruttamā |
mamāpi duṣkṛtaṃ karmma kṛtaṃ vā me vigarhitaṃ ||
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa mamāpi gatirīdṛśī |
anantaṃ yatra paśyāmi tatra yāsyāmi durmatiḥ ||
tato jagāma kauṇḍinyo vanaṃ vyāghrādisaṅkulaṃ |
vratasyānveṣaṇaṃ karttuṃ pādau draṣṭuṃ tathā hareḥ ||
vihvalaḥ sa yayau mārge janajantuvivarjjite |
tatrāpaśyacca taṃ vṛkṣaṃ phalapuṣpasamanvitaṃ ||
varjitaṃ pakṣisaṅghātaiḥ kīṭaiścaiva viśeṣataḥ |
tamapṛcchat tvayānantaḥ kvaciddṛṣṭo mahādruma ||
sa covāca mahāvṛkṣo nānantaṃ vedmi bho dvija
tato gacchan dadarśāgre tṛṇamadhye savatsikāṃ ||
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvanto na khādati na jighrati |
he mahādhenuke brūhi kimanantastvayekṣitaḥ ||
savatsā tamuvācātha nānantaṃ vedmi he dvija |
tato gacchan dadarśāgre vṛṣaśreṣṭhaṃ vane sthitaṃ ||
tamapṛcchadayaṃ vipraḥ ananto vīkṣitastvayā |
vṛṣabhastamuvācedaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati ||
yadyanantamahaṃ jāne tadā me gatirīdṛśī |
tato vrajan dadarśāgre gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā ||

nānāmāyāpracarantaṃ madagarjjanadarpitaṃ |
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijo.arṛcchadanantaṃ dṛṣṭavān kimu |
pratyuttaramuvācedaṃ nānantaṃ vedmi he dvija |
tato vrajan dadarśāgre ramyaṃ puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ ||
anyonyajalasaṃghātairvvīcibhirupaśobhitaṃ |
śubhaiḥ kumudakahlāraiḥ kamalotpalaśobhitaṃ |
bhramaraiścakravākaiśca haṃsakāraṇḍavairyutaṃ |
tamapṛcchat dvijo.ananto bhavatībhyāñca lakṣitaḥ ||
puṣkariṇyāvūcatusta na jānīvo hariṃ kvacit |
nipapāta tato vipro hāhā kṛtvā rudan bhuvi ||
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ paśyāmi taṃ vibhuṃ |
tataḥ kṛpālu hṛdayo deveśo devapūjitaḥ ||
tatkṣaṇādbhagavān viṣṇurdvijapratyakṣamāgataḥ |
anantaṃ darśayiṣyāmi kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivaṃ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ samādāya pātālavartmanā purīṃ |
tāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa tataścāntardadhe dvijaḥ |
sa tāṃ dadarśa kauṇḍinyaḥ purīṃ trailokyadurllabhāṃ
divyanārīnarairyuktāṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitāṃ ||
suvarṇaracitāṃ sarvvāṃ veṣṭitāṃ takṣakādibhiḥ |
tatrāpaśyat sa kauṇḍinyo devadevamanantakaṃ ||
viśvarūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ caturbbāhuṃ kirīṭinaṃ |
dakṣiṇe vilasallakṣmīṃ vāme krīḍatsarasvatīṃ |
saptaphaṇāsamāyuktaṃ divyasiṃhāsanesthitaṃ |
evaṃ rūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā stutiḥ kṛtā |
jagāma bhūmau śirasā anantasya samīpataḥ ||
namo.astvanantāya sahasramūrttaye sahasrapādākṣiśirorubāhave |
sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ ||
ajñānena mayā deva yat kṛtaṃ pāpakarmaṇā |
tatsarvvaṃ kṛpayā śaṃsa kṣamasva madhusūdana || ||

atha kauṇḍinyaviprasya stutiṃ śrutvā janārddanaḥ |
prasanno bhagavāndevaścānanto.anantarūpadhṛk ||
kathaṃ me priyamākhyātamihāgaccheti bhūsura ||7 ||
ananta uvāca |
tuṣṭo.ahaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha bhaktyā tava viśeṣataḥ |
varaṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra tuṣṭo.asmi tyaja vismayaṃ ||
| kauṇḍinya uvāca |
svakarmmaphalabhogena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ vrajāmyahaṃ |
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ hṛṣīkeśa haribhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ||
tadāgaḥ kṣamyatāṃ nātha praṇamāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||
śrutvānantastu tadvākyaṃ dadau tasmai varatrayaṃ |
dāridranāśanaṃ dharmmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ tathākṣayaṃ |0||
kauṇḍinya uvāca |
pūrṇo manoratho deva mama cādya viśeṣataḥ |
kicit pṛcchāmi deveśa tanme brūhi jagatpate ||
kaścūtaḥ ko vṛṣaḥ kā gauḥ kintat puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ |
kaḥ kharaḥ kuñjaraḥ ko vā ko vā vṛddhadvijottamaḥ |
